rows.name: StackHoops
rows.short_description: A casual multiplayer basketball-like game. Play against your friends, random matchmaking, or against the computer. Customize your ball, court, and more to showoff to the world and win in style. Complete challenges and prove your skills!
rows.description_html: How To Play Make the shot and add to the Cash Pot. Copy your opponent's shot and add to the Cash Pot. Miss the shot that your opponent made and your opponent takes the Cash Pot. The first player to reach $1000 wins the game! Features FREE TO PLAY. Purchases for cosmetics only. Online Multiplayer. Single Player 1v1 and Challenges. Rewards for winning Online and completing Challenges.

rows.name: The Jeffy Game
rows.short_description: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises! Now available on Steam!
rows.description_html: Experience the adventure of a lifetime through the eyes of Jeffy. DEFEAT THE GREEN BEANS, COLLECT THE CEREAL BOXES, AND CLAIM VICTORY! Each carefully crafted level will leave you wanting more with its innovative puzzle elements and thought-provoking worlds. DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? Throughout your journey you will encounter different types of enemies and obstacles that you must overcome. SECRET LEVEL! If you collect all of the hidden cereal boxes you will unlock a secret level in which you will discover lore relating to the Kable10 universe. After you have finished the game you can also unlock Golden Jeffy which allows for even more replayability and fun!

rows.name: GraalOnline Era
rows.short_description: Era is a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of GraalOnline Era, a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path! There are a ton of unique weapons available. Melee weapons for close quarters or take out your enemies from long range with guns! Complete quests to access other items to boost your arsenal. Character customization is a staple of GraalOnline! There are thousands of hats and outfits with the option to upload your own graphics to the game, which makes the customization options endless! Player houses and gang houses offer further customization options, with stores across the map providing a wide variety of ideas and unique furniture items. Seasonal changes bring various updates, including unique themed shops, season-appropriate methods for making money, and unique changes to the map. Game Features: Create your Gangster There are infinite Free ways to customize your character when you start playing, options to upload your pixel art to create endless customization possibilities and to show off your style. House customization, with countless shops in-game that sell thousands of unique pieces of furniture to customize your house the way you want. Massive Open World PVP Battle against thousands of players in real-time on GraalOnline Era, Whether it be 1 v 1 sparring matches or 5 v 5 gang spar matches, or maybe you join your friends and play Laser Tag, defend against waves of enemies in Plasma Corp, or join in a Battle Royale! Or even take part in a Gang War with gangs of up to 25 players to claim Gang Bases or battle players across the giant map! Collect GraalOnline Era is updated regularly with various hats, weapons, items and furniture to collect! Jobs There is something for everyone to do to gain currency in GraalOnline Era. Make pizzas at Speedy Pizza, dig up shells at one of the beautiful beaches around the game, collect mushrooms and garbage across the massive map, and many more!

rows.name: Little Crab Fisher
rows.short_description: A clicker-style crab fishing game based in a fantasy world. Collect mythical crabs, travel the high seas, and upgrade your ship. A fun-filled adventure awaits!
rows.description_html: Buzz ***LITTLE CRAB FISHER WILL SOON BE FREE ON STEAM ON AUGUST 18th!*** About the Game ***LITTLE CRAB FISHER WILL SOON BE FREE ON STEAM ON AUGUST 18th!*** Welcome to Little Crab Fisher, the playful clicker adventure game that takes you on a journey through the Crustacean Sea! Step aboard and get ready to explore the vast, cartoonish world of Little Crab Fisher. Set sail on your own customizable vessel and navigate the sea, all while putting your fishing skills to the test. With unlockable islands, Little Crab Fisher offers a simple yet intriguing story that will lead you to uncover the secrets of the Crustacean Sea. Collect achievements along the way as you complete challenges and unlock new items and themes to customize your boat. But the real thrill of the game is discovering and collecting the mythical crabs that are scattered throughout the sea. With a unique mythical crab at each location, the journey to collect them all is sure to keep you hooked. Sell your catch to upgrade your boat and unlock even more features to enhance your gameplay. In addition to fishing for crabs and collecting mythical creatures, Little Crab Fisher offers even more excitement with the chance to discover pirate treasure hidden throughout the Crustacean Sea. And if that's not enough, keep an eye out for feeder storms that lure more crabs to the area. Chase them down and increase your catch! While frantically harvesting crabs can be enjoyable, keep in mind there might be something mysterious lurking in these depths. Put on your finest sailor's hat and come join the fun. Experience the exciting world of Little Crab Fisher!

rows.name: Blade Mistress
rows.short_description: Blade Mistress is a old school skilling and crafting styled game. Designed to require team work and a community of players who help each other to discover what has caused monsters to invade this world and fight as lovely ladies. Loot, kill and fight your way to the top.
rows.description_html: Blade Mistress is an old school retro styled 1990s like game where you become a lovely lady and fight your way in a magical world against creatures who threaten to destroy it. Travel to unique realms and discover the secrets of what caused this chaos. Take part of a class selection to help and aid others or to become the fighter and need support from others. Blade mistress is a online multiplayer which is designed to incourage team work and player aid to each other with little to no hand holding it is your job to find out things and what is truely happening in this world. Create your own personal dungeons with Geomancy, or join other players in their own dungeons, Become 1 of 6 classes Physical, Magaical, Creative, Beast Master, Generalist, and War Mage. Each class having a unique set of skills design to aid each other.

rows.name: Abathor - Atlantis Landing
rows.short_description: Play Abathor Atlantis Landing and relive the glory of arcades in this action platformer for up to 4 players.
rows.description_html: Atlantis is being razed! Demon hordes have burst through dimensional gates to destroy the entire continent. The last Atlantean refugees have been devoured by a sea abomination as they boarded their ships to flee the massacre. In this game excerpt, the monsters appear to be led by a mysterious enemy: cunning General Kipak. What is happening in the once mighty Atlantis? The heroes land on a dangerous beach, each with a powerful reason for being there... Relive the glory of arcades in this action platformer for up to 4 players. This game excerpt contains: 5 distinct levels of increasing difficulty (from the more than 50 stages that the complete game will have), riddled with enemies, traps and challenges. The beginning of Abathor's story. You will start to sense what is happening on the Atlantis continent and how to deal with the threat. A combat against the sea abomination that has devoured the fleeing Atlanteans. A pixel-perfect art design, beautiful and detailed, and epic musical compositions.

rows.name: Planting Trees
rows.short_description: Take on the role of a reforestation expert.
rows.description_html: Planting Trees is a unique and entertaining simulation game that allows players to explore the wonders of nature and the importance of environmental conservation. In this game, players take on the role of a reforestation expert and must plant seeds, care for animals, and maintain a good balance of the environment. With the use of buildings, including research labs to discover new plants, players can progress and build a thriving ecosystem. Enjoy the satisfaction of watching their seeds grow into mature trees and the thrill of discovering new species of plants and animals. The game offers a playful and engaging way to understand the complexities of the natural world and the challenges of environmental sustainability. Whether you're an eco-enthusiast or simply looking for a fun and educational game, Planting Trees is a must-play.

rows.name: Dragabox
rows.short_description: Use your intellect to clear a pathway to the door. Push and pull boxes out of your way, and deactivate electrical barriers. Over 200 levels of brain-busting challenges. Give it a try. See if you can complete them all!
rows.description_html: GET THESE BOXES OUT OF THE WAY! Use your intellect to navigate your way through over 200 puzzling levels. You might think you have played some games that require pushing things around, but this game requires a lot of pulling! Do you have what it takes to reach the door? You must first clear a path by moving boxes that stand in your way. There are combinations of pull boxes, push boxes, and electric barriers that need to be deactivated to create a path to success. Dragabox is an addictive game as you are drawn into apparently simple mazes only to occasionally find yourself cornered. The levels are increasingly tricky, adding different types of obstacles and problems, leading to a natural learning curve of problem-solving. This game will sharpen your intellect! This game is friendly for all ages and is great for logic training and problem-solving. Features: - 12 fun animated avatars you won't find anywhere else - 225 levels - undo last play button - reset level button - 15 original musical arrangements - step counter - stars for personal best scores Give it a try. See if you can complete all 225 challenges.

rows.name: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH
rows.short_description: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH is a game about mind-bending puzzles and unique platforming challenges, all with a dreamy atmosphere and physics-defying mechanics.
rows.description_html: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH is a direct look inside of the perplexing mind of its creator: it is a compilation which explores the past mistakes and the dubious decisions of a failed artist who let himself be consumed by his passion. In this game, you will solve a series of carefully crafted physics puzzles, exploring unique experimental mechanics, and test your skills at equally mind-bending 3D platforming challenges. Puzzle types: Top-down tile pushing: some tiles may enter areas the player cannot, and vice-versa. Some tiles can only be pushed indirectly by another, and some must be pushed directly. This gives rise to complex emergent mechanics you will be tasked with exploring and exploiting. Gravity puzzles: the player has to power to change the direction of gravity. Some objects will keep their original gravity, whereas some will mimic the player. You will need to figure out how to alter the gravity of specific tiles in order to hold others in place, all while guiding the player to the objective. Fractal puzzles: tiles cast ghost-like images around them that do not interact with physics in the way you would expect. As the puzzles near a solution, you will find the grid more and more cluttered by these images, blocking your path. You will need to guide the player to the Objective while keeping all 'buttons' pressed. Zero-G puzzles: The shortest puzzle type, where the player can freely float around in space, and solve 3D tile pushing.

rows.name: Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia
rows.short_description: Andarin Weppes is a first person puzzle experience of a man with ever advancing dementia...
rows.description_html: Step into the tangled mind of a dementia patient as he visits the house of his late grandpa, who also suffered from the ethereal embrace of dementia. Witness your perception warp, gravity surrender its grasp and the very essence of space and time tumble into a puzzling dance as your advancing dementia twists your reality into the unfamiliar. Pre-Dementia Play through 6 levels and acquaint yourself with the early stages of dementia where your illness only mildly affects your mind. You'll notice and have to overcome subtle anomalies in your environment. Explore as much of the house as you can and get familiar with the environment before your illness starts affecting you more severely. Key Features A Surreal Dwelling: Explore a once-familiar house now shrouded in the mystique of dementia. Traverse its non-Euclidean environments, where up and down lose meaning, and rooms meld in perplexing arrangements. Unravel Puzzles: Engage your mind in solving intricate puzzles scattered throughout the enigmatic abode. Each riddle holds a piece of the profound story that connects memories, dreams, and reality. Journey Through Memory: Witness the convergence of memories and delusions as you venture deeper into the shifting chambers of the mind. Experience the blurred boundaries between lucidity and illusion. Ambiguous Reality: Embrace the uncertainty. Prepare to question what is real and what is not, as the lines between reality blur. Rewind: Fear no more from mistakes of the past. Prepare your mind for a symphony of illusions and truths, and immerse yourself in a journey where the journey and the destination are an enigma. Dare to tread the paths that defy reason and embrace the boundless realm of a dementia inflicted mind. Step forth into the mysteries of Andarin Weppes:Pre-Dementia and uncover the surreal truth that awaits within.

rows.name: Cronous
rows.short_description: Cronous Online is a large MMORPG that features character growth and confrontation as its main features. Players can enhance their own strength in various ways to confront the demons of Cronous continent.
rows.description_html: Full 3D client online game Cronous Online is a fully 3D MMORPG. Supports image zooming in/out, lens rotation, and height adjustment. Players can enjoy the game in a familiar environment. Diversified career settings The game has four initial professions to choose from, namely Warrior, Assassin, Barbarian, and Magician. Any profession can be promoted by advancing to the corresponding level. There are usually two different directions for advancement, and players can choose the gameplay that suits them based on their preferences and character positioning. Mature social functions Cronous has a complete community interaction system, such as chatting, dialogue, teaming, and guilds, which gives players a stronger sense of belonging. Good social relationships will make the character's growth and exploration process more exciting. Classic battle scenes In terms of visual expression of combat and magical effects, Cronous maximizes the continuation of classic style. In addition, the game sound will also change accordingly with the character's behavior and distance. Guild Castle Battle When the guild has sufficient strength, it can choose to capture the castle. After successfully occupying, the guild will receive more taxes and produce higher-level equipment. The president can set different ranks for members, and each rank will also have different guild rights.

rows.name: 13iew
rows.short_description: A girl abandoned in the basement of a hospital for some reason. Escape the hospital avoiding the doctor who abandoned the girl in the basement! Complete the story through hidden foreshadowings and various devices throughout the map and find out why the doctor abandoned the girl in the basement.
rows.description_html: A girl abandoned in the basement of a hospital for some reason. She gets out of the basement and goes above ground, where she sees the doctor in the distance. It seems that the doctor abandoned the girl. Help the girl escape the hospital by dodging the doctor! 13iew is a spooky horror puzzle game. Play by switching between first person and side view, and solve puzzles by interacting with various objects according to the viewpoint. Our game is not a horror game. It's a spooky game. You'll have to use your brain a bit because you have to play with differentiating between objects you can interact with in first person and objects you can interact with in third person. Controls are similar to other side-view games, but with the addition of first person, it can be a little complicated, but you will soon get used to it. Explore in 1st person a space that can't be seen in 3rd person, search for clues and solve puzzles. You can feel the atmosphere of a third-person game and the atmosphere of a first-person game at the same time. There are 3 chapters, and feel the atmosphere of each chapter and find the foreshadowing all over the map. You can enjoy it by understanding why the doctor abandoned the girl in the basement as you complete the story through hidden foreshadowings and various devices throughout the map. ps. Made by a team of college students, there may be many missing parts. Thank you for your understanding.

rows.name: PANDORA
rows.short_description: Pandora is a third-person action-adventure hack n slash game that combines teleportation and combat abilities. Take on the role of Phase, a cyber-enhanced super-soldier detained by their creator, Sai-Corp. Escape the orbital testing facility and earn the freedom they stole from you long ago.
rows.description_html: You've grown tired of their experiments and constantly being used as their tool of oppression. Sai-Corp developed new weapons that'll soon phase you out. And then what? Do they throw you away? Do they keep you as an experiment? No, don't let them choose for you like they always have. It's time to stand against Sai-Corp and earn the freedom they stole from you. Pandora is a third-person action-adventure hack n slash game that combines teleportation and combat abilities. Take on the role of Phase, a cyber-enhanced super-soldier detained by their creator, Sai-Corp. Escape the orbital testing facility and earn the freedom they stole from you long ago. Fluid Movement: Use Phase’s training and cyber-teleportation abilities to experience an engaging move set. A merge of basic and complex movement abilities that give you options when avoiding attacks from enemies or when traversing the broken facility. Advanced Combat: Building on the fluid movement, the game gives Phase his favorite weapons, a katana, and his teleportation dagger. Combine Phase’s move set with his sword-slashing abilities to defeat anyone trying to stop you. Enticing Environment: Utilize the different abilities while traversing the destroyed Sai-Corp Orbital Testing Facility and discover the environment that imprisoned Phase for so long. development Team: Ben Dookram - Sound Designer Hamzah Kashmiri - Programmer Kevin Kulendran - UX/UI Designer Hayder Mahamood - 3D Artist/Co-Manager John Muia - Project Manager Thomas Soares - Level Designer Music Team: Anthony Kubelka - Composer Jake Robertson - SFX Artist Harris the First - Voice Coordinator Yiyang Zhou - Music Coordinator VA Team: Atlin Hofer - Voice of Phase / Co-Scriptwriter

rows.name: POOSTALL Royale
rows.short_description: APRIL FOOLS 2023ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ Don't let the title fool you, this isn't a battle royale game. Maybe this isn't even a game at all... well, just download now and figure it out!
rows.description_html: APRIL FOOLS 2023 That's right, this was all part of an elaborate April Fools joke. But what exactly is real and what isn't? Quite simply, the game is real, the people who worked in it are real and all the plans to continue improving the game are real too! While this game was never meant to be taken too seriously, the people behind the 'C Team of RWS' are passionate and are willing to continuing polishing this game. All the new updates will be FREE! _____________ So you got to this Steam page and you're wondering what in the blue hell you're seeing right in front of you. It's hard to explain really, one month in the making and the C team of RWS crapped out this absolute masterpiece that is available for you to download right now! We can't believe we're not charging you for this masterpiece! It's almost like that game... Hatred! Shoot your way through multiple waves of braindead NPCs who are literally only programmed to run towards you while yelling random things recorded from a bathroom stall with a cheap USB microphone. Compare your highscore with your friends, if you have any. Enjoy the beautiful assets that we've bought and didn't even bother to make ourselves! We've gone WOKE! For the first time ever, you get to play as a female POSTAL Dude, complete with voice lines and everything. The Pigeon Mission Many years in the making, and it's finally here... the super ultra cool PIGEON MISSION is finally a reality! Feed pigeons as fast as you can and... well... that's it really. Wait, you expected to be able to kill them? we've gone woke, remember? In case you haven't realised by now This is an April Fools joke...

rows.name: Kingsblade: King's Keep Prologue
rows.short_description: The Kingsblade has been called, and you've answered! Leap across peril! Deal with dastardly rats! Break the bones of cowardly skeletons! Save the Princess in this Hack 'n Slash platformer!
rows.description_html: Kingsblade: Next-Gen Escape's mobile hack 'n slash platformer! Leap across peril! Deal with dastardly rats! Break the bones of skeletons! Save the Princess! (This indirect prologue to Next-Gen Escape's King's Keep Escape Room is spoilers-free and adds to the story behind the escape room. It is not necessary to play King's Keep to enjoy this game.) In Kingsblade, players take on the titular role and try to save Princess Ariana from the foul dungeon beneath the capital city. You'll encounter vicious rats, and toiling skeleton guards as you venture further in the dungeon... And find a most dangerous foe in the bottom chamber... Jump over danger and slash at your foes! You are the Kingsblade!

rows.name: Fantasy Quest Prologue
rows.short_description: Protect cute anime girls. Shoot monsters. Simple.
rows.description_html: An absolutely cute funny game about you saving cute anime girls from monsters. Fight your way through cute monsters. Collect fantasy-based powerups and blast through your enemies. Collect keys to unlock new areas on the map. Have a blast traversing through the stylized bright beautiful arena The world of Aria is being attacked by monsters, The elves constructed a summoning circle to summon an other world wanderer to save them from the monster horde. You are entrusted with the magic staff of the elves that is created from the branch of the ancient tree in their homeland. Gameplay: classic fps mechanism number 1 : magic bullet number 2 : burst razor leaf number 3 : lightning bolt number 4 : fireball This is an Anime themed Arena Shooter game with the classic arena-style weapon system with a fantasy twist. Features fantasy-based weapon system.

rows.name: Kemono Friends Opening Day
rows.short_description: A fan visual novel where you join Nana at Japari Park as new caretaker. Fun and food await in adventures with an energetic serval cat and an always hungry fox!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Japari Park! After passing a month-long training program, you’ve finally become a Caretaker at the world-renowned Japari Park ! You’ve learned all about taking care of Friends , animals who have turned into animal girls, and their mysterious home, Japari Park, a massive archipelago where every type of natural environment in the world can be found. But you didn’t come halfway around the world without a reason. You’ve been invited to work at the park by Nana , a Caretaker responsible for two particularly troublesome Friends. Nana needs your help to manage a Serval cat with loads of energy and an Ezo Red Fox with no respect for the rules. If she can’t find someone who can handle them, Nana won’t be able to start teaching part-time at the Learning Center. Meet the Friends of Japari Park! As a Japari Park Caretaker, your responsibilities don’t end with Serval and Ezo Red Fox! You’ll meet many more cute and misbehaved girls who will need your guidance in order to live happy, healthful lives in the park. How you choose to handle their troubles and trauma will lead to either good or bad outcomes for these girls, and the fate of everyone may even depend on it! Kemono Friends Opening Day is a Kemono Friends fan project visual novel where you make friends with Friends and do your best to guide them to a good ending, no matter how difficult things become. Chapter 3 Available Now! Play the all new 3rd chapter ! Enjoy the biggest mall in Japari Park with Serval and Ezo Red Fox, meet new Friends like Humboldt Penguin and Royal Penguin, learn more about Anubis and Cerberus, see the girls dress up in cute outfits, and help Hululu overcome her past trauma. Thanks once again to all our hard working team members for their work bringing chapter 3 to life! We look forward to delivering the next chapter of the game when it is ready.

rows.name: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency
rows.short_description: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate exciting horror cases. Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation.
rows.description_html: Join the fun in this brand new Early Access Multiplayer Horror Game! WELCOME TO THE H.I.A: HORROR INVESTIGATION AGENCY The H.I.A. is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate horror cases . Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation. Get the evidence you need and return to the H.I.A. headquarters safe and sound. FEATURES 1-6 player online co-op Play through fun horror missions together with your friends or with random teammates. Explore unique missions with each their own story and challenges. Have you and your friends got what it takes to complete them? Welcome new employee! As an H.I.A. employee it is your task to help horrified customers in need. Manager Dominic is always on the phone with new customers which you can help. Head over to Ricky, select a case, and finish the job. Casual Apart from solving horror cases, the H.I.A. is also a great place to have casual fun with friends. Hangout, spend time, make yourself look cool, and don't poop your pants when the monster gets you! SOCIALIZE Besides the H.I.A. being a horror game, the H.I.A. is also a place to socialize and have fun with others. Make use of chat, chat emotes, gestures and physical emotes to express yourself and communicate with friends and fellow players. APPEARANCE Customize your character appearance and express yourself with a variety of clothing & cosmetic options. Hats, outfits, backpacks and more customization options on its way. GADGETS The H.I.A. has a fun and intuitive tool system . Interact with tools around the world, each having their own unique functionality. Pick them up and store them in you tool slots. SOLVE CASES Decide which mission you and your friends will be playing by selecting cases in the lobby. Once you and your friend have decided on which case to solve, jump in the car and head to the mission. NPC INTERACTIONS Interact with lively NPCs . Some tell you some stories, other ask you for help, and who knows, some might even jumpscare you! THINGS YOU CAN DO IN H.I.A. Play missions Fun multiplayer with up to 6 players Replayability Socialize with friends or strangers Customize your character Talk with NPCs Equippable tools Horror chasing AI Jumscares Chat & Voicechat Emotes & Gestures Puzzles Find/Collect objects Objectives Arcade Gamemodes (Coming Soon) And plenty more features added every week! What you can also expect in H.I.A: Jumping across obstacles, Fun(ny) horror stories, Different types of Equipment, Socializing, Multiple unique Monsters and Cases to solve, A mighty fun time.

rows.name: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories
rows.short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories' is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are a henchman who has to make his way through variety of puzzles to make it to a job interview on time. Can you solve all of the puzzles that stand in the way of your employment?
rows.description_html: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are looking to get hired by an international criminal organisation. Unfortunately for you, the job interview is being held in a very inconvenient location, and you must make your way through an old sewer system to get there. To make it in time, you must make good use of your wits to overcome the challenges that await you in the sewers. Solve Puzzles Wide variety of simple and fun puzzles, that are sure to make you laugh, or at least to make your friends laugh at you. Explore and Discover You will get to enjoy exploring a dirty sewer system, as you try to make it to the job interview. There are plenty of hidden collectibles and safety violations for you to find as you make your way through the sewer. Work Together Play solo, or distract your friends in up to 5-player multiplayer.

rows.name: PUNCHERMAN!: First Day
rows.short_description: PUNCHERMAN!: First Day is a first-person comedy physics dad simulator where you play as a retired FPS hero/generally manly man trying to become the best dad ever. One problem: the only way he can interact with the world is with an incredible punch. Use your fists of fury to prove your heart of gold!
rows.description_html: PUNCHING IS ALL YOU KNOW. YOU'VE PUNCHED ALIENS, DEMONS, ZOMBIES—BUT WITH THESE THREATS GONE, YOU FACE YOUR GREATEST CHALLENGE YET: FAMILY LIFE. PUNCHERMAN! : First Day is a comedy physics dad simulator where you live a day in the life of a former violent FPS protagonist/superhero/generally manly man as he tries to prove himself as a good father and husband. But there’s one problem with that: the only real ability he has is an insanely powerful PUNCH! Engage in the most masculine of stay-at-home-daddery by completing household chores and running errands using only your fists of fury… and accidentally destroy everything you see in the process. FEATURES AND CONTENT! A short vertical slice of the concept: about 20 minutes of chaotic punching fun! A to-do list of 10+ basic chores and errands to punch your way through Four distinct maps filled with physics objects that break or get launched on being punched 3D first-person punching with both hands Optional timer display for speedrunning

rows.name: Aphotic Descent
rows.short_description: In Aphotic Descent, you play as a diver whose submarine crashed at the bottom of the ocean. With no other option for survival, you must make your way to a nearby underwater research facility facing terrifying creatures, all while descending deeper and deeper...
rows.description_html: A mobile research facility exists deep down in the ocean where scientists from all over the world study the ecology of creatures ranging from the euphotic zone down to the aphotic zone to carve the path open to deep sea exploration and understanding. After not hearing from the facility for months, a rescue team is sent by submarine to investigate. When the team finds a lead, the submarine is hit by a sudden force. A lone diver manages to escape through a bathysphere and crashes down onto the sea floor... Explore the Depths Descend into the ocean, where you’ll journey through various zones, from the sunlit surface zone to the twilight zone and finally the aphotic zone where monstrosities of the deep exist. Prey vs Predator Encounter a diverse range of creatures, where every encounter presents a unique challenge that requires you to adapt your skills and equipment in order to survive in tense environments. Revelations from Within Your only company are the scattered documents found throughout revealing the true nature of the world engulfing you. Gather information about the horrific experiments conducted and creatures lurking in the dark watching your every move. Suit Up Equipped with a powerful flashlight and your trusty diving knife, you’ll illuminate the dark waters around you, while using the blacklight feature to reveal hidden clues and solve puzzles, and defend yourself against aggressive predators and destroy key objects to complete encounters. NOTE: Aphotic Descent was developed by a team of students, and we greatly appreciate any feedback you may have!

rows.name: Embervale
rows.short_description: Welcome to Embervale, the ultimate idle fantasy RPG on Twitch and Steam! Dive into a magical world, strive to be the strongest player, and uncover unique treasures. Thrive in Adventures, where your strategic decisions with streamers and viewers determine your success and lead to victory!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Embervale, the ultimate idle fantasy RPG on Twitch and Steam! Dive into a magical world, strive to be the strongest player, and uncover unique treasures. Thrive in Adventures, where your strategic decisions with streamers and viewers determine your success and lead to victory! Embark on thrilling adventures alongside your favorite streamers and experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat! This mode is designed to enhance the interactive experience for streamers and their communities! No matter where you play, any unlocked achievements will automatically appear on your Steam profile. This seamless integration ensures your accomplishments are always up-to-date and ready to show off!

rows.name: Color Summoners
rows.short_description: Color Summoner' is a card game in which players play cards simultaneously on the same turn. Defeat your opponents by reading their actions!
rows.description_html: Outwit your opponent and reduce their life points to zero! Simultaneous Turn-Based Gameplay Instead of taking turns, both players declare and resolve actions simultaneously. This means you must constantly anticipate your opponent's moves and make strategic decisions on the fly. Simple Cards, Powerful Combos Each card has a simple yet powerful effect, leading to a wide variety of combo possibilities. Discover and master devastating combos to outplay your opponent. No Rare Cards, No P2W Forget about common cards being inferior to rare ones! This game has no rarity system. Every card is carefully balanced, and victory depends on your ability to read your opponent and build powerful combos. Free to Play We want everyone to enjoy this game, so it's completely free to play. Play with Friends or Strangers Use the matchmaking system to find online opponents or create custom matches to play with friends. Join the Community Join our Discord server to find opponents, make friends, and discuss the game. Respect This game is a modified reproduction of a Flash card game called 'Card Commander' which is no longer available. I am not affiliated with the original creator of Card Commander, 'hozo', but I would like to express my gratitude for his work.

rows.name: Revenge of the shadow ninja
rows.short_description: Platform game with a gloomy artistic style. Challenging levels with many traps and enemies. Use all your skills to avoid dangerous traps. Destroy all opponents on your way to revenge.
rows.description_html: Revenge of the shadow ninja is a platform game with a gloomy artistic style, you will play the role of a samurai named Shimazu. Shimazu's son is kidnapped and his wife is killed by Takeda with the help of a demon named Fudo. For the past 10 years, Takeda has been sealed away by Shimazu, it is Shimazu's duty to take revenge and try to save his son. Use all your skills to avoid dangerous traps. Destroy all opponents on your way to revenge. Progress through levels by destroying your enemies with dashes and shurikens. Avoid deadly traps, collect gold and upgrade your skills.

rows.name: The Artist
rows.short_description: Do you feel good where you are? Some people do, some don't even if they have everything in the world. Does love fix that sort of feeling, even if such feelings feel so hard to grasp and such love could be toxic to yourself? What is a loving muse to the artist who paints them?
rows.description_html: Step into the shoes of a successful lawyer in ‘The Artist’ , a gripping and dramatic visual novel that puts story and character above all. Experience a mix of humour, romance, and drama as you navigate your relationship with Ava. With multiple possible endings depending on the choices you make, ‘The Artist’ takes you on an emotional and thrilling journey through the depths of love and trust. After a run of bad luck on the dating scene, and having seemingly explored every avenue available to you, you unexpectedly meet a woman named Ava who captures your heart and attention. You find yourself falling into a deepening relationship that is hard to get a grasp of. Ava is an utterly mysterious muse that brings curiosity and so many feelings out of you that make you second guess yourself endlessly. She is the kind of woman that will make you question everything you know about relationships. Will you stay by Ava's side, even as the evidence against her mounts? Or will you cut ties and move on with your life? The Artist is currently in Early Access, and the first act of the story is available to play for free. The current version features: - Over 1,200 static renders - Over 26,000 words of dialogue - 12 Animated Scenes - Jam-packed with Meaningful Interactions - 10 Achievements to Unlock - In-game Gallery There are three major updates planned for The Artist , and these will be delivered in the form of 'Acts'. - Act One is available for free to give you a chance to play the game, get a feel for the story and characters, and ultimately not waste your time and money. - Act Two will continue where we left off, and will be around the same length as Act One - Act Three will be the final release of The Artist , and will see the end of the story. - We will be releasing bonus content in the form of DLC that go directly towards the production of The Artist and all future stories we choose to tell.

rows.name: The Last Veggies
rows.short_description: The Last Veggies is a 2d top-down shooter roguelite where you play as a farmer or his friends fighting hordes of monsters while trying to save humanity by delivering fresh veggies. Play different maps with different characters and an always changing set of Items and Upgrades.
rows.description_html: The Story A giant meteor full of weird looking creatures has crashed on our planet. Those monsters overran our cities and ate all our food before we were even ready to defend ourselves. The survivors have set up giant safezones that are monster free but they are running out of food. Carl and his friends, a special team of veggie loving monster killers have been sent to the farmlands, the last green spot on earth to look for a new food source. Grow veggies, deliver them to the safezones and fight of those evil creatures as long as you can! The Game In the Last Veggies it is all about Veggies and Monsters. Plant veggies, deliver them to make some money or defend them at all costs. Use your income to buy random items and upgrades for yourself, your weapons or your farm! Fight waves of monsters and defeat even more powerful bosses! Collect golden carrots by defeating enemies to unlock new playable characters, maps or even gamemodes! Veggie Delivery An Endless gamemode with Veggies, Monsters, Raiders, evil Bosses and even Lootatos for the right amount of fun! Here you have to plant, defend and deliver your veggies to make a living and to secure the survival of humanity. Delivering veggies will provide you with some cash to buy upgrades for yourself or your farm! watch out for Raiders that attack your farm and prepare yourself for insanely powerful bosses! Survive as long as you can! The Last Veggies You are slowly running out of seeds to plant veggies and there are not that many left... Defend the Last Veggies until help arrives! In this gamemode you will have to defend veggies to the last Wave. You will gain some money for each surviving veggies that you can use for upgrades and items to make surviving a little easier. There are no Bosses or Raiders here but that doesn't mean that this gamemode is easier! Seed Savers Oh no! Now we are running out of Seeds! Travel to secret location where humanity has stored the last of the seeds to make sure that there are always enough veggies. get those seeds to your vehicle and leave before you are overrun! This mode includes evil bosses, new creatures and tons of seeds! A wide Selection of Characters Carl has a lot of friends out in the Farmlands and you can play each one of them. Every Character comes with a unique set of skills and each character carries a different weapon that will change your playstyle completely! Choose your difficulty Each Map and GameMode can be played in 3 different difficulty levels. If those 3 difficulties are still not enough for you there are events that can be switched on or off to make the game even harder! But the higher the difficulty the higher the chance to fond rare golden carrots!

rows.name: Curse of the Corsair
rows.short_description: Echoes of a swashbuckling and treacherous past reverberate through a vast and untamed sea, brimming with riches and danger. In this action-packed adventure RPG, you'll set sail on a journey inspired by the modern classic Hyper Light Drifter, but with a salty, scurvy twist.
rows.description_html: Echoes of a swashbuckling and treacherous past reverberate through a vast and untamed sea, brimming with riches and danger. In this action-packed adventure RPG, you'll set sail on a journey inspired by the modern classic Hyper Light Drifter, but with a salty, scurvy twist. As a pirate in search of lost treasures and hidden knowledge, you'll explore a world full of danger and wonder. But beware: your character is plagued by a debilitating curse, driving you ever deeper into the mysterious depths of the ocean in search of a cure for the curse of the Corsair. • With everything from characters to environments rendered in lovingly hand-drawn animations, you'll be fully immersed in a vibrant and dangerous pirate world. • Slice and dice by getting up close and personal with melee combat or engage from afar with ranged weapons, it's up to you! • The challenges you'll face are daunting and plentiful; enemies are ruthless, the environment can be unforgiving, and true allies are few and far between. • Discover new weapons, learn unique skills, and uncover valuable equipment as you navigate through a detailed and branching world full of secrets and hidden paths. Set sail for adventure and discover the untold riches and ancient secrets that await you in this epic pirate RPG!

rows.short_description: Here, you will start from scratch and meet like-minded comrades. With wisdom and courage, you set out on a journey to conquer and unite the lands. Use the Strategy system and deploy Frontline, Center, and Rearguard units to fight your opponents in small-scale skirmishes.
rows.description_html: A Three Kingdoms war strategy game Genre: SLG Art Style: 2D Release: Global Languages: Multiple The whole map has a total of 165 Cities, restoring the atmosphere of the Three Kingdoms with the real geographical relationship Resource bonuses can be obtained by capturing the City, which means the City is the treasury. Resource points and wild monster points outside the City exist in the sandbox Restore the ancient battle between the front, middle, and rear armies, which requires cavalry, infantry, and archer respectively. The battle process is that the troops of both sides are closing. Then, the front, middle and rear troops attack in order in each round. Finally, the side that completely destroys the opponent wins. Easy to play for the famous characters, which means it does not need extra education costs Each character has unique skills and his skills generated from the history of the Three Kingdoms Players' pursuit of various popular weapons, famous steeds, and treasures are truly restored and presented in the game. Also, the equipment of the characters can be freely weared

rows.name: Space Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Welcome to cosmic chaos. This non-stop action arcade will test you to see if you are truly worthy of space travel. The full use of 3d space, five classes of weapons, and upgrades based on alien technology and alternative dimensions make for the most competitive and mind-expanding game out there.
rows.description_html: Welcome to cosmic chaos. This non-stop action arcade game will test your skill to see if you are truly worthy of space travel. Inside are five classes of weapons, unique maps with multiverse portals and upgrades based on alien technology. Everything to build the ultimate fighting machine — and dominate the arena. Are you ready space pilots? Fight your way to the final showdown inside the mysterious Cube, unleashing havoc and leaving behind only the debris of your rivals. Oh, you're the one left among the wreckage? Upgrade your attributes and modify the ship – and get back into the carnage! Play strategically, placing mines and moving between cover – or go guns blazing shooting lasers and rockets all around! Space Battle Royale welcomes all playstyles. But keep an eye out — your rivals aren’t so welcoming. Features: Battle Royale. In space. The game scales up the familiar fun of the genre to new, orbital-level heights. Survival of the fittest. Master five weapon types, AI drones, and a complex system of upgrades to defeat your opponents. Everyone can be a pilot. Zero-G navigation and shooting mechanics are finely tuned to be approachable for beginners and rewarding for advanced players. It’s easy to start flying but it can take a lifetime to master. The future of space tourism. Explore and master our starting battlefields, alien artifacts, multiverse portals and asteroid belts. NOTE: The safety of space tourists is absolutely not guaranteed. The team behind this game is a group of mathematicians and physicists specialised in alternative dimensions So watch out, you never know where you might end up!

rows.name: Michi
rows.short_description: Michi: a unique blend of Slay the Spire, Teamfight Tactics & Super Auto Pets. Build your Aibo team, climb a 20-floor tower, evolve creatures, and battle rivals. Face the ultimate boss & claim victory!
rows.description_html: Introducing Michi, an engaging and innovative game that blends the strategic deck-building elements of Slay the Spire, the intense auto-battling of Teamfight Tactics, and the adorable charm of Super Auto Pets. Assemble your ultimate Aibo team, draft powerful cards, and guide them through fierce battles against other Aibos in a thrilling journey to conquer the towering challenge that lies ahead. Venture through 20 captivating floors, each presenting a unique challenge as you choose from easy, medium, or hard encounters, all leading to the ultimate showdown against a formidable boss. Along the way, combine your Aibos to evolve them into mightier forms, and collect valuable artifacts to bolster your team's prowess in future battles. Features: - Draft and build your Aibo deck , selecting from a diverse array of creatures with distinct abilities and synergies. - Engage in exhilarating auto-battles against other Aibos , strategically placing your team members to achieve victory. - Choose your path through a multi-tiered tower , with each door offering varying levels of difficulty and rewards. - Evolve your Aibos by combining them , unlocking their full potential as they grow in power and complexity. - Collect and equip artifacts discovered throughout your journey , enhancing your team's capabilities for future battles. rows.name: Chrono Crystal
rows.short_description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the mysterious continent of Falantero! We have been waiting for you for a long time. As the power of darkness invades, the evil and greedy monsters and evil people start to move. The demon king who brought great calamity a thousand years ago is about to awaken again. He will break the seal and lead his army to sack everything ...... The armies are waiting for your command! Before the Chrono Crystal unleashes its powerful ability, you need to freely plan tactics within the countdown and use uniquely stylized defense towers to defeat the enemies attempting to destroy the Chrono Crystal, until the very last moment. You will travel with the human prince through several distinctive regions and meet with regional leaders to find ways to cooperate. The various heroes you meet along the way will bring their unique talents to bear. Ultimately, you will work together to defeat the Demon King and find the truth behind this terrifying conspiracy. Features - Classic style strategic tower defense. - Battle in many special areas such as forest, kingdom, sacred tree, mine, snow realm and volcano. - 18 towers with different abilities and unique skill effects. - 90+ different enemies. - 6 heroes with unique skills that can move freely around the field. - Many challenging main levels. - 2 additional challenging difficulty modes are available: HARD and HELL. - 60+ unlockable steam achievements. Contact us We are always happy to receive feedback and comments from our players! Whether you want to leave feedback or report bugs, please keep in touch with us through our email address: service@my51share.com

rows.name: Home Designer Makeover Blast
rows.short_description: Join Hazel on her journey as she transforms drab houses into modern and space-saving homes. Solve challenging blast puzzles and choose the best design that meets her clients' requests. Unleash your creativity and let the designing begin!
rows.description_html: Design from scratch Design from scratch and use a blueprint to match all of your clients’ desires. Create beautiful living rooms, bedrooms and kitchens according to their requests and watch as they ooh and aah over your work! Play blast levels Keep your mind active and exercise it by playing blast levels. Not only can you have fun, but also win coins for house decorations and progress through the game. Choose the fitting furniture When it comes to selecting furniture for your clients’ home, take the time to explore multiple designs and see which fits best with their style. With the ability to compare three different designs side-by-side you can make sure that the furniture you choose is exactly what you envisioned. Follow the story When creating designs, it's important to pay attention to your clients' stories. For example, Luke wants something comfortable and easy going. For Ben and Debbie, they're looking to create a cozy family nest. Anna's aim is to make her place inviting for her friends - she's a singer, songwriter, model, and playwright!

Customize every corner of their mansion with unique furniture and decorations, and watch as the beavers enjoy their new home. rows.name: Mystery Society 2: Hidden Puzzles
rows.short_description: Dive into a hidden object adventure with unique tasks, puzzles, and a riveting story. Join elite detectives in a secret organization, uncover hidden treasures, and solve crimes across the globe.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of this hidden object adventure, where you'll explore a variety of locations with unique tasks that will challenge your detective skills. Classic hidden object scenes with named items, shadow silhouettes, and thrilling 'find the difference' puzzles are just the beginning. You'll be drawn into the heart of the mystery as you navigate through a collection of diverse and intriguing scenarios that will put your observation skills to the test. But the excitement doesn't stop there! This game also features engaging puzzles that add another layer of entertainment to your crime-solving adventure. Exercise your strategic thinking and quick reflexes as you clear the board of colorful jewels, uncovering precious artifacts and unlocking hidden secrets along the way. With each successful match, you'll be one step closer to uncovering the truth behind the criminal underworld. Join the ranks of the elite detectives in a secret organization, and embark on a riveting story of adventure and intrigue. You'll be tasked with finding unique treasures and collections, and as you do, you'll uncover the enigmatic tale of a secret society that operates in the shadows. Travel across three continents, from the bustling streets of New York to the exotic landscapes of Asia, uncovering hidden gems and solving crimes that have stumped the world's finest detectives. As you dive deeper into the game, you'll collect unique artifacts and objects, forming stunning collections that reveal the rich history and secrets of the secret organization. With each new discovery, you'll gain valuable rewards and unlock powerful tools to aid you in your quest. Share your progress with friends, trade items, and join forces to uncover the hidden truth that lies beneath the surface. With a vast array of hidden object scenes, puzzles, and a captivating story, this hidden object adventure is the ultimate game for both new and experienced players alike.

rows.name: Bearskull
rows.short_description: Fight with your friend 'Skull' in this top down dungeon adventure - will you be able to stop Sorkin?
rows.description_html: Can you manage, Sorkin, to finally destroy the evil pumpkin wizard and defeat all his undead followers? So far, no living being has succeeded, but are you perhaps something special? A unique hero with extraordinary abilities? But to get to Sorkin in the first place, you have to go through the Land of the Dead. The dead, who have already stopped numerous ones before you from reaching Sorkin. Fight your way through the different levels and get closer to Sorkin over and over again. Roam through the Overworld and try to leave all the undead behind. But it's not that easy because the undead also learn and become stronger. To keep up with them, you have to collect their souls and then use them in the shop to upgrade your equipment, such as your sword or backpack, and always maintain the upper hand in the fight against Sorkin and his followers.

rows.name: Bingo Pinball Gameroom
rows.short_description: A collection of 80 Bingo Pinball simulations. Discover why people became addicted to these mysterious machines in the past. 'For amusement only', but used for gambling nevertheless. Too dangerous, so eventually banned in many states. Start right away: Bally Show Time is included, free to use!
rows.description_html: Bingo Pinball Gameroom is a collection of 80 extremely realistic Bingo Pinball simulations, amusement machines that were very popular in the 50s to mid 70s. Although officially 'for amusement only', used for gambling nevertheless. Eventually banned in many states all over the world. They proved to be too addictive, too dangerous. Those who know Bingo Pinballs – maybe even had the chance to play them – will appreciate the realistic gameplay. Those who don't know them may be surprized: at first glance it looks just a kind of flipper pinball. But they will soon realize that to score the highest wins, hard decisions have to be made with many possible strategies to follow. No, there's no money involved in the simulations, but can prove to be very addictive still. And no, they have nothing to do with that other bingo game, often played in senior homes... Look and feel of original Bingo Pinball machines All sounds sampled from real Bally and United Bingos Large, crisp graphics Built-in support for multi-screen Virtual Cabinets (using PinballX, Pinup Popper or any other frontend software) Interface to connect to a real Bingo Cabinet Available for Windows and Apple OSX Bally Show Time included, free to play

Design and build your colony towards fame and fortune in a deeply-simulated fantasy world. Chill out in peaceful mode with a bustling settlement, or fight for survival against monsters and invasions!
rows.description_html: Mountaincore is a game of designing and building a burgeoning colony in a deeply-simulated fantasy world. Current Features Start with 7 dwarves but you can build and support a population of hundreds A simulated world with changing weather and seasons that have a big impact on gameplay Every one of your settlers has their own needs and desires to fulfil as they work together for the common good A deep crafting tree that leaves no natural resource unused, tied together into satisfying production chains Progress through skill tiers to craft better tools and weapons Trade with merchants to increase your wealth even further Form up and train your military to battle monsters and invaders... ...or play in Peaceful Mode to chill out with a relaxing city-builder experience Twitch integration (using viewer names for settlers) to encourage stream audience interaction Built 'Mod-first' so that everything is moddable Now released as open source As the developer for this game has shut down, we've decided to release it as free to play and also open source under a very permissive license. Current Features Start with 7 dwarves but you can build and support a population of hundreds A simulated world with changing weather and seasons that have a big impact on gameplay Every one of your settlers has their own needs and desires to fulfil as they work together for the common good A deep crafting tree that leaves no natural resource unused, tied together into satisfying production chains Progress through skill tiers to craft better tools and weapons Trade with merchants to increase your wealth even further Form up and train your military to battle monsters and invaders... ...or play in Peaceful Mode to chill out with a relaxing city-builder experience Twitch integration (using viewer names for settlers) to encourage stream audience interaction Built 'Mod-first' so that everything is moddable Now released as open source As the developer for this game has shut down, we've decided to release it as free to play and also open source under a very permissive license. rows.name: That Potato Game
rows.short_description: Explore life as a potato and roll your way through the cozy, mystical home of Hilbert. Complete puzzles, gain abilities, and find hidden secrets within!
rows.description_html: Take on the form of a blundering spud in That Potato Game, a physics-based puzzle adventure! Roll through the mystical home of the questionable and eccentric alchemist, Hilbert, and gain new abilities by exploring the rooms around you. Solve puzzles to unlock new rooms and discover hidden secrets and stories left behind by Hilbert as you make your way closer to the big finale of your journey, an ascent into the great beyond of space. BECOME A POTATO Potatoes are round, potatoes can roll. Now, so can you! EXPLORE ECCENTRIC ROOMS Traverse through Hilbert’s kitchen and observatory and find hidden secrets within as you roll around every nook and cranny.. UNLOCK SPUD-SATIONAL ABILITIES As you explore and interact with items in Hilbert’s house, unlock abilities that will take your tuber form to tubular levels. MEET FASCINATING CHARACTERS Meet Ashbel, a ravenous flame, and Anastasia, a gracious doll, who will help you throughout your journey in discovering Hilbert’s house.

rows.short_description: Эта игра представляет собой шутер на арене, где у вас есть оружие, и вы должны отбиваться от полчищ врагов.
rows.description_html: Börd killer is a game about killing börds. Equipped with only a shotgun, you must defeat hordes of these creatures. The game contains 6 levels and some upgrades to kill börds to your hearts content!

rows.name: Fitting-In
rows.short_description: Fitting-In is a single player puzzle game where you perform movement combos to jump over, through, and inside obstacles! There are walls, pause blocks, break blocks, and move blocks that all require creativity to overcome!
rows.description_html: As you work through a level, your past moves are stored in a move history. When you move in the pattern “direction, direction, opposite direction, direction” (for example up, up, down, up) you perform a happy jump which flings you three places instead of one. Things start to heat up when different blocks get introduced that serve as both obstacles and advantages. Walls are the simplest block. You can’t walk through them and have to happy jump over them. Pause blocks are tricky buggers. You can walk inside of them, but the move you make into them is not counted in your move history. The move you make out of the block is counted! Break blocks are the opposite. You can’t walk inside a break block, but running into it will add to the move history even though your player stays in exactly the same spot. Move blocks can be pushed around to clear a path or used in tandem with break blocks to make some crazy moves possible. There are currently 39 levels! I hope you have as much fun playing them as I have had making them.

rows.name: Duels of Fortune
rows.short_description: A crazy, explosive fighting game with an expressive combo system and a diverse character roster! Play as superhumans, skeletons, aliens, and even stick figures! Battle dangerous foes, take part in lots of exciting singleplayer modes, throw your opponents into the sun, and so much more!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Duels of Fortune , a super-powered fighting game featuring a crazy diverse cast of loveable characters with unique abilities, and freeform systems that let you play the game your way. It provides a simple control scheme that makes the game accessible for beginners, while keeping plenty of mechanical and character-based depth for serious players to dig into. From intense clashes against friends and rivals, to expansive singleplayer content, to a rich setting full of interesting characters to learn about, there's something for everyone in Duels of Fortune! VERSUS MODE - Battle it out with local friends or CPUs in traditional 1-on-1 duels! ARCADE MODE - Fight your way through a gauntlet of increasingly difficult opponents, culminating in a boss battle with the tournament organizer himself! MISSION MODE - Take on over 75 hand-crafted challenge battles that add special conditions and obstacles to the match! TRAINING MODE - Practice your skills using a customizable training dummy! BOSS FIGHTS - Easily rematch any of the unique and challenging bosses found throughout the game! COMBO TRIALS - Learn what each character can do by trying out increasingly tricky pre-made combos! STAGE HAZARDS - A toggleable feature that flips stages on their head with all sorts of crazy effects, including ring-out zones, throwable items, giant skeletons that attack you from the background, and MORE!! LORE JOURNAL - Read up on the lore and backstory of each character, and learn what they fight for! JUKEBOX - Jam out to the bangin' soundtrack composed by Jack7! All with 20+ UNIQUE FIGHTERS to choose from, with even more on the way! Perform stylish and dynamic combos with an open-ended attack cancel system! Build up your Super Meter to unleash powerful and cinematic Super Moves , or defend yourself in a pinch with invincible Reversal attacks! Strategically use Break Burst to shut down your opponents' combos, or go all-in on your own combo with a well-timed Blast Burst ! Schmoove around the stage with a variety of movement mechanics , including dashes, long jumps, airdashes, free air drifting, and tons of unique character-specific options! And on top of all that, explore each character's plethora of unique attributes , giving every one of them a completely distinct feel and playstyle! What would a fighting game be without its fun and diverse cast of playable characters? Here's just a handful of the loveable (and despicable) fighters you can choose from! ‎ Clyde is a boxing prodigy with an attitude, and one of the most renowned fighters in the world. Clyde doesn't need any weapons; his fists, his natural speed, and his ability to create fire from his hands are all he needs to put up a good fight! TRAILBLAZER - Rush in and overwhelm your opponents with Clyde's incredible speed and offensive capabilities! BRING THE HEAT - Clyde's special moves are focused on raw power and combo utility, delivering fiery punches left and right! KING OF THE RING - Keep your opponent on the ropes with fast mix-ups that force equally fast reactions! ‎ Annie is a young engineer with a big brain, and an even bigger heart. Using her powerful mechanical arm, her vast arsenal of gadgets, and her helpful robotic companion Gizmo, she holds her own even despite her lack of experience! GADGET GIRL - Annie's wide array of projectiles and traps let her set up an unbreakable defense, and she has the tools to easily convert her long-range zoning into close-up pressure! BLAST OFF - Annie's special rocket boots grant her a midair jump, as well as the ability to drastically slow her descent! HELPING HAND - Annie's Super Moves summon her little robo-buddy Gizmo to assist her in various ways, like firing massive lasers or carpet-bombing the whole stage! ‎ Long ago, Rattlebone was a royal knight who loyally served his kingdom, until one day he fell victim to a horrible trebuchet accident. Now, revived into the modern day in skeletal form, he continues to fight as honourably as ever with his trusty sword and shield! FOR HONOUR - An honest and noble fighter, Rattlebone is primarily focused on the absolute fundamentals of combat! RATTLE ME BONES - Rattlebone's skeletal form grants him plenty of new techniques, like throwing his own head as a bouncing projectile! CHIVALROUS SPIRIT - Unleash a powerful Super Move that imbues Rattlebone's sword with special properties for a limited time! ‎ Shoto is a young, yet highly skilled student of the Locks Dojo. While he may have the personality of a cardboard box, his powers of electricity and his unbreakable focus in combat make him a force to be reckoned with! GREASED LIGHTNING - Shoto's attacks are fast and precise, giving him a natural advantage in hand-to-hand combat! GLASS CANNON - Shoto may sport a low health pool, but he's got lots of ways to dish out far more damage in return! SHOTOKAN SPECIAL - With straightforward projectiles, a powerful uppercut, and a flurry of advancing kicks, Shoto remains true to his namesake while putting his own unique spin on the formula! ‎ A brash, delinquent punk from the Capital, Red's aggressive and brutish nature is reflected in his fighting style. Red aims to get in his opponent's face and stay there, relentlessly beating them down with his energy beam! BRUTE STRENGTH - Red is a powerful attacker who prefers to brute-force his way in, rather than relying on speed or zoning. UNYIELDING RAGE - Red's special Rage mechanic lets him unleash stronger versions of his special moves after taking or dealing enough damage! SMASHIN' KNEECAPS - Thanks to his many grappling attacks and deadly mix-ups, Red almost never has to let up his offense once he has the advantage! ‎ Often called the 'strongest man alive', Baron's overwhelming desire to fight strong opponents led him down a dark, bloody path that ended with a life sentence. Now set free again thanks to the manipulation of Sylvan Blackjack, his titanic strength and powerful grappling techniques will crush all who oppose him. WRESTLING LEGEND - Baron's mighty grappling moves can dish out damage like nothing else, and can even be comboed together under the right circumstances! UNBREAKABLE - With a huge HP pool and a variety of armoured attacks, Baron is both an unstoppable force, AND an immovable object! THE BIGGER THEY ARE... - Baron's great power comes at the cost of mobility. Use your techniques wisely to keep the opponent on the back foot and avoid getting overwhelmed! ‎ ‎ Sylvan is the founder and CEO of the Diamondeye Company, one of the largest and richest corporations in the world. Naturally, this can only mean that Sylvan is as sleazy and underhanded as they come, and he'll put all his chips down to get the job done. ACES HIGH - Sylvan revolves around his card drawing mechanic. The more Aces he draws using his card draw attacks, the more options he gains! FULL HOUSE - When Sylvan has all 4 aces, he enters a state called Full House mode, where he becomes the most powerful character in the game for a limited time! GOOD LUCK - It can take some time and luck to get to Full House mode, but tools like a slot machine that grants random effects, and your faithful bodyguard Mr. Withers, can help buy you some time. ‎ Once a feared high-seas pirate, Shiverskull is back from the dead to plunder the competition! With his twin swords and the help of his trusted pirate crew, he isn't afraid to take some serious risks to win. You can't kill what's already dead! AYE, MATEYS - Shiverskull can summon the members of his pirate crew one after another to perform assist attacks, each with their own strengths and uses! RECKLESS SAILOR - Shiverskull is great when it comes to running in and putting on the pressure — but be careful, as messing up can cost you dearly! MORE SWORDS - Wield a deadly Super Move that summons a ring of damaging swords around you for a short time! ‎ Black Heart is an alien parasite that feeds off people's inner hatred to take on their form. Having taken the form of Clyde, Black Heart inherits his speed and fire abilities, but like the trickster they are, they use those powers in much more devious ways. TRICKSTER - Black Heart is capable of all sorts of mix-ups that are extremely difficult to react to, forcing their opponents into a guessing game! SLIPPERY SLIME - Black Heart has some of the trickiest movement in the game, with unique dashes and special moves that let them easily dodge enemy attacks! HEART BREAKER - Rain terror with a Super Move that traps the opponent in a massive smoke cloud, letting you be nearly invisible as you get in their face! Everyone's favourite green, legless superhero, Callowman blurs the line a bit between bravery and stupidity. But regardless of his quality as a hero, he certainly has the raw strength to warrant being called the mightiest warrior in the universe! GRAPPLING WITH EVIL - Callowman's slew of advancing grappling attacks make him extremely fearsome to fight, especially since he's no slouch on speed! SHOW OFF - Successfully taunting as Callowman powers up your grabbing attacks, and you can use them in combos! Now that's what I call a flex! ALMIGHTY POWER - One of Callowman's Super Moves, if used with a full Super Meter AND a full taunt-buff meter, can instantly KO the opponent!! ‎ The fourth-wall-breaking, two-dimensional menace, Doodle emerges from the depths of development hell to exact his revenge for all the cancelled games he was meant to star in. The first step of his vengeance quest? Breaking ALL the rules! CHARGE UP - Doodle goes against the game's normal control scheme, introducing special moves inputted with charge motions! SCREEN HOG  -   Doodle's lingering projectiles can create difficult situations for the opponent to get around, especially since he's no slouch on offense either! METER BURNER - Unload tons of damage with a Super Move that lets you spend even more meter to increase its power! And this is just a small sample! There are  even more characters to discover for yourself when you hop into the game! So what are you waiting for? Get in there and SHOW YOUR POWER !!

rows.name: Blade Fury
rows.short_description: The player is equiped with advanced movement mechanics in order to clear levels by avoiding obstacles, killing enemies and eventually obtaining a key which will be used to access the next level.
rows.description_html: This is a fast-paced, first-person hack-and-slash game with 9 different levels that takes place in a futuristic and stylised environment. The player is equipped with advanced movement mechanics such as double jumping, wall running, ziplining, dashing and grappling to help traverse levels, avoid obstacles and kill enemies to obtain a key which can be used to access the next level.

rows.name: EndlessCar
rows.short_description: The car passes through obstacles to earn points mini-game.
rows.description_html: EndlessCar is a casual mini-game that allows you to earn unlimited points to control cars, and the controls are simple and easy to play. The screen you see is all about the game, no upgrades, no levels, and the way you control it is A/D to dodge obstacles left and right while gaining oil drums to gain points and power-ups. The makers thoughtfully added the function of switching backgrounds for players to make it less monotonous, using the keyboard :W. This will not affect the progress of the game. If you want to take a break from a stressful game, you can also press ESC to pause the game. Conditions of Death: 1. The energy bar state disappears, that is, it loses power, so collect as many oil barrels as possible to keep energy. 2. Avoid crashing into obstacles! Points Requirements: One point is awarded for successfully obtaining the oil drum. Please note: there is no upper limit to the maximum score! Have fun!

rows.name: Pedros Eggventure
rows.short_description: we are doing this game for a project at 'univercity'. we hope you enjoy this game that we made. we have everything you would want, a main character who totally does not look like Pedro Pascal, a dragon, a run for your life and just some good old egg puns. - Ms Maddy of Breakfast Crew
rows.description_html: Roadmap Unfortunately there is no roadmap. Our game will be made as is please leave a review. Tell us what we might of done differently to captivate you. About the Game Introducing Pedro's Eggventure, the thrilling first-person and 2D action-adventure game that'll have you hooked! Embark on an epic quest as you navigate through diverse environments in search of the elusive EGG. Unleash your skills and strategy as you face the fierce boss dragon in an unforgettable showdown. Designed for single-player action, this captivating game offers a smooth gaming experience with minimal system requirements. Get ready to embark on the ultimate Eggventure and return home victorious!

rows.name: Sword Art Online: Integral Factor
rows.short_description: Aim to conquer Aincrad with Kirito and Asuna
rows.description_html: The popular smartphone game SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor (SAOIF) will now be available on Steam! Play it with a controller or your keyboard with custom key configurations! See the world of Aincrad come to life on a large PC monitor! This time, the protagonist is...you! You appear in this online RPG as a member of an Assault Team, working with other imprisoned players to reach the 100th floor of Aincrad! What if you were trapped in a game of life or death? You can experience meeting familiar characters and connecting to the original SAO story from your own POV. Experience behind-the-scenes stories not seen in the original SAO, and completely different story developments! Live out a 'what-if' story where you affect Aincrad! Battle System Fight through the sprawling fields of Aincrad with your partner Koharu, trapped together in a game of life and death! You'll need to cooperate with Assault Teams across the land and battle together to beat powerful monsters and tough quests! Forging stronger weapons, using skills with all kinds of effects, and preparing for each enemy's weak points and attack patterns are all key to your success!

Battle System Fight through the sprawling fields of Aincrad with your partner Koharu, trapped together in a game of life and death! You'll need to cooperate with Assault Teams across the land and battle together to beat powerful monsters and tough quests! Forging stronger weapons, using skills with all kinds of effects, and preparing for each enemy's weak points and attack patterns are all key to your success!

rows.name: Bone Boy
rows.short_description: Feeling bad to the bone? Shred through the body as Bone Boy - learn rad tricks, help your friends and collect epic hats along the way. Get out there and tear it up, kid!
rows.description_html: Play as Bone Boy in this humerus game. Skate your way through the body as you use your rad tricks to defeat enemies and unleash your need for speed. Encounter an unforgettable range of characters such as Uncle Funny Bone and Jerry The Sentient Gum Wad. Explore cool environments such as the dystopian liver or the blasted tundra of the lungs. Unravel the mysteries of the body as you encounter the various illnesses that plague it.
