rows.name: Aphelion Headhunters
rows.short_description: Aphelion Headhunters is a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring two unique player characters, each with their own distinct playstyle, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades.
rows.description_html: Step into the shoes of one of an elite mercenary wielding powerful abilities and firepower in Aphelion Headhunters , a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring high octane combat and specially crafted abilities and perks. Play as either the Hellion or the Sunslinger, two highly trained Headhunters seeking to the claim the bounty on the head of a notorious Raider and his army of minions. Each of the Headhunters features their own distinct playstyles, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades, offering high replayability and thoughtful buildcrafting. Abilities Each character in Aphelion Headhunters features One Weapon, Three Active abilities and a Passive Ability. Active Abilities are powerful skills that can be used at any time while off cooldown, offering fun and unique gameplay advantages. Passive Abilities are charged up in response to certain triggers, and once ready, provide special boons that further compliment their unique playstyle. The Sunslinger A deadly marksman wielding a rapid fire SMG and the destructive power of the sun in the palm of his hand, the Sunslinger burns down his enemies in a hail of gunfire. Able to blind enemies, hurl fireballs and reload his weapon at the speed of light, the Sunslinger is a deadly foe and a master of dishing out high damage in a short time. The Hellion A close range brawler wielding a shotgun and mysterious yet powerful psionic abilities, the Hellion gets up close and personal and stays there until her enemies are demolished at her feet. Able to weave the power of psionics into swords, shields and bursts of telekinetic fury that stuns opponents, the Hellion is able to keep herself alive by dealing damage, granting her a useful overshield so that she can keep on fighting. Perks System The unique abilities featured by both characters can be further augmented using a selection of specifcally crafted perks, enabling players to tailor their experience to fit their playstyle. Choosing up to 3 perks from a total pool of 8, players can make the characters their own, and enjoy hours of replayability with different perks and builds.

rows.name: Trolley Delayma
rows.short_description: Top down puzzle game about manipulating the tracks to redirect the trolley to save the victims. Solve the trolley problem in various forms of tiny puzzles.
rows.description_html: Trolley Delayma is a tiny puzzle game where you move around manipulating the tracks to save the victims and delay the inevitable fate forever. A combination of puzzle solving and fast reaction to save everyone, including you! Features 20 different levels for about 30 minutes of Gameplay. This game was originally created for the Ludum Dare 50, with the theme 'delay the inevitable'.

rows.name: NonFullControl
rows.short_description: A simple and short minigame.When some of your actions are not under your control, can you unravel the truth behind? Relying on partially controllable operations to pass through the level, there seems to be some anomalies in the space.
rows.description_html: This is a simple minigame that used to be a testing project. Inspiration was generated in several simple scenes, and since then, that space has taken on new meaning and I wants to share it. Q: What kind of game is this? A: This is a 3D, platform like jumping, level breaking game. Q: What will you experience in the game? A: In the game, players need to overcome numerous levels without fully controlling their own operations, and ultimately be led to the truth behind them. Q: Where will the game's save be stored? A: The game's archive will only exist locally. Free Plan: This game is planned to be converted to a free game after the actual sales volume is less than (unknown reasons) or equal to 1111 . The mobile version will also eliminate advertising. Self-rating: 5/10 —— Bilibili：危途异客

rows.name: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt
rows.short_description: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is an old-school shooter game with charming pixel art graphics that will take you on a Halloween adventure. Fly on a broomstick and battle your way through three exciting levels, each one featuring unique spooky creatures such as pumpkin monsters, evil crows and ghosts.
rows.description_html: Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is an old-school shooter game with charming pixel art graphics that will take you on a Halloween adventure. Fly on a broomstick and battle your way through three exciting levels, each one featuring unique spooky creatures such as pumpkin monsters, evil crows and ghosts. With three different modes of difficulty to choose from, our game provides a fun and enjoyable experience for players of all levels. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, Witchcraft: Candy Hunt is the perfect game for all ages. Join the witch on a magical journey and help save Halloween from spooky creatures in this charming old-school shooter game! The game offers three difficulty modes for players of all skill levels: - The Rainbow mode is the easiest and is recommended for young or inexperienced new players. With fewer monsters and less aggressive enemies, it's the perfect way to ease into the game - The Moderate difficulty is a balanced option that is designed to be fun and challenging for most players - The Hostile mode gives the player a real challenge. With more enemies and a greater level of difficulty, it's the perfect choice for experienced players who want to put their skills to the test Casual arcade action Experience non-stop action with infinite lives and checkpoints in Witchcraft: Candy Hunt! Choose from five types of powerful spells to help you defeat spooky creatures, including powerful blue bullets, laser green spells, homing yellow bullets, large wave pink spells, and double bullet purple spells. With each type of spell providing a unique advantage, you'll have the tools you need to overcome the toughest challenges in the game. The levels Explore three distinct levels – the Forest, Graveyard, and Castle – each with its own unique look and feel. Encounter many monsters along the way, each with their own set of powers, making every level a new and exciting challenge. As you progress, you'll face mini-bosses and bosses at the end of each level, each with their own distinct patterns and multiple phases to conquer. It's up to you to understand and overcome their challenges to progress through the game. Get ready to experience a world full of spooky creatures and thrilling battles, and emerge victorious as the ultimate witch of Halloween!

rows.short_description: Explore enchanting landscapes with unique pixel art graphics. Join a guild for thrilling adventures and epic battles. Cooperate to conquer dungeons and dragons. Trade in the Open Market, master professions, and create your build. Forge friendships and shape your destiny in our immersive RPG world!
rows.description_html: Tinker with the best gear and harness the power of intricate rune words to enhance your abilities and overcome formidable challenges. Every battle is an opportunity to showcase your expertise and optimize your loadout, ensuring you're prepared for the diverse range of content that awaits. Forge lasting friendships as you embark on thrilling adventures together. Engage in epic guild content, such as challenging dungeons and exhilarating dragon fights, where cooperation is the key to victory. Unleash your entrepreneurial spirit in the bustling Open Market, a vibrant hub where players can trade equipment and goods. Shape the dynamic in-game economy and get rich as you engage in thrilling transactions. Take a break from epic boss battles and delve into the realm of professions. Engage in the tranquil art of harvesting and fishing, where you can immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. With unique pixel art graphics, our game invites you to embark on a visually stunning adventure. Experience the freshly revamped starting location and explore various enchanting landscapes, from verdant elvish forests to mystical dwarven ruins.

rows.name: Year 500
rows.short_description: Year 500 is a third-person, hack-n-slash adventure game featuring swordplay, magic casting, and an engaging story set in a fantasy world. Reclaim your memory, oppose and defeat evil, and save the kingdom by any means necessary.
rows.description_html: 'Your memory is failing you again? I will indulge you just this once...' It is the Year 500. Chaos fell upon the world ten years ago when an unknown and mysterious celestial body arrived and began orbiting Earth. Given the name 'The Witness' by the natives of the Runic Empire, the celestial body eerily leered down at the people of the world as its energy gifted people with magical powers beyond their wildest dreams. Ranging from control over the elements like Earth and Fire, to more sophisticated powers like control over animal life and even the gift of healing, humanity found plenty of uses for the newly-found powers they had been bestowed. The gifts people received were named “Bursts” after their ability to burst through the limitations of what humanity once thought was possible, and those capable of using them were named “Breakers”. Humanity appeared to be entering a Golden Age of power…but their prosperity was short-lived. Soon, those who relished themselves too extensively in the Witness’ gifts found themselves corrupted, their mental sanity breaking down as the Burst magic running through their veins malformed their minds and bodies. These lost souls were referred to as the Broken, and they ranged from mindless zombies to intelligent monsters. Among them was King Runic, the most powerful wizard to ever live. When the witness appeared, he used the chaos to consolidate his power and take over. His presence as the king allowed him to maintain control over his many conquered nations. Among his many loyal men, three soldiers were brought together by the sheer gravity of his power. These soldiers served as extensions of his power and were used to conquer and control the region. When King Runic eventually passed, a void of strength was created; one that could only be filled with more strength. Over the years, factions were formed around two of the pillars while the 3rd disappeared completely. The runic kingdom was split once more between the 2 mad kings: Weiss and Saladin. Though mercenaries are looked down upon by society as ruthless individuals and contracted killers, there is one particular group of them that act in the interest of the people. This group, led by the protagonist, Oden, is one such group. You, as the player, take control of Oden who is famous across the region for his combat aptitude and unwavering stamina and strength. Though, Oden is a victim of severe amnesia and his past is a complete mystery to him, but not all hope is lost after his group is contracted to neutralize the Three Pillars of the Runic Kingdom. With this quest accepted, Oden and his band of mercenaries venture across the land to combat evil and the Three Pillars themselves in an epic and action-packed adventure. Will you reclaim your memory and save the kingdom from total corruption? Lethal Swordplay Use your sharpened and lethal sword to strike down foes and maintain your Breaker Gauge. Magic Casting Oden isn't just limited to his sword. Oden can cast magic spells that deal great damage to enemies. Be careful, however, as continued use of these spells can subject Oden into what we call... Broken Mode Continuous exposure to magic and Bursts casts Oden into Broken Mode, a transformation that boosts all of Oden's combat capabilities. Be sparing with this mode, as it will limit your vitality the more you use it. Engaging Story The world of Year 500 has plenty of characters and lore to discover. Speak to your fellow mercenaries, descry the world around you and be exposed to a rich lore that has more than meets the eye.

rows.name: Moonring
rows.short_description: A dark-fantasy, turn-based, retro-fusion of classic turn-based RPGs and roguelikes, all presented with a unique neon aesthetic.
rows.description_html: A free game by the co-creator of the XBox's Fable series. Five hundred years ago, the land of Caldera was plunged into endless darkness. Decades later, five moons rose in the sky, bringing light to the world and strange Gods with it. With them came the Dreams: calls to Devotion promising supernatural Gifts. Thus, the new Calderan civilisation was born; a world of Devotion and Dreamers, Gods and Gifts, with a Dreamless Archon acting as the Gods' mortal representative. But Archons are not eternal, and a successor must be found. You are Dreamless: free to choose your own destiny, to ask questions others dare not, or even become Archon yourself. What will you do, Dreamless one? Moonring is a retro-inspired open-world, turn-based, tile RPG in the style of the classic Ultima games, but created from the ground up with modern design sensibilities. The world's geography is hand-designed, but the deadly dungeons beneath the surface reconfigure each time you leave... or die. Travel, trade, sneak, fight and sail the world of Caldera. Speak with the townsfolk, learn Caldera's secrets, and challenge the Archon for his throne... or even overthrow the Gods themselves! Features: - Large, hand-designed open world - An infinite supply of dungeons generated using your character name - Over 100 varied enemy types, from fodder to bosses - 35 unique Gifts from the Gods, their usage changing with the moon phases - Sailing, ship-to-ship combat and boarding - A Dungeon Synth OST with over 50 tracks, all made using retro Mod Trackers! - A hidden magic system and many other mysteries A note from the creator: Hi folks. I've loved RPGs since the early 1980s, and grew up playing games like Lord British's 'Ultima' series and early Roguelikes. This is my love-letter to a style of gaming that has largely fallen out of fashion: with its vivid, bright sprites overlaid on stark black backgrounds, true open-world gameplay, and lack of handholding. The days I spent playing these games were spent in joyful exploration and discovery, venturing into the dark unknown, a co-author of the experience, filling in the gaps left by the primitive art with my imagination. For those of you who did the same, I hope Moonring recaptures some of the spirit of those days for you. For those who did not, I hope that the more modern conveniences you find in this game allow you to catch a glimpse of what we did 40 years ago. My heartfelt thanks to all who spared even a moment to play this. Please be kind to my mistakes. I will fix them. :-) - Dene

rows.name: Luckie Ball
rows.short_description: A short precision platformer where nothing is fully solid. Roll, float, and air jump your way through zany worlds and bonus challenges!
rows.description_html: Luckie Ball is a short precision platformer where nothing is fully solid. You'll float to the top of everything! Inspired by the Flash games you used to play in the school computer lab, Luckie Ball features dozens of hand-drawn levels for you to traverse through. The tight and responsive controls lend well to advanced mechanics and optimized movement. Collect Luckie Coins to unlock a wealth of bonus levels and character skins! Take on the Extreme Gauntlet, a set of three torturous levels that'll test the limits of your patience and skill. Expert understanding of the physics engine is mandatory. Flex your creative muscles with the custom level creator! Share the level file with your friends so they can enjoy your masterpieces too. Need another way to compete? Set the fastest time you can in Speedrun Mode! All of this content is totally free. There's no in-app purchases or paid DLC! That means there's no excuse for you not to play. Or maybe there is. I'm not you, I wouldn't know.

rows.name: Fusionist
rows.short_description: Introducing Fusionist Launch Version: The New Beginning! On Dec. 23rd, 2024, Fusionist will bring forth new maps, powerful weapons, and the game-changing Core System! Experience deeper customization and exciting strategies as you dive into the new Fusionist adventure!
rows.description_html: Fusionist is a turn-based strategy sci-fi game. Players lead a team of five mechs, strategically combining cores and mechs to create unique tactical combinations for battle. The game features three elemental types—Frozen (Ice), Burn (Fire), and Electric (Lightning)—allowing players to trigger diverse elemental reactions, such as ice-based control, continuous fire damage, and electric chain explosions, greatly enhancing combat strategy. Each of the five mech classes has distinct roles: melee Striker, shielded Defender, ranged Buster, precision Sniper, and backline Support. Players can adapt their tactics to the battlefield situation. Turn-based combat emphasizes action order and formation placement, offering deep strategic gameplay. Players can complete missions to collect resources, forge and upgrade their own mech squad. In the arena, they can compete with commanders worldwide, where team composition and skillful operation determine victory. The new version introduces more powerful weapons and innovative core mechanics, allowing players to fully enjoy the strategic sci-fi mech experience.
rows.about_html: Fusionist is a turn-based strategy sci-fi game. Players lead a team of five mechs, strategically combining cores and mechs to create unique tactical combinations for battle. The game features three elemental types—Frozen (Ice), Burn (Fire), and Electric (Lightning)—allowing players to trigger diverse elemental reactions, such as ice-based control, continuous fire damage, and electric chain explosions, greatly enhancing combat strategy. Each of the five mech classes has distinct roles: melee Striker, shielded Defender, ranged Buster, precision Sniper, and backline Support. Players can adapt their tactics to the battlefield situation. Turn-based combat emphasizes action order and formation placement, offering deep strategic gameplay. Players can complete missions to collect resources, forge and upgrade their own mech squad. In the arena, they can compete with commanders worldwide, where team composition and skillful operation determine victory. The new version introduces more powerful weapons and innovative core mechanics, allowing players to fully enjoy the strategic sci-fi mech experience.

rows.name: HexBat
rows.short_description: Challenge your Friends in this Free turn-based, chess-like strategy game with Healers, Rogues, Archers, and more! Create your own Hexagon Grids for near endless variation.
rows.description_html: This is a 2 player turn-based strategy game. Think chess meets turn-based RPGs. Each player's team is made up of one character from each of these positions: -Forward (Tank) - Usually has high health and damage while also being the slowest character. -Flex (DPS) - Is flexible with how each character plays but is usually the fastest character. -Support (Healer) - Has support abilities that enable other characters. Characters take turns depending on their speed and generate Action Points at the start of each of their turns. Action Points (AP) are used for either Actions (Attacks / Healing) or Moving (1 AP per tile). Any unspent Action Points are carried over to the character's next turn up to a maximum of 6 AP. Hex Grids consist of up to a maximum of 25 tiles of Five different types: -Spawn: Spawn point for a Character (turns into a grass tile during game). -Grass: Basic tile with no direct effects. -Mud: Costs an additional AP to traverse. -Molten: Take 10 Damage at the end of Character's turn. -Corrupt: Doubles all Damage Character receives. You can create your own custom Hex Grids with the in-game editor. Victory Condition: First player to kill 2 characters of the Opponent's team.

rows.name: Angels vs Angels
rows.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter where angels battle angels using divine weapons in surreal arenas.
rows.description_html: Angels vs Angels A fast-paced multiplayer action shooter where angels battle angels using divine weapons in surreal, symbolic arenas. Angels vs Angels is a competitive PvP game focused on quick matches, skill-based combat, and chaotic celestial warfare. Players take control of powerful angels, each armed with unique weapons and abilities, and fight across abstract environments inspired by sacred architecture and religious symbolism. The game emphasizes immediate action, readable combat, and short match sessions — jump in, fight, and improve your skills without long waiting times. Key Features ⚔️ Fast-paced multiplayer combat Short, intense matches designed for instant action and replayability. 👼 Playable angel characters Different weapons, abilities, and movement styles to support multiple playstyles. 🏛 Stylized celestial arenas Battle inside churches, heavens, and abstract symbolic locations. 🤖 Bots & AI support Play even when online matches are quiet — no empty servers. 🔄 Active development New maps, balance updates, and gameplay improvements planned. Early Access Angels vs Angels is currently in Early Access. The game is actively evolving, and player feedback directly influences future updates. Expect changes, improvements, and new content over time.

rows.name: Minor Scale
rows.short_description: Minor Scale is a rhythm-based tower defense game with a 2D / 3D hybrid whimsical aesthetic. You will conduct a band of cute little Critters to defend their jam session from the creepy Crawlies threatening their home with the power of music.
rows.description_html: Buggy Beats Be sure to stay on the beat or else you will end up in a sticky situation. Play through multiple levels accompanied by custom-composed music and artwork. Building Phase: Use your conducting skills to earn currency to buy even more critters with varying instruments. Each bug's specialized instrument will act differently so be sure to strategize. Wave Onslaught: Once you exit the building phase the wave phase will begin. See how well you keep the beat to attack these creepy intruders. When in doubt you can always use a powerful crescendo attack to wipe out incoming waves! Keyboard Critter Co is a student-driven company that was established in 2022 out of the Entertainment Arts and Engineering (EAE) program at the University of Utah. Our goal is to provide a fun experience to our players while also showcasing the hard work and talent of up-and-coming game developers. Our current working title, Minor Scale, is our collective graduating project. We hope you enjoy the experience and thank you for taking the time to play our game! 🐦Twitter: 🐛TikTok: 🐜Youtube: 🐝Itch.io: 🕸 Epic Games: COMING SOON! About the Game Minor Scale is a rhythm-based tower defense game with a 2D / 3D hybrid whimsical aesthetic. You will conduct a band of cute little Critters to defend their jam session from the creepy Crawlies threatening their home with the power of music. - Unique combination of rhythm and tower defense mechanics - Place critters to defeat the crawlies by playing along with the music - For lovers of rhythm games, tower defense, and cute creatures - Hit notes to earn crescendo meter - Defeat crawlies to place more critters to earn currency - Original soundtrack - Start your waves on your own time

rows.description_html: Cash Dash is a 2.5D fun platformer game where the player has to run, jump, slide, and crouch through various platforms in record time while attempting to collect as much money as possible. In addition, the game has moving platforms, spikes, speed runs, checkpoints and jump boost pads to help or slow down the player while trying to complete the level. At the end of each level, the player gets a completion rate which depends on the time taken to complete the level and the money collected. The game has 10 themed levels with varying levels of difficulty. All the levels were created by the crew members at nonPareil. nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.

rows.short_description: In this real time strategy game, defeat your friends by destroying their castle. The last player with their castle still standing wins! Players must manage their economy, build their base and defenses, while producing and upgrading their units.
rows.description_html: In this real time strategy game, defeat your friends by destroying their castle. The last player with their castle still standing wins! Players must manage their economy, build their base and defenses, while producing and upgrading their units. Build: -House: generates money -Forge: generates iron and upgrades your army's armor (3 different armor types: blunt, piercing, and slashing) -Pillar: generates magic and enchants targeted unit, so that they bypass enemy non-magic armor. -Barracks: recruit and upgrade soldier soldier -Archery range: recruits and upgrades archers -Foundry: recruits and upgrades canons -Wizard tower: recruits and upgrades wizards. -Defensive Tower: shoots 3 arrows at enemies in the vicinity. -Walls: blocks unit movement. -Gate: A wall that can let units go through Produce your army from a range of 4 different units: -Archer: attacks from afar with piercing damage but are more accurate at close range. -Soldier: attacks with slashing damage, have higher HP and armor and can change their weapon type to counter their opponent's armor-type -Canon: attacks from a long range causing blunt damage, effective at taking down enemy defenses. -Wizard: attacks from medium-range, causing blunt damage and can cast powerful fireballs and defensive shields at the cost of MP. Upgrade your army: -There are 3 types of armor upgrades (blunt, piercing, slashing) available to your army, try to upgrade the right ones to counter your opponent's army. -You can also level up your army's units, which will improve their attack power and max health -the cost of upgrades depends on the number of units you own.

rows.name: Enid
rows.short_description: Help Enid stay aflame while exploring the forest and playing minigames with woodland creatures!
rows.description_html: Enid is a ¾ perspective, single-player RPG with a retro feel, wherein the player collects objects and completes tasks for their fantastical friend - an anthropomorphic fire named Enid ! The core gameplay hearkens back to a nostalgic era, drawing inspiration from classic games (as well as newer indie titles) like Harvest Moon , Pikmin , Stardew Valley , Celeste , and A Short Hike . Imagine a laid-back, lo-fi exploration RPG where the player takes care of their new pal, who reveals bits and pieces of a grander and secret narrative as they help one another move forward - all this in tightly packaged, easy to play minigames! Above all, Enid is a game about exploring, collecting, solving, and progressing through manageable, bite-sized chunks of gameplay and story!

rows.name: Highrise Guardian
rows.short_description: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is an Arena FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, dominate your enemies with map control, and make an art-like battle style to become the Anime gunslinger.
rows.description_html: ARENA ABOVE THE SKYLINE: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is a fast-paced Online Area Retro FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, and dominate your enemies with map resource control. Make your battle style like arts to fulfill your Anime gunslinger fantasies. BUILD A HERO OF YOUR OWN In Highrise Guardian, You can select freely select 3 Weapons, 2 Active ABilites, and 2 Passive Perks from the area to create your own anime gunslinger. WEAPONS: Conveniently Assassinate Select from Rowdy SMGs, Ruthless Long-range Laser Rifles, Rampant Rocket Launchers, and Shotguns that blow holes in your face. Whether you want to be a long-range sharpshooter or a close-quarter Gun-Kata master, you will find your fancy way to dominate your enemies in style. Weapon List: Phased Plasma 40W: Bolt Action heavy hit energy beam weapon. Slow fire rate. Sheriff 800: Lever Action Rifle loaded with 12G buck shot. Damage scaled by the number of fragments collided with enemies. Denzel-10: Full-Auto high fire rate nail projectile shooting weapon. Projectiles take travel time to land on enemies. TubeScreamer-10: Classic Rocket Launcher with mid level fire rate. Rockets may knock back players and enemies to force position displacement. Wick’s Sidekick: Semi-Auto magic pistol that has infinite ammo. Low damage output. ACTIVE ABILITIES: Be the First to Strike Extra Agilities, Stealty Infiltration, Intel Scouting, and Control Distortion, Select the active abilities to put yourself on the high ground in the fight you initiated. Ability List: Wind Rush: Quick dashing to the front for a small distant. Optic Phase: Shift into full invisible for 3 seconds. Thermal Sight: Detect nearby enemies in any condition. Magnetic Intervention: Reverse enemies' camera control input. PASSIVE PERKS: Born With Talents Under Pressure, Pinned down? No Stress! The Perks provides you with a passive bonus to help you overcome disadvantaged situations and outplay your enemies. Perk List Stalker: Strafing speed increase to 150% under the battle. Berserk: Receiving bonus of output damage scaled by losing HP. Favor of Battle: Regenerate 50% of Total HP after elimination. Hesitation is death: Deal 130% to enemies by default, dealing 10% less damage to enemy after receiving damage. MAP DESIGN: Higher than the rooftop and Wider than the canal In Highrise Guardian, you will be assigned to one of the two fractions, Operators and Heisters, to create your class of a Hero and intensely fight each other over the rooftop of the bright city downtown and overcast canal ports. The maps are designed for creative interaction and dynamic combat, and emphasizes vertical engagement, shifting gun-sight aligning, and fast position change. The maps also provide portals and jump pads for flanking and quick engagement. Most importantly, be creative and get yourself on the move. RESOURCES: Hotspot to Contend Securing high value pickables with map control and vantage point hold! Crush your enemies not only with your gun skills but also the resource dominiation.
rows.about_html: ARENA ABOVE THE SKYLINE: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is a fast-paced Online Area Retro FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, and dominate your enemies with map resource control. Make your battle style like arts to fulfill your Anime gunslinger fantasies. BUILD A HERO OF YOUR OWN In Highrise Guardian, You can select freely select 3 Weapons, 2 Active ABilites, and 2 Passive Perks from the area to create your own anime gunslinger. WEAPONS: Conveniently Assassinate Select from Rowdy SMGs, Ruthless Long-range Laser Rifles, Rampant Rocket Launchers, and Shotguns that blow holes in your face. Whether you want to be a long-range sharpshooter or a close-quarter Gun-Kata master, you will find your fancy way to dominate your enemies in style. Weapon List: Phased Plasma 40W: Bolt Action heavy hit energy beam weapon. Slow fire rate. Sheriff 800: Lever Action Rifle loaded with 12G buck shot. Damage scaled by the number of fragments collided with enemies. Denzel-10: Full-Auto high fire rate nail projectile shooting weapon. Projectiles take travel time to land on enemies. TubeScreamer-10: Classic Rocket Launcher with mid level fire rate. Rockets may knock back players and enemies to force position displacement. Wick’s Sidekick: Semi-Auto magic pistol that has infinite ammo. Low damage output. ACTIVE ABILITIES: Be the First to Strike Extra Agilities, Stealty Infiltration, Intel Scouting, and Control Distortion, Select the active abilities to put yourself on the high ground in the fight you initiated. Ability List: Wind Rush: Quick dashing to the front for a small distant. Optic Phase: Shift into full invisible for 3 seconds. Thermal Sight: Detect nearby enemies in any condition. Magnetic Intervention: Reverse enemies' camera control input. PASSIVE PERKS: Born With Talents Under Pressure, Pinned down? No Stress! The Perks provides you with a passive bonus to help you overcome disadvantaged situations and outplay your enemies. Perk List Stalker: Strafing speed increase to 150% under the battle. Berserk: Receiving bonus of output damage scaled by losing HP. Favor of Battle: Regenerate 50% of Total HP after elimination. Hesitation is death: Deal 130% to enemies by default, dealing 10% less damage to enemy after receiving damage. MAP DESIGN: Higher than the rooftop and Wider than the canal In Highrise Guardian, you will be assigned to one of the two fractions, Operators and Heisters, to create your class of a Hero and intensely fight each other over the rooftop of the bright city downtown and overcast canal ports. The maps are designed for creative interaction and dynamic combat, and emphasizes vertical engagement, shifting gun-sight aligning, and fast position change. The maps also provide portals and jump pads for flanking and quick engagement. Most importantly, be creative and get yourself on the move. rows.name: Pincrediball
rows.short_description: The Automata Pinball Wizard game! YOU design the machine and the Automata Pinball Wizard plays it to get a High Score. Earn medals to advance levels and build ever more extensive machines!
rows.description_html: Pincrediball is a fun twist on the pinball game genre. You design the Pinball machine, and the Automata Pinball Wizard follows a 'Playbook' to play your design. Achieve High Scores and earn medals to advance levels. How to play Think of a 'Machine' as a 'World' with stages (or 'levels'). At each level you unlock new components to add to the Pinball machine. Place these components in the right spots on the machine, and hit 'Run Playbook' to see what score it gets you. With some tiny spoilers, here's one way to handle the Tutorial Machine's final stage: Every playbook must end by draining the ball (at the bottom of the machine) within the given time limit. If you succeed, your score will count and gets you a bronze, silver, or even gold medal if you cross a certain target. At least bronze is needed to advance a level. Going for silver and gold after bronze? Or advance to the next level? It's your choice! And you could also go back to go full completionist on a level!! What is included? Pincrediball has many features, including (but not limited to): A Tutorial Machine (a 'world') with several levels to play. Target scores (bronze, silver, gold) and a progression system, based on high scores. A multi-multi-multi-ball 'Stress Test' mode to test your setup, or just for fun! The trailer showcases all these features as well as many others. About the Development This game was created as a solo sabbatical project. You can read about the full development history on the website's devlog, and even view the source code (written for the Godot 4 engine).

rows.name: Little Keepers
rows.short_description: What are friends for if not to defend each other from mutant plants that want to hurt you? Build your enemies, destroy your defenses and restore chaos in the garden! ... Wait, it was the other way around.
rows.description_html: Little Keepers is an indie chaotic couch-coop tower defense that will put your friendship to test! Mom has been doing experiments in our garden and now the plants are attacking us! As the Little Keepers, you’ll be given the chance to gather resources, build your defenses and create the best strategy to defend your home from spooky creatures. You and your partner in crime, hand in hand against cute spooky hordes... Good Ol’ Couch Coop. Collect materials throughout the map and choose between metal or wood to give life to your creations! BUT BEWARE, some resources are too heavy to carry alone… the two of you must team up to carry them. Enjoy a balanced system with multiple options to complete levels and a difficulty curve worthy of the best strategists. In Little Keepers each game is different, and each strategy is as unique as its creator. It won't matter if you and your buddy work together as synchronized as a Swiss clock... CHAOS IS INEVITABLE! (But it's also funny so enjoy!) Step into a cute & spooky wonderworld and face together the monsters that shelter the forest. For the loners… you are not alone! Little AI will be by your side in good and bad (but mostly good, really, it’s extremely efficient!)

rows.name: Medusa VR
rows.short_description: Medusa, the Croatian word for jellyfish. Medusa VR is 10 minute solo-developed VR film. Join Russel and Zlatan - two Croatian actors in Califonia for a coffee by the canal as they discuss grief, change and loss. When on strange shores, would you swim with Medusas?
rows.description_html: A scene from an original virtual reality story by Tomis Fras. Medusa is a story about two Croatian actors, adapting to a rapidly changing industry. From acting in plays at the Croatian National Theatre to acting in motion capture suits for a major Hollywood studio. They explore themes of artistic integrity, cultural identity and learning to cope with uncertainty. In this 10 minute Room-scale VR experience, you’ll join them for a conversation over coffee at the canals of ‘A-Studios’. This piece is a solo-devoloped passion project - fully voiced and mocaped in Croatian with English subtitles. Context: this is a proof of concept for a full three Act Medusa VR Film - this scene is from Act 2 Scene 5 of Medusa. Should you be interested in ever seeing the full VR film come to life, feel free to comment in the reviews. To find out more about the behind-the-scenes of Medusa VR or see more of my work visit my website.

rows.name: It Belongs in a Museum
rows.short_description: It Belongs in a Museum is a Rogue-lite, treasure hunting, artifact collection VR story game. Join a shadow organization and help its weakened, resurrected goddess search for magic treasures to undo the curse they unleashed in procedural dungeons, tombs, lost cities, and ancient ruins.
rows.description_html: Run, don’t walk like an Egyptian to your nearest Steam store and check out It Belongs in a Museum! put on your virtual reality headset and join a secret organization that has been around for thousands of years, in a story that wouldn't sell out a block buster movie, but is JUST good enough for VR! Your task is simple: take your ample goddess companion into battle across five stages listening to her recall the story while destroying monsters with an array of weapons. Look for sparkly treasure strewn across large, small, and procedural dungeons to satisfy your need to buy much needed guns. Marvel at the lack of consistency in story telling as the plot unfolds leaving you with more questions than answers! And when all of that is finished, you can extend your gameplay experience by repeating the stages in a similar fashion to a hamster in a wheel for the sole purpose of buying virtual versions of REAL artifacts from the skeleton dealer to fill up your museum… to scratch that “I need to collect something….” Itch! So, act now! Copies are limited…. Wait… digital games aren’t limited, are they? OK screw it I’m too old for this. Features: - Multiple weapons: pistols, SMGs, assault rifles, shotguns, grenades, bow and sniper! - Enough Unity store assets flipped you’ll think it’s a gymnastics tournament! - Foul mouthed NPCs that keep it PG-13! - A “story” written in the span of weeks when time allowed, loosely based on Akkadian/ Mesopotamian mythology with a large order of plot holes and logical fallacies! - Smooth motion with no teleporting! - snap and smooth turning! - Full body IK now with glitchy arms and hands! - slow time just to make shooting look cool! now cool shooting in slow Mo does more damage! - Companion fully voiced by a REAL actress and other NPCs voiced by REAL AI! - Inconsistent pacing and level design because sometimes I just thought: “Not realistic, but it looks cool!” - Various types of enemies from skeletons, zombies, and mummies… OH MY! - Climbing on various surfaces such as walls, pyramids, and …..stairs! (Achievements not yet included. Side effects may include headache, fever, runny nose, nausea, lack of ambition, weight gain, indigestion, and priapism. Consult your doctor if you have two or more of these symptoms lasting longer than 4 hours.) In all seriousness, Thank you for reading to the end. I enjoyed putting this game together and I hope that you enjoy playing it. - CoffeeSerpent

rows.name: The Unfallens: Awakening
rows.short_description: Returning from exile underground, a shattered world awaits you. The civilization of Unfallens lies in ruins. The ruthless guardian waits to attack. Journey through remains. Awaken your true power. Reclaim what was lost. Experience challenging action boss battles in this compact, high-quality game.
rows.description_html: 'The Unfallens: Awakening' is a soul-like action-packed boss battle game where you play as a surviving member of the 'Unfallens' civilization using a ghost scythe to challenge the merciless guardians BOSS. Narrative Background A shattered world awaits you as you return home from your exile in the underground. The once-thriving civilization of the Unfallens now lies in ruins, with only ruthless guardians left to attack you. Journey through the remains of this fallen civilization, using your skills to overcome intense boss battles and uncover the truth behind the devastation. Awaken your true power, and reclaim what was lost. Challenging Action Combat The game's action combat is challenging, requiring you to master the distance of different attack movements, use dodges to correctly respond to the rich moves of the boss, and survive under the formidable enemy. Satisfying Combat Feel Feel the solid sense of the soul scythe hitting the enemy, and participate in intense combat through smooth animations, realistic sound effects, visual effects, screen shaking, and other methods. Full Support for Controllers and Keyboard and Mouse You can choose any control method suitable for you to play. Whether you prefer a keyboard and mouse or a controller, you can find your play style. Gorgeous Game Graphics The game uses high-quality graphics effects to create a unique atmosphere and characters full of details. Abuot the developers Floatonic Studio, a team of talented student developers, created 'The Unfallens: Awakening' over six months. Three students from the University of Utah led the development effort, while two students from the Berklee College of Music contributed to the game's immersive audio experience. Despite its compact content, the developers aimed to provide players with the best quality game featuring a unique and challenging boss battle experience. Through their hard work and collaboration, the team has brought this action-packed game to life for players to enjoy.

rows.name: Genting Party
rows.short_description: Genting Party is a VR social hub， loaded with a variety of free VR games, continually updated and ever-expanding!
rows.description_html: There's an island, surrounded by clouds with a pleasing landscape. But also it's a hub for fantastic exciting adventures. 【Loads of Games - Continually Updated】 Play all sorts of VR games with your pals - competitive, adventurous, team-based, chill - there's something for everyone. And we're adding more all the time! Genting Zuma Blast those colored orbs with your space gun, rookie astronaut. As you level up, things get tougher! Zombie Cave Enter the deadly cave with your team, and fight off the cheeky zombies that interrupt your adventure. Homeland Defenser As the village's last line of defense, protect your home from invaders with powerful weapons. High Noon A Western shootout - new sheriffs on the scene, gunslingers going rogue. Time for a duel in the Wild West! Heroes Unleashed Intense battles in dangerous settings. Defeat the boss in the allotted time, power up by eliminating smaller enemies, and repelling other players. Bonfire Campsite Experience the warmth and romance of a camping trip under the starry sky. Perfect for a game of Werewolf! Virus Clash Shoot those viruses with your trusty bow, send them fleeing. A fun mix of offense and defense on a colorful battlefield, full of action and fun! 【Engage in delightful social interactions, nurture pets, and build your dream home】 Have a blast socializing and creating your world in Genting Party! Socializing in the Lobby The cloud island is the perfect place to make friends, chat, and have fun. A simple high five is all it takes to add someone as a friend. Don't forget to take a group photo with the in-game camera! Lobby Mini-Games Play lots of fun games in the hall - basketball, whack-a-mole, cosmic slingshot, hoop toss, darts, dragon dance, and many more. Twice the fun with friends! Pets Experience the joy of raising pets in the cloud. Pets in Cloud Party can be taken anywhere, cared for, and nurtured into your own unique pet! Home We provide a customizable private space where you can place a wide variety of furniture and decorations, cultivate crops, and create a home that truly represents your style and tastes! -Outfits Express yourself with our colorful outfits. From cool to cute to quirky, make a stunning statement in Genting Party!

rows.name: Every Letter
rows.short_description: Write letters with your typewriter on behalf of others in this cozy single-player game. Compose everything from simple hellos to theater scripts and love letters, express each client’s emotions, and find your own meaning to letter writing.
rows.description_html: With your typewriter, write letters on behalf of others, and transform their sentiments into words in this cozy single-player letter writing game. Experience the first day of your new job as a letter writer, typing freely on your typewriter. Receive requests from clients and turn their messages and feelings into letters, from casual hellos to love letters and theater scripts. As you write, uncover intertwining stories told across multiple clients’ requests, grow accustomed to the quirks of a typewriter, and find your own meaning to letter writing. Key Features A narrative-driven, single-player game with a charming cast of characters Over a dozen possible letter requests with side stories spanning multiple requests Beautiful hand drawn art A lovingly detailed typewriter, down to the satisfying clicks and clacks (Content warning: written mention of death and grief, written mentions of food) Thanks to XtlusArt, the Locasaurus team, Lucie Teulières, Sasha Boucheron, Sarah Deville, Anabel Morales, Ōkami, Hasanh, Ayliz Yıldız, Haigang Zhou, Rafaela Fernandes, and Nhung Tran for their hard work helping make Every Letter!

rows.name: Wizardry Variants Daphne
rows.short_description: 3D Dungeon RPG The portal of despair opens again. The labyrinth calls you to destruction. Revel in the endless dangers, relish the risk, devour the rewards. Savor the risk.
rows.description_html: Wizardry Variants Daphne carries on the lineage of the classic RPG series, Wizardry. The portal to the labyrinth of despair, where even destruction is pleasure, has opened once again. ■ Story Once every 100 years, the Abyss opens. It is a curse of death that consumes the continent. A Warlock who coveted Death, devoured people and animals and enveloped the world in despair. Inheriting the power to seal the Abyss over generations, kings have continued to protect the kingdom from its curse. But now, the king has vanished, and the world is being consumed by death, moment by moment. Resistance itself is meaningless. There is naught but to perish. ■ Adventure with allies Experience an adventure of your very own with unique allies based on combinations of classes and races. ■ Difficulty with a bite Perilous traps and mighty foes await in the dungeon. Take on a high difficulty that only Wizardry can offer. ■ Cadre of renowned creators Main Character Design: Yusuke Kozaki Manga artist and illustrator; in addition to writing manga, he also does design work for anime and games, and is well known for the fine touches in his character designs. Boss Monster Design: Katsuya Terada His work, centered on manga and illustration, includes character designs video games and movies, as well as poster for theater productions. Sound: Hitoshi Sakimoto Has composed for more than 130 game titles of all genres. With their rich sound and epic scale, his scores have received tremendous support not only in Japan, but also from overseas. ■ Magnificent cast brings the fully-voiced scenario to life [English Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Morgan Cambs Pulgritte: Dev Joshi Dylanhardt: Doug Cockle Elmon: Laurence Bouvard Vernant: Christopher Ragland Pickerel: Alex Capon Leaufonde: Garrick Hagon Shagtis of Sorrow: Jay Rincon - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Beth Robb Adams, Mike Bodie, Sarah Borges, Davis Brooks, Shin-Fei Chen, Doug Cockle, Clare Corbett, Arlene Decker, Sarah Galbraith, Garrick Hagon, Arina Ii, Jules de Jongh, Dev Joshi, Samantha Kamras, Rae Lim,Elsie Lovelock, Meaghan Martin, Gianni Matragrano, Joseph May, Alexander McMorran, Eric Meyers, Sarah Pitard, Christopher Ragland, Matt Reeves, Jay Rincon, Cecily Bednar Schmidt, Kerry Shale, Martin T Sherman, Adam Sims, Ina Marie Smith, Colin Stinton, Alex Vincent, Alexandra Vincent, Glenn Wrage -- Other appearances (in alphabetical order) [Japanese Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Inori Minase Pulgritte: Yui Ishikawa Dylanhardt: Chikahiro Kobayashi Elmon: Satomi Korogi Vernant: Yoshimasa Hosoya Pickerel: Junya Enoki Leaufonde: Takaya Hashi Shagtis of Sorrow: Takehito Koyasu - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Yutaka Aoyama, Masumi Asano, Koji Ishii, Maaya Uchida, Yu Kobayashi, Tetsuo Komura, Jiro Saito, Yu Shimamura, Yoko Soumi, Shinya Takahashi, Hiroki Takahashi, Yumi Toma, Yuichi Nakamura, Romi Park, Fairouz Ai, Shinshu Fuji, Takanori Hoshino, Anna Yamaki, Aoi Yuki -- Other appearances (in Japanese alphabetical order) ■What is Wizardry? Wizardry is a computer role-playing game released in the United States in 1981 with elements such as party organizing, labyrinth exploration, monster fighting, and character development having such a tremendous impact on the various RPGs that followed, that it is often referred to as the origin of RPGs. Numerous sequels have been released, and nearly 40 years after its release, it remains a timeless masterpiece that enjoys strong popularity around the world.

There is naught but to perish. ■ Adventure with allies Experience an adventure of your very own with unique allies based on combinations of classes and races. ■ Difficulty with a bite Perilous traps and mighty foes await in the dungeon. Take on a high difficulty that only Wizardry can offer. ■ Cadre of renowned creators Main Character Design: Yusuke Kozaki Manga artist and illustrator; in addition to writing manga, he also does design work for anime and games, and is well known for the fine touches in his character designs. Boss Monster Design: Katsuya Terada His work, centered on manga and illustration, includes character designs video games and movies, as well as poster for theater productions. Sound: Hitoshi Sakimoto Has composed for more than 130 game titles of all genres. With their rich sound and epic scale, his scores have received tremendous support not only in Japan, but also from overseas. ■ Magnificent cast brings the fully-voiced scenario to life [English Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Morgan Cambs Pulgritte: Dev Joshi Dylanhardt: Doug Cockle Elmon: Laurence Bouvard Vernant: Christopher Ragland Pickerel: Alex Capon Leaufonde: Garrick Hagon Shagtis of Sorrow: Jay Rincon - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Beth Robb Adams, Mike Bodie, Sarah Borges, Davis Brooks, Shin-Fei Chen, Doug Cockle, Clare Corbett, Arlene Decker, Sarah Galbraith, Garrick Hagon, Arina Ii, Jules de Jongh, Dev Joshi, Samantha Kamras, Rae Lim,Elsie Lovelock, Meaghan Martin, Gianni Matragrano, Joseph May, Alexander McMorran, Eric Meyers, Sarah Pitard, Christopher Ragland, Matt Reeves, Jay Rincon, Cecily Bednar Schmidt, Kerry Shale, Martin T Sherman, Adam Sims, Ina Marie Smith, Colin Stinton, Alex Vincent, Alexandra Vincent, Glenn Wrage -- Other appearances (in alphabetical order) [Japanese Voice Actors] Lulunarde: Inori Minase Pulgritte: Yui Ishikawa Dylanhardt: Chikahiro Kobayashi Elmon: Satomi Korogi Vernant: Yoshimasa Hosoya Pickerel: Junya Enoki Leaufonde: Takaya Hashi Shagtis of Sorrow: Takehito Koyasu - Other Voice Actors, etc. - Yutaka Aoyama, Masumi Asano, Koji Ishii, Maaya Uchida, Yu Kobayashi, Tetsuo Komura, Jiro Saito, Yu Shimamura, Yoko Soumi, Shinya Takahashi, Hiroki Takahashi, Yumi Toma, Yuichi Nakamura, Romi Park, Fairouz Ai, Shinshu Fuji, Takanori Hoshino, Anna Yamaki, Aoi Yuki -- Other appearances (in Japanese alphabetical order) ■What is Wizardry? Wizardry is a computer role-playing game released in the United States in 1981 with elements such as party organizing, labyrinth exploration, monster fighting, and character development having such a tremendous impact on the various RPGs that followed, that it is often referred to as the origin of RPGs. Numerous sequels have been released, and nearly 40 years after its release, it remains a timeless masterpiece that enjoys strong popularity around the world.

rows.name: Wyvia: Prologue
rows.short_description: Wyvia is an open world 3D action RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Save your world from a monstrous invasion. Choose from 4 unique classes, and customize them with a robust cross-class skill system. Craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Explore dungeons full of enemies, and defeat terrifying bosses!
rows.description_html: In this prologue to the game you fill the shoes of a fresh recruit of the Mercenaries. Get your footing in the land of Wyvia and begin to unravel the mystery of the where the Wyverns have gone. Your mission is simple, find the wyverns, uncover the source of the invasion, and discover your role in saving Wyvia. Prologue Features 2 open world areas 11 locations 4 classes 2 bosses 12 enemies 21 accessories Wyvia features fun and simple combat that feels good to utilize! Whack Goopies with a huge axe or fire away with screen clearing abilities! Mix and match skills between 4 (11 in the full game) distinct classes, allocate points into stats and skills, and create a character that's really your own! Explore a variety of locations from plains, deep caves, spooky forests, and frozen wastes as you struggle against the invasion of monsters in your world and find the source of their intrusion. Use the power of Wyverns to fly, gain new abilities, augment your combat prowess and explore the world around you.

rows.name: Duel Timers
rows.short_description: Duel Timers is a split screen, local multiplayer FPS platformer. Choose your Weapon and Power-Up and begin the fight! On a vertical map, jump from tile to tile to get to or away from the enemy, or to collect ammo and health!
rows.description_html: Duel Timers is a local multiplayer FPS Platformer. Fight against a friend with On-the-Couch Local Multiplayer or through Steam Remote Play (All multiplayer requires a Bluetooth Gamepad). Jump from platform to platform on a vertical arena to avoid enemy players and the impending void! Master Jump Charging, Quick Falling, and Double Jumping to maximize your movement. Collect Ammo Boxes and Med Kits to keep the fight going! Activate Power-Ups to annoy your friends or give yourself an advantage! Duel Timers is a unique take on two classic genres! Important Note: Duel Timers requires both a Controller and Keyboard and Mouse. Player 1 will always play on Keyboard, and Player 2 will always play on Controller. This also applies for players using Remote Play Together. Remote Play Together also works across platforms, but a controller is still needed for Player 2, as is the case for all Remote Play Together games with multiple independent players.

rows.name: illum
rows.short_description: Embark on a heartwarming journey with your little light friend to solve puzzles and bring light to the mystical realm of Illum.
rows.description_html: illum welcomes you to a mystical 3D third-person adventure game, where you embark on a quest to illuminate a dormant kingdom using the power of light. AWAKEN THE SLEEPING KINGDOM Form heartwarming bonds with your light friend as you journey together to connect light gems and awaken the slumbering world of Illum. EXPLORE A POETIC, EXPANSIVE WORLD Discover the beauty and narratives embedded in Illum's atmospheric world, as you unravel its secrets of the world. EXPERIENCE A VISUALLY STUNNING AND EMOTIONAL JOURNEY Delve into an immersive and poignant adventure that weaves together striking visuals, immersive audio, and atmospheric gameplay to create a truly memorable experience. Illum was created as part of CTIN 532: Interactive Design and Production I at the University of Southern California by main developers Elsa Liu and Tianyue Gu, with audio by Raphael Almeida, Richard Wang, Eduardo Resende, and Alexander 'Gooch' Duong. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.

rows.name: Ashes to Ashes
rows.short_description: Shoot your way to vengeance as the infamous undead gunslinger Quinn del Ramo. In this weird wild west, experience a story-driven action-packed adventure with bullets, magic, and betrayal.
rows.description_html: Hex, dash, and blast your way through the mystical canyons of Gloam Country. Seek your undead revenge against the Red Wake gang for their betrayal and burying you six feet under. Discover the lore of the land through echoes of spirits long passed to assemble and remember your past. Standoff against dangerous gunslingers and teach them the meaning of fear. Key Features Harness the power of hexes to combine the elements of flame, frost, and quake to make any environment your personal playground of destruction. Aim for precise headshots to clear waves of bandits quickly before they’re able to shoot back or toss dangerous hex grenades. Travel through diverse settings to hunt down key members of the Red Wake gang in the form of epic boss battles. Seek breathtaking vistas to give respite from the onslaught of bullets. Immerse yourself in our epic original soundtrack by the talented Collin Anderson.

rows.name: Quest for the Golden Candelabra
rows.short_description: Lead a group of childhood friends in a series of difficult encounters played under the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop OGL ruleset.
rows.description_html: Quest for the Golden Candelabra is a 2D turn-based tactics game based on the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop OGL ruleset. You lead a group of four colorful characters through a series of encounters, fighting against monsters, acquiring loot and eventually -- hopefully -- recovering the ancient artifact that's the object of your quest. For an experienced player of tabletop roleplaying games, the entire game takes about 40 minutes to play through, from beginning to end. Five difficult encounters in varied locations against varied monsters Four interesting characters to play as (an honorable orc fighter, a silent rogue, a well-spoken sorcerer, and an excitable cleric) A complex OGL-based rule system which makes for strong strategic gameplay Cut straight into the gameplay This game is a cinematic experience, where you fight one combat encounter after another, and these fights are interspersed only with (voiced!) cinematic cutscenes. The game doesn't waste your time: animations are lightning fast, cutscenes skippable, and you can really focus on the engaging combat experience. Powerful rule system Each turn, you get three actions to spend on moving, attacking, casting spells, taking combat maneuvers, drinking potions and defensive or other actions. You can preview the effects and success probability of all actions before you commit and weigh your options. All combat encounters are balanced but difficult: To win the game reliably and consistently, you will need to make use of almost all of your options. Story of the Dawnsbury Four Experience the first steps of an up-and-coming party of young adventurers as they take on their first quest and attempt to recover an artifact that has once protected their beloved home town. A taste of Dawnsbury Days This game is greatly expanded upon in the follow-up game, Dawnsbury Days, which contains the content from Quest for the Golden Candelabra but also allows you to create and customize your own characters, enhances art and rules fidelity and otherwise greatly improves upon this game, and most importantly, adds additional combat encounters and additional character levels. You don't need to play this game first. Dawnsbury Days contains the full story that's contained in this game.

rows.name: G.O.M.P!
rows.short_description: G.O.M.P! is an action-packed game where you defend your farm from invaders. Compete with friends and survive wave after wave of enemies. Yeehaw!
rows.description_html: Howdy y'all! Welcome to G.O.M.P! Also called Get Off My Property, ya hear? This is the game where you play as a tough-as-nails redneck defending your farm from an endless swarm of invaders who are trying to steal your food. Grab your trusty weapon and get ready for some fast-paced action-packed gameplay that'll test your shooting skills and survival instincts. Whether you're playing solo or with your buddies, G.O.M.P! offers a rootin' tootin' good time that'll keep you on the edge of your seat. Compete against your friends to see who can rack up the highest score and become the ultimate redneck defender. But be warned, each wave of invaders gets harder and harder to defeat, so you'll need to stay on your toes and be ready for anything. With each game session lasting between 10-15 minutes, G.O.M.P! is perfect for a quick gaming break or a marathon session. So what are you waiting for? It's time to defend your farm and show those pesky invaders who's boss! Get G.O.M.P! today and get ready to blast your way through wave after wave of enemies. Yeehaw!

rows.name: Section Gamma
rows.short_description: Section Gamma is a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world for 1-4 players. It combines classic RTS elements with the strategic depth of chess. Play an exciting single-player campaign or fight alongside friends in multiplayer matches.
rows.description_html: We're lost without you! Welcome to Section Gamma , a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world where a meteorite impact has left the Earth in ruins. As a commander, you must lead your faction in a fierce battle for dominance over the valuable energy crystals discovered in Section Gamma. With limited resources and an uncertain future, you must make strategic decisions to upgrade your troops, unlock new technologies, and mine the valuable crystals to secure your place as the dominant faction in this world. But be warned, your opponents are just as determined to succeed as you are, and you'll need to stay one step ahead to emerge victorious. With turn-based action and strategy gameplay, Section Gamma offers an immersive and challenging experience for players. Whether you choose to go solo or team up with others, you'll need to use all of your cunning and tactical skills to outmaneuver your opponents and emerge as the ultimate victor. So what are you waiting for? Join the battle for dominance in Section Gamma today and prove that you have what it takes to lead your faction to victory!

rows.name: The Sinking of the Dream Chaser
rows.short_description: Servant robot Led reboots in the stern of the ship Dream Chaser, only to find he's broken and malfunctioning. His memory drives have been corrupted. He has no idea what's going on. And he needs your help to find out what happened to himself, the ship, and to his master.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the post-apocalyptic world of 'The Sinking of the Dream Chaser'! This 2D point-and-click adventure game takes you on a journey alongside Led, a servant robot with a mysterious past and a dire need for answers. As the game begins, you find Led awakening in the stern of the ship named Dream Chaser. However, something is terribly wrong. Led discovers that he is broken and malfunctioning, and his memory drives have been corrupted. Lost and confused he needs to unravel the enigma that surrounds him. In 'The Sinking of the Dream Chaser', you will embark on a quest to uncover the truth behind Led's existence, the fate of the ship, and the whereabouts of his master. The game features: Engaging Point-and-Click Gameplay: Experience the classic point-and-click mechanics as you interact with the environment, solve puzzles, and progress through the story. Enigmatic Storyline: Dive deep into an intriguing and mysterious narrative to uncover the truth. Stunning 2D Visuals: Immerse yourself in a beautifully hand-drawn world, filled with intricate details and atmospheric settings. Rich and Dynamic Soundtrack: Enjoy an original musical score that enhances the immersive atmosphere of the game. Join Led on his extraordinary adventure and become part of a compelling tale filled with twists, revelations, and a captivating world waiting to be explored. Will you be able to piece together the fragments of Led's past and unveil the secrets hidden within the ship? The answers lie in your hands.

rows.short_description: In an average town somewhere in America, a disturbance has been felt. Vivian Carmine and her badge, Nicholas, have come from the Gap Between Worlds to investigate.
rows.description_html: Vivian Carmine is an anime style visual novel featuring point and click gameplay. Something has been detected in this world which should not be here. Play as Vivian, an interdimensional investigator, and her partner Nicholas, to figure out the source of the disturbance and fix it. Meet the duo: Vivian: A young, mildly inexperienced, but competent investigator dedicated to doing what she must to ensure order between the worlds is kept. Nicholas: Vivian's badge and partner. The more experienced of the two, he is dedicated to assisting Vivian in any way he can. Features: Point and click gameplay Anime-style graphics Explore the town, ask questions, and see what information you can gather!

rows.name: Xenosis
rows.short_description: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon to escape
rows.description_html: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Your only hope for survival is to explore the temple and find a way to escape. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon along the way! EXPLORE AN ANCIENT TEMPLE FORGOTTEN BY TIME Explore an ancient temple forgotten by time. With non-linear exploration, multiple paths, and hidden secrets to uncover, Xenosis offers a personalized experience that allows players to choose their own path and play at their own pace. COMBAT AN UNFORGIVING ALIEN INFESTATION Throughout the temple, you will combat alien insectoids, mechanical defense golems and automatic temple defense systems. Xenosis has challenging enemies, platforming puzzles, and a variety of weapon upgrades to discover. EXPERIENCE A COSMIC ATMOSPHERE WITH CLASSIC METROIDVANIA GRAPHICS Immerse yourself in a cosmic temple atmosphere with brooding instrumental music and classic metroidvania graphics that capture the nostalgia of retro gaming. Xenosis was created independently by students in the University of Southern California’s games program. The game was developed by Noah Lee, Luke Todaro, Simon Burdick, Ryan Wilson, Emily Jiang, and Hudson Nguyen. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website.

rows.name: Nomad
rows.short_description: A serene first-person 3D platformer where you use a magical rope to traverse the body of a dormant ancient colossus in order to heal its wounds and awaken it once again. Embark on a relaxing journey of melancholy to rekindle one of nature's long-lost wonders.
rows.description_html: Nomad is an atmospheric first-person platformer where you embark on a relaxing journey of melancholy to rekindle one of nature’s long-lost wonders. Your goal is to climb on top of a colossi to awaken it from its eternal slumber by combining jumps and a magical rope. Climb the Collosi Use your trusty grappling hook to latch onto the collsi and propel yourself forward. Chain your grappling hook to launch yourself into the air. Explore and create your own paths up the giant. Explore nature from a new perspective Explore a magical land of enormity. Enjoy breathtaking views as you continue to rise higher and higher into the clouds. Nomad was created by Bob Wu and David Zheng as part of the University of Southern California’s Game Development class. This included a collaboration with many talented musicians at Berklee College of Music, including David Contarino, Zhengzheng Fan, Sara Maeng, Albert Wang, and Andrea Brun. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.

rows.name: Machine Heart
rows.short_description: Delve into the captivating cross-timeline puzzles of Machine Heart, and unravel the conspiracy behind a mass mind-uploading scheme.
rows.description_html: Machine Heart is a 2.5D Sci-fi Puzzle-Adventure Game featuring two interconnected storylines. You'll play as Avis, a defiant scientist hunted for her research, and Vox, a sentient robot who lost all his memory. By bringing together two storylines from two distinct eras, you'll uncover the striking secret behind the fate of humanity. Throughout your journey, you will learn to solve challenging cross-timeline puzzles with a mix of stealth, bike chasing, and exploration. Will you be able to find out what truly happened to all of mankind? TRAVEL BETWEEN TWO ERAS The two storylines are set in two distinct times and spaces. Carefully explore the dystopian Cyberpunk city of Avis's storyline, or immerse yourself in the post-apocalyptic ruins of Vox's storyline. Switch between storylines at any time and discover the surprising connection between the two protagonists. EXPERIENCE THRILLING STEALTH GAMEPLAY When you play as Avis, the scientist, you'll need to evade hostile patrols by staying out of their spotlight. Hurry up and get to your lab as soon as you can because your research might decide the fate of humanity. CHALLENGE YOUR WITS WITH UNIQUE PUZZLES Solve unique and challenging puzzles throughout your journey. Some require careful observation of the world, while others test your ability to connect various clues you've gathered. Can you piece together the solutions and the true story behind the game? Machine Heart was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Advanced Game Project (AGP). For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, check out USC Games website, linked to the right.

rows.name: The Stoevi Curse
rows.short_description: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.
rows.description_html: The Stoevi Curse is a chilling first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria, where you must protect your farm and save your family from a nightmarish creature. You are Dimo Stoev, a single father determined to protect his farm and rescue his children from the creature that terrorizes the land after nightfall. Drawing from Bulgarian folklore, The Stoevi Curse immerses players in a chilling tale of survival and family. RESOURCE AND TIME MANAGEMENT Strategically manage your scarce resources and beat the clock to return home before the sun sets, when the Bulgarian bogeyman comes out to hunt. STEALTH AND EVASION Stay low and quiet as you navigate your farm, avoiding the sinister creature that lurks in the shadows, ready to strike when you least expect it. SURVIVAL AND FAMILY Withstand the relentless nightmare plaguing your land each day, and summon the strength to save your family from the clutches of the dreadful Stoevi Curse. The Stoevi Curse was created as part of CTWR 410: Game Narrative Workshop by developers Colin Spiridonov, Austin Fuad, Tian Yang, M. Mo, Simon Burdick, Max Hall, and Anthony Sabatino. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website.

rows.name: The Flying Feathers
rows.short_description: Nia accidentally goes into her best friend—Alice's past, the only way to escape and go back to the real world is to help Alice to solve all her problems. When you can go back to the past, do you want to do everything you can to save what you've lost?
rows.description_html: The player will play the role of Nia, who accidentally enters Alice's past memories on the train to her best friend Alice's graduation ceremony. The only way to escape the illusion and return to the real world is to help Alice solve all the problems she is currently facing. Examine every clue around you to understand the current story and dilemma that Alice is facing. Collect clues and solve puzzles to help Alice solve her troubles or fulfill her current wishes. Experience the journey and learn about what happened to Alice. During this process, Nia gradually learned about everything Alice had gone through. If she could go back to the past and start all over again, would there still be any regrets left? The Flying Feathers is a first-person narrative game, which combines interactive experience and cutscenes to immerse players in the story.

rows.name: Hare 136
rows.short_description: Drag adorable coin-riding rabbits and slide them across the board. Solve engaging cozy puzzles. Help our little fluffy friends get back to their home!
rows.description_html: No matter if rabbit or hare, it's always puzzling! After enjoying a whole day playing outside, it's time to go home. And there's no time to waste, be clever and try to do it in the minimum number of moves! Hare 136 is a simple and relaxing but increasingly challenging sliding puzzle game where you find the best path to move rabbits across the board. You can choose between the two available game modes: 'Slider' where you try to get one of the rabbits back into their den, and 'Sower' where you try to get the rabbits go through every tile to seed the whole map. Key features: Two game modes : Choose between Slider and Sower , where you use the sliding mechanic to reach different goals. 136 unique levels for each mode : Those are 272 unique levels in total! Daily puzzle mode : If 272 levels weren't enough, you can come back tomorrow to get a completely new random level. Cute hand-drawn artstyle : The rabbits are cute and fluffy, so are the puzzles. An amazing soundtrack : If you ever wondered how rabbits and puzzles sound, this is how. Steam achievements : A digital trophy for all the puzzles you are able to solve. Slide rabbits, Solve Puzzles!

rows.name: Axecutioners
rows.short_description: A minimal-input fighting game to determine who is the greatest Axecutioner of them all! Your huge, unwieldy axe ensures that each of your attacks are slow yet powerful, meaning you need to think and strategize before your next attack to claim victory over your opponent!
rows.description_html: Axecutioners is a 2D fighting game in which players must determine which axecutioner reigns supreme! In a kingdom dying of boredom, the ruling king took it upon himself to find his subjects (and himself) a new source of entertainment. Enter the colosseum, with its new (totally willing) participants, all of the prisoners in the land! However, as the kingdom runs out of prisoners to pit against one another, the duty of entertaining the masses has fallen to the king's loyal executioners. Now at the mercy of a local necromancer (to ensure the fights never end), the executioners, armed with their larger-than-life axes, are now tasked with slaying each other in an endless cycle to see who can be spared being brought back from death once again! In Axecutioners you play as an axecutioner fighting for their life for the entertainment of the king, the kingdom, and the necromancer! Utilize your low, mid, and high attacks in rock-paper-scissors style combat. However, be careful; even though you are an absolutely yoked fighter, your axe is quite large and unwieldy, meaning your attacks are powerful but slow! This means you need to be very intentional with each attack, or else your opponent will win the favor of your audience! Additionally, pick up the crown each round to empower your attacks! While it won't make you hit any harder (it is just a crown after all), it will give you the extra ability to cleave your opponents in half if you land the killing blow! Impress the audience (and your friends) by showing the other axecutioner who's boss!

rows.name: Yappie! Knockout
rows.short_description: You can play with up to 24 players simultaneously across 13 levels. It's time to call your friends and use your running, jumping, and other skills to win in Yappie!
rows.description_html: The game features up to 24 players Competing in a series of mini-games that take place in a colorful and chaotic world filled with traps and obstacles. The objective of the game is to be the last player standing after completing each round and avoiding elimination by falling off the edge of the platform, being knocked out by obstacles, or failing to complete the mini-game withinthe given time limit. • Supports up to 24 players at once, matching players over the internet • Requires skill and fast reflexes, while remaining fun and entertaining • Tracks and obstacles are randomly generated, making each game unique • Easy to learn and play with simple controls such as jumping and pushing • Includes various game modes like race, team-based, survival, and more Download Yappie now and experience the fun!
