rows.name: The Monster War
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic journey as a knight in a fantasy war. Experience Tower Defense, Side Scroller and Casual Puzzle modes all in one thrilling adventure. Defend the kingdom from the monster invasion, push back the threat, and conquer their bases of operations to emerge victorious from the war!
rows.description_html: This is my first game, created in within a limited timeframe and minimal budget, which is why it is not fully polished and uses many free assets. Every aspect of this game reflects a labor of love. It is my hope that you will enjoy it for what it is, and be able to see my vision and the potential of what it could be. Welcome to The Monster War This game combines 3 game modes into 1 exciting and unique experience, bringing to life the heroic exploits of Lyonel Cooper, a valiant knight from the pages of 'A Tale of Destiny' (my first book). Play as our hero on a quest to protect the kingdom from a relentless onslaught of monstrous invaders. Starting in the Side Scroller mode, immersive yourself in adventure across a landscape filled with danger. Push back the monstrous threat with combat and exploration, but beware—run out of time and the monster war will come to your front door. If you do not win the Side Scroller mode, you are sent to the front lines of Tower Defense mode. Lead the battle against waves of enemies as you fortify the castle's defenses and thwart the advancing horde of goblins, orcs and trolls. If you do manage to locate the monster's base in the side scroller mode, you must win the Casual Puzzle mode, to determine the fate of the kingdom. Launch catapults and dismantle their base piece by piece. Failure here will bring you back to the Side Scroller mode, requiring you to locate their nearest stronghold again, but victory will bring an end to the war! Join the battle in The Monster War to become a part of this epic tale!

rows.name: Creeping Deck: Pharaoh's Curse Prologue
rows.short_description: Creeping Deck is a strategic roguelite deck-builder with RPG elements. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Upgrade, and unlock new skills, options, and artifacts to protect all of Egypt!
rows.description_html: Join now the early access! SUBSCRIBE TO THE NEWSLETTER About the Game The prologue only gives you access to the first 3 temples Embark on a journey through Ancient Egypt as you conquer dungeons and face mythological creatures. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Uncover hidden treasures, and discover powerful artifacts, potions, and epic cards, upgrade, unlock new skills and options in order to protect all of Egypt! More than 100 cards available to build your deck Face up to 10+ type of enemies: Giants, Zombies, Impious and more. Boss fights! You'll encounter 1 boss per dungeon Upgrade your character, increase HP or energy level, unlock rest options and more in the dungeons! Unlock definitive upgrades for your character in the God's Lair Start your run by choosing a set of initial cards with a random artifact Each battle unlocks new cards and artifacts for you to use in your deck Open chests to find new loot such as artifacts, potions or epic cards! Creeping Deck is the first collaboration of Tavrox Games (Overboss, Neurodeck) and Miju Games (Planet crafters), two indie game studios originating from the same city in the south of France, joining forces to create challenging and strategic experiences through gaming!

rows.name: Fursona Festival
rows.short_description: Wander into the carnival of a giant magical dragon lady, where nobody ever leaves unchanged! Answer an extensive list of questions disguised as mini games as you explore the carnival grounds to discover what animal spirit lives inside you.
rows.description_html: Ever wonder what animal your personality matches best? This game let's you answer an extensive list of questions in the form of a point-and-click adventure/visual novel. The game will analyze you over 200+ personality questions, determining what Jungian archetype best suits you, and the related animal based on historical symbolism. A great game for streamers to connect with their audience by answering a bunch of quirky or insightful questions about what drives them. It's also a wonderful experience for anyone curious about anthropomorphization or the furry fandom: find out what animal you're most like, risk free! Plus, you're guided along on your journey by a 9ft tall dragon lady! Pretty neat!

rows.name: Octodad (Student Edition)
rows.short_description: You are Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family!
rows.description_html: (This is the original free student project. The fully complete Octodad: Dadliest Catch can also be purchased on Steam.) Octodad is a third person adventure game about destruction, deception, and fatherhood. The player controls Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family. The player controls Octodad like a marionette, dragging his arms and legs around while his body flops along. The player’s goals are often simple household chores made difficult and interesting by the flailing, tenuous control they have over Octodad’s body. Being an octopus also has its strengths. Octodad can slip through tight spaces, grab objects with his suckers, and knock things around with tremendous strength. But if the player does things too out-of-the-ordinary, Octodad’s family will grow suspicious and realize what he really is. If they do, it’s game over for Octodad! FEATURES: 6 levels full of comedic failure! 3 family members to deceive! Roughly 35-45 minutes of gameplay! One very non-canonical ending! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Octodad: Student Edition is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! This is the game that started it all! Octodad was made before the founding of Young Horses by a group of students at DePaul University. Our goal was to enter the Independent Games Festival in 2010 (we did enter, but we didn't win). Octodad made a big enough splash that we decided to take our chances and start a company to develop a commercial sequel! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

rows.name: Your World VR
rows.short_description: The ultimate VR building game! Build just about anything you can imagine. Build obstacle courses, dungeons, custom npc's. There are many items to choose from that are all customizable. Share and experience other worlds through the Steam Workshop.
rows.description_html: MAIN FEATURES Avatar customization Many items that can be placed anywhere All items can be made any size All items can be recolored Items can be made climbable All items can be left frozen or made to be affected by physics Place traps, enemies, obstacles, and much more Import your own models Share and try community made maps using Steam Workshop WHAT WILL YOU BUILD Use your imagination to build Your World anyway you want. You build the landscape and everything in it. Build a giant obstacle course to try and conquer with traps, enemies, and even a boss that gains new abilities as its weakened, or anything else you could imagine. Use the npc builder to create custom made npc's from any items you choose to make a truly unique companion. All progress can be saved and shared through the Steam Workshop. Join the discord for tips , help, or to share or find community made worlds

rows.name: Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure
rows.short_description: A free-to-play demo for a turn based RPG. Explore the world and fight challenging battles. Play fun mini games. Gather food and cook it.
rows.description_html: A free-to-play turn based RPG that serves as a short demo. It is a fair gauge if you as a player may or may not want to pick up the full games.  The main story is a short series of quests to help Anri recover an artifact. Meet interesting people. Recruit new party members. Learn about your party members and the region you are exploring. Explore the world and fight challenging turn-based battles. Repeatable dungeons with harvesting and chest nodes that reset. Play fun mini games. Gather food and cook it. Designed with widescreen monitors and laptops in mind In addition to the base game, we have the following DLCs available: Optimization DLCs: a free download for Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure and one for Interstellar and it is intended to be used on lower end operating systems. The other DLCs are are effectively 2 games and 1 big expansion pack in a trench coat. Luminous Skies: The Pilgrimage: A standalone game set prior to the events in A Short Adventure and Horizons. Luminous Skies: Horizons: an add-on for A Short Adventure. It adds a many new quests, new encounters, new overworld zones, secrets, weapons and armors, and new party members. We hope to add additional content on a regular basis. Mainland and new world access has opened up for more exploration. If The Pilgrimage is a standalone game, Horizons is a standalone expansion pack. Luminous Skies: Interstellar. Another standalone game, this time set in a Sci-Fi setting. Explore many worlds and contend with the Solar Regime and their plots to conquer all of known space. Please refer to our announcements in the community section for further details on updates. In some ways, these games have more in common with games of the 1980s or 1990s than those of the current year. What are you waiting for? It's all out there for you to find and experience for yourself. We do not use A.I. in our products.

rows.name: World Capitals Quizzer
rows.short_description: Guess capitals, flags, countries and geography in this fun and educational trivia quiz. Learn and play your way to becoming a geography master!
rows.description_html: Test your knowledge of world capitals, countries, flags and geography in this fun and educational trivia game! World Capitals Quizzer has entertained millions of players worldwide. Whether you are a beginner or a geography expert, this game helps you learn, play, and improve your world knowledge while having fun. Learn the world through play Explore every corner of the globe with quiz modes covering world capitals, countries, flags, landmarks, currencies and regions. Play short quizzes to sharpen your skills, or tackle harder challenges to become a true geography master. Features Guess all the world’s capitals and see how many you know Identify countries and their national flags Explore landmarks, famous regions and currencies Learn about national animals, flowers, anthems and historical figures Multiple quiz modes: capitals, flags, states/regions and more Fun, relaxing, and suitable for all ages Challenge your friends or test yourself solo Regular updates with new quizzes and features Why choose World Capitals Quizzer? Perfect for students who want to study geography Great for quiz and trivia fans who enjoy testing their knowledge Ideal for travellers curious about new countries and cultures Entertaining and educational for players of all ages World Capitals Quizzer is more than a quiz – it’s a learning journey. Improve your knowledge of world capitals, flags and countries while enjoying an engaging and relaxing gameplay experience. Play free today and join the global community of trivia fans discovering the world one question at a time!

rows.name: Pixel Madness
rows.short_description: Pixel Madness is a simple 2D clicker game where your main goal is to level up/craft/fight bosses and complete different achievements.
rows.description_html: - About the game - Pixel Madness - is simple 2D clicker game but with cool key elements that will help you achieve your goals and make your gameplay more fun. - You can - CRAFTING - use your workbench to craft different materials from different resources. TRANSMUTATIONS - use your 'Magic knowledge' to splice essences into something very cool. DIFFERENT WORLDS - visit different locations to obtain better resources with more XP. BOSS FIGHTING - fight different bosses to earn XP and maybe you can even get a good reward after beating the boss. WORLDS - use the unknown power to travel between different worlds to farm even more different resources. ACHIEVEMENTS - complete goals and unlock cool looking pixel images called achievements. - More... - Our biggest goal is to make a really good community that is really interested in what we are doing and also wants to be a part of the game development! We are going to make a lot of updates in the future with new mechanics/bosses/locations and more, so don't forget to join our official discord server to know about all our announcements & updates!

rows.name: Cavera - The Island of Apes
rows.short_description: Cavera - Island of Apes: top vacation spot for Apes and degens. Socialize, dance with up to 99 others. Explore, swim, chill on this multiplayer game.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Cavera - The Island of Apes, a top-rated vacation destination for all those who identify as degens or Apes. Immerse yourself in a cinematic island setting and enjoy socializing with your Ape friends while grooving to music in a spacious house. Whether you're looking for a chill chat or a thrilling adventure, Cavera has it all. Join up to 99 other players in this exclusive multiplayer game, where you can connect with like-minded individuals and engage in exciting activities. Take a dip in the crystal clear waters, or explore the island's lush terrain. With endless possibilities and a vibrant community, Cavera offers an unforgettable experience that you won't want to miss. So what are you waiting for? Come and join the fun at Cavera - The Island of Apes.

rows.description_html: Game Features Shooting and Rebounding In this game, players can use blocking to rebound enemy bullets. Perfect rebounds will temporarily disable enemy attacks. Jumping Use different routes to reach the destination. Cute and Healing Pixel Art Style The use of pixel art style for the paper character is not just to save art resources! Game Objective Defeat the final boss to open the exit of the maze.

rows.name: It gets so lonely here
rows.short_description: A yandere yuri visual novel with a fairytale theme. Can you escape from your mysterious pursuer?
rows.description_html: You are running through a forest. It is late at night and the sky is as black as pitch. The trees which surround you, jutting out of the earth like eerie monuments to a foreign god, are blotting out most of the moonlight. You do not know where you are going. You have no map; no route; no plan. You have no desire, as you run, save to escape. You cannot let yourself be caught. All you can do is run, on and on and on... But, despite all of your hard work, your best efforts will, invariably, be in vain. It’s already too late for you. After all... You’ll never be able to escape from me. About 50k words of text (approx 2-3 hours of reading) A branching story with several choices 800x600 resolution for that old-timey aesthetic Custom character artwork A custom soundtrack which comes bundled with the VN Three(?) pretty girls who will love you to death Three exciting ways to die!!! An archly amused narrator who berates you for your poor life decisions Cannibalism ♥

rows.name: Fish Collector: Aquarium Story
rows.short_description: Run your own aquarium and evolve fish into mermaids! Fish Collector is a relaxing aquarium tycoon game that blends fish farming, idle resource production, match-3, and merge gameplay to build your fantasy ocean world.
rows.description_html: Raise fish, evolve them into mermaids, and become an aquarium tycoon! Build your dream aquarium in this relaxing simulation game! Raise fish and watch them evolve into beautiful mermaids. Manage resources, decorate your aquatic paradise, and grow your aquarium business. Collect over 100 mermaids and sea creatures through relaxing gameplay. Enjoy fun match-3 puzzles and merge challenges as you expand your collection! Raise, Collect, and Relax Enjoy the most relaxing fish collecting experience! Watch adorable sea creatures swim peacefully in your aquariums - from tiny clownfish to mysterious pirate lanternfish. Each fish has its own personality and charm, creating a soothing atmosphere perfect for unwinding after a long day. Evolve Fish into Legendary Mermaids Witness the magic as your ordinary fish transform into stunning mermaids! Through careful nurturing and special care, watch your aquatic friends undergo amazing evolutionary changes. Collect dozens of unique mermaid species, each with their own beautiful design and special abilities. Customize Your Aquarium World Design every corner of your aquarium paradise! Choose from hundreds of decorative items - palm trees, coral reefs, guide shelves, and themed decorations. Create different zones for different creatures, build walking paths for visitors, and craft the perfect aquatic environment that reflects your style. Play Smart, Be a Tycoon Run a successful aquarium business! Harvest raw materials, develop visitor products, and manage your resources wisely. Balance your fish care, decoration budget, and souvenir production to build the world's most profitable aquarium. ※ Game Features: ► Collect 100+ mermaids and sea animals ► Raise fish and evolve them into mythical mermaids ► Decorate and customize your aquarium with hundreds of themed items ► Craft souvenirs and trade rare items ► Enjoy diverse mini-games, including match-3 and merge puzzles ► Team up with friends and compete in global leaderboards

rows.name: Carnage Cuisine
rows.short_description: You are a banana with a gun! Blast your way through hordes of evil cooks and machines in this survivors-like, action rogue-lite. Collect loot, unlock powerful skills, rally your food allies, and lead them to victory! If you fail, upgrade your character and skills, and rise stronger for the next run!
rows.description_html: Carnage Cuisine is a survivors-like, action rogue-lite experience where food fights back! Prepare for a culinary revolution as you embark on a thrilling adventure to fight against evil cooks, liberate oppressed foods and become their hero. 🔥 Survivors-like: Dive into survivors-like bullet hell mechanics. Choose the upgrades that suit your play style. Create unique builds. Beat the game by killing the boss. 💎 Meta progression: Collect purple gem things, the strange currency of this gastronomical uprising, and utilize them to upgrade your character and attack skills. 🍌 Go bananas: Take on the role of a courageous warrior, Banana, fighting alongside the rebellious edibles. More playable characters are on the way! 🍽️ Boss battles: Face off against formidable bosses (currently there is only one boss though, more on the way) who serve as the ultimate test of your culinary prowess. Show them who's the true master of the kitchen as you outmaneuver them and deliver the final blow to claim victory. 🛠️ Early access: Join the revolution in the early access phase and witness the game's evolution firsthand. Stay tuned for upcoming updates as we plan to introduce new playable characters, bosses, skills, weapons, game modes, and maps. Carnage Cuisine is the battle for food liberation that you've been craving. Can you restore freedom to the oppressed edibles? The time has come to unleash your skills and savor the taste of victory!

rows.name: Project Hardline
rows.short_description: Project Hardline is a party first person shooter game where two teams fight to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. With every round a team faces, they will come back with better gear. This game is perfect for a party of friends.
rows.description_html: Project Hardline is a first person shooter game where two teams of mercenaries fight to be the last ones left or to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. Every time a team loses a round, they come back better equipped with better weapons, gear and equipment. This game is perfect for a party of casual shooter players, with tight physics based gun mechanics and fast paced round. NOTE: This game is developed nearly entirely by one person, content updates may be slow and sporadic and bugs may still exist due to the limited resources available to testing the game. Bug reports are highly appreciated and any considerable bugs and errors will be patched immediately.

rows.name: Dwarfender
rows.short_description: Dwarfender is an action-strategy fantasy game in third person, set traps to repel waves of angry golems ! Take control of Rigolain, a dwarf-engineer, ready for anything in the heat of battle !
rows.description_html: Dwarfender is an action-strategy fantasy game taking place in the dwarven caves, take control of a powerful dwarf named Rigolain ! Use your blunderbuss and a set of traps to defeat your stone foes and steal their crystals ! Use these crystals to build more traps and huge towers to make a perfect stronghold ! **Features :** • 3 unique levels ! Fight waves of enemies ! • 5 kinds of traps including 2 types of towers ! • 3 types of golems to destroy ! • Find out why Rigolain cares so much about crystals ! A game made by students over the course of three months.

rows.name: Wandering Skies
rows.short_description: Navigate through the Sky Lands and uncover its secrets to restore their lost harmony. In this first person platformer, use your abilities to reach the end of each level. Observation and skill are the keys to success !
rows.description_html: Somewhere, high in the sky, resides a forgotten and magical place. An elusive paradise filled with secrets, wonders and adventures... Wandering skies, a student game, is a first-person platformer adventure taking place in the desolate Sky Lands, a fantastic world that has been corrupted and destroyed by a strange magic. Observe your surrondings and use your abilities to reach the portals in each level, bringing you closer and closer from your main objective : the harmony crystal. Jump, slide and run across the various platforms and dangerous gaps. Activate buttons and magic mechanisms to progress through each zone. Use your two obtainable shooting powers to create acesses and uncover secrets. Five hidden gems hiding in each levels, plus one super-secret collectible ! A total of 7 levels to discover and explore

rows.name: Everlasting Abundance
rows.short_description: A greedy AAA game company rules the world with an iron fist. You must join a faction of independent rebels and defeat the tyranny of Everlasting Abundance. Can you succeed? Is it all just a pointless dream?
rows.description_html: Everlasting Abundance (the game) is set in a dystopian future where a AAA game company controls everything and pushes its predatory practices like loot boxes and forced gambling into the everyday lives of people. You play as an orphan teenager, and along with your little sister Kiyoko and your childhood friend Mirai , you will need to break out of your daily routine and join a faction of independent rebels called the Circle in order to try to defeat Everlasting Abundance (the regime). However, ushering in a new era of freedom isn't as easy as 1-2-3. Conflicts will arise. Tears will be shed. Meat & potatoes will be eaten. And the flowers will grow back... Probably. This game is 3 to 4 hours long, has 4 different endings and an original soundtrack (heavily influenced by classic JRPG music). It also has a Story Mode if you want to breeze through the combat and mostly experience the narrative. Pride & Accomplishment!

rows.short_description: STRAFTAT is a 1v1/2v2 ONLINE first person SHOOTER with quick rounds in over 350 MAPS ; Including all WEAPONS, proximity chat and 4 players FFA.
rows.description_html: Straftat is a free to play, online, proximity chat enabled, 1v1, 2v2 or FFA first person shooter taking place in a wide variety of maps with a large choice of firearms, explosives and melee weapons. A match is composed of a number rounds. A round ends when only one survivor remains. Each round takes place in a different environment. Straftat features over 350 arenas to play in. Each map contains its own set of weapons. Pick them up and hunt down your opponent. Unlock hats and fashion ware through unique challenges. Keyboard and Gamepad supported

rows.name: Raw Nerve
rows.short_description: Raw Nerve is a slippery, small driving sandbox in a psychedelic galaxy. Take a casual rip or speedrun to the summit for a top time. It’s one truckin' awesome ride.
rows.description_html: Drive this truckin’ weird and wild world of jumps, traverses and winding ascents. Uncover artifacts, help build the sonic landscape, conquer the summit, and try to clock the fastest time. • There is no traction control in space! A sandbox of hidden paths, cutty jumps and sonic artifacts. • Discover shortcuts to clock the best time to the finish line. • Use checkpoints as your guide or just go exploring. • It’s a vibrant and psychedelic drive.

rows.name: Nature is hungry
rows.short_description: After a plane crash, fight for survival against deadly predators. Gather essential supplies to stay alive and uncover the mystery behind two long-dead skeletons and the crocodiles' presence. In this horror FPS game, the night is your greatest enemy. Can you survive until dawn and solve the mystery?
rows.description_html: Welcome to a world of darkness and danger, where survival is key and enemies lurk around every corner. You find yourself stranded in the middle of nowhere after a plane crash, with nothing but predators for company. Crocodiles, bears, and wolves are just a few of the deadly creatures that you must face in each round. Armed with an array of weapons and the ability to scavenge for health packs, ammo, and batteries, you must fight your way through the darkness and uncover the mystery behind two long-dead skeletons. But beware, for the darkness is your greatest enemy. With limited visibility, you must use your wits and your resources to stay alive. The batteries you collect are essential to lighting up the environment, revealing the horrors that await you in the shadows. This game is not for the faint of heart, as it combines elements of horror with the intense action of a first-person shooter. With a storyline that unfolds as you progress, you will be on the edge of your seat as you uncover the truth about the mysterious skeletons and the reason behind the deadly predators. This game is the ultimate test of survival, as you fight to stay alive and uncover the truth in a world that wants you dead. Are you ready to take on the challenge? The predators are waiting, and time is running out.

rows.name: Bifröst: Through the Realms
rows.short_description: Bifröst: Through the Realms is a fast-paced multidimensional platformer with Norse and Sci-Fi themes. Use the power of the Bifröst to save the realms from Ragnarök.
rows.description_html: Bifröst is a fast-paced, multi-dimensional platformer with Norse and Sci-Fi themes. Race through different Realms using the Bifrost; a device capable of opening Rifts and Bridges to alternate worlds. Master the unique effects of these abilities to battle and platform your way through the different realms! Utilize 6 unique abilities to explore the realms! Explore three massive levels, containing two realms each! Highly replayable, try to beat your best time! Treat your ears to an epic musical score! Feast your eyes on Bifröst's vivid and stylized art! And always listen to Heimdall, your AI companion! Good luck, Valkyrie!

rows.name: Derpy Dino
rows.short_description: Unleash your primal roar! Conquer the different stages in Adventure Mode, where different enemies will try to stop you. Or test your limits in Endless Mode, where the sky is literally falling! Meteors are crashing down, and the action never stops. Can you beat your highscore?
rows.description_html: Get ready for a dino-mite adventure! Derpy Dino is a 2D survival game where you play as a lovable, yet hapless dinosaur trying to survive in a world filled with danger. In Survival Mode, dodge falling meteors and see how long you can last. The timer will keep track of your progress. But that's not all! In the brand new Adventure Mode you can take on five levels filled with dangerous enemies and delicious fruits! With its pixel art graphics and catchy chiptune soundtrack, Derpy Dino is a nostalgic treat for gamers of all ages. And with two exciting game modes to choose from, you'll never get bored. So grab your keyboard and mouse or controller, and get ready to join the Derpy Dino adventure! Can you survive the meteor showers and defeat the enemies to become the ultimate Derpy Dino champion?

Mushroom marauders have invaded the greenhouse, targeting the garden goddess and choking the life out of her children. It is your duty to traverse the expanse of the greenhouse and slay these invaders.

rows.name: Mirage
rows.short_description: Jump through mystical desert ruins and shoot the bird-like guards to steal their treasure.
rows.description_html: Mirage is a 2D action platformer-shooter game that transports you to a surreal desert world. You play as Ono, a cat; and Vio, his fireball-shooting snake friend. Together, they're on the hunt for treasure! Traverse mystical desert architecture to explore the world of Mirage across three game levels. Each takes place in a different time, with beautiful art direction and hand-drawn animation! Maneuver your way through difficult jumps and treacherous hazards to reach the end of the ruins. Along the way, you'll encounter strange bird-like creatures called Gobs, who guard the treasure with their lives. Watch out—the Gobs will be angry if you take it, and you'll have to make a daring escape! 2D shooting Platforming action Hand-drawn character animation Beautiful art direction An exciting ending escape sequence to every level This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Operation Space Force
rows.short_description: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. Explore weapon customization and different heroes, your base, fight against enemies, and experience different game modes.
rows.description_html: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. KEY FEATURES With 6+ unique characters on the roster, experiment with their speed and power. Select the one who shall deem you victorious in the arena. There are four slots: Two to choose from between 13+ guns, one to select from 2+ grenades, and one for a knife. Weapon customization allows you to change certain parts of the gun and offers a variety of skins. Roam in 4+ different maps, where two maps will stay the same, while three maps will change every time a new match is loaded. Join a team and play up to 5+ game modes. Host a game, have the freedom to decide the gameplay, and create. Joining a game is perfectly optional as well.

rows.name: Pens: The Freeware Collection
rows.short_description: A complete compilation of all four freely released games in the PENS series, each featuring drastically different gameplay styles. Action, comedy, drama and pure ridiculousness await in this cartoony story!
rows.description_html: Pens: Ballad of the Erasers was not the beginning! There was actually some stuff that happened before then, and here it is in all it's glory! For the low, low price of absolutely nothing, witness the complete story leading up to Pens: Ballad of the Erasers in PENS: THE FREEWARE COLLECTION! For the first time, all four freeware titles in the PENS series - the original PENS, its follow-ups PENS 2: REVENGE OF THE SPRINGS and PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR, and the prequel FALL OF THE SPRINGS - have been bundled into one handy dandy package. A weaving tale of tragedy, cartoonish epicness and mutated living office equipment awaits! One download, four complete games, four completely different gameplay styles and all for the price of a breath of fresh air? Why, that's madness I say! And wild and wacky madness is what you will find in this ridiculous dramedy story! What do I get in PENS: THE FREEWARE COLLECTION? Why, all of this! -- PENS With the war already in full swing, fight as a determined green Pen against the army of the red Pens, shooting your way through six enemy-infested levels and battling against six wildly varied bosses. -- PENS 2: REVENGE OF THE SPRINGS The Springs have invaded and the war continues! Pilot your weapons-toting UFO through five chapter-divided missions against the Springs. Then, once you're done, play through as the Springs and experience their side of the story! -- PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR - COMPLETE EDITION Why is PENS 3 the only one to feature 'Complete Edition' in it's title? Why, that's because it's chock-full of add-on content, of course! Explore and blast through thirteen hilarious story missions in a massive side-scrolling open world in the main campaign, stop a zombie apocalypse in PENS 3: NIGHTS OF DEATH, see the setup for Pens: Ballad of the Erasers in PENS 3: BLEAK OMEN, fight against experiments-gone-wrong in PENS 3: TALE OF THE ACCURSED and take a couple of quick trips to the moon in PENS 3: TO THE MOON and PENS 3: LUNAR PLAGUES! -- FALL OF THE SPRINGS The entire story makes no secret that the reason behind everything that happens is because, just over a century prior, the Springs lost their world in a civil war. Explore a side-scrolling open world and witness first-hand the final days of the Springs' home planet in the eight story missions of FALL OF THE SPRINGS, then find out what happened to the leader of the Spring rebellion in the years between then and now in FALL OF THE SPRINGS: AURORA'S GREAT ESCAPE. ** PENS 3: TIDES OF WAR - COMPLETE EDITION is the only game in the Collection to be fully voice acted. All other games make use only of written text.

rows.name: Invasion: Family Ties
rows.short_description: Rick travels to Indiana to visit his mother, but during his stay, unexpected events occur that lead him on a thrilling adventure. However, little does he know that a major threat looms on the horizon that will change everything. Will Rick be able to save the day and protect those he cares about?
rows.description_html: Rick travels to Indiana to visit his mother, but during his stay, unexpected events occur that lead him on a thrilling adventure. As Rick navigates through the challenges of his visit, he uncovers a series of mysterious occurrences that keep him on his toes. Along the way, he must overcome obstacles and solve puzzles to ensure his visit goes smoothly. However, little does he know that a major threat looms on the horizon that will change everything. Will Rick be able to save the day and protect those he cares about? Invasion: Family Ties is a third-person adventure game where you play as Rick. Set in Indiana, you'll need to explore your surroundings to uncover the source of a mysterious and unusual event.

rows.name: Rite as Rain
rows.short_description: A magical open world RPG, where your choices matter!
rows.description_html: The weather is yours to control... how will you use it? Rite as Rain is a whimsical turn-based open world game where you, Eira, are tasked with stopping elemental spirts gone awry. Solve puzzles, help villagers, and decide the fate of your enemies. Will you choose the light, or let darkness consume you? Use your weather magic to solve puzzles and interact with your environment. Explore the world to discover clues to solve puzzles. Find magical potions to help you survive dangerous battles with elemental enemies. Explore the vast villages within Estelia, and interact with a variety of villagers! When battle is required, use your magic to fight enemies using turn-based combat with your familiar, Looney the cat! (This is a student game made by UCF undergrad students! We're open to feedback so we can continue to improve.)

rows.name: (val)iant: or, val's guide to having a broken vag
rows.short_description: (val)iant is a single-player narrative game about pelvic pain. play as val, a nonbinary college student struggling with their relationship to their body, as well as their relationship with sex. this game is fundamentally about how we as a society learn (or don't learn) about sex.

rows.name: Kessler Syndrome
rows.short_description: Alone in orbit with a corpse and no way to reach Earth, play as an astronaut who must keep a defunct space station aloft. Maintain the onboard systems, deal with the constant threat of space junk, and navigate the dark halls in zero-gravity. Day by day more systems fail, and the void draws closer.
rows.description_html: Alone in orbit with the corpse of your only colleague and no way to reach Earth, play as a weary astronaut who must struggle to keep a defunct space station in orbit. While aboard the Damocles space station you must maintain the various systems aboard, deal with the ever-present threat of great storms of space junk, and navigate the dark halls in zero-gravity. Day by day more and more systems fail, and the cold of the void draws ever closer. Kessler Syndrome is a student made slow-burn horror game, developed at Champlain College as a capstone project. We are excited to showcase what we have been working on this semester to any and all who may be interested! Key features: 6 degrees of freedom allows you to float through the space station with ease Check your task log and navigate your way through the ship to pick up tools and complete tasks Maintain the ship for a week to achieve a climactic conclusion.

rows.name: Save King
rows.short_description: Carefully adjust the force so that the princess does not fall down from the maze to reach the 11th floor. Traps installed throughout the maze interfere with the princess, so it is easy to go to the beginning floor if you do something wrong.
rows.description_html: The king of the peaceful kingdom was kidnapped by Demon. On behalf of the sick prince, the princess leaves to save the king. Can the princess who followed daemon who ran away through the door that appeared in a small pond on a hill near the kingdom save the king. The purpose of the game is to save the king from Daemon's prison located on the 11th floor. This game belongs to a casual 3d puzzle. But it's never easy. How to play: 1. Press and drag the left mouse button. 2. The princess changes direction with the dragged direction. 3. The length of the dragged line is the force that indicates how far the princess will run. 4. If you have decided on the direction and force, release the left mouse button. The princess is running. 5. The princess jumps when you press the space bar. The game features: 1. Each floor is in the form of a maze, but the maze consists of only roads without walls. It means that when the princess gets off the road, she immediately falls down. So strength control is the most important thing. 2. There is nothing on the first floor except the road, but the road moving from the second floor and about 10 kinds of traps from the third floor interfere with the princess. 3. If you fell from a maze above the second floor, you should fall down and go up again from where you arrived. If you are not good at controlling your strength, you will fall down a lot, so you will increase your patience and calmness. 4. From the second floor, a skull-shaped bullet flies toward the princess from time to time. If it is shot, the Hp gauge located in the upper left Ui will be reduced, and if it is shot 10 times, the princess will die. 5. From the 2nd floor, in addition to skull bullets, Hp recovery bullets fly in the direction of the player. After 10 shots, you will recover 100%. 6. Traps function like getting off the road, moving to the starting point, stabbing with a thorn, or sending it downstairs. Traps also appear on the road two in a row. 7. Time flowing through the ui in the upper left affects the ranking. Other than that, there is no stress or disadvantage to the player. 8. When you reach the final floor on the 11th floor, don't worry if you fall down because you're inexperienced in controlling your strength. It starts again at the starting point on the 11th floor. The developer is niceguy. 9. Get the key on the road on the final floor before saving the king on the final floor. It's necessary to destroy a prison. Now you have the key and save the king!

rows.name: Elementcore Revelations: Journey Prologue
rows.short_description: The balance of the elements has been disrupted and long-disappeared monsters have reappeared. The youths have embarked on a dangerous journey. Join them and unravel the mystery of the royal family that has lasted for thousands of years and restore this broken world!
rows.description_html: Elementcore Revelations：Journey Prologue is a casual RPG game that features idle leveling, synthesis and upgrading of hundreds of weapons, and a variety of treasure chests to discover. Players can choose a character and embark on a journey to visit familiar and unfamiliar locations, upgrade their character's equipment, configure talents, defeat monsters along the way, and discover the stories of each girl's journey, while uncovering the reasons behind the increasingly chaotic world. As the first game in the Elementcore Revelations , Journey Prologue portrays the personal stories of the characters that appear in this game series. This game will allow players to experience the gameplay of one of the main characters in a free format, while other characters will gradually appear as DLC. Different characters will have different skills, talents, applicable weapons, storylines, and more. It is hoped that this character will provide players with a clearer understanding of the gameplay and a greater curiosity about the world within the game. Suggestion: We highly discourage the use of cheat engine (CE) to expedite game progression, as it can lead to the occurrence of numerous unforeseen bugs. QQ：341513903 ，E-mail：liuliyule@163.com

rows.name: MailPop
rows.short_description: A Clicker where you will try to send an email while getting rid of annoying pop-ups that will flood your screen. The perfect warm-up to hone your aim between games! Have you ever wanted to punch those annoying ads in the face? NOW YOU CAN!
rows.description_html: Mail Pop is a game where you’ll have to smash your keyboard to write an email while hilarious and chaotic pop-ups try to drive you insane. Destroy those ads with a furious click, type as fast as you can, and reach ultimate enlightenment and relaxation in Mail Pop. Will you attack with the keyboard or defend with the mouse? Decide which strategy works best in each of the 4 brand-new levels of Mail Pop. Discover new types of pop-ups... and DESTROY THEM. Get the highest multiplier in the whole office. Mash out your emails and send them before time runs out. Unlock all achievements before carpal tunnel claims another victim and your coworkers start envying you at the coffee machine. You can now enjoy the incredibly relaxing Mail Pop experience in English! Type those emails in multiple languages! (Well… two, to be exact.)

rows.name: Phantom Blaze
rows.short_description: Phantom Blaze sets the stage for an adrenaline-fueled odyssey, drawing inspiration from fearless commanders worldwide. This pulse-pounding game pushes players to the edge as they scavenge for cutting-edge weaponry, seizing every opportunity for victory while battling to stay alive.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the immersive world of Phantom Blaze, an extraordinary online multiplayer gaming experience developed and published by the visionary team at ZONK STUDIOS PTE. LTD. Phantom Blaze is more than just a game; it's a tribute to the unyielding bravery and remarkable instincts of Indian Commanders. An Epic Tribute: Phantom Blaze stands as a testament to the valor and audacity exhibited by Indian Commanders throughout history. It's a game that pays homage to their unwavering commitment to protecting their homeland and their unquenchable thirst for victory. The Ultimate Battlefield: In Phantom Blaze, players find themselves thrust into a dynamic and ever-evolving battlefield. Your mission: Seek out the most potent weapons and equipment, master the art of strategy, and seize every opportunity to triumph while safeguarding your own survival. Unparalleled Excitement: This game isn't just about adrenaline-pumping action; it's a journey of heart-pounding excitement. Every decision counts, every move shapes your destiny, and every victory is a testament to your prowess. Key Features: Tactical Gameplay: Engage in strategic warfare, where every choice you make can tip the scales of victory. Weaponry Galore: Explore a vast array of weapons and equipment to customize your gameplay and enhance your combat abilities. Multiplayer Mayhem: Join forces with friends or go head-to-head with players from around the globe in epic multiplayer battles(Coming Soon). Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in the breathtaking landscapes and meticulously designed environments that bring Phantom Blaze's world to life. Commander's Legacy: Learn from the tactics and strategies of legendary Indian Commanders and use their wisdom to outsmart your opponents. Phantom Blaze isn't just a game; it's an ode to courage, an adventure of survival, and a celebration of the warrior spirit. Are you ready to step onto the battlefield and forge your own legend? Join us in the world of Phantom Blaze and become a part of gaming history. *Please Note:- This is a Beta Version of Phantom Blaze , This Beta Version doesn't represent the final quality of the product. Thanks for your understanding and support, Team Phantom Blaze.

rows.name: Little Postman
rows.short_description: Puzzle game where you rotate islands to find your way around different archipelagos.
rows.description_html: You are a little postman exploring different archipelagos. You move safely tile by tile on a grid-based environment. You will find some magical triggers that allow you to rotate small islands. By modifying the landscape, do your best to create a path towards the end of each level and give letters to the inhabitants ! Each of the nine levels propose a unic puzzle around this concept.

rows.name: Starcade FACTIONS
rows.short_description: Starcade FACTIONS is a turn-based strategy game that puts you in command of epic, fast-paced ship battles, perfect for quick bursts of action.
rows.description_html: Embark on a strategic journey in Starcade FACTIONS —where every move could be your path to victory or defeat! Every turn offers up to three powerful actions: Build new ships for your fleet... Play a powerful Action card... Move ships and launch attacks... Your mission is clear: capture the enemy’s Flagship and claim your victory! In this fast-paced, turn-based strategy game, you're not just a commander; you're the mastermind behind epic space battles. Engage in quick, action-packed games that last just about 5 minutes, perfect for when you need a quick burst of high-octane action. With 10 unique ship types like Fighters, Medics, and Builders, you’ll uncover layers of strategy that are easy to grasp but challenging to master. The simplicity of the controls means anyone can jump in, but only the best can truly dominate. As a passion project from a solo developer, Starcade FACTIONS is brimming with potential. Your support can help it reach new heights—download it for free and join the growing community today!

rows.name: Arobynn: Below The Surface
rows.short_description: Finally, the multiplayer VR dungeon crawler we've all been waiting for! Complete with floor bosses, traps, and a glowing immersive environment. Dive into the depths, upgrade your gear, and work your way farther into the unknown dark below the surface!
rows.description_html: Finally, the multiplayer VR dungeon crawler we've all been waiting for! Complete with floor bosses, traps, and a glowing immersive environment. What can I say except you're welcome! Whether you like it or not, share it on social media to help the genre grow. Game Story Most of the living word and the surface has been destroyed during the Geocubic wars of the past. A devastating technology that crystalizes structures was weaponized and used heavily during the wars leading to the fall and collapse. For centuries, the surface remained barren and hope for the future was lost, but beneath the desolation life began to return. Your adventure begins exploring the extent of Geocubic crystallization Below The Surface. Loot for materials, upgrade your weapons and armors, and work your way farther into the depths. Gameplay -Light from the surface effects the faces of Geocubic crystal and can be used to navigate. [Clever players may also spot braille lettering] -Find the weapons and playstyle that works best for you. -A well timed dash can make all the difference.

rows.name: NeoCars
rows.short_description: Original and immersive cyberpunk driving game. Use your drifts to make your lines deadly for your opponents. Solo, local cooperative and online multiplayer modes. Play on a team with players of the same or different colors. Immersive soundtrack. Unique and stimulating gaming experience.
rows.description_html: ℕ𝕖𝕠ℂ𝕒𝕣𝕤 Is a cyberpunk driving game that offers an immersive experience in a futuristic universe. The game's concept is based on creating lines every time your car moves. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 𝔻𝕣𝕚𝕗𝕥 And you must skillfully drift to make these lines deadly for anything that passes through them. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 𝕊𝕒𝕦𝕥 𝕋𝕖𝕞𝕡𝕠𝕣𝕖𝕝𝕤 Unless you use your car's ability to perform temporal jumps to teleport and avoid the lines. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The game offers solo, local cooperative, and online multiplayer modes for up to four players. An interesting feature of the game is the ball system with colors, which adds a competitive and strategic dimension. You must avoid players of a different color to avoid being eliminated, but you can also choose to team up with players wearing the same color. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This also: In summary, NeoCars is an exciting and original cyberpunk driving game that offers an immersive experience in a futuristic universe. With its concept of deadly lines and its color-coded ball system, NeoCars provides a stimulating gameplay experience that will satisfy players who are keen on competition and strategy.

rows.name: You Have 10 Seconds (2023)
rows.short_description: A fast paced platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given 10 seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying. 25 areas with unique level design mechanics to learn.
rows.description_html: You Have 10 Seconds is a fast paced arcade platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given ten seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying before time runs out. There are 25 Areas which each introduce a new mechanic to the gameplay, eventually creating extremely complex and difficult levels. Master collecting keys, swimming through acid, dodging motion sensors, time traveling, swapping dimensions, and so much more to clear areas as quickly as possible. - Get a rating at the end of each Area depending on how well you performed! Steam achievements for S ranks! - Unlock Steam achievements for completing certain challenges and finding secrets! - A gauntlet of never ending randomized levels from the main game and more, how long can you survive? - Removes all transitions between worlds and menu interactions for seamless gameplay for speedrunners. - Some surprises hidden away that may not be found for a long, long time.

rows.name: Amalgamare
rows.short_description: In this 2D horror adventure game, play as the protagonist May as she is siphoned into a horrific new world on Halloween night. In a brave feat of love for her cat Matilda, May embarks on a gruesome journey through an otherworldly environment where she must utilize her wits to find her way out.
rows.description_html: Amalgamare is an episodic indie horror experience with more episodes to come! Controls: WASD or ARROW KEYS to move Z to interact ENTER to talk with NPCs SPACEBAR to Attack In Episode 1 of Amalgamare: In this 2D horror adventure game, play as the protagonist May as she is siphoned into a horrific new world on Halloween night. In a brave feat of love for her cat Matilda, May embarks on a mysterious and gruesome journey through an otherworldly environment where she must utilize clues and interactions to find her way out. Control May’s journey from a mysterious sewer maze into a grotesque mansion while simultaneously unraveling the secretes within. EXPLORE your environment INTERACT with objects and entities FIGHT off monsters DISCOVER the secrets of the mansion Character Descriptions: Often the target of her friend’s ridicule, May is a reclusive young girl who finds solace mainly in her cat Matilda whom she found 6 months prior to the start of the story in a dumpster. May had a humble upbringing with her friends Bea and Max, but as they grew older, her friends began to look down on her for being different and coming from a lower-class family. Bea is a young girl who treats May poorly despite being very close with her from a young age and has grown to exploit their friendship as they have gotten older. After her father got a better-paying job, Bea’s family moved away from May’s neighborhood and began to ditch May for a more popular crowd. Max becomes friends with May and Bea later in their friendship but teams up against May when it comes to ridiculing her for her introverted nature. He is a hotheaded and privileged individual who often does not understand the discrepancies between his situation and the circumstances of others.

rows.name: Hotel Manibella
rows.short_description: Get ready for the ultimate horror puzzle game! Check into Hotel Manibella for a spine-chilling experience. With a unique art style and secret storyline, journey through the floors of a haunted hotel, with each level becoming scarier and more intense.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Hotel Manibella, the ultimate horror puzzle game that will leave you trembling with fear and excitement! Step inside the doors of this eerie hotel and prepare to be transported to a world of terror and mystery. As you make your way through the dimly lit hallways, you'll encounter all sorts of creepy creatures and spine-tingling puzzles. Each floor of the hotel brings new challenges and scares, and the deeper you go, the more intense the horror becomes. But don't worry, you're not alone in this terrifying journey. You'll have to use your wits and skills to uncover the secret storyline behind the hotel's dark history and find a way out before it's too late. What sets Hotel Manibella apart from other horror games is its unique art style, which perfectly captures the unsettling atmosphere of the hotel. Every detail, from the creaking floors to the ghastly monsters, has been meticulously crafted to give you an immersive and unforgettable horror experience. So if you're looking for a truly spine-chilling adventure, Hotel Manibella is the game for you. Buy it now and brace yourself for a journey into the unknown. But be warned, once you enter the doors of this hotel, there's no turning back! Initially, you find yourself confined in a room. Upon successfully escaping the first room, you advance to the next level by means of an elevator. In the subsequent level of the building, you must navigate through a maze to elude another monster. The pattern repeats in the following levels where you must also evade a monster and continue to progress.

rows.name: Traitorous Trek
rows.short_description: Welcome to Traitorous Trek ! Immerse yourself in a universe teeming with deception, betrayal, and nail-biting tension. As a member of an interstellar fleet, your mission is to unravel the hidden shadows lurking within, thwart the conspirators' plans, and safeguard the future of humanity.
rows.description_html: As a party game, we recommend playing with friends at a LAN party or online via voice chat. The game requires one player to host, and supports 4 to 12 people playing at the same time. The Astronaut Objective: Complete all missions or discover all traitors! If all traitors are expelled, or if all missions are completed, the astronaut wins! Astronauts need to complete a series of tasks on the spacecraft, including repairing equipment, cleaning the room, navigation control and so on. Missions help astronauts earn victory points, but also let others know what they're up to, making it easier to deduce the traitor's identity. Astronauts need to respond quickly to neutralize the traitor's sabotage. The ghost after the death of the astronaut can still continue to carry out the task assigned to him, and strive for victory for the astronaut camp. The Traitor Objective: Eliminate the crew or destroy the spaceship! If the number of traitors is greater than or equal to the number of astronauts, the traitors win! Traitors need to sabotage the ship undercover, killing the crew and framing bystanders, causing confusion and suspicion. Traitors can pretend to perform missions to hide their identities, but they also need to avoid being discovered by others. Emergency Meeting When the player walks near the corpse or the emergency meeting button, they can press the report button to call the entire astronauts for an emergency meeting. At this time, the player can tell who he suspects to be a traitor and what information he has. Traitors must try to prove their innocence, or accuse the other crew. A vote can be held in the meeting, and the result of the vote will determine whether to expel a player. The ejected player will be immediately thrown out of the airlock.

rows.name: Grand Tanks: WW2 Tank Games
rows.short_description: The game combines the two best sides of gameplay: part from a serious tank simulator and part from exciting and fast arcade battles. Millions of players from all over the world are fighting on the best representatives of tank equipment of the Second World War.
rows.description_html: Battle of Legendary Tanks Get into the spirit World War II and plunge into realistic 3D tank online battles in the game Grand Tanks! Brave tankers, get ready for an interesting game where strategy and the power of combat vehicles decide everything. A combination of genres Grand Tanks is not just a tank game, it is a combination of such popular genres as action, shooter, arcade and strategy. Show your strategic abilities in exciting online battles where every shot can be decisive. rows.name: Antbassador
rows.short_description: Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident!
rows.description_html: Today is the day The Antbassador will come, to speak words of peace with Her Majesty Queen Antoinette IV. The Kingdom of Antopia has finally grown accustomed to a life without war, and its people are willing to forge an alliance with their one-time foe. If The Antbassador is good and kind, he might well see their worlds connected. Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. His massive bulk makes him strong but unwieldy, and if you're not careful you're liable to squish your tiny hosts! You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident! CONTROLS: Move the mouse to push yourself here and there. Click the mouse to curl your finger. FEATURES: 5 minutes of fumblecore finger fun! Dozens of NPCs to avoid squishing! Reused assets from Octodad: Dadliest Catch! One climactic duel for the kingdom! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Antbassador is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! Back in 2014 while freshly finished with Dadliest Catch, a portion of the Young Horses team decided to participate in the Ludum Dare game jam #30. The theme for the jam was 'Connected Worlds', which we interpreted fairly loosely. Over the course of 72 hours, we conceived and developed Antbassador using the Horsepower engine. To our delight, Antbassador took first place in the jam, scoring highly in innovation, humor, and fun! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

rows.name: Mencia. A never was tale.
rows.short_description: Mencia. A never was tale, is a styled rogue-like, 2D platform, in which you will have to face agains an invasion of cute aliens using the properties a magic sword will give you. Let's go!
rows.description_html: Mencia. A never was tale is a rogue like 2D platforms desing to be difficult. This game tells us about Mencia's story, as well as Pinchur. In the Late Middle Age, Pinchur, the protective magic sword of the reign, searchs desperately for a brave and strong man who is capable of facing a long lasting battle againts an alien invasion which have destroyed everything that were on their way. The only person alive in the whole reign is Mencia, a little girl who spends her time in taking care of animals and harvesting the crops, she is the chosen one, by process of elimination, like the saviour of the reign. Guided by the magic sword, not by own will, Mencia will have to make her way through 4 levels, helped by the teletransportation power of the sword, facing all kind of different traps and aliens who have the intention of turning everything in front of them into squares until reaching their leader. Also 'squared', of course. Breath in, Mencia. You can do it. You will be able to play 'Mencia: A never was tale' with not only keyboard and mouse, but controller as well. The controls are simple, jump, attack, throw the sword and teleport next to it, but the speedness and need to combine these movements will make this game a challenge out of it. ¡Careful! If you turn into a square you must start over again. This game has been developed by Timber Films in colaboration with the students of the 3D Animation, Games and Interactive Enviroments grade of the Higher Vocational Training of Camara de Comercio de Sevilla Center.

rows.name: Edge of Grief
rows.short_description: Edge of Grief is a 2D action platforming game about restoring a dark world to its former glory. It combines discovering deep emotions and an action platform experience as you become the ‘hero’ unveiling the truth inside as you take another step closer to atonement
rows.description_html: Edge of Grief is a 2D action platforming game about restoring a dark world to its former glory. It combines discovering deep emotions and an action platform experience as you become the ‘hero’ unveiling the truth inside as you take another step closer to atonement. Hack and slash or utilize your magic to kill enemies and progress through the world. If fighting is not your style utilize movement and dashing mechanics to weasel your way around opponents. Integrated within the game is a speedrun system that keeps track of your current time on a level. Tyrannical Studios developed this project as a passion project over the course of a university semester. We hope that you will be able to play through our game and give us relevant feedback. Thanks for your time.

rows.name: Sweetland Slumber Party
rows.short_description: Ready, Set, Slumberparty! Play as one of the many pajama-clad characters as they try to wake up on time for school!
rows.description_html: After a night of a sugar-fueled tv marathon, a group of friends fall into a deep slumber and find themselves in a strange dream world. Jump, climb, and explore as you work with your friends (or against them) to complete puzzles and reach the end. Help the Familiars along the way, collect, trading cards, and zipline through multiple levels in order to hit the alarm clock and make it to the bus on time! - Embark on a journey with up to three of your friends as you (sugar) rush your way though an exciting 3D Platform puzzle game. Press buttons, gather tasty snacks, unlock the adorable familiars, and zipline through an exciting adventure! CO-OP fun! - Invite up to 3 of your friends to help (or hinder) your progress! (While we don't endorse pushing your friends off a cliff, we cannot deny it's very funny) Friend or Foe? - Battle it out in our competitive modes in a race to the finish! Wake up on time! - Run through the levels and slam the alarm clock buzzer to wake yourself up in time for the bus!

rows.name: FFFL: Brutalball Manager
rows.short_description: FFFL: Brutalball Manager is a Franchise Management Simulation game, based mostly on American Football in a Fantasy setting. Take full control of the entire league. Tons of customization, deep stat tracking and unique rules.
rows.description_html: Join the Discord About the Game The FFFL is a Franchise Management Simulation game, based mostly on American Football in a Fantasy setting. The goal is to create a game that’s fun to watch and manage with lots of complexity and stat tracking. After decades of hobby programming, I decided to finally release one of my games to the public following all of support from the Legend Bowl community for the Legend Bowl Franchise Mod I created. This game will remain FREE. I made FFFL: Brutalball Manager for myself and family. We've played many seasons together online, and I just want to share the fun. There are no plans for microtransactions, just a Supporter Pack for those that want some extra races and other goodies. Primary Features: 8 v 8 football, players play both sides of the ball Fantasy races: Orcs, elves, dwarves etc. 14 Base and 10 DLC Races with over 70 variants! True Simulations: Simulated games use the exact same engine as games watched at normal speed Total control of all teams: You can assign AI to manage any aspect of the game at any time. This also allows for Multiplayer Hot Seat and Multiplayer Streaming Leagues. Works with Steam Remote Play. Franchise Features: draft, unique off-season free agency, in season events, end of season awards, league records, career stat tracking, Hall of Fame Players have hidden personality traits that influence weekly events and free agency Moddable: In game Team and Player Editor (84 teams already included in the game), Import your own logos, Game variables moddable in game, History, Coach and Schedule file that is fully moddable Why Fantasy Setting? Stories and personalities are an important part of management sims With most sports franchise games it is difficult to connect to all of the players in the league - often there is little to distinguish players beside numbers and a few facial features. Fantasy races make for quicker connections and associations with the players, immediately giving them a bit more personality. Also, adding things like player death is more fitting in a cartoon fantasy setting. This also makes it easier to let go of American football conventions allowing for more rule innovations. The driving goal of this game is for the off-season and game play to foster stories and memories. Coupled with internally consistent stats and recording of major events each league should generate an interesting history. Example stories shared by beta testers: 'Had a funny moment in a game earlier, in a blood thirsty sort of a way. One of my players killed an opponent who had previously spent multiple All-Pro seasons with my club before parting ways with us in the previous off-season. A pretty brutal way to treat a former team mate who left in free agency!' 'The Championship game was 4-4 after 100 plays and it was WILD! Four of my starters were injured including the league MVP. I had a little goblin come off the bench who hadn't played a down all year, only for him to spark the winning touchdown drive. We scored the walk-off title clinching TD 20 plays deep in OT' 'I'm currently in the midst of a truly brutal season! We're 1-5 having made it to the championship game last season and have lost to four teams with a worse overall rating. I've had three starters killed including my star player, a two time league MVP. I'm looking forward to a very high draft pick and a lower team salary at least!'

rows.name: Triad Ball
rows.short_description: In NeoFuturistTown, anarchy reigns. The underworld barons have taken control and are fighting for territory. To put an end to these confrontations, a brilliant inventor proposed to settle the conflicts by triad matches. A sport created by this man of science.
rows.description_html: Warning: 2 gamepads are required to play. In the city of NeoFuturistTown anarchy reigns. The big barons of the underworld have taken control of the city and have been fighting for many years over the territories through internal wars. To put an end to these confrontations in the middle of the street, a brilliant inventor proposed to settle the conflicts by triad ball matches. A sport created by this man of science. To do this, he created impulse suits that attracted opponents and allowed them to propel themselves on balls of energy. The goal of the game was to score 5 goals to the opposing camp to win the conflict. Since that day, no more confrontations took place in the street... In triad ball, a student game, the players compete in 1 vs 1 in side view - You must score 5 goals to win the game. - Players can propel themselves on the energy balls present on the field and attract their opponents. - Hit the ball to change its direction - Teleport to get back to the cages - Jump and double jump and move around the field (Students Game)

rows.name: ADDRESS1
rows.short_description: 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world.
rows.description_html: Overview 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world. PreStory She has lost her precious memory. She is heading to the facility where all the records are stored. She seeks that precious memory ...... Whatever the cost...... Circumstances The robots guarding the facility [Canaria] were scheduled to perform a 'military exercise in preparation for an attack on the facility by a foreign enemy'. The robots were divided into two groups ,the attackers and the defenders, and they conducted military exercises and collected the data obtained from the exercises. The matrix AI would build more advanced robots and the operational AI would formulate more advanced strategies. The each of the attackers and defenders developed on their own. ...How many exercises did it take for an exercise to become so fierce that it could no longer be called a exercise? Main Character Appearance Her appearance can only be described as a humanoid robot, but it is unclear whether she is a robot from the start or a human who received cyborgisation surgery in order to adapt to the harsh environment, as seen in [the unchosen humans] after [Jocelyn]. To assume that she was a robot from the start, she has some aspects that would not lead you to believe that she was a robot, and to assume that she was originally human, she has some aspects that would not lead you to believe that she was human. It is considered to be a female or female-typed robot due to its female-like facial features. Her entire body is made up of parts that are clearly mismatched (mainly for weapons equipment), so it is thought that a number of combat-use cyborgisation surgeries have been carried out. She is missing parts of her memory and is not sure whether the name Penryn is her real name. She uses this name [Penryn] because she barely remembers 'being taught to call herself [Penryn] that for convenience'. Due to this lack of memory, it is also unclear whether she is a robot or a human being who has undergone cyborgisation surgery. Her hair is silver in color, but this is thought to be a result of decolourisation of the blonde hair. In fact, blonde hair is also found on the inner hair of the head, which is less affected by the outside world. She wears a green shirt jacket and a navy blue skirt. These are thought to be linked to her identity, but details are unknown. It is thought that these may relate to missing memories. Weapons She uses modified weapons from [comedians] who have been shot down in past military exercises. One particular weapon is the large sword held in both her hands, which can neutralise [Comedian]'s energy weapon and barrier, and converts them into energy material. She uses these two large swords as a way of either attacking or defending. She easily swings two large swords single-handedly, which are not appropriate for her body size, and the fact that she does not even lose her balance is thought to be a result of combat-use cyborgification. Origin Unknown. miscellaneous Height: 152.2 cm Weight: 158 kg Features Game is made up of total of 5+α levels. Genre is shoot'em up, but the combat style is mainly close combat with large sword slashes. Stage-clear style that makes it easy to try again even if you fail. An adventurous story is unlocked as you progress stages. 'HOW TO PLAY' which is a basic operation guide. 'PRACTICE ROOM' where the player can freely control their character.

One particular weapon is the large sword held in both her hands, which can neutralise [Comedian]'s energy weapon and barrier, and converts them into energy material. She uses these two large swords as a way of either attacking or defending. She easily swings two large swords single-handedly, which are not appropriate for her body size, and the fact that she does not even lose her balance is thought to be a result of combat-use cyborgification. Origin Unknown. miscellaneous Height: 152.2 cm Weight: 158 kg Features Game is made up of total of 5+α levels. Genre is shoot'em up, but the combat style is mainly close combat with large sword slashes. Stage-clear style that makes it easy to try again even if you fail. An adventurous story is unlocked as you progress stages. 'HOW TO PLAY' which is a basic operation guide. 'PRACTICE ROOM' where the player can freely control their character.

rows.name: Snakedate
rows.short_description: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection! When the Charmr app pops up, you'll see a potential date. If you think they're compatible, swipe right and go find them in the club. Be warned, you'll abandon your current date if you have one! Every successful date is worth a certain Charmr Score based on compatibility. High score dates will need more coils around them to be satisfied. Relationships today are about volume, so get as high a score as you can! CONTROLS: Left Mouse (Left Arrow, A) Turn left, Swipe left on Charmr Right Mouse (Right Arrow, D) Turn Right, Swipe right on Charmr Middle Mouse (Escape, Space, S) Pause/Unpause FEATURES: Physics-based speed-dating arcade action! 11 lonely horses to date! Theoretically infinite replayability! Also an infinitely long snake (no relation to the snake from Snake)! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? Snakedate is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! Back in 2015 we took a break from developing Bugsnax to try our hooves at Ludum Dare game jam #34. The two themes for the jam were 'Two Button Controls' and 'Growing'. Over a hectic 72 hours, we developed Snakedate using the Horsepower engine. It was a modest success, scoring third in the humor category for the jam! So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

rows.name: Blood of a Demon
rows.short_description: You have woken up inside of an escape room, however, you are not by yourself in here, for a demon lies inside of these rooms waiting for your arrival. Can you escape? 5 rooms, 1 escape.
rows.description_html: BLOOD OF A DEMON is a horror escape room game where you get entangled in a supernatural plot of revenge causing you to mysteriously wake up in an escape room. But beware, if you think you are alone in here, think again because you are not. A demon lies in the rooms waiting for your presence and will not let you out easily. This game contains 5 rooms for you to try and escape. But even when freed, your job is not over yet. SEE NO EVIL The demon is invisible, however, you have a radar to help you, use it wisely. HEAR NO EVIL The demon is completely silent, you can not hear it so be careful. SPEAK NO EVIL The plushie wants to help you but it can not speak, it can only whistle.

rows.name: Slime Knight
rows.short_description: Use an extendable slime arm to “dissolve”, punch, grab, and throw enemies in order to save your slime brethren and navigate through the decrepit insides of an ancient Worm in this top-down hoard battler.
rows.description_html: You are a humble slime that has recently found refuge for you and your family in a small village. Everything seemed peaceful...until a gigantic wurm, thought to be a myth, emerges from the deep underground and devours the entire civilization in one enormous gulp! Separated from your family, you awaken inside the beast's maw, and discover the corpse of a knight wearing a suit of armor. After imbuing the corpse with your slimy essence, you are able to deftly maneuver around the hostile creatures that lurk around you, as well as fight back with your stretchy, toxic appendages! Your family must be deeper inside the belly of this beast. Will you be able to fight your way through and rescue them before it's too late? Take Control of Slime Knight! The slightest touch of your gooey essence will damage almost anything it touches. Use this to your advantage and take enemies by surprise by stretching your arm out, and whipping it in their direction! Swing, Punch, Grab, Throw, Survive! Your extendable arm is deceptively simple, but offers you a bevy of tools to handle a variety of situations. Swing your arm through hordes of enemies to damage them en masse. Punch creatures out of your way with your first. Or, grab them and throw them at their allies to really stir some chaos! Use it to its full extent to tackle any challenge that comes your way! Devour the Devoured As a slime, you have one more trick up your sleeve that could turn the tides of battle. If you deal enough damage to an enemy while it is clutched in your gooey fist, you can finish them off by devouring them completely. Doing so will grant you unique abilities that could help get you out of a desparate situation. Different enemies grant different abilities when devoured, so be sure to experiment and plan your targets strategically!
