rows.name: Sol: Last Light
rows.short_description: Sol: Last Light is a third-person, action-adventure RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world. Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness energy from the sun and battle against robots on your journey up the mountain to find your captured sister. Made by students at Full Sail University.
rows.description_html: Experience the action-packed gameplay of SOL: Last Light. A third-person action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world. Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness the energy of the sun and battle against robots as you climb higher up the mountain to find your captured sister. Play through 5 unique levels as you unlock key abilities to defeat enemies. Uncover the secrets of this shattered world and find clues that will lead you toward saving your sister. “The world is scarred from the sins of the past. The Sun has dimmed darker than ever recorded, lowering the atmosphere of Earth to apocalyptic conditions. Humans now roam the Wastes of what was the North American continent as groups of nomads, scavenging the landscape for any means of survival.” - John Black IV

Cast spells, brew potions, and team up with other players to take on epic quests and battles. With regular updates and events, the excitement never ends.

Launching first with 16 main characters, each with different traits, skills, powers and abilities, the MagicCraft world is completely scalable, built to gradually expand from a MOBA game into a complex and challenging massively multiplayer metaverse experience. Prepare to embark on a thrilling adventure in a world of magic and wonder. Cast spells, brew potions, and team up with other players to take on epic quests and battles. With regular updates and events, the excitement never ends.

rows.name: Byte Wars
rows.short_description: Byte Wars is a strategic top-down rocket shooter where every shot counts. Take control of a spacecraft, rotate to aim, and launch a single rocket at a time, carefully navigating the pull of nearby planets that warp your trajectory in real time.
rows.description_html: Byte Wars is a strategic top-down rocket shooter where every shot counts. Take control of a spacecraft, rotate to aim, and launch a single rocket at a time, carefully navigating the pull of nearby planets that warp your trajectory in real time. Players pilot a ship and fire one rocket at a time, requiring careful aim, as gravity from nearby planets dynamically alters rocket trajectories. Think before you shoot: accuracy are the keys to victory. 🛰️ Key Features: Online Multiplayer – Compete in real-time Elimination and Team Deathmatch modes Gravity Mechanics – Plan your rockets around planetary fields that curve and twist their paths Player Progression – Earn score and climb the leaderboard Customization – Equip your ship with visual cosmetics and power-ups for a personal edge Byte Wars offers a unique, thoughtful twist on arcade shooting action.

rows.name: My Life of Repayment
rows.short_description: If you don't work, you will eat dirt! To pay off your loans, you will take on various jobs. Make pancakes, perform archery, and operate a space drone! Enjoy a changeable work experience in your busy life!
rows.description_html: My Life of Repayment is a simulation game with debt repayment as the core. The player will play the role of a cat who has just graduated from college, working around to pay off debts. Manage finances, time and physical state Players need to properly allocate time and money, replenish vigor, saturation and mood after work, and repay debts regularly. Use the remaining money to buy food, or items that can improve your work efficiency. Diverse work experience Archery Performer: physical simulation gameplay that emphasizes operation Drone Operator: A roguelite TD Pancake Cook: cooking simulation with reaction capability + time management

rows.name: 2023: Alien Bugs Invade Earth
rows.short_description: Why are alien insectoids invading Earth in 2023? This narrative driven 2D shooter pits you against a seemingly hopeless battle against the invading Insectoids. How will you (and Earth) manage to survive? What hidden technological, historical, and spiritual secrets will you discover as a result?
rows.description_html: ***************************************** ***IMPORTANT UPDATE ABOUT THIS GAME*** ***************************************** NEWEST UPDATE: new content is arriving! Look for 2024: Aliens Are Coming This game currently uses the Unity game engine. Due to Unity's recent behavior at the corporate level, development on this game is halted until it can be ported to a new game engine. This is a massive undertaking that will not happen quickly, but it must be done. Much more content is planned, but the release of new content will be delayed until 2024 because of this. (If you're reading this after 2024, then a new game has been released in a different engine) ***************************************** ***************************************** ** Based on the Kindle novel: '2023: Alien Bugs Invade Earth' ** A threat is brewing on the outer reaches of the Solar system, and when it makes landfall in 2023, chaos will erupt worldwide. Panic will grip nearly everyone...except for you! In this story-driven 2D casual platform shooter, run, jump, and shoot across levels as you try to take down the alien Insectoids. Since their exoskeleton armor is 3 inches thick, things might not go well for you on the first or second try... Keep at it, and the end of each level contains text-based debriefings where you might discover what secrets humanity has been up to since the 1947 Roswell crash, and those secrets will help you gain upgrades in weapons and armor to turn the tide against the Insectoid invaders in the more challenging levels. In the current early access version, the player can expect: -To run/jump/shoot alien insectoid invaders on three 2D levels -To read through visual-novel-styled beginnings and endings for each level outlining more information about what is going on during the invasion. -Most sounds, music, and visual backgrounds already implemented -Alien insectoid implemented with basic AI & sounds -Placeholder sprite art for player/hero character PLANNED ADDITIONS: -Intermediate story ending (alien UFO and debriefing about government secrets) -Later in the game, you will take the fight to the skies and into space on a 2D rail shooter in your top-secret space fighter. Your target is the hive queen mastermind behind the invasion!

rows.name: A Hint of Purple
rows.short_description: A short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly.
rows.description_html: A Hint of Purple is a short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly. A short but sweet experience that respects your time. (40min-1hr) Engage with Maya's inner struggles by conversing with her Prefrontal Cortex, providing a unique and introspective look at her mental and emotional state. An emotionally rich queer story told in the form of a visual novel. Hear from a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique stories and perspectives.

rows.name: Mystic Mischief
rows.short_description: Fly as Mammon the chaotic thieving bird as he attempts to achieve the biggest heist of his life. Poop, caw, and steal your way through his adventures. Avoid the dangerous dragons as they try to keep you from stealing their treasures.
rows.description_html: Mystic Mischief is a quirky fun adventure entailing dragons, rats, magic, and all kinds of tomfoolery. Fly through this magical world and steal to your hearts content. Rank up to become the best thief in the land. You will collect hats that will give you special abilities to acquire treasure and ward of the dragons. Experience the carnival, an abandoned castle, and a cave. Discover the tales of how the dragons came to live in their homes. Follow the heart-warming story of how a bird and human can band together to become the best thieves. Will the wizard finally grow up and become the man he should have been? Or will he continue his loser ways and achieve nothing? Play as a bird that flies around dangerous creatures, stealing high value items while fulfilling your kleptomaniac desires. Collect or use items to defend yourself from enemies. You can also poop on enemies to keep enemies away!

rows.name: Hot Candy Land
rows.short_description: A 9 to 5 desk job is not really your thing? Go grab your smart phone, start filming and get ready to fulfil your destiny as the King of the Adult Industry in this crazy classic tycoon parody!
rows.description_html: Time to inject some excitement, sex appeal and humour into your gaming! It's time to say goodbye to shining gems, cutesy gardens, ageing dragons and tedious quests. Say hello to double-D measurements, triple-X ratings, bombshell actresses, and a healthy dose of adult humour! Build an adult empire! - Become the greatest pimp Pornwood's ever seen by taking to the streets and bringing a world of hurt to your competition. Claim their patch and their girls. Invest in real estate to ensure all those lonely sailors, “handy”-men and pizza delivery guys get plenty of bang for their buck! But be warned: You're not the only pimp in town who wants to make it big! - Work your way up the food chain by giving a hand or two. - Take on the adult film industry. - Create your real estate empire. - Rule the streets & the red lights while you manage your team. - Build the most powerful gang in town to protect your investments! Warning: Gameplay contains a lot of satire & parody. Oh right, and some nudity...

rows.name: Transfusion
rows.short_description: Slice enemies into tiny pieces and wield the power of blood magic to survive another day in this fast-paced VR hack and slash!
rows.description_html: As a prisoner far from home, you must earn your freedom in the Arena slaying lizard-like creatures called Lacerites. Utilize the gifts of bloodthirsty gods to gain the edge in combat as you tear through wave after wave to survive! SLASH, STAB, AND SEVER Butcher hordes of Lacerites in gladiatorial combat with a variety of weapons from ancient Roman and Aztec cultures. Weaken enemies with your weapons to break them both in body and spirit. Dismember opponents limb by limb until you’re the last one standing. BUILD YOUR ARSENAL Unlock a variety of weapons to smear Lacerites onto the arena floor. Sprout a tree from a spear, bash a skull with a super-sized macuahuitl, and wield the abilities of the gods with unique weapons specialized to your playstyle. JOIN THE RIDE Transfusion is an early access title and a passion project for our small dev team. If you enjoy our game, and want to help determine its future, please join our discord, help grow our community, and shape the game we have been working on. FOR THERE BE BLOOD

rows.name: ALTER EGO
rows.short_description: ALTER EGO is a 2D point-and-click narrative-based adventure game featuring psychological elements. Explore two levels with atmospheric environments, solve puzzles, and use your inventory items to uncover the mystery behind Reese and Winona’s relationship, and find the real culprit—if there is one.
rows.description_html: Winona is the perfect girlfriend. She's so giving and kind, and the light of Reese's life - until one day, she winds up dead in Reese's kitchen. Reese is accused by a gargantuan tiger named The Judge of murdering Winona, and stumbles through a mindscape of her own making, exploring old memories and feelings about Winona in order to find the true culprit behind Winona's death. ALTER EGO is a 2D point-and-click narrative-based adventure game featuring psychological elements. Reese the Rat discovers the dead body of her girlfriend, Winona the Sheep in her kitchen. Explore two levels with atmospheric environments, solve puzzles, and use the items in your inventory to uncover the mystery behind Reese and Winona’s relationship, and find the real culprit—if there is one.

rows.short_description: Expand among the stars! It is 72k years in the future, and a new wave of Human expansion abounds. Join the ranks of the Ecxos, prep star systems for habitation, and develop your tools and ships to enterprise ever faster and further.
rows.description_html: It is the 726th century - Humanity has expanded among the many galaxies, numbering in the quintillions, joining the teeming cornucopia of intergalactic sentient life. Wanting to experience different ways of living, a massive new wave of colonization begins as people seek to experience a less technic life. You take on the role of an Ecxo, travelling far ahead of the colonization waves, and leagues outside of Human inhabited space. It is your task to setup the initial phases of system colonization. You will build matter extractors, solar collectors, surveyors, and the like to assess suitability of planets and solar systems. Collect data along the way to research new ways to optimize your buildings, your ship, and your enterprise. How far will you go? Incremental Gameplay, start out with basic technologies and improve them as you gather new data from planets Explore new landing sites, setting up an economy, gathering resources, and collecting data to return to your ship Upgrade your buildings to explore, expand, and exploit on their own, and watch as your landing zone grows from barren landing to sprawling complex Upgrade your ship over time, and take to new systems, exploring planets faster and faster. Clone a new Ringer of yourself, warp to a new galaxy, and do it all again! (Gaining powerful advantages along the way)

rows.name: Classic Marathon
rows.short_description: From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.
rows.description_html: Alien forces have boarded the colony ship UESC Marathon in the Tau Ceti system, in orbit around humanity’s first interstellar colony. The situation is dire, and as a security officer assigned to the Marathon, your duty is to defend the ship and its crew from the alien threat. This classic 1994 Bungie™ FPS had a foundational influence on the genre, and is now maintained by the fan community. Experience authentic game play using the original data files, with optional widescreen HUD support, 3D filtering/perspective, positional audio, and 60+ fps interpolation, just in case the original is too authentic. Classic Marathon is powered by the Aleph One engine, which is available under the terms of the GNU General Public License (GPL) Version 3.

rows.description_html: Marathon Infinity takes the closed universe of the Marathon series and blows it wide open. The solo/co-op campaign, “Blood Tides of Lh’owon,” is a 20-level scenario sporting new textures, weapons, and enemies. rows.name: Sect-Machina
rows.short_description: Sect-Machina is a fluid, atmospheric bug-themed metroidvania rendered in a vibrant 2D pixelated style, crafted with meticulous attention to detail in its combat, characters, environments, sound, and story.
rows.description_html: Mona, a young butterfly, is disguised in the hood of a moth’s design for her own protection. But from what, Mona does not yet know. There are many things about the world Mona has been purposefully kept from knowing. Holed up in her nestroom, she looks out of her window and gazes upon the distant, glittering, twinkling lights of an alluring place which lies near the heart of this unknown world of bugs. Her need for answers grips her hearts tightly, and one night, she decides it’s time to venture out alone, equipped with her trusty steel bat, just in case things get risky. Smack! Hop! Dash! Talk! ...your way through the outskirts of cyberpunk bug-society to make your way towards the alluring lights of a place far beyond anything you’ve ever had the chance to know. Fluid Combat and Movement! Mona’s bat bonks and smacks with an effortless grace and a satisfying crunch, sending the dregs back to their dwellings, wondering why an odd-looking moth has so much bite. Her deftness is owed to her light and spritely form, hop and dash across the unique and diverse landscapes in Mona’s way. A Rich World Worth Exploring! Bugs of all kinds find and make homes where they must, from the old residential district to the dreadful badlands to the deep dank sewers. Each environment is detailed and full of bugs to talk to, listen to, and items to uncover. The more you dig into the world, the more it gives! This free proof of concept was lovingly and passionately crafted by a team of students and served as their academic thesis. We hope you enjoy!

rows.name: Cooktopia
rows.short_description: Cook and serve the best burgers in the world as fast as you can. Do you have what it takes to be the best chef in the world?
rows.description_html: Cooktopia is a singe-player third-person cooking simulator game where you work towards making the best burgers in the world! Overview: Welcome to Cooktopia, where your cooking dreams come true! Cooktopia is a video game where you cook in a cartoonish kitchen, have tons of fun, and aim to become a top chef. In this cooking adventure, you'll craft delicious dishes and work your way up to improve your skills and efficiency to the max! Key Features: Endless Culinary Creativity: A game where you can create different kind of burgers with fries, salads, and drinks! You have the chance in your hand to be the best master chef of all-time! Realistic Cooking Mechanics: Experience the thrill of cooking with intuitive, physics-based controls. Slice and cook your way to becoming a culinary genius. Stylized Environment: Immerse yourself in a stunning stylized kitchen to make yourself feel like you are inside the game. Competitive Timer Mode: Complete the orders as fast as you can and become the best chef in the world of Cooktopia. Your Own Personalized Kitchen:

rows.name: Noxious Weeds: Prologue
rows.short_description: Face the corruption that poisons your harvest! Noxious Weeds is an action rogue-lite where you slay hordes of creatures with the help of cute veggies and a combination of your favorite tools. The harvest is power. Choose wisely!
rows.description_html: JOIN US ON DISCORD 💖 The corruption is spreading! Hordes of evil creatures are coming your way! You are a former adventurer who retired, looking for a peaceful farming life. Did you really think the days of dangerous adventures and fetch quests were finally over? Too bad, no cozy farming here! Grab the tools and slay the monsters before they taint your fields. Resist waves of enemies through nights and days. 20 minutes play sessions A variety of upgradeable Tools to wipe out the swarm once and for all. Your belt can carry a maximum of 6; your choices will change the outcome. Rescue and team up with the cutest companions. Some will heal you, while others will fight at your side. Collect the perfect crop combination to achieve game-breaking builds. Accessibility. Tweak monsters' health, speed, and damage to better suit your play style. Prologue content 19 Tools to choose from. 3 Playable characters. 46 Harvest items for incredible builds. 3 Different companions. Spring season difficulty. 2 Characters and 6 crops unlockable through Steam Achievements. Inspired by the masters of rogue-lite survivor/bullet hell games: Risk of Rain, Vampire Survivors, and Brotato.

rows.name: The Mask Game
rows.short_description: Which is worse: a toxic friend or a literal demon?
rows.description_html: STORY What would you do to know, definitively, whether your friends are lying? It's Halloween, and for Catherine Seong that means one thing: costumes! But when her best (worst) friend refuses to wear the costume that Cathy had so painstakingly made for her, the only solution is petty revenge. In this case, that means skipping the bar crawl and instead dragging the party into the basement to perform a creepypasta ritual they got off the internet. After all, what better way to spend an evening with your toxic friend group than summoning a demon who punishes liars? ABOUT The Mask Game is a short game about friendship, crushes, communication issues, and demons. The ladies from this game will be returning in the upcoming death game . FEATURES Fully voice-acted 8 endings Original OST Illustration gallery ~2 hour playtime

rows.name: Oh Satan, I gotta hide
rows.short_description: A Prophunt game made by Students at a Folk Highschool Named 'Asane Folkehogskole' in norway Hide around our school or look for the monster's that have become Props
rows.description_html: The props have gone wild, hunt all of them down to win. This is a typical Prop hunt made by a small group of students. You either become a hunter or a prop. As a hunter, your job is to search the level to find all the props within the timelimit. worry not, the more props you kill the more hunters will join you in the hunt. As a prop, your job is to hide as an objekt. anywhere is allowed but will your friends like it? That we wont know. want to annoy your friends? good, good. We have a taunt button just for that. hope you will enjoy our little school project. Disclaimer: This is a school project made in a few months by students going to a Folk Highscool in Norway, its not a serious gamedev class. The only way to play this game is to do it on a local network, or using software to emulate that. Its a bit simple, but we had a lot of fun making it! The goal was to release it on steam, so we did!

rows.name: Skoory Rush
rows.short_description: Arcadey arena platformer. Collect items, chain together combos, and enjoy the colorful graphics & energetic sounds.
rows.description_html: Join our acorn-obsessed, furry protagonist on a wholesome platform-hopping mission through a world of colorful chaos. Outwit wacky woodland creatures, collect crunchy acorns, and perform gravity-defying, combo chaining stunts in this interactive collect 'em up. Swim in underground oceans and be the one of the first squirrels to reach outer space. Challenge your friends and climb your way up the online leaderboards. Watch out for those pigeons - they may look friendly, but they'll send you crashing back down to earth in no time. WHAT IS SKOORY RUSH? A game where you can jump and collect as many items as possible. A game where you can earn combo points by collecting items without getting hit. A game where you die a lot and restart fast. A game with no menus, that goes straight into the action. A game you can play in short bursts (unless you want to keep retrying to get a better score). A game where you can zone and chill out to while listening to your own soundtrack. A game with colorful graphics and energetic sounds.​ A game with Steam leaderboard and achievements. HOW TO PLAY Skoory is very light and floaty. Jumping gives vertical momentum, but horizontal momentum is also maintained. The longer you hold jump, the higher the jump. A quick tap equals low jump. You can't jump while in the air, but a limited number of consecutive wall jumps are allowed. You can even 'bird jump', 'fruit jump' or 'acorn jump' with practice. There is a trail effect after performing a 'wall jump'. Enter 'frenzy mode' by collecting 4 acorns without getting hit. Every acorn you collect during frenzy mode has a points multiplier, the birds give more acorns during frenzy mode.​ Collecting 2 or 3 fruits without touching anything else (including platforms or sides of the screen) will trigger a 1000 or 5000 points bonus. Always go for fruit combos for maximum points. You can pause with escape and change the volume with the +/- keys.​ Now, unleash your inner squirrel parkour skills and let the Skoorily shenanigans begin!

rows.name: SolForge Fusion
rows.short_description: SolForge Fusion is a collectible card-battler where you are a mighty Forgeborn. Command fierce creatures, cast powerful spells, level up your cards, and crush your foes to earn glorious rewards. Created by Richard Garfield (Magic: The Gathering) and Justin Gary (Ascension).
rows.description_html: SolForge Fusion is a one-of-a-kind collectible card battler where every card you play levels up, evolving into stronger forms and unlocking devastating combos as the battle unfolds. Play solo or head-to-head in tactical, ever-shifting matches where your strategy evolves with every turn. Created by Richard Garfield ( Magic: The Gathering ) and Justin Gary ( Ascension Deckbuilding Game ), SolForge Fusion fuses deep strategy with limitless variety. FUSE DECKS TO FORGE YOUR DESTINY You are one of the mighty Forgeborn, wielding powerful spells and commanding evolving creatures born from the fusion of two unique faction decks. Go head-to-head against players around the world, train in one-off solo matches, or explore our rich, rogue-lite campaign mode. LEVEL UP AS YOU PLAY Cards in SolForge Fusion don't just enter the field—they grow stronger every time you play them. Choose wisely when playing your cards, adapt your tactics, level up your creatures and spells, and outsmart your opponents in a game where timing is everything. EVERY DECK IS ONE-OF-A-KIND With more deck combinations than atoms in the universe, no two players will ever have the same deck. Combine two faction decks to forge a new strategy, and evolve your cards mid-game to unleash devastating combos. EARN REWARDS WORTH FIGHTING FOR Win battles and complete daily and weekly quests to unlock rewards, enhance your collection, earn distinct cosmetics, and discover new deck combinations. With both a persistent progression track and rotating seasonal achievements, your next reward is only a few games away. CLIMB THE RANKS. CLAIM THE GLORY. Take your deck to the next level in physical and digital events, seasonal leagues, and community-run tournaments. With official support for organized play and a thriving Discord community, there’s always a new challenge (and a new rival) to face. LOVE THE STORY, LIVE THE STORY Immerse yourself in the world of Solis and participate in our one-of-a-kind Storyline events to leave your mark on SolForge forever. Our player-driven narrative evolves with the choices you make. READY TO PLAY. EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO MASTER. SolForge Fusion features a fully voiced tutorial to get you into the action fast. From there, dive into fast-paced battles, endlessly unique decks, and deep progression that rewards experimentation, skill, and smart deck fusions.

With both a persistent progression track and rotating seasonal achievements, your next reward is only a few games away. CLIMB THE RANKS. CLAIM THE GLORY. Take your deck to the next level in physical and digital events, seasonal leagues, and community-run tournaments. With official support for organized play and a thriving Discord community, there’s always a new challenge (and a new rival) to face. LOVE THE STORY, LIVE THE STORY Immerse yourself in the world of Solis and participate in our one-of-a-kind Storyline events to leave your mark on SolForge forever. Our player-driven narrative evolves with the choices you make. READY TO PLAY. EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO MASTER. SolForge Fusion features a fully voiced tutorial to get you into the action fast. From there, dive into fast-paced battles, endlessly unique decks, and deep progression that rewards experimentation, skill, and smart deck fusions.

rows.name: Soccer Kids Alpha
rows.short_description: A game about soccer, made by people who suck at playing soccer. Guide your team of nerds to victory in this tight, tactical soccer game!
rows.description_html: A game about soccer, made by people who suck at playing soccer. Soccer Kids is a tactical, turn-based sports game where you control a teenage mathematical savant, guiding his friends on a quest to win the local street soccer tournament. The game is set in Poland in the 90s - a period where the country transitioned from a socialist republic to a democracy with a free market. It focuses on the latchkey kids of this period, who fell in love with the new cultural influence from around the world. Check out the game for free in its early stages and share your feedback with us, we'd love to hear it! The current version of the game features: Tight, grid-less tactical action. No match is ever the same! Play the tutorial, or Against a AI opponent, or Against your friends in a local hot seat match, or Online through the magic of Remote Play Together! This is a early, alpha version of Soccer Kids - all content is subject to change.

rows.name: malViolence - Definitive Edition
rows.short_description: CAUTION: Escape from this supervillain at your own risk...A short sci-fi visual novel packed with brain-teasing puzzles, gruesome deaths and heartbreaking secrets.
rows.description_html: Made within a month for NaNoRenO 2023. Now enhanced for Steam! I, the great Cautionne, Disciple of Danger and Emperor of MalViolence, am holding you as my latest test subject. 'Course, you trespassed on my lair first, so it’s not like you can complain. I get it. You wanted something from me. Or your boss did. Or your boss’s boss did. So how about we make a deal? You solve my escape rooms, do a little lab work, consult on a deadly trap or two, and I'll let you leave scot-free. Doesn't that sound nice? But before you go, let me give you some advice... Don't make any mistakes. Because if you do - you're not gonna like what happens next. A gripping, villainous scenario written by Mado, Of The Devil's Brian Mulholland, and Z. Escape rooms with several brain-bending puzzles, crafted by speck and Artificial Selection's KigyoDev. 3 main endings and even more bad endings. Animated, speaking CGs: all drawn by Mado! Partial voice-acting by the talented Carrick Inabnett and Vyn Vox, with the direction of Very Berry Studio's Phebe Fabacher! Gorgeous, rendered backgrounds by Reina! A slick UI by spicaze! An 100% original soundtrack by Melo-dii and Doran. Audio mastering and mixing by Cooking Companions' D.ray! An eye-catching trailer by Mado and jennymhulla! 1 cute mad scientist with a hidden agenda… (This project also features tools by dmochas, tofurocks, wattson, glsuoa, and npckc .)

rows.name: Mr. Mookie and the Runaway Cookie
rows.short_description: Help Mr. Mookie retrieve his giant cookie in this adorable puzzle-platformer! Glide through the clouds, explore alien lands, and solve complex puzzles to get the cookie and dip it in milk.
rows.description_html: Help Mr. Mookie retrieve his giant cookie in this adorable puzzle-platformer! Glide through the clouds, explore alien lands, and solve complex puzzles to get the cookie and dip it in milk. Explore Different Lands Explore five different environments ranging from a cheery, lively playground to a dark, creepy factory as you try to recapture your cookie! Solve Complex Puzzles Each of the five chapters has 20 unique, hand-crafted levels, from simple relaxing ones to complex head-scratchers, giving you a wide range of puzzles to complete. Unique Pickups that Alter Gameplay Catapult a cookie over castle towers, glide through the clouds with a hang glider, and skyrocket with a jetpack in the factory. Each of the five chapters has different pickups that change how you play the game. Features Puzzles: Explore 100 hand-crafted levels spread out across five different chapters Increasingly Difficult Puzzles: Each of the levels contains puzzles, ranging from simple relaxing ones to complex head-scratchers Mechanics Build: New mechanics start off easy in earlier levels, then get increasingly difficult, letting you master the different elements of the game Unique Pickups: Each chapter contains their own pickups, like jetpacks, a hang glider, and even a watering can, each one altering the gameplay

rows.name: Borefest
rows.short_description: 'Why would you waste your time making this? Couldn't you have made something fun instead? Games are supposed to be fun...' - The Game Developer's Dad
rows.description_html: Welcome to Borefest. The most boring game ever made. Do you hate having fun? Enjoy torturing yourself with lackluster puzzles, dialogue that tries WAY too hard to be funny, and/or graphics 'drawn' by someone who can't draw? Well, you've come to the right place... Borefest is the most boring game in the world, and in it, you'll be waiting in line at the post office, answering questions during a workplace safety meeting, serving customers during a VERY slow shift - basically, all the most tedious things in life are in this game... Only those with brave enough souls and the most tenacious spirits can endure: - 6 'mini'games that each span upwards of 30 minutes - An unlockable 'hard mode' that makes those 'mini'games EVEN worse - A soundtrack comprised of royalty-free 'Kevin Macleod' music - Extremely long loading screens - Dull gameplay mechanics that include: waiting around and pressing one button, QTE's, quizzes. - Unskippable dialogue Don't buy this game if you enjoy having fun - if you want to experience the most boring things life has to offer and try to conquer them in an extremely anti-climactic fashion, this 'game' is for you! You'll have the life sucked out of you as you visit: the post office, a fast food restaurant, the A&E waiting room... You'll meet moderately humorous characters such as: a creepy clown, your boring boss, an obsessive stamp collector... ...Honestly, just go play something else.

rows.name: Chicken Tricks
rows.short_description: Peck, dodge and shoot your way through endless waves of enemies. Upgrade your Chick and prove you have what is needed to avoid being turned into fried chicken.
rows.description_html: Have you ever felt trapped? Like you want to escape your leathery prison? It's time to upgrade your cock to freedom in Chicken Tricks ! Fight through waves of enemies for your good ol' american freedom, using all the weapons at your disposals... Which aren't many, because you're a chicken ... ya know. Peck, poisons, explosive eggs, everything just works in Chicken Tricks . Use them to defeat your enemies, which will grant you with a determined amount of XP. Once you have enough, you will level up, which lets you choose one of 4 possible upgrades . Choose new abilities to slap your way through making new and different builds avoiding death. Each level, the spawn rate of mobs raises and, each 5 levels, several improved enemies will spawn, making sure of making your mission harder to accomplish. If you get killed while at maximum level possible, a little surprise awaits. Just do anything to make sure you don't become another one in the line of the next KFC frier, and save your legacy from that doomed fate!

rows.name: Idle Medieval Tavern
rows.short_description: Once upon a time, in a realm of danger and intrigue, you find yourself entrusted with the management of a quaint medieval tavern. This captivating idle game weaves a tale of daring quests, legendary heroes, and a thriving tavern that serves as the heart of a bustling community.
rows.description_html: As the innkeeper, your journey begins with the assembly and training of a band of heroes. You scour the land, seeking out valiant warriors, elusive saboteurs, and sharp-eyed rangers. Under your guidance, these skilled individuals forge into a formidable team. With specialized skills and expertly chosen equipment, they embark on perilous journeys for fame and fortune, aiding the innocent and vanquishing evil. Under your guidance, these skilled individuals forge into a formidable team. With specialized skills and expertly chosen equipment, they embark on perilous journeys for fame and fortune, aiding the innocent and vanquishing evil. As your heroes' renown grows, so too does your tavern. Unlock new rooms and amenities, transforming the modest tavern into a lively hub of activity. The aroma of delicious feasts wafts through the air as patrons gather in the dining room, while the entertainment room buzzes with excitement from thrilling knife-throwing competitions. Your inn evolves into an opulent refuge, where luxurious bedrooms adorned with fine art and hunting trophies welcome weary travelers. The aroma of delicious feasts wafts through the air as patrons gather in the dining room, while the entertainment room buzzes with excitement from thrilling knife-throwing competitions. Your inn evolves into an opulent refuge, where luxurious bedrooms adorned with fine art and hunting trophies welcome weary travelers. But this is just the beginning of your journey. With each success, you are inspired to build a legacy of legendary inns, each more illustrious than the last. From bustling market towns to the remote corners of the realm, your taverns boast unique ambiance, entertainment, and culinary delights, drawing travelers from near and far. As the tales of your exceptional establishments spread, caravans arrive from distant lands, eager to trade and replenish their supplies. Your keen negotiation skills secure lucrative deals, bolstering your inns' prosperity and ensuring their continued growth. Amidst this thriving business, your tavern becomes a beacon for mercenaries, drawn by the promise of camaraderie and opportunity. With each new ally, your guild's reputation soars, and more heroes answer the call to embark on even the most dangerous of quests. In this enchanting idle game, every decision you make has far-reaching consequences as you strive to build the ultimate tavern empire. Will you rise to the challenge and etch your name into history as a legendary innkeeper? The story of your legendary journey awaits...

rows.name: World of BoreCraft
rows.short_description: Retro 2004 flash-like parody that asks the question, how much will you sacrifice to become the greatest WoB player ever?
rows.description_html: Key Features! Over 140 decisions! Over 25 Unique buffs and debuffs that force you to change up strategies mid game. Randomized choices so every game is unique. Challenging and engaging relationship faction system. Randomized events, rewards and chances for surprise results with each choice. Even obvious choices are randomized in the amount of reputation you gain or lose to remain unpredictable. Satirical jokes about an MMORPG ruining your relationships. Also 100% FREE! Jump in! Play as someone in 2004 who just bought World of Borecraft in this randomized choose your own adventure combined with balancing different reputations in order to win. With each choice presented to you there are only three possible options, and you'll want to think hard about which one you pick before moving on to the next one. Make decisions that damage or strengthen your relationship with your family and friends, girlfriend, and work. If they get too low, you'll have to start giving up progress in the game in order to keep your relationships in good standing. Obtain powerful buffs and debuffs which affect your reputations in unique ways, providing a different gaming experience every playthrough. Your ultimate goal is to reach 1000 in game reputation without damaging your relationships too greatly; should they fall to zero then you won't be able to play World of Borecraft any more!

rows.name: Project Asteroids
rows.short_description: In the vastness of space, you are a lone robot desperately trying to survive. Build, explore, and fight for your life as you face deadly threats in the asteroid belt. This hardcore game shows no mercy—dangers lurk at every step, ready to destroy you at any moment.
rows.description_html: Project Asteroids — Online survival game with a focus on PVP WARNING: This is a hardcore game. You will be killed everywhere and constantly. Dangers lurk at every turn, and only the strongest will survive. I have no feelings. I have no fear. I must work. And I’m working. My modules are outdated, but as long as they exist, I am useful. My body is rusted, but as long as I can move, I am useful. I don’t know where I am, but it doesn’t matter. I know my goal. To survive. rows.name: When Night Comes
rows.short_description: When Night Comes is an immersive and spine-chilling horror game. If you're a fan of survival horror games and want to test your skills against a terrifying demonic force, then this game is definitely for you. Are you brave enough to face the Entity? Play When Night Comes and find out!
rows.description_html: When Night Comes is a heart-pumping survival horror game that will have you on the edge of your seat. The game is set in a dark and terrifying atmosphere, where the only goal is to survive your dreams and avoid being claimed by the demonic force known as the Entity. The Entity invades your nightmares, preying on your fears and vulnerabilities to claim your soul. The stakes are high, and every decision you make can mean the difference between life and death. As you navigate through the haunting landscape, you must use all of your wit and cunning to evade the Entity's grasp. Every step you take brings you closer to either salvation or doom. With stunning graphics and bone-chilling sound effects, When Night Comes delivers a truly immersive horror experience. Do you have what it takes to survive the Entity's grasp? Play now and find out! Credits: Artwork: Calixte Walls Music: Vivek Abhishek Voice Acting: David Piper Narrative Design: Vera Burd QA Tester: Dakota Chapman

rows.name: Blacksite Theta
rows.short_description: A 3D puzzle platformer developed as a project for the 2023 UW-Whitewater Capstone Course. Harness your newfound mutant arm powers to conquer challenging terrain, ultimately unlocking your path to freedom by solving puzzles and navigating treacherous obstacles to escape the facility.
rows.description_html: The year 1996 marked a screeching halt to the United States' Occult Research Program in a rather violent fashion. Following the total failure of one of the experiments, a lockdown order was called, dropping a heavily reinforced seal and several tons of rubble down on the entrance in order to keep whatever went wrong contained indefinitely. It was presumed there were no survivors. This is technically not the case. You are Frank Sorenson, seemingly the only survivor of whatever catastrophe befell Blacksite Theta. Previously a test subject, you now have no reason to stay here and nobody to make you stay, allowing you to wander free in hopes of finding a route out of the newly created ruin. While you wouldn't wish the procedures you underwent on your worst enemies, they do offer you some rather... occult... benefits. According to the dusty ritual texts used to experiment upon you, you have become a Conduit, or one who can communicate with a being from the Plane of Force. His advice and the power he grants you shall be the one lifeline you have in your desperate struggle to escape. In order to overcome increasingly complex puzzles deep within the facility, players will need to employ their recently acquired mutant arm capabilities, including pushing, destroying, pulling, grappling, and dashing. As they delve further into the challenges, players must also evade the perilous traps set by the facility, as failure would lead to their assimilation into the enigmatic Blacksite Theta. The ultimate objective is to secure your escape from this dire predicament at all costs.

rows.name: Cross Impact
rows.short_description: Cross Impact is an Early Access free indie crossover platform fighting game, featuring a diverse cast of iconic characters, multiple modes, and a fully-fledged training mode to perfect your moves. Gather your friends for local & online matches! Prepare to Make Your Impact!
rows.description_html: Mort the Chicken - OUT NOW!!! About the Game Overview Cross Impact is an Early Access platform fighter designed to celebrate the indie game community. It is still under development and subject to changes and improvements based on community feedback. Experience intense battles like never before with up to 8-player simultaneous multiplayer, whether you choose to play locally or online with rollback netcode! With a unique roster featuring 12 fully playable characters from different indie franchises, 15 detailed stages, and over 30 music tracks (including remixes and returning favorites), Cross Impact is a platform fighter like no other. Features Unique Roster: Play as 12 fully playable characters from different indie franchises, each with their own moveset, playstyle, and personality. Detailed Stages: Battle it out in 15 carefully crafted stages, each with its own layouts, platforms, and visual flair. Epic Soundtrack: Enjoy over 30 music tracks, featuring remixes and returning favorites from your favorite indie games. 8-Player Multiplayer: Duke it out with up to 8 simultaneous players locally or online with Rollback Netcode. Assist: Call the help of an additional character help you out during the battle. Voice Acting: Listen to voice actors bring the characters to life with their unique voices and expressions. Team Battles: Form teams with friends and fight against others in thrilling team battles, with each player bringing their own strengths and strategies. Training Mode: Use the fully-fledged training mode with lots of tools for labbing and hone your skills to become a true master of Cross Impact. Characters Introducing Ortheo , the fearless protagonist from the game Ortheo (2022), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With an All-Rounder playstyle, Ortheo is a mid-weight fighter ready to take on any challenge. His home stage is the bustling Carloon Harbor, a location that perfectly showcases his adventurous spirit. Introducing Pal , the villainous mastermind from LUMbA: REDUX (2022), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With a rushdown/stage control playstyle and a lightweight class, Pal wields a hammer with the finesse of a swordie. Pal's home stage is My World, a location that represents his strong connection to his home dimension. Pal can summon Lumba as a special move, providing backup firepower and leading to further stage control. Introducing Alex , the enigmatic fighter from YIIK: A Post-Modern RPG (2019), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With a mix-ups/stage control playstyle and a light weight class, Alex plays like no other. In battle, Alex wields a unique set of moves and attacks, drawing inspiration from the surreal and otherworldly world of YIIK. His home stage is Frankton, a location that holds many secrets and memories for him. Introducing Toree , the chirpy protagonist from Toree 3D (2021), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With a Glass Cannon playstyle, Toree is a lightweight fighter who can dish out massive damage but can also be taken down quickly. Toree's home stage is the bustling city of Neo Osaka, where busses and trucks pass by. Introducing Jacket , the infamous assassin from Hotline Miami (2012), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With a brawler playstyle, Jacket is a mid-weight fighter who can throw his weapons with deadly precision. Jacket's home stage is The Metro, which is where his first mission takes place. Introducing Stardrop , the bouncy hero from Indie Pogo (2018), as a playable character in Cross Impact! With a unique playstyle, Stardrop is always jumping and can charge aerials and parkour to compensate. Their home stage is Colosseum, where the character selection screen in Indie Pogo takes place. Introducing Cowboy , the western swordsman from Your Only Move Is HUSTLE (2022), as a playable character in Cross Impact! Our first traditional sword-wielder, with fast moves. Utilize their explosive bullets & the sword's long range. Cowboy's home stage is Hustle Highway, where the fights from Your Only Move Is Hustle take place. Introducing V1 , the dead-cold killing machine from ULTRAKILL (2020), as a playable character in Cross Impact! V1 has a style meter, can cancel moves, and has a powerful jab. V1's home stage is Layer Two. Introducing Fark , the high-speed, electric robot from Spark the Electric Jester (2017)! Fark brings his lightning-fast reflexes and devastating combos to the battle in Cross Impact, capable of dashing around opponents and delivering powerful strikes with his electrified blade. Fark’s home stage is Flower Mountain City. Introducing NAIR Block , the nonsensical enigma from NAIR (2021), as a playable character in Cross Impact! NAIR Block is… well, ihard to describe. It defies logic, physics, and reason in every way. With a unique chaotic playstyle, NAIR Block thrives on unpredictability, making it a perfect choice for players who love keeping their opponents—and themselves—on their toes. Introducing Jackie , the overworked intern from Going Under (2020), as a playable character in Cross Impact! Jackie’s relentless hustle shines through in her high-speed mix-up playstyle. As a lightweight fighter, Jackie utilizes her arsenal of office-themed weapons—including staplers, monitors, and even... cactie?—to deliver fast and relentless attacks. Jackie’s home stage is Styxcoin, a chaotic, neon-lit crypto dungeon. Introducing Mort the Chicken , the unlikely hero from Mort the Chicken (2000), as a playable character in Cross Impact! Mort clucks his way into the roster with a quirky mid-weight playstyle that combines agility, humor, and barnyard flair. He can also peck, flutter, and headbutt opponents, utilizing the same offbeat energy that made him a cult classic.

rows.name: 40 Seconds
rows.short_description: A hidden object puzzle game inspired by public health issues related to suicide.
rows.description_html: Did you know that one person commits suicide every 40 seconds worldwide? Suicide is one of the leading causes of death in young people. The suicide rate is higher than all the yearly victims of wars and natural disasters combined. Have you ever felt sad or lonely? You are not alone. Today, we can easily see how other people are living. Just with one smartphone, we can check out what is going on around the world whenever we want. However, we do not know about the people who commit suicide every 40 seconds world wide. Although suicide is a serious public health problem, it is shocking that most of us know so little about it. Trapped in the world of smartphones, we have lost our faces. Please find a person who will commit suicide before 40 seconds pass! How to use a controller (HTC Vive): Use Trigger to select menu. Use Touchpad to select a target and jump inside the game. Choose your language: Select English or Korean (한국어) by using Trigger of your controller.

rows.name: A Heart of Butterblue
rows.short_description: A horror visual novel with farming mechanics. Investigate, farm and woo the villagers while trying not to die at the hands of the mysterious dogs that roam the lands at night. A complete game that is free.
rows.description_html: A murdered father and a missing grandfather... It is under these circumstances that Phebe finds herself moving to the isolated frontier town of Edgefield. Rumors have it that monsters roam the lands after dark and anyone caught outside is never heard from again. With eerie murderous howling heard every night, Phebe has no choice to become accustomed to this new life if she wants to find her missing grandfather. Play as this polite city girl as she forages, farms and (possibly) woos the local villagers as she navigates this new life of hers. A horror VN and farm sim, A Heart of Butterblue has 3 endings and a word count of 32k. A game you can complete in an afternoon. Features: Forage, fish, farm and buy items in order to uncover the mystery of Phebe's missing grandfather. Three villagers to get close to, each of whom might have their own secrets. Time progresses as you play, keep your eye on the clock! A free, complete mystery/otome game drawn, coded and written by a solo dev(hi~!).

rows.name: Kortstrid
rows.short_description: Kortstrid: a captivating TCG in a vast fantasy world. Battle with unique heroes, foes, and companions in strategic, ever-evolving gameplay. Dive into an enthralling adventure filled with camaraderie!
rows.description_html: Kortstrid is an enthralling trading card game (TCG) set in a vast and immersive fantasy world, blending elements of MMOs and strategic battles to provide players with a truly unique gaming experience. At its core, Kortstrid features a diverse cast of heroes, enemies, bosses, gods, NPCs, and companions, each possessing their own distinct abilities and roles within the game. One of the most remarkable aspects of Kortstrid is that the cards are uniquely created for every player, ensuring that more often than not, no two cards are the same. As players collect beautifully illustrated cards, they can level up, hone their skills, and engage in a variety of cooperative and competitive challenges. In Kortstrid, players will find an engaging in-game economy, numerous game modes, and card rarities that cater to various playstyles. The game emphasizes strategic gameplay and encourages players to form alliances, creating a dynamic and exciting experience for both casual and hardcore gamers. As part of its ongoing commitment to expanding the Kortstrid universe, the development team actively hosts tournaments and community-driven events, fostering a vibrant and active player community. The game is available across multiple platforms, ensuring that players can enjoy Kortstrid whenever and wherever they want. So gather your cards, assemble your ultimate deck, and join the ever-growing Kortstrid community as you embark on a thrilling journey filled with camaraderie, breathtaking landscapes, and exhilarating battles.

rows.name: Asteroids ++
rows.short_description: Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids game you will ever play in your life. Customize your spaceship with your weapon loadout, save your solar system, and destroy those damn Asteroids! And remember, you can never end Asteroid genocide!
rows.description_html: Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids clone you will ever play in your life. The Year is 2450. Humanity has expanded their technology and improved in Rocketry. There was nothing out of the ordinary until disaster struck! A moon one light year away exploded and has spread asteroids all over our solar system, this is where YOU come in! You play as one of the captains who will control one of the spaceships! Go from planet to planet and get rid of the Asteroids! When starting the game, you randomly generate sectors in planets based on set seed. Inside the shop, expect to buy and customize parts for your spaceship. There are a bunch of weapons, abilities and unique utilities, which give over one million possible combinations for your loadout. Each weapon is unique. Shoot homing rockets that lock onto the biggest Asteroids, or have recruitments collect money instead of you doing it! Stop time with the Timestop ability or DROP DOWN A F______ NUKE Upgrade your speed upgrade for the spaceship so you can be so fast that your spaceship pierces through Asteroids! In the game you'll face different types of enemies. Yellow Asteroids split up into more smaller ones than usual UFOs mimic the player's weapons and will try to use them against you. A Triplet is a spinning triplet of big asteroids that sprrads out smaller asteroids! Contribute and trade in the steam market! Gather dropped items in-game to be able to listen to songs, play additional campaigns, spawn owned asteroids from your inventory in Sandbox Mode, and more! This game uses the steam inventory and makes the items MATTER There's loads of more content! Seasonal Campaign Additions Weekly Planet Events Fun in-game Cheats Rich Story through Computer Logs you find Player Customization Frequent Free in-Game Updates and so on... This game is FREE TO PLAY! If you think that you are ripping me off, well, of course you are! So, what are you waiting for! And remember, you can never end Asteroid genocide!

rows.name: Hexagon Survivors
rows.short_description: Is a game that is not for the faint of heart. With its challenging difficulty level, players will need to be on their toes at all times. Those who are up for the challenge, Hexagon Survivors offers a thrilling, cyberpunk-inspired adventure that is sure to keep players engaged for hours on end.
rows.description_html: Hexagon Survivors is a challenging, roguelike game that takes place in a cyberpunk world. With its 15 levels, the game offers a difficult challenge for players, culminating in an epic battle against the final boss. Players are thrust into a world where survival is key. The game features randomly generated levels, which means that players will never have the same experience twice. Each level is filled with dangerous enemies, deadly traps, and a plethora of obstacles to overcome. Players will need to use all their skills to navigate through the levels and make it to the end. To aid players in their quest for survival, Hexagon Survivors features a vast array of passive and active abilities. These abilities range from defensive skills that protect players from harm, to offensive abilities that deal devastating damage to enemies. With so many options available, players can experiment with different combinations of abilities to find the strategy that best suits their playstyle. The game's cyberpunk aesthetic is evident throughout, with futuristic environments, neon lights, and cutting-edge technology. One of the standout features of Hexagon Survivors is its music. The game's soundtrack is composed of a variety of electronic and cyberpunk-inspired tracks that perfectly capture the mood of the game. The music helps to ramp up the tension during combat encounters and adds to the overall atmosphere of the game. Hexagon Survivors is a game that is not for the faint of heart. With its challenging difficulty level and randomly generated levels, players will need to be on their toes at all times. But for those who are up for the challenge, Hexagon Survivors offers a thrilling, cyberpunk-inspired adventure that is sure to keep players engaged for hours on end.

rows.name: B-B0 The Delivery Bot
rows.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer where you play as a robot whose sole purpose is delivering packages on time! Your package is your only means of defense and attack, use it wisely to navigate levels and reach your goal, like a good little delivery bot :)
rows.description_html: BTDB is a 2D puzzle platformer game that will leave you truly feeling like a delivery bot. The future is now, all delivery companies have opted into automated delivery services. YOU are a part of that service, a mere tool at the hands of a giant delivery company. As B-B0, the Delivery Bot, your responsibilities are : NAVIGATING LEVELS, PUZZLES, AND TRAPS TO SAFELY GET FROM POINT A TO POINT B. delivering packages won't be easy, there's always gonna be something in your way... DELIVERING YOUR DESIGNATED PACKAGES AS FAST AS POSSIBLE time is money, no one likes a late delivery. impress your customers by delivering their package right on time. GETTING RID OF YOUR COMPETITION you will be the greatest delivery bot there is! even if that means ridding of all your competitors.

rows.name: We Carry the Fire
rows.short_description: We Carry the Fire is a fantasy-adventure visual novel about four people embarking on a dangerous quest to save a small village from an apocalyptic curse.
rows.description_html: We Carry the Fire is a visual novel set in a world that is slowly ending. Every few years after the new moon disappears from the night sky, it will return red, and when that red moon is full every town, village, and city in the Empire will be attacked by mindless, spectral monsters called Shades. The only weapon the people have in their defense is Fire, an ever-burning white flame believed to be a gift from God Himself. Players follow Ashe, a young person whose red eyes mark him as an outcast. When a new red moon appears, Ashe volunteers to deliver Fire to a remote farming village that would otherwise be destroyed under the full moon. This mission will be particularly dangerous because it requires him to cross the Forest, a mysterious wilderness believed to be home to malicious spirits and terrifying monsters that otherwise live only in myth. But Ashe will not face these dangers alone. He is joined by a party of other outcasts like himself: Blaise a former knight excommunicated from her order for an alleged heresy; Kol, an Alfar of the Forest exiled from his clan for breaking a taboo; and Luz, a magical prodigy expelled from her university for stealing secrets from restricted texts. Their success is far from guaranteed. Rather, each of them joins this mission knowing they will likely fail, and failure means death. Yet they are each willing to accept that great risk for their own reasons. The trials they face in their journey will reopen old wounds and push each of them to their breaking point, and to find a way forward they will each be forced to let go of something important.

rows.name: Solar Showdown
rows.short_description: Welcome to Solar Showdown - the ultimate 2-player couch competitive game where you harvest solar power, build defenses, and produce minions to attack your opponent's towers. Generate enough power to activate your base's ultimate weapon and blow up your rival! Grow, build, defend, and dominate!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Solar Showdown This is Solar Showdown - an edge-of-your-seat couch competitive game where you take on the roles of a farmer and a botanist, both harvesting solar power to build defenses and produce minions to attack your opponent's towers. With a variety of strategic options at your disposal, from defensive turrets to shields, the key to victory lies in generating enough solar power to outpace your rival and activate your base's ultimate weapon. Will you focus on building an impenetrable fortress, or unleash a swarm of minions to overwhelm your opponent? The choice is yours in this high-stakes battle for dominance. Gather your friends and get ready to engage in intense 2-player action as you compete to blow up your opponent and claim victory in Solar Showdown! What is Solar Showdown? Solar Showdown is a 2-player competitive game with RTS and Tower Defense elements. It requires 2 controllers to play local multiplayer. A BYU Center for Animation Capstone Project This project was planned, developed, and tested over the course of a little less than a year, completely through student work. We are proud of what we were able to accomplish in that time period. However, please note that Solar Showdown is not representative of a complete game. Additionally, many of the students who worked on this have moved on to other coursework, internships, or jobs, meaning future work on this game after release is unlikely. While what we have released showcases the core mechanics and gameplay features we wanted in our game, it may contain bugs, optimization problems, and other issues that impact the overall experience. We appreciate your understanding and your feedback.

rows.name: The Dark Book
rows.short_description: An obscure old-school rpg - Single player offline with a skeleton warrior
rows.description_html: The Dark Book is an old school action RPG, you won't be the usual champion of justice who wants to save the world from the bad guy, here you'll think about saving your skin, or rather, your bones! DIRECTLY FROM BEYOND THE GRAVE You will play a skeleton that will be brought back to life thanks to the magic of the dark book, you will find yourself in Don Slawen Town, a small stronghold unknown to you, you will only remember your name and should investigate how and why you got a new life. You will talk with Characteristic NPCs that will make the story deeper and deeper and full of mysteries that will help you in your main mission, find the dark book and who used it to bring everyone back to life and find out why he did it. SKELETON WARRIOR The character will favor hand-to-hand combat with melee weapons and you will rarely find magical weapons with which you can inflict more damage on your enemies such as goblins, demons, cyclops and other strange creatures. Don't forget to use some magic to recover health or deal unexpected damage to enemies. Hit enemies repeatedly and you'll get your adrenaline pumping to unleash a special attack that will deal much more damage than a normal attack. THE WASTELAND OF MORGHOTH In the world of Morghoth you will not find human beings, they became extinct a long time ago, but you will find many mysterious areas during your journey, dungeons, caves, crypts and much more, some areas are much darker than others but the further you go the your path, the more you will notice that the world around you is nothing more than the specter of what we know, everything seems abandoned and destroyed, but ancient spells hide the truth.

rows.name: Cat
rows.short_description: Cat is a fun little clicker game where you can rest and click some cats. You can earn 2 drops to your steam inventory every 8h and gain 33 achievements.
rows.description_html: Cat is a delightfully simple and strangely addictive clicker game where your mission is to collect cats, unlock powerful upgrades, earn achievements, and watch your feline empire grow. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore cat collector, there's something purr-fectly satisfying for everyone. Features: 33 Achievements to unlock 24 Unique Upgrade Types with nearly 1,000 total levels for massive cat-scaling potential. 34 Collectible Cats, each bringing unique CPS (Cats Per Second) and CPC (Cats Per Click) bonuses that stack as you build your cat collection Auto-save Function so your progress is always safe, even if you get distracted by real cats. Customization options Item drop pool: 70% Common 25% Uncommon 4% Rare 1% Epic 0.01% Legendary Idle Cat Drops Every 8 hours, you can get 2 new cats just by checking in. The more cats you have, the stronger your passive income becomes. It pays to keep coming back! Q: Why Should I Play This Game? A: Cats Q: Isn't that just a copy of the Steam game Banana, but named Cat? A: No. Cat gives you more gameplay choices like upgrades and changing your cat avatar. Q: Is this an NFT game? A: No, cats are not connected to any blockchain. Warning: This game is a clicker, not an RPG with three times the map size, five times the graphics, and ten times more quests than the XYZ game. Most of the time, you will just click the cat button and spend your cats on upgrades.

rows.name: Journey
rows.short_description: One day, Maaya accidentally brought home an object that would soon bring misfortune to her family, especially her younger sister. Join her as she unravels the mystery behind it.
rows.description_html: One day, Maaya brought home something and left it accidentally. She did not realize this would bring misfortune to her family, especially to her younger sister. Embark on a journey with her to unravel the mystery behind the object. Key Features: Exploration: Immerse yourself in the detailed settings of a Japanese town. Side Quests: Uncover hidden stories and secrets through engaging side quests that weave into the main narrative. Dual Endings: Your choices determine the outcome of the story, leading to either a grim or hopeful conclusion. Gameplay: Although the main storyline can be completed in about 10 minutes, the intricate side stories and multiple endings encourage multiple playthroughs. Adventure Horror Genre: A horror adventure game that blends spine-tingling suspense with the thrill of exploration

rows.name: Zombiflux: Sleepless War
rows.short_description: Survive and create your own civilization!
rows.description_html: As unknown viruses spread, human civilization has fallen from grace. At the intersection of the old and the new world, you are the Commander in this doomsday that marks the fall of the old and start of the new. Crossing this threshold to enter the new world will be a very challenging task. But don’t worry, you are not alone in this fight for survival. Zombiflux: Sleepless War is a modern zombie apocalypse strategy game. In this brand-new zombie-themed SLG game, you can explore the map, expand territories, and battle to survive in a world of rampant zombies and smoldering forces of chaos. As the Commander, you have a crucial mission to lead the Survivor Camp and fight together with other Survivors to live. ▶ Survive the Zombie Horde ◀ While the humankind is falling apart, you will thrive to win every future battle in the doomsday. Build, upgrade, and expand your own army into an invincible force. Zombies are everywhere attacking in endless hordes. This power will help you survive. Survivors also want more than just surviving. They can be as dangerous as zombies. You’ll need the power to fight against them too. Every victory will push you further on the path of survival. ▶ Build Your Base ◀ Survive first to rebuild human civilization. Build your base from scratch to make it safe and stable. When doing this, you need to manage all resources to maximize productivity of the base and enhance the defense system to prepare for future attacks both inside and outside the wall. This is not just any base. It is your home, Commander. Please protect it! ▶ Real-Time Strategy ◀ During a horde attack, you can be ambushed at any time. But no worries, March forward! As the Commander, you need to deploy different heroes strategically so that they can break through the siege of the hordes. Only those with good tactics can survive! Use your strategies to survive in this world full of zombies! ▶ Unite with All Survivors ◀ Hearing 'you are not alone' from someone in the doomsday is heartwarming yet somewhat daunting. Meet other survivors and build an alliance. But remember, choose your allies carefully. A friendly environment and a decent leader of the alliance will help you grow better. Or, you can become the leader yourself to forge a powerful civilization in this deadly jungle. Be careful of survivors lurking in unknown places. After all, human nature is unpredictable, especially in the doomsday when old rules don’t work any more. ▶ Explore the Map ◀ In the doomsday, this vast land is no longer in the hands of human beings. But humankind cannot be chained between those high walls! You need to climb over the walls, investigate, explore, and fight to get more food and resources for the base or even save other Survivors. In this wasteland, you will also encounter unusual challenges. Use strategies and the power of your army to conquer them one by one. Commander, do you have the will, the commitment to bringing back human civilization to its former glory?

But humankind cannot be chained between those high walls! You need to climb over the walls, investigate, explore, and fight to get more food and resources for the base or even save other Survivors. In this wasteland, you will also encounter unusual challenges. Use strategies and the power of your army to conquer them one by one. Commander, do you have the will, the commitment to bringing back human civilization to its former glory?

rows.name: The Life of a Magical Circle
rows.short_description: Control a circle with your mouse. Eat smaller circles and uncover the rules of a strange geometric world. Experiment, die, and be reborn until you understand your purpose; then come full circle with your mysterious narrator.
rows.description_html: The Life of a Magical Circle is a philosophical collect-and-survive roguelite about finding your purpose in life. Control a circle with your mouse. Eat smaller circles and uncover the rules of this strange world. Experiment, die, and be reborn until you understand your purpose; then come full circle with your mysterious narrator. Features: Control a magical circle with fluid, mouse-based movement Dodge menacing triangles and squares Eat smaller circles that will either help you find your purpose, or change the game in strange and amusing ways A mysterious narrator will react to your choices, reflect upon his own life, and wonder aloud about the nature of chasing one's dreams Gaze upon a beautiful, evolving, fractal-based background Listen to a wonderful soundtrack that you contribute to through your actions 30 minutes to 3+ hours long depending on your skill level, how wise you are, and how much you want to see

rows.name: Shattered Legacy
rows.short_description: Start an exciting journey through a magical world, where the familiar idea of nudging blocks and solving puzzles combine to offer an amazing adventure puzzle game. Discover a magical world. Explore difficult puzzles and cryptic challenges in unique levels.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic journey through a mystical world filled with puzzles and hidden treasures. As a brave adventurer, you must use your wit and skills to navigate challenging environments and uncover the ancients' secrets. With intuitive gameplay and stunning visuals, this adventure puzzle game offers hours of exciting challenges and discovery. Solve mind-bending puzzles, collect valuable artifacts, and unravel the mysteries of this enchanted world. 'Shattered Legacy' draws inspiration from the classic idea of nudging boxes and combines it with a variety of tricky puzzles in an immersive and adventurous world. With 7 different areas and over 50 levels, you will have the opportunity to explore challenging environments and uncover the secrets of the ancients. Challenge your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with increasingly complex puzzles. Get ready to unravel the mysteries that lie within! Product Features Challenging Puzzle Mechanic Engage your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you navigate through meticulously designed levels filled with increasingly complex puzzles and obstacles. Multiple Enchanting Environments Traverse through a series of visually stunning and thematically diverse environments. This game features 7 locations to explore, each with its own unique atmosphere and set of challenges. Intuitive Controls and User-Friendly Interface Enjoy a smooth and seamless gameplay experience with user-friendly controls and an intuitive interface that allows you to focus on the immersive world and captivating puzzles. Replay Value With a multitude of levels to conquer and challenging puzzles to solve, expect hours of gameplay that will keep you engaged. Revisit completed levels to discover new solutions and achieve better scores.

rows.name: Sneak Out
rows.short_description: Sneak Out is a free to play multiplayer game full of mischief and fun for up to six players. Enter the Haunted Castle and prepare to hunt, hide, or prank 'em all, causing all kinds of hilarious mayhem while trying to win the deadly game of hide and seek!
rows.description_html: Sneak Out is a crazy free to play multiplayer game of hide and seek full of mischief, pranks, and fun for up to six players. You enter the Haunted Castle with your five friends, and one of you gets randomly chosen as the Hunter. The remaining players must hide and survive within the Castle, completing tasks and avoiding the Hunter until the escape portal opens. Those unlucky penguins who get caught can still assist their friends as Ghost, messing with their pursuers. And those who become Hunters must do everything to stop ‘em all from escaping. Simple, right? Like the childhood game beloved by all. But more sneaky. Hunt as the Hunter This is the most mischievous game of hide and seek ever, and… you are it! Selected at random to be the most sneaky Hunter ever, make ‘em all fear for their lives! Pick your favorite character to embody from a list of terrifying monsters, such as the scythe-wielding Reaper, the blood-thirsty Vampire, or the pumpkinhead Scarecrow (just to name a few), and embrace the thrill of the chase, taking advantage of the unique abilities that come with your choice. The clock is ticking, and time is on your side, so track down those annoying penguins, and don’t let them escape the Haunted Castle! Escape as a Hider Ready or not, here comes the Hunter! But don’t worry, being chased can still be quite funny. It all depends on your attitude! Run away from the Hunter, hide wherever you can, get sneaky, and complete tasks to open the portal to safety. Too easy? So snap and retaliate! Use traps to catch the Hunter off guard or a well-placed banana peel to slow him down, hop on a magic broom to fly away, resurrect your fallen friends, or choose to turn yourself into a lamp while at it. Yes, you can do a lot, but there is no escaping if you’re not putting up the work. Finish tasks, both big and small to earn coins and open up the portal to safety. And if you feel the Hunter’s breath on your neck, do whatever it takes to survive, even if it means sacrificing a friend or two. Haunt as a Ghost Congratulations, you're dead! But here, in the Haunted Castle, death is just the beginning. You get to become a Ghost, and your sole purpose is to annoy the Hunter to help your friends. Seems funny enough? Because it is! Possess a Knight’s Armor to get back at the one that hunted you down, slow him by making it slippery with your ectoplasm, or hurl a chair or two directly at his head. Afterlife feels like a dream if you get comfortably mischievous and make it fun for yourself, no? Customize your style Whether you instill fear as the Hunter or run away aimlessly as a Hider, you need to have a sense of your own style. And we are not talking about the gameplay here. No, no! We are talking fashion, trinkets, and bling. When you complete tasks, you get money. Money means you can customize your very own outfit with a variety of available items and accessories waiting for you. Embrace your inner fashionista even in the sneakiest games of hide and seek!

rows.name: The Cursed Amulet
rows.short_description: Enter a mysterious cave and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. Explore the depths of the cave, search for clues, and solve challenging puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
rows.description_html: The Cursed Amulet is an immersive puzzle adventure escape room game. In this single player game, you play as a curious adventurer who finds themselves trapped in a mysterious cave full of puzzles and hidden secrets. Your mission is to solve the puzzles, unravel the mysteries, and ultimately escape the cave before it's too late. Puzzles Challenge your mind with eight unique and exciting puzzles that will keep you engaged and entertained throughout the game. Mysterious Atmosphere Immerse yourself in a mysterious and ambient atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.
