rows.name: Isop0dyssey
rows.short_description: trash-infested power fantasy crawling sim with racing & crustacean elements set in the gritty, segregated world of ocean floor society
rows.description_html: Dive into the trash-infested power fantasy of being a parasitic isopod on the seabed and gallop your fish steed in underground street races. Welcome to Abyss City: the last link in a chain of seabed cities stretching from the shores to the unexplored depths of the ocean. Built on the edge of a deep sea trench, Abyss City is a polluted metropolis fueled by the garbage and waste of the world above. As a parasitic isopod with the ability to ride fish, you are part of the logistics workforce that keeps the city running, but you are also an oppressed minority in a society dominated by higher isopods. Break free from the cycle of oppression and win your way to the top of the underground street racing scene. Features including, but not limited to: -Realistic fish handling & power drifting -Immersive factory shift mechanics -A party platter of discoloured isopods to find & talk to -Uncover secrets & mysteries of Abyss City, the world above and below

rows.name: Chronicles of Vipers
rows.short_description: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies.
rows.description_html: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies. You play as a secret CIA agent, Steven 'The Viper' Rogers. Your task is to free all your colleagues from captivity in different parts of Colombia, as well as to destroy a new threat - the 'Free Drug Seekers' cartel. The game includes 'old school mechanics': - Only two types of weapons; - Several types of enemies; - 6 different locations inspired by VHS era movies; - Simple plot; - Dynamic gameplay; - Stylized graphics for the zero era. Help agent 'Viper' in the case of liberating friends and eliminating a drug den in the territory of Colombia. For this, you have a pistol and a machine gun, as well as the ability to open any door. So - act!

rows.name: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. El Dorado - Prologue is a strategy city-building game in which you plan, build and develop your settlement to conquer Jukatan and earn the title of The Golden City. Become a leader, whom even Gods will bow to.
rows.description_html: CHECK OUT MORE GAMES FROM OUR FRIENDS About the Game This is the prologue of our upcoming El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - the prologue is just part of the full game that will let you get to know the game before its official release and it's completely free. Build the mightiest and most expansive empire of Yucatan Your aim in the game of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue, is to create the mightiest empire of the whole Yucatan peninsula. Develop your early small settlement into a city bustling with life and dripping with gold. Build, develop, manage your resources and appease the Gods. Dominate other newly rising or existing settlements of other families through conquest or peaceful talks. Diplomacy or blood… it is your choice. Become the architect of your mythical city As the Leader, you will be responsible for every building built on your territory, such as sawmills, temples, housing, barracks and many more. Skillfully plan your city as every path may play a vital role in managing your city. Well-planned zones of your empire will have a special impact on the proper and quickly develop your city. The fate of the citizens depends on you. Gather resources There are many resources on your territory crucial for the development, conquest and keeping your empire stable. Some will be used for daily life, other resources will have a chance to become part of a variety of weapons – so vital to plan your skirmishes. Offer sacrifices to the Gods to earn their favor… Without sacrifices, there is no game based on a mythical ancient tribe, right? God's favor is one of the basic and important quests in the game. Thanks to their approval your city will not only develop freely but also expand its borders and acquire greater military and political capabilities. Satisfy your Gods to avoid their wrath. You can make sacrifices through your Priest in places of worship such as temples. Choose an appropriate slave, organize a grand festival in honor of the chosen Deity and perform secret dark rituals to the delight of the audience. In return, you can expect divine protection from different cataclysms or an increase in yields from your farms and fields. … or prepare for their wrath Gold, riches, extraordinary development… it can’t be that easy. Each repeating or grand one-time festival requires sacrifices. If you happen to forget about worship, the Deities will send many cataclysms to your empire or other problems that will hinder your development. Some will be more or less taxing, but it is always better to evade a lone lightning bolt striking your home and setting the city ablaze or a huge tornado wreaking havoc in your city. Plan well what and when you offer your Gods as no mortal has survived their wrath. Conquer and enslave neighboring people Every gold is paid for in blood and war is the easiest way to get rich fast. Plunder resources, earn slaves and conquer new land needed for development. Gods are not the only worry, there are other peoples and tribes aiming for the same goal as you. Organize military expeditions, and reinforce the war front or defense lines with resources, which will help in your skirmishes with the enemy. Skillful resource management during war will have an impact on whether your people will come back as victorious conquerors bearing gifts or losers. Fight for the title of the mightiest ruler of the Golden City, El Dorado! Do not lose yourself in pride.

rows.name: Food Fighter Clicker Games
rows.short_description: Food Fighter Clicker is a clicker game to become the best food fighter in the world by eating fast food and improving your skills. Tap Tap and be the fastest clicker in the world!
rows.description_html: FOOD FIGHTER CLICKER Food Fighter Clicker is a clicker game to become the best mukbang food fighter in the world by eating fast food and improving your skills. Tap Tap and be the fastest clicker in the world! DAILY GIFT! Every day you play Food Fighter Clicker you will get an amazing reward. Eat your favorite food as fast as possible in this mukbang clicker game. Tap and get your fingers ready for this mukbang game to click and tap tap tap fast to unlock amazing skins and many different types of food in these clicker games. EAT 10 EGGS IN 30 SECONDS! Through the different levels of this food fighter clicker game, you must complete amazing challenges like a figher to have a great time in these clicker games and discover all that Food Fighter Clicker has in store for you. rows.name: SWOLLEN TO BURSTING UNTIL I AM DISAPPEARING ON PURPOSE
rows.short_description: SWOLLEN TO BURSTING is a weirdo RPG in which something is very wrong. A flying saucer has crash landed in town, but it's Thursday so you have to go to work at the post office.
rows.description_html: Just recently, in 'Vomit', a flying saucer appears. SWOLLEN TO BURSTING is a weirdo RPG in which something is very wrong. A flying saucer has crash-landed in town, but it's Thursday so you have to go to work at the post office. THE COOL FEATURES OF SWOLLEN TO BURSTING ORACULAR GAMEPLAY! You're free to do what you'd like in SWOLLEN TO BURSTING . Engage in various misadventures in order to gain access to more places. Find a way into the flying saucer and solve the mysteries within (If you want)! There are many strange secrets to discover. We bet you can't find them all! EXPLORATION IN THE TOWN OF VOMIT! Enjoy humorous and sincere interactions with a variety of fun characters! Meet and get to know everybody over the course of a day. Dine in at the café, or maybe fish up at the pond! CUTTING EDGE 3D 'GRAPHICS' & AN ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK! SWOLLEN TO BURSTING features a variety of diverse, explorable locations. As you progress through the story, time will move forward in town. The weather and lighting will change throughout the in-game day. OVER A DOZEN 'EFFECTS' TO COLLECT! Collectable 'Effects' can be used in a multitude of ways: Level up to get past enemies! Obtain clues to help you progress! Make cosmetic changes to your character! And maybe more!(?) FANS OF THESE WILL LOVE SWOLLEN TO BURSTING : Strange JRPGs such as Yume Nikki & Chulip Old JRPGs such as Final Fantasy IV & Mother The Beatles' self titled album Hideaki Anno movies And other stuff but we don't wanna give too much away SWOLLEN TO BURSTING UNTIL I AM DISAPPEARING ON PURPOSE is just a few hours long. You could probably play it before going to bed two or three times and be finished. We hope you will play the game and have a good time.

rows.name: A Collection of Mini-Games
rows.short_description: This is just a handful of mini-games that I created as I learn how to use and just play around with my RPGMaker. I created these just for fun, but was happy enough with the results that I wanted to let them be played by people to get their opinions, or any advice they may have.
rows.description_html: In this collection of mini-games you can experience four different scenarios, each with different styles of gameplay, including resource management and avoiding the enemies trying to catch you. None of these short games have nearly enough content to be a full game, but they were all fun for me to create and play, so I wanted to let others play them, as well. In these four mini-games you can take the role of an Immortal Dragon God trapped in a prison and plotting revenge, a young apprentice to a powerful wizard who undergoes a dangerous test, a young boy who has to overcome a challenging journey, and a... rock. Yes... a rock. You'll see. All four games have simple controls and their own unique stories. I hope to continue making fun games in the future using everything I've been learning so far, and would genuinely appreciate honest feedback.

rows.name: Yunoia
rows.short_description: Iris, a light spirit, tends to the color of her world with a prismatic mask. One day, darkness envelops the skies and it begins to vacuum away the colors of her beloved Eden. Set out on a journey together to restore this world by dispersing the iridescence that can be found within.

One day, darkness envelops the skies and it begins to vacuum away the colors of her beloved Eden. rows.name: Disco Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. Disco Simulator: Prologue is a game where you play the role of the owner and manager of a music club. Buy equipment, sound system, lighting and decide on the appearance of your club. Make money and have fun!
rows.description_html: Prologue is a part of the full version of Disco Simulator and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Disco Simulator so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Select a manager At the beginning of the game, you will be able to choose your manager. Each of them has their own unique skills to manage different aspects of the club. Decide in which direction you want to develop your club. The skills of the manager you choose will bear fruit in further gameplay, for example: bonuses for bartenders, organizing concerts, or taking care of customer satisfaction. The choice is yours! Choose your club There is a wide selection of clubs waiting for you in the game and each of them poses different challenges and has unique victory conditions. Clubs are located in various places: a village, a small town, the center of a big city. Choose wisely and enter the club legend scene! Care for your customers Your success depends on customer satisfaction. Every guest has their own individual needs, which you must meet in order to keep them in the club. Do they prefer elegant drinks in stylish cocktail glasses? Or maybe they want to dance to the best hits until dawn? Your job will be to make sure that the music, atmosphere and service meet their expectations. Take care of your customers and thanks to this they will recommend your club to others, thus increasing your reputation. React to unexpected events - a fight in the club, a clogged toilet or a drunk customer, you will have your hands full! Organize events We have the club ready and the best staff so it's time to party! Organizing spectacular concerts by bands and DJs is the key to increasing the recognition of your club. Invite celebrities to a stage that will not only attract crowds of fans, but also allow you to gain more customers. Themed events, special performances and exceptional concerts will raise the temperature on the dance floor and attract new customers. Feel the thrill of your parties becoming events that are talked about everywhere! Develop your club In Disco Simulator, the development of your club is a key element that will allow you to reach the peak level of club glory. Spend your money on a variety of upgrades that will make your club a real paradise for music and dance lovers. In the game, you will be able to improve every aspect of the club - furniture, decorations, music equipment, lighting or sound system. Also, do not forget about hiring employees, choose from among the available and create the best event that will be talked about for years!

rows.name: The Severn Rising 2222
rows.short_description: A graphic adventure set 200 years in the future in the flooded city of Worcester. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? Guide a swan and a duck as they attempt to find out.
rows.description_html: Severn Rising 2222 is an ambitious imagining through gaming, of what the City of Worcester, might look like 200 years in the future, where Worcester has been flooded, humans have left, and the city is consumed by nature. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? In the style of a classic point and click adventure you guide a swan and a duck as they explore the abandoned city. Talk to characters and solve inventory puzzles as you attempt to uncover the mystery. The Severn Rising 2222 Features * Hand drawn illustration by artist Sarah Millin. * Classic point & click interface. * Fiendish puzzles. * 20 unique locations to explore. * A cast of characters to meet & interact with. * Fully voiced dialogue. This is a short game originally intended for public display at locations around Worcester. Suitable for all ages. Dominated by the River Severn which flows through it, Worcester is already at the mercy of nature, and regularly experiences flooding which leads to residents and wildlife alike, modifying their lifestyle. The Severn Rising 2222 project, challenges the player to learn more about climate change, pollution and the direct impact it will have on their community. The game brings together beautiful, vibrant depictions of nature and Worcester’s landmarks by artist Sarah Millin, with the game design skills of Paradise Multimedia. The game was developed through a series of creative workshops held in heritage, cultural and environmental venues, across Worcester during 2022. The workshops encouraged participation from a wide demographic of Worcester residents and explored environmental impact through art. The voices and ideas of the residents of Worcester, form the basis of the Severn Rising illustrations and animation and the engagement of the community was central to placing the project at the heart of The City. An exciting legacy of the workshops were the messages in a bottle written by the workshop participants. The messages provide a tantalising prediction of how participants envisage Worcester to look in 200 years’ time. A key feature of the game is the beautiful Worcester locations that the characters visit, which are based upon the partner sites and buildings which the artists felt held a special interest to the community. There is a real array of architecture in Worcester’s skyline, and this is reflected in the mixture of Tudor, Victorian and Brutalist building that are highlighted in Severn Rising. Now you have read all about the development of the project, why not be transported 200 years into the future in flooded Worcester and experience The Severn Rising 2222 for yourself? The Severn Rising 2222 project has been made possible through generous support of the Arts Council England, Elmley Foundation & Worcester City Council.

rows.name: Project CarnEvil
rows.short_description: Project CarnEvil, the ultimate VR horror experience, invites you to confront your fears. This game will test you to your limits with difficult carnival games and a crazed clown to banish. Will you be able to overcome your fear and escape alive?
rows.description_html: Project CarnEvil is the ultimate VR Horror carnival game, transporting players to a ghostly realm filled with dread and thrills! Prepare to be immersed in an atmospheric landscape as you explore the terrifying carnival. The only way out of this sinister carnival's grip is to accomplish a series of challenges. Can you survive the four terrifying carnival games and free the lost plushies trapped inside each? The most difficult challenge of all awaits you in the tent of terror. The land's insane clown king is waiting for you, ready to put your bravery and determination to the test. Are you strong enough to defeat the clown and escape this nightmare? Keep in mind that the stakes are high, and failure is not an option. Will you be the one to break free from this twisted carnival, or will you become one of the lost souls? You have a choice! Features: 1. Haunting atmosphere: Project CarnEvil immerses players in a dark and eerie world, complete with spooky music, dim lighting, and unsettling carnival sounds. This game is not for the faint of heart! 2. Terrifying challenges: To escape the carnival, players must beat four terrifying carnival games, each with their own unique set of challenges. From shooting to ring tosses, these games will push players to their limits. 3. Sinister clown boss: The final challenge in Project CarnEvil is facing off against the mad clown ruler of the carnival. This boss battle is intense and requires skill and strategy to defeat. 4. VR immersion: Project CarnEvil is designed for VR, which means players will feel like they're inside the haunted carnival. This level of immersion adds to the intensity and scares of the game. 5. Replayability: With multiple stages and a variety of challenges, Project CarnEvil has high replay value. Players can try to beat their own scores or compete against friends to see who can escape the carnival the fastest. 6. Thrilling storyline: Discover the hidden pages within the game to uncover the horrors of the carnival.

rows.name: Titor's Time Traveling Tale
rows.short_description: Step into the shoes of a medieval physicist studying the theory of time travel in 'Titor's Time Traveling Tales,' the VR escape room game. While conducting experiments on a strange artifact, you accidentally activate it and find yourself transported to a server room in the distant future.
rows.description_html: Step into the shoes of a medieval physicist studying the theory of time travel in 'Titor's Time Traveling Tales,' the VR escape room game. While conducting experiments on a strange artifact, you accidentally activate it and find yourself transported to a server room in the distant future. Dive into this Demo VR Escape Room game where you must do a series of puzzles/activities to continue. Find the mystery behind your untimely traveling and Use your VR headset and controllers to navigate around the world to solve simple puzzles. Pull levers, push buttons, and find various objects to complete objectives given to continue. Assets used in the game: Medieval Level: Omni Studio Server Room: iPoly3D Dark Room: Meshtint Studio

rows.name: Symphony of Souls
rows.short_description: Save your beloved from the clutches of the God of the Dead! Symphony of Souls is a rhythm-based platformer about the Greek myth of Orpheus. Traverse the Underworld attempting to reach your goal to the beats of the music. Your performance also affects it, unlocking more elements the better you play!
rows.description_html: Set in the Greek Underworld, Symphony of Souls is a single-player, first-person platformer with music-inspired gameplay. You, as Orpheus, will rush through the Underworld, attempting to get to the end while platforming and solving puzzles to the beats of the music. Explore the unnatural lands of the Underworld. The lands of the dead are irregular to the minds of mortals, where each region presents Orpheus with different challenges. The constant shifts in the locale will constantly keep both you and Orpheus on your toes, as you explore the modern retelling of the Greek tragedy. Throughout the Symphony of Souls, you can expect: Rhythm is Everything: Every action that you can take on the beat will reward you, allowing you to flow through the level with ease and unlock more and more of our original soundtrack as a representation of your skills. Advanced Player Movement: Orpheus can’t rely simply on his musical talents to take on the land of the dead. He must be able to flow through the levels with magically gifted movement. With a combination of running across walls, dashing through the air, and even a grapple hook within his lyre, the only thing that could stop Orpheus may be Hades himself. Lastly, Orpheus is a musician who weaves songs to life, and you will be as well! With that in mind, the music system in Symphony of Souls is interactive, where your performance affects it directly. As you progress through the levels, you will slowly build the music by performing actions on the beat, building upon the songs to show the full glory of the original soundtrack! Symphony of Souls is a work of love. With a team spread across five different programs at LaSalle College Vancouver, the gameplay and story is an effort to show the creative take we hope to bring to our mediums of choice. Due to restrictions in budget and time, it encompasses only the first two levels of our project in this form: a free experience where you can enjoy and share with your friends!

rows.name: J-Town: A Visual Novel
rows.short_description: A friendly crash course in Japanese American history, culture, and community! Inspired by the real stories of the three historic Japantowns of California: San Francisco, San Jose, and Los Angeles's Little Tokyo.
rows.description_html: J-Town: A Visual Novel offers an easily accessible avenue to learn more about the ins and outs of Japanese American culture. With hand-drawn art inspired by the the real world counterparts in San Francisco, San Jose, and Los Angeles, explore our J-Town in this small slice-of-life narrative adventure. Talk to the community about real world issues like gentrification, cultural appropriation, and spatial preservation. And equally as important as the problems we face, come celebrate with us as we talk about cultural identity, our history, and more! The Plot A corporate contractor has tasked you with infiltrating the quiet neighborhood of J-Town and finding a weakness for him to move in and open up a new store. However, as you meet the locals, they challenge you to see this community for what it really is. Residents from all walks of life come together to share what makes this place so special. Visit shops and establishments and dip your toe into the rich experiences that bring our real world Japantowns to life!

rows.name: Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition
rows.short_description: A fast-paced arena fighter where animal toys seek to recycle each other in a world of plastic and raining buckets. Throw buckets on the heads of other players, push them off a ledge and be the last toy standing.
rows.description_html: Join us on Discord Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition is an early student project version of our upcoming game Bucket Brawl . Follow us on social media or sign up to our newsletter to stay up to date on the development of our upcoming game. About the Game Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition is a frantic couch multiplayer about animal toys seeking to recycle each other in a world of plastic and raining buckets. In Bucket Brawl, you'll engage in epic battles using buckets as your primary weapon. Toss buckets at your plastic friends, knock them off ledges, convert them into reusable material or send them on a train to hell. Strive to be the last toy standing. Choose from a variety of adorable animal characters and customize them with your preferred colors. Immerse yourself in exciting environments with map-specific mechanics. Don't kick the bucket, kick your friends' ass. It's time to make the world a better place. It's raining buckets! Watch out for buckets falling from the sky. Pick up buckets and throw them at your friends. Buckets rebound from walls and obstacles so use them as your advantage. Got bucketed? It's not over yet. Spam the throw button as fast as you can to get free before your friends get rid of you! Goodbye! Push your plastic friends into traps or off the stage. Just converting waste into reusable material. Nothing personal. Watch out for golden buckets! Hitting a player with a golden bucket will instantly send them to the heavens. The longer the rounds get, the higher the chance for golden buckets to appear. 7 maps with their unique environments and obstacles Don't have enough controllers? Bucket Brawl supports 2 players on the same keyboard (WASD and arrow keys) Supports Xbox controllers and other popular PC gamepads Bombastic soundtrack

rows.name: Garage Flipper: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. Garage Flipper: Prologue is a game where you get to be a builder and renovator of garages and car repair shops. Your task is to complete jobs and build up your empire by buying and restoring old facilities.
rows.description_html: The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. You're an ambitious contractor with a passion for repair shops. The task seems simple, but is it really? Will you handle demolishing walls without having the roof collapse on your head? Can you give them a nice, even paint job? Starting's always tricky but remember – practice makes perfect! CLEAN UP Many people treat their garage like a dumpster and, unfortunately, before you can get to decorating the interior, you'll first have to liberate it from old junk. Rusty mufflers, used-up batteries, shelves of empty cans, as well as old fridges and washing machines are just some of the things people tend to stuff and forget in their garages. Sort the recovered materials or try to sell them to scrap collectors. REMAKE THE GARAGE Go for your hammer and bust open the old walls! You can make rooms bigger by building new ones and installing new roofs and floors. Choose your preferred paint color and soon you'll see new life breathed into the garage! BUY NEW FURNITURE Place a brand new workbench and tool cabinets, as a more expensive preset, or create a collection yourself by laying out tools individually. Remember that everything needs its proper spacing and placement.

rows.name: The Picture of Café au lait
rows.short_description: The picture of café au lait is a visual novel game that makes the players feel immersed in story and character. They will experience the story in the game through the first-person perspective of the main character in the story named 'Takagi'.
rows.description_html: The picture of café au lait Introduction The Picture of Café au lait is a visual novel game that makes the players feel immersed in the story and the characters. You will experience the story through the first-person perspective of the main character in the story named 'Takagi'. This game allows the player to make decisions and has multiple endings. Your crucial choices will change the conclusion of the story. Synopsis This is the story of a 3rd high school student named 'Takeomi Takagi', the only member remaining in the Art club because of his wrongdoings in the past. His goal is to win the art competition before his graduation from high school. He meets “Itsuki Eimi”, the cheerful junior high school girl in the Basketball Club, because she ruins his painting that he will send to the competition by accidentally running into it. This is the coming-of-age story and love story between two people who have opposite personalities. They both have their dreams and face their obstacles together. “Takagi”, the strict and sharp-tongued yet kind senior who tries to help Eimi achieve her dreams to redeem himself from his past faults. “Eimi”, the cheerful junior who always hides her sadness, wishes to become a full member of the basketball team. Will they achieve their dreams or give up? What future awaits them is for you to decide. Main Characters Itsuki Eimi “I don’t want to lose to myself again and again. So, I will only move forward as you said” The Heroine of the story. Eimi is a 1st year high school student who has a cheerful personality. She often jokes around and likes to tease Takagi because of his overly strict personality. Her dream is to become a full member of the basketball team, even if her body is on the short side. She is a joyful and determined girl who loves basketball, but she always hides her sadness behind her smile. Because of her kind personality, she decides to be Takagi's friend, who is lonely and often comes to the Art club room to meet him and makes him smile.

rows.short_description: Our Bee-Man's hives are scattered all over the place. Help it collect all of the hives in each level and travel to the next level in the bubble!
rows.description_html: It's the Bee-Man game ( ﾉ ﾟｰﾟ)ﾉ Our Bee-Man's hives are scattered all over the place. Help it collect all of the hives in each level and travel to the next level in the bubble! The levels get increasingly challenging with new mechanics that keep the fun alive! - Jump over floating blocks over the water! - Avoid the falling icicles! - Reverse gravity and walk on the ceiling! - Fly the Bee-Man around! Collect all the items in each level to gain all three stars. Can you do that for all levels? --- Bee-Man is a level based mini-Metroidvania puzzle platformer in which the objective is to collect all the bee hives in each level to be able to advance to the next level. There are also bonus items to collect to achieve a three stars score for each level.

rows.name: A Date with Death
rows.short_description: Fight against & romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a romance chat simulator where you date(?) the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through text and video calls.
rows.description_html: You're just an ordinary person... or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck... or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down. As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul? A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. Create your own character, from appearance to pronouns, decorate your apartment, and spend the (possible) last week of your life getting to know the one hunting for your soul. 💀 Make Your Character: Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game! 💀 Design Your Apartment: Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to. 💀 Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion: Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend in-between chats. 💀 Choices That Matter: Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper? 💀 Beautiful Art of the Babygirl Grim Reaper:  Fill up your gallery throughout your playthrough with beautiful CGs, backgrounds, sketches, and more!

rows.name: Mages of Osmea
rows.short_description: Mages of Osmea is a top down spellslinging RPG where you create your own spells to defeat corrupted monsters. Fight through waves of monsters and bosses, completing objectives in singleplayer or with friends.
rows.description_html: Become a mage and fight the corrupted monsters threatening the peace of Osmea. Invent your own spells ranging from multi-stage projectiles to area effects or healing and speed buffing spells. Invite your friends to help you in battle against waves of monsters and powerful enemies. Tinker around and finetune your arsenal of spells and level up your attributes until you are strong enough to challenge the 3 bosses who are at the root of the corruption. Spell Creation Use a powerful editor to create new spells and customize every aspect. Design projectiles that follow enemies or heal friends. They can even trigger more projectiles in multiple stages or end in an area of effect. Tune self targetting spells to heal yourself or give you a speed boost. Specialization Specialize your playstyle with skills such as adding chaining damage that jumps to nearby enemies, make area effects move with you, or add healing over time to your healing projectiles.

rows.name: Zombie Ants VR
rows.short_description: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that drives creatures (in this case ants) to change their behavior in order to propagate the fungus and ultimately kills them.
rows.description_html: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) educational experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that drives creatures (in this case ants) to change their behavior in order to propagate the fungus then ultimately kills them. This fungus was a large inspiration for the video game series Last of Us and is often affectionately referred to as the 'Zombie Fungus'. The game offers several different control schemes to accommodate all sorts of players from those who have never used VR before (and those susceptible to motion sickness) to those who want a more interactive experience. Educational content reading level recommended for ages 12+. This project was a student & recent-grad driven endeavor developed through a collaboration between the University of Central Florida (UCF) biology & game development departments as well as the University of Utrecht (UU) biology department. It was supported by NSF Career 1941546, made available to Charissa de Bekker.

rows.name: All is Fair in Love and Vore: The Tavorion Collection
rows.short_description: Vore visual novel! Vore! Sex! Complex characters! Profound thoughts! Women! Well-researched historical settings! Cannibalism! Never before has it been so easy to play all 6 iconic masterpieces, now with extra content!
rows.description_html: Vore. It is the lifeblood of this world! Experience the experience all your work colleagues have been talking about, and finally get around to playing Tavorion's classic games! The collection includes never-before-seen short stories hidden throughout the games, and a complete unlockable Gallery. Not to mention, the entire thing is in both English and Spanish! Expect walking, talking, and the occasional poorly-made minigame. The stories will take you through thrills, chills, and... so much more! You literally cannot afford to miss out on this free artistic experience! The Beast of Tier 4 Play as Rana, a stunningly beautiful woman with a horrifying secret: she devours human beings alive! Seduce and deceive prey to lure them away from safety, and into your stomach... Voyage to Satiety Stephen is trapped on the ship of the enigmatic former-celebrity Olivia Ashdown, and forced to fight to avoid being devoured alive! Will he survive? Does he care about the lives of his fellow captives? Who will he grow close to? Find out! Voyage to Satiety 2 Given a second chance, will Liv finally learn to live a life she's happy with? No! Mission 74 Vore assassin! Avoid the stylishly-designed robots, devour the target! Epic! Hunger of the Fifth Sunset Ex-soldier Alexandria Twain is on a journey through war-torn Guantemana to find her cousin, and decides to stay a few nights at a welcoming hostel. But behind the welcoming smiles, warm food and vibrant colours, there are rumbling stomachs yearning for live human flesh... All is Fair in Love and Vore In the thrilling conclusion to this game saga, the characters fight the other characters and some of them die and there's vore (+ kind of vore) and it's allegory for important stuff.

rows.name: Space Crab VS
rows.short_description: Battle against other crabs with time tested arcade action! Form galactic partnerships and starlight rivalries in the story mode, or battle against other players locally with more than 20 unlockable crabs- some strange, many powerful.
rows.description_html: Space Crab VS brings the time tested, heart pumping Space Crab gameplay into the multiplayer battle-zone! As the the long awaited sequel to Space Crab 2, Space Crab VS offers wonderful all-new features, including an exciting story mode - a series first! Use your Space Crab skills to take your opponent down! Collect meteor dust to make your own meteors, or charge up for a powerful special attack! Pick from 20+ different unlock-able crabs to fight with! Each one has their own movement patterns and special attacks. From the shadow sneaking Ninja Crab to the time manipulating Chrono Crab, you'll find a crab worthy of your partnership! Experience the story of Space Crab putting together the Star Seekers, a group of crabs who explore the galaxy and it's many secrets. Meet strange friends as you fight towards your goals! Battle it out with your real life rivals in local multiplayer fights! Take a break from the excitement and chill out with classic Space Crab game-play, with all new VS style move-sets to keep things fresh. Unlock-able single player and multi-player secrets to uncover! Discover your Starlight Rival, in Space Crab VS!

rows.name: Vesna
rows.short_description: Vesna is an indie made fantasy, turn-based game. Made using Unreal Engine.
rows.description_html: In this heartwarming re-imagination of Slavic lore, travel to Vyriy, home of the gods, a world full of mysteries and adventure at every turn. Follow Vesna and her sister Morena as they battle their way through dust bunnies and frog minions and discover that destiny is not always written in stone. Vesna is a turn-based, top down video game for Windows. Playing as the titular character Vesna, her sister Morena and the bog knave Dennis, use strategy to plan our your movements before attacking. Vesna's close range sweep and thrust attacks pair well with Morena's ice ping and ice wave attacks. rows.name: Sybil is Haunted
rows.short_description: Sybil has a very scrambled mind. Some days she just needs you to push her along. Help Sybil navigate the horrors of her bedroom and see what adventures await. Find every ending to see what lays in her future. HYIPHYOP
rows.description_html: (This game deals with sensitive subjects. Be careful.) This game is not a straightforward experience. Depending how you treat Sybil, and what adventures you take her on, your ending will be different. In this game you wander the detailed confines of Sybil's room and search for each ending. You'll have to play mini games, make choices, converse with Sybil, and watch the horrors unfold. Try and help her the best you can. Check the light switch to see what endings you've got so far. 5 endings total. Controls WASD - Walk Z - Interact X - Cancel F4 - Fullscreen

rows.short_description: Slay the night creatures and save the church, you are the last hope! Defiled Survivors is a time survival medieval game with rogue-lite elements, where you choose your character's path and slay hundreds of enemies on your way.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME! About the Game [/url] This is the free version of Defiled Survivors, a medieval themed, action roguelite game that challenges you to defeat thousands of enemies and bosses in order to progress through levels. As a player, you can choose from different characters, each with their own attributes and play styles. To enhance your character's abilities, you can purchase upgrades, runes, and companions. The game requires you to move around the map, searching for treasures and leveling up to improve your chances of survival. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, and you'll face tougher enemies and bosses. The free version of the game provides a taste of what Defiled Survivors has to offer, but some features and assets may be limited or unavailable compared to the full version of the game. However, even with these limitations, players can still experience the core gameplay mechanics and enjoy the challenge of battling their way through hordes of enemies. rows.name: Pogglewash
rows.short_description: A 3D platformer in which you play as a robot on an alien planet cleaning up polluted goop while interacting with cute creatures named Pogglewonks.
rows.description_html: Pogglewash is a casual 3rd person platformer and shooter. You play as DIPPER, a robot who’s sent to an alien planet named Pogglerock, home to the Pogglewonks, Gloons, and Wubaroos. Unfortunately, the planet is completely covered in goop, but the Pogglewonks don’t have the hands to clean it with. That’s why DIPPER’s mission is to clean it up with his water gun! DIPPER cleans his way through and restores this beautiful alien landscape, helping and being helped by the Pogglewonks in turn, and receiving shiny star-shaped crystals for his efforts. Just be careful around those idyllic shores! Robots aren’t very good at swimming, after all. Engaging 3rd person platforming and shooting Vibrant tropical islands to explore Dynamic level music The Adorable Pogglewonks This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

DIPPER cleans his way through and restores this beautiful alien landscape, helping and being helped by the Pogglewonks in turn, and receiving shiny star-shaped crystals for his efforts. Just be careful around those idyllic shores! Robots aren’t very good at swimming, after all. Engaging 3rd person platforming and shooting Vibrant tropical islands to explore Dynamic level music The Adorable Pogglewonks This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.description_html: Begin your adventure Face down hoards of foes as you by navigate a devasted kingdom. With an arsenal of three spells you must navigate the ruined kingdom of your kind and take down the snails resposible for it's down fall. rows.name: War and Peace
rows.short_description: Welcome to the true world of strategy! This game is a unique project created specifically for players seeking an exciting pastime and a test of leadership and strategic skills.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the true world of strategy! This game is a unique project designed specifically for players seeking an exciting pastime and a test of leadership and strategic skills. Here, you can control the movement of troops on the battlefield and send them to capture mines with just a click. This is the only online flash strategy game where you have full control over each fighter and squad. Manage your squads, find the enemy's weak points, create complex tactical maneuvers on the battlefield, and enjoy thrilling battles. Are you ready to face the challenge of real tactical battles? Each battle is a true test of your skills and tactical abilities. Play for free and join thousands of strategists who have already appreciated the unique gameplay, found an exciting pastime, and made true friends. Earn rewards by completing challenging raids and improving your skills. Play with your friends, share secrets and experiences, and win joint battles in clan wars. When certain resources are scarce, you can increase your own supplies and trade resources with other players. This is not the final version of the game. The game is constantly being developed and improved. Develop your economy, trade technologies, choose development paths, and create an invincible army. You will have an in-depth exploration of new features and game secrets. Embark on an exciting adventure, showcase your individuality and creativity, pass the tests, and become a true hero of this fascinating world.

Make friends or lovers, fight enemies, explore lands, all in an adult setting. Romance : get to know Cynthia, the powerful half elf mage, who is helping the orcs against her brethren. Help her create powerful spells and potions by gathering specific ingredients, eventually becoming her lover in an uncensored setting. Uncensored sex scenes. Magic : learn how to cast magic spells. Use them to defeat your enemies. Combat : Can use multiple melee weapons and shield. Think at strategies on how to approach multiple enemies, overcome their abilities and guide your team to achieve victory. Weapons : multiple weapons with different attributes unlocked as the story progresses. VR Skills : Specific actions done by the player in real life translated as impressive skills in the virtual world. Twist of faith, twist of death, earth shaker.

rows.name: Familiar - Battle of the Labyrinth
rows.short_description: An autobattler where you traverse a mysterious labyrinth. Summoning familiars to fight enemies and finding collectables along the way, as you delve deeper to find what lies at the end.
rows.description_html: In this game, Familiar: Battle of the Labyrinth, you will embark on a treacherous journey through a large and mysterious labyrinth. You will need to summon all the familiars you have to fight a large number of powerful creatures that guard the labyrinth's secrets. Your goal in the labyrinth is to find what lies at the end by fighting through automated battles during which you strategize the best way to defeat your enemies. As you travel through the game, you will find more familiars to fight by your side in battle. In addition, you will have the chance to explore new and interesting locations and find collectibles rare and unique to bring back with you. Do you think you will be able to figure out the secret at the end? or will your story end here, and be forever forgotten? Will you survive the Labyrith? Collectibles Randomly generated battles Replayability Type based battle mechanics This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Saloon Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Saloon Simulator Prologue lets you restore an abandoned Saloon and discover that managing it isn't just about creating drinks and meals. Clean up, organize, and choose the right friends - all to become the most recognizable business in the Wild West!
rows.description_html: America, 19th century after the Civil War. Sand dunes, hot sun, and galloping horses - feel it all while holding a portion of Tequila on ice in your hand. In Saloon Simulator Prologue, take on the challenge of rebuilding an old saloon in the heart of the Wild West and become a pioneer in the liquor business. Prepare drinks, serve them to customers, and discover their stories Not everything went your way; you were cheated, but don't worry! Your longed-for paradise is closer than ever - refresh the ruined interior and repair the damaged furnishings. Purchase the most necessary equipment, stock up on alcohol, and start designing the saloon to your liking. Just remember, money is not manna from heaven - ill-considered purchases are not necessarily advisable here! Prepare dishes, feed your guests, and observe their reactions In Saloon Simulator Prologue, you are the owner of a ruined Saloon. Make the wooden walls once again become a place of bustling meetings with a lot of alcohol. Attract customers and fulfill their expectations with the utmost care, while learning about drink recipes or various types of alcohol inspired by 19th-century America. But that's not all, your task will also be to provide an atmospheric decor, and thus maintain order. Enhance your saloon by choosing from over 50 decoration models. Earn reputation points and attract more and more customers. Make your new guests want to come back again and again with generous tips. Create the most recognizable business in the Wild West. Build relationships with 8 unique NPCs and become a part of their lives. Serving drinks or preparing food is a hard and time-consuming job, but it becomes impossible without prior preparation of the logistical background. Plan your orders in advance and keep your saloon stocked. Increase your business capital through negotiations. Maintain your saloon for customer comfort Expand your Saloon - unlock new equipment or rooms. Establish new relationships with characters and reap the benefits of them, all to help your business thrive. Dive into the mechanics of the criminal world The 19th-century West beyond the sand dunes and hot sun offers history-soaked grounds and a variety of activities. As the day begins to head west, while holding a glass of cold Tequila, take a look at what the area outside the Saloon has to offer, as well as its residents, whose favor will make your life easier more than once or twice.   Saloon Simulator Prologue, includes: -16 Quests: Engage in a variety of tasks that introduce you to saloon management. -12 Drinks and Recipes: Mix and serve a selection of 10 drinks and 2 special recipes. -8 NPCs: Interact with unique characters, each with their own stories and challenges. -Bartending Mechanics: Master drink preparation and cooking. -Criminal World Mechanics: Experience thrilling activities like dismantling carts and hiding bodies. -Full Customization: Customize every aspect of your saloon from the floor to the chandelier. -Premises Management: Unload goods, clean up, and maintain a pristine environment. -Bar Fights: Handle conflicts and keep the peace in your saloon. -3 Merchants: Trade with various suppliers for essential goods and decorations. -Over 50 Customizable Objects: Personalize your saloon with a wide range of items. -Dealing with Death: Navigate the darker aspects of saloon management, including handling dead bodies. Get ready to dive into the life of a saloon owner and create the most recognizable business in the Wild West with Saloon Simulator Prologue.

rows.name: Honey Are You There?
rows.short_description: Matthew Nate, a middle-aged man plagued with mental health problems whose home has become a site of unexplainable paranormal activity and a malevolent female entity is pursuing him to his death.
rows.description_html: Honey Are You there? Matthew Nate, a middle-aged man struggling with mental health issues. Recently, his home has become the site of unexplainable paranormal activity, and a malevolent female entity is pursuing him with deadly intent. Navigate the eerie house and survive the entity's pursuit while grappling with Matthew's deteriorating mental state. Can you uncover the truth behind the haunting before it's too late? Playtime: Around 40 minutes. The Gameplay This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration mechanics. Key Features Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics. Player voice activity. Endings: The game has 2 Endings. As a new game developer, I'm thrilled to release my very first project into the gaming world. I'd like to express my gratitude to those who've purchased my game, and thank them for taking a chance on a new developer. I'm excited to hear feedback from players who've experienced my game, and I encourage them to leave a review and share their thoughts. I want to know what they enjoyed, what they didn't like, and what they'd like to see in future projects. I'm open to constructive criticism, and I want to use it to improve my skills as a game developer.

rows.name: Butterflies
rows.short_description: Butterflies is a video game about inline skating and graffiti. Apparently some people did that before, but they don't seem like they'll be doing it anymore.
rows.description_html: Butterflies is a video game about inline skating and graffiti. Apparently some people did that before, but they don't seem like they'll be doing it anymore. So, here are some skates and some cans, and some adrenaline-pumping tunes to hype you up for the ride. You'll be dodging your way through taser cameras, angry cops and much more. Go paint. Or don't. Be free. Be everywhere and nowhere. Run. Jump. Fly - like a butterfly. This app contains the base container app and Episode 3. The other two episodes are DLC and are there for completeness' sake. Features Ultra-tight momentum-based platforming and timing-based graffiti system Pumping soundtrack by a variety of artists including Sashko Naganuma, DJ Saturn, Frostix, Graphiqsgroove and many more Open-world maps and mission-based single-player story with unlockable characters Splitscreen multiplayer with race, tag and survival modes

rows.name: The Mildew Children: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel. Chapter 1 is the very beginning of the grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. A young witch Kyrphel, along with her sisters, are bound to perform a macabre Ritual in order to save their village.
rows.description_html: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel, The Mildew Children: Chapter 1 is the very beginning of the grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. Guide a young witch named Kyrphel, along with her sisters and make sure they survive the macabre Ritual in order to save the village. A witch's demise during the ritual is not extraordinary, since not all can triumph over Mistress Death. This time, Kyrphel is strong enough to handle it. Or so she thought. Combining the elements of fairy tale and horror, the story draws on pagan folklore and ancient beliefs. Accompany Kyrphel and her friends in this grim, beautifully hand-drawn adventure game. Take part in the Ritual and discover the secret of the village, interact with peculiar villagers, bewitch, and overcome the affliction that haunts the young sorceress. - A full chapter of the origin story that introduces the player to local traditions and sets the stage for the adventure that follows. - Approximately 1 hour of narrative and gameplay combining investigations, puzzles, quick-time events (QTE) and multiple-choice dialogues. - The variety of unique locations: the village streets, the burial ground, the RItual. - A series of tough decisions that will force you to think twice about how you proceed - will you go against ancient traditions or follow them to the end? - Characters with a detailed personality and story, unique portraits reflecting the characters' emotions during dialogues. Numerous side characters Kyrphel would have to interact with in order to fulfill her goals.

rows.short_description: Go through the Persistent Realm of your character. As they get deeper and deeper into the artificial dream, things start to go wrong.
rows.description_html: Welcome to ATNRPG. In this game, you play as a young man who's traveling the fantasy land that was his creation. Along the way you meet monsters and people. Some good, some bad. Meanwhile trying to stop two horrible Deities who have total control over the world! However, things are bound to go wrong when you can influence things greatly while in an unstable condition. Explore the Vast Open World, defeat horrible beasts that lurk the dungeons, and discover more about these characters and their moral values. Most importantly... Have fun, and Stay Lucid.

rows.name: War For Galaxy: New Era
rows.short_description: Become the ruler of the entire Galaxy: colonize planets, extract resources, build defenses and fight in planetary battles!
rows.description_html: The planetary base is your fortress. The main resources for construction are extracted and stored here, scientific research is carried out, new projects for the construction of spaceships are being opened, and much more. The space fleet and ground defense will help protect the base from uninvited guests. Build energy domes, laser cannons, and upgrade technologies. The dock is the forge of spaceships. Currently, there are 15 types of ships in the game that will be available upon completion of the game. Each ship has its own characteristics and purpose. There are warships with different levels of armor and tactical weapons, there are scout ships, transport ships, there are ships for exploring new planets, collecting debris and even stealing. The player is given the opportunity to form flotillas himself and send them on various missions. WarForGalaxy is a multiplayer, cross-platform open-world game based on construction, battles and robbery. You have a choice: be friends with your neighbors or make them your source of power. Attacking the planets of other players, you cannot completely destroy or conquer them, but you can destroy the enemy's fleet and defenses, take away his resources - the most valuable thing in the galaxy. Before attacking, send scout ships to the planet and think over a strategy. Attention! Fights in the game do not happen instantly. The flight to the target takes some time, and the farther away the enemy planet is from your star system, the longer the fleet will fly. However, sometimes you may even run out of fuel and then you will have to develop a new strategy. When the fleet reaches its destination, you will receive an alert on the bridge about the start of the battle. You can personally take command of the flotilla  and influence the outcome of the battle. By choosing the right targets and using the special skills of the ships, you can inflict more damage on ships and enemy defenses. If you are offline, the fight will take place automatically, and you will receive a report on the fight.  Did you want to take someone else's goods for yourself with impunity? Then you should come to us. Sign a contract with the pirates and the Marauder ship will appear in your Dock. Even if the loot turns out to be small, you'll be able to lime your neighbors pretty well. And if you like fair fights and resource extraction, you can trade resources on the stock exchange. There is no currency in WFG, resources are exchanged for resources, and fuel is the most valuable resource. Expansion is the engine of progress. It is impossible to stay on the same planet all the time and develop effectively. With the development of Planet Exploration technology, it becomes possible to send ships to uninhabited planets, establish colonies there and keep these colonies under the rule of the first planet. The more advanced this technology is, the more planets can be part of the empire. You choose which planet to colonize. Planets differ in size and temperature, which in turn affects the volume of extraction of certain resources. Manage your empire from various gaming devices. The game is supported on PC, Android, iOS and WebGL

rows.name: Crescent Quest
rows.short_description: Crescent Quest is a mostly medieval turn based open world RPG that is inspired by 2000s MMO / MMORPG designs while being a single player experience. Increase your skills, go on unique quests, grind for and collect rare items, join the world of Reltionus which is over ten years old!
rows.description_html: Enter the world of Reltionus, exploring the worlds regions as your own character on your own adventure, uncovering many mysteries of the world and other realms. You may get sidetracked with many quests, areas, skills, and customization that will keep you busy. Begin your adventure in the open world of Crescent Quest today! Crescent Quest is inspired by old 2000s MMO / MMORPG designs while still being a unique, single player only experience. There's currently 17 skills to gain experience in, 30+ quests to discover, and 10+ Chyfrinx to collect and raise. Feel free to join and mark your name in the history of Crescent Quest and join the growing world of Reltionus, including the community for the game! Crescent Quest will continue to be formed over time indefinitely and there are many events year-round to be a part of including events for various holidays such as Easter, Halloween, and Christmas. Don't miss out if you are a completionist! Crescent Quest has been in development for over ten years and it will keep receiving updates for an indefinite amount of time. Only specific controllers are compatible with the game, when using a keyboard and mouse only the keyboard will be in use, the mouse is not used within the game. As Crescent Quest receives updates the screenshots and trailer on this store page may change, in-game content and visuals may also change over time. Crescent Quest is powered by the RPG Maker VX Ace engine. The in-game music is from the RPG Maker VX Ace engine. The trailer music is composed by  Irene Chan .

rows.name: Vroom Vroom Valley
rows.short_description: Hit the race track and improve your racing skills or take a sunday drive in a beautiful scenery. Vroom Vroom Valley offers a safe driving experience for the rookies but can also challenge the most seasoned veterans.
rows.description_html: Gameplay A driving game that gives the player a manual transmission car to drive with. After each playsession, you'll understand more of the car and how it handles. Also you'll get more familiar with the roads, which helps you to take better lines. As you get these skills under control, it's time to push and reach the finish as fast as possible. Whether you are a fan of rally stages or race tracks, we got you covered. Scenery changes keep the game fresh, from twisty country road down at ground level to looping road high in the valley. The game includes a long rally stage and 4 race tracks. Rally stage is playable in Stage Rally and race tracks in Time Trial. Race tracks are located in 2 different places with 4 different routes in total. In Stage Rally mode, the player will drive through the valley collecting time bonuses along the way, which helps you get further in the valley, perhaps all the way to the finish. The game ends if time runs out. In Time Trial mode, player is given 3 laps to drive through the track. The car has manual transmission. Using 2nd and 3rd gear is the most efficient way of driving this car. After each play session, you'll get more familiar with the car and the roads, which helps you to get better results.

rows.name: Anonymous Messages
rows.short_description: You find yourself lost in a strange, eerie forest with no memory of how you got there. Equipped only with a flashlight and a cassette player, you must survive and recover fragments of your memory. But beware—the trees are watching you.
rows.description_html: You wake up in the middle of a bizarre, unsettling forest with no recollection of your past. Armed with nothing but a flashlight and an old cassette player, you must navigate through the wilderness, seeking clues to regain your lost memory. As you explore, your heart rate slowly begins to rise, filling you with dread. Your only hope comes in the form of six cassette tapes scattered throughout the forest. Each tape contains cryptic, anonymous messages that provide fleeting moments of clarity and calm your pounding heart. But with each tape you find, the forest grows more hostile, and the trees seem to close in on you as if they’re watching your every move. Can you survive long enough to piece together your forgotten past, or will the forest consume you? Features: Psychological Horror: Experience a creeping sense of insanity as memory loss and the eerie atmosphere turn your surroundings into a nightmare. Immersive Environment: The unsettling, otherworldly forest provides a haunting backdrop that amplifies your feeling of being truly lost. Unique Survival Mechanic: Your heart rate is both your friend and enemy. The more it rises, the closer you are to losing control. Localization: Play with English or Arabic subtitles for an immersive experience across different languages. --------------------------------- This is a port of the original game developed & published in 2013 which was developed by: - BUG GAMES Team - Programmer: Danar Kayfi (@DanarKayfi) Artist: Mohammad Al-Dmour (@LightOfDarkness) Original Idea By: Anmar Al-Obaidy (@PhAnmar) Voice Over: Toni Sattler (@ToniSattler) ---------------------------------

rows.name: Citizens: On Mars - Prologue
rows.short_description: Experience the ultimate turn-based colony building game in Citizens: On Mars - Prologue! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet.
rows.description_html: More great games About the Game Experience the ultimate turn-based colony building game in Citizens: On Mars - Prologue! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet. Unique turn-based gameplay: Manage your colony's resources, expand your territory, and develop your colony as you plan each turn carefully Random events: Face unpredictable challenges such as Worker Strikes and Smuggler Dominance , forcing you to adapt and overcome adversity Faction system: Balance the interests of the Social, Scientific and Industrial leaders to maintain harmony and progress in your colony Take charge of your colony's future, and navigate the intricate web of social, scientific, and industrial factions as you lead your citizens through a new era of Martian history. With each turn, you'll make decisions that shape the development of your settlement, while managing resources to ensure its survival and growth. In Citizens: On Mars - Prologue, the future of humanity rests in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and build a thriving Martian civilization, or succumb to the harsh realities of life on the Red Planet? The choice is yours.

rows.name: Bronzebeard's Tavern
rows.short_description: Bronzebeard's Tavern is a goofy and playful restaurant manager sim where 1-8 players can work as a team with multiplayer co-op. Fulfill a number of different roles, serve a diverse range of customers and cook up delicious dwarven cuisine.
rows.description_html: Bronzebeard's Tavern is a goofy and playful restaurant manager sim where 1-8 players can work as a team with multiplayer co-op. Fulfill a number of different roles, serve a diverse range of customers and cook up delicious dwarven cuisine. 8-Player Multiplayer! Work together (or try) to keep the tavern running for as long as you can with seven other dwarves in online multiplayer. Serve Customers! Properly manage customer seating and orders and deliver them the correct foods to reap rewards! Cook Up and Blend Delicious Food and Drink! Prepare food for the customers upon receiving orders from your teammates, being careful not to burn anything! Customize your Menu! Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast and food sales! Many Customers to Discover! There's always an unfamiliar face showing up when you're working in a tavern... can you satisfy them all? Upgrade your Tavern! Build up your tavern with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for progressing into tougher days. Opt for more customer capacity with a shiny new expansion or utilities like more blenders or more stoves to increase your output!

rows.name: Homicipher: Demo
rows.short_description: Homicipher is a female-targeted language deciphering and exploration ADV based on the concept of 'romance with horror men.' The protagonist, who has wandered into another world, interacts with non-human beings to decipher their language while striving to escape.
rows.description_html: This Trial version included the first chapter of Homicipher. The savedata of Trial version will not be available for the final version. Update date: January 22, 2025 ver 4.0 This is a trial version, so updates may be made without prior notice. Please note that save data from previous versions may become incompatible. When the protagonist wakes up, they find themselves lost in a different world. As they learn the words of the mysterious monsters that speak a strange language, they search for a way to escape. Along the way, will they fall in love with the monster men who come to their aid...? Really? In this alternate world, a different language is used. Players will interpret and dechiper characters' words through expressions, gestures and the objects they point to. The language of this world isn’t as refined as human languages. One meaning is concentrated in one word, with almost no particles; a string of words conveys only a rough meaning. This is a point-and-click adventure game. Players will investigate items to learn words or engage in conversation to progress. Choices for actions are available at various points. Small changes in development, branching paths, or even instant death can occur. Even if you reach a game over, you can retry from just before without any penalties. There’s no affection management, and acquiring flags will unlock more choices. Players can freely jump back to previously encountered scenes from chapters and try again. Play comfortably and easily!

rows.name: Eldritchvania
rows.short_description: Explore unearthly ruins, solve arcane riddles and pick up your sword against the indescribable horrors that lurk amidst the forgotten depths of our world. Beware the creeping grip of madness as you uncover secrets not meant for the eyes of men!
rows.description_html: In Eldritchvania, you will explore unearthly ruins, solve arcane riddles and pick up your sword against the indescribable horrors that lurk amidst the forgotten depths of our world. Beware the creeping grip of madness as you uncover secrets not meant for the eyes of men. Over 70 hand drawn rooms to explore! Countless enemies and traps! Puzzles and riddles that will test your cunning! Upgrades and items to help you on your journey! Damnable bosses! Madness and insanity that affect how the game is played! Lore and story based on and inspired by the works of H.P Lovecraft Eldritchvania follows the aged occultist, Dougald, as he desperately tries to track down his son, Fergus. All clues lead him to believe Fergus traveled to the small island of Blackhorn, just outside the coast of northern Scotland. Dougald is convinced he must save his son before he unearths the ungodly knowledge buried deep beneath the island. But will his quest force him to uncover the very same secrets? Unearthing the long since abandoned ruins of lost civilizations, your cunning, endurance and sanity will be duly tested. Are you up to the task?

rows.name: Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity
rows.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of a derelict facility as you control two characters with unique abilities simultaneously in this thought-provoking 3D puzzle adventure.
rows.description_html: Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity is an immersive 3D puzzle-adventure game that challenges players to think strategically and overcome electrifying challenges. Take control of two unique characters, Data and Surge, as you navigate through a derelict facility and uncover its hidden secrets. Use Data's rocket-powered mechanical arms to interact with machines and devices and use Surge's incredible electrical powers to activate the corporation's circuits and unlock new paths. Switch between the two characters at any time and make them work together to solve challenging logic puzzles. Experience a thrilling adventure full of surprises and secrets as you help Data and Surge find their way to freedom! Key Features: Dual-Character Gameplay : Seamlessly switch between Data and Surge, each with their own distinct abilities, to solve intricate electrical puzzles. rows.name: ENDLING
rows.short_description: Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in this short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness.
rows.description_html: What's your favorite color? Would you eat meatballs for the rest of your life? Are dogs really that cute? Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in ENDLING , a short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness. A Lifetime of Choices Life is full of hard questions and difficult choices—but who says exploring them can't be fun? Watch as each new day brings more questions and curious changes. Marvel as your surroundings twist and turn to accommodate your every wish. But how—and to what end? This quizzical first-person game will have you wondering, guessing, contemplating—but it will take an inquisitive mind and a fondness for reckless destruction to really get to the bottom of things. Inspired by other story-driven, short-form games,  ENDLING  features not only a mind-boggling, soul-searching story, but also home-thrashing excellence and unparalleled high-octane beach ball action. The Perfect Day Just Got Better Originally released in 2021, this school-project-turned-indie-hit finally makes its Steam debut, featuring a slew of exciting improvements including: Enhanced graphics and lightning Upgraded UI, audio, and subtitles Better stuff-breaking physics A ton of puzzling achievements Bug fixes of every magnitude And more! Best of all, ENDLING  is still  free to keep and play! We want everyone to have the chance to live the perfect day—over, and over again!

rows.name: Blind Bullet
rows.short_description: Blind Bullet is a 'blind' 2D action shooting game. The player cannot see but can perceive their surroundings through echolocation generated by footsteps. Shoot down unknown enemies with a shotgun, investigate the area with companions, and uncover the truth behind what has happened to them.
rows.description_html: Blind Bullet is a top-down 2D action shooting game. The player is blind but possesses exceptional hearing, allowing them to perceive their surroundings through echolocation generated by footsteps. Evasion In the game, unknown enemies will attack the player. When sound waves from footsteps hit the area where an enemy’s attack is coming from, the color of the waves changes. Pay close attention to the changes in the echoes to avoid enemy attacks. Attack When sound waves from footsteps hit an enemy, the waves flicker, revealing the enemy’s location. The player is skilled in handling firearms and can effortlessly use a shotgun when acquired. Rely on the echoes to aim and take down enemies. Investigate The player is unaware of their current situation. While they wish to find out what has happened to them and what is going on around them, their blindness limits what they can do alone. Work together with companions they meet along the way to uncover the truth. Contact & Guidelines If you encounter any issues, I would appreciate it if you could contact me via my Discord server or by DM on X (@tesakiza). The streaming and content guidelines are available at patreon.
