rows.name: Ex Vitro
rows.short_description: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.
rows.description_html: FEATURES: A retro love letter to the Metroid series, with a few quality of life adjustments, such as teleporters, rechargeable ammo, item collection tracking by area, and more Discover journal entries hidden throughout the facility, explaining the grim fate of humanity and its war against the galaxy Uncover the nature of the main character and their role in the conflict Collect and upgrade powerful weapons Traverse 8 different biomes, each with their own inhabitants, secrets, and traps Fight multiple massive boss enemies Unlock 2 endings based on item completion Original music tracks by Sam Bionn STORY: By the end of the twenty-second century, Earth was a dry, arid husk. Billions of humans were crowded into overpopulated shelters, rife with disease and death. Just as their ancestors did so long ago, humanity looked to the stars for salvation. Using incredible technologies designed out of desperation, billions of people forged journeys into the darkness, establishing vast networks of interstellar colonies. The discovery of countless forms of alien life was met with indifference - an indifference that quickly turned to contempt. A powerful human military, honed by centuries of warfare, overpowered and conquered isolated alien worlds, claiming them as new territory for the massive human diaspora. Humanity had avoided extinction and resettled itself, but had made a galaxy of enemies in the process. Survivors of countless fallen alien worlds banded together, and launched a suicidal campaign of revenge against the upstart race. All of humanity’s military and technological advances crumbled under the fury of an enraged galaxy, and soon, only a few million people remained, hidden in isolated pockets across the stars. Once again faced with extinction, humanity turned to the tool that had brought them to the stars: innovation. But now, surviving military leaders were uninterested in saving lives or defending worlds. Their focus was far more singular - the eradication of everything. Terrible, reality-warping weapons were created by bending the very laws of nature. Captured alien species were spliced together and twisted into genetic abominations. Artificial intelligences were designed and built to brutalize their enemies, stripped of any ethical or moral restraint. But there were a few dissenters. Not everyone believed that humanity’s last acts should be dedicated to nihilism. Some tried to reason with those in charge. Some refused their orders. And a small number decided to act. DEVELOPER’S NOTE: Ex Vitro began its development many years ago as a tribute to one of the greatest games of all time: Super Metroid. I quickly realized any fangame would be squashed with legal trouble, so I shifted the graphics to my own design and tried to ride the line between ‘tribute’ and ‘knock-off’. It remains to be seen how successful I was, but as a solo developer, I learned a lot about game design in the process. It was the first game I started making, and it contains all of the lessons I learned along the way. Due to its origin, I feel that it’s unfair to charge for it. But I’ve included a bonus pack to go with it, if you want to support future development of new games by me! BONUS PACK INCLUDES: Instructions on how to build your very own Terrarium! (with special tips from the Facility Administration on how to care for genetic abominations) 3 original music tracks by Sam Bionn High res concept art images of the character, final boss, and ending slides High quality wallpapers with various resolutions Royalty-free sprite sheets of unused graphics that never made it into the game, and behind-the-scenes descriptions of why they weren’t included 8 Royalty-free tilesets of every environment from the game

rows.name: The Alpine Express
rows.short_description: Experience the majestic Jungfrau summit in this short walking simulator.
rows.description_html: Too poor to travel? Or don't have time at all from your busy schedule? Don't worry, this game takes you on a journey to the famous summit - Jungfrau - located close to Interlaken, Switzerland. Visit the Glacier Café and complete the travel log. Chopper down and go for a stroll and don't forget to bring some warm clothes because you are gonna need it.

rows.name: A Steamboat Willie
rows.short_description: Sail as mikey mouse with steamboat willy. Move and sell cargo for money but look out for customs officers as they are out to confiscate your illegal cargo.
rows.description_html: Sail a steamboat and movecargo for profit Cargo Cargo can be bought and sold at different ports for money. Some places are illegal to move cargo between but give a higher resale value. Be carefull tho because the customs enforcers may seize your cargo if they catch you. rows.name: Pact of Joy: Prologue
rows.short_description: As Jack Argyle, you are tasked with restoring communication at the underwater ex-Aegis facility known as Phorcys Station. Be careful, or risk joining the spirits trapped inside.
rows.description_html: Prologue: -Jack Argyle, a skilled contractor, arrives at Phorcys Station accompanied by his trusty robotic assistant. Their objective: repair the station's malfunctioning communications system and return home. What should be a straightforward job becomes twisted when they're confronted by the dangers aboard the station. Setting: -Set in the same world as Test of Courage and Born Into Fear, carefully navigate the underwater ex-Aegis facility, Phorcys Station, in the near future of the year 2043 while you attempt to restore its communications. Gameplay: -Piece together the fragments of the station's history and uncover the truth behind its troubled past through dialogue, terminal entries, and more while you attempt to accomplish your mission. -Overall, the gameplay combines atmospheric exploration, survival elements, and an engaging narrative to provide a thrilling and immersive experience within the haunted depths of Phorcys Station. - Repair control panels to restore access to locations around Phorcys Station. - Meet some of the colorful souls who lived in Phorcys Station. - Learn about the past lives of the Children of Joy through their personal computer terminals. Features: - Visions : Get a glimpse of something otherworldly happening in the station. - Variety of characters : Speak to various NPC's and avoid the failed experiments of the Ambassador. - Randomized solutions : Each console will have a different solution for everyone. - Drone Companion : Your constant companion throughout the game, Robuddy will speak to you and give you advice on your quest. He’ll also serve as your flashlight and can highlight interactable objects/objectives using Enlightened Vision. Can you bring the Children of Joy the peace they seek?

rows.name: Road to Top G
rows.short_description: Survive waves of zombies, collect perks, unlock boss door, and face the Top G in an intense showdown.
rows.description_html: Road to Top G is an intense and action-packed game that combines the thrilling elements of a zombie survival game with the added twist of defeating the notorious antagonist Top G. In this game, players are tasked with surviving relentless waves of zombies and ultimately confronting the formidable Top G in an epic boss battle. The gameplay revolves around the player's journey with hordes of undead creatures. To reach the final confrontation, players must demonstrate their survival skills and reach Wave 10, unlocking the elusive boss door. Each wave presents increasingly challenging hordes of zombies, requiring players to strategically utilize their resources and abilities to stay alive. Are you ready to take on Road to Top G and face the infamous boss in a battle for survival and dominance? The fate of humanity rests in your hands!

rows.name: 2 Minutes 16 Seconds (2分16秒)
rows.short_description: This is a 2D Pixel Top-Down Space Shooter Game. The game implemented Rogue-Lite elements, like the survivor series.
rows.description_html: This is a 2D Pixel Top-Down Space Shooter Game. The game implemented Rogue-Lite elements, like the survivor series. 'Captain, every 2 minutes and 16 seconds, the Alien Mothership catch up with us using Spatial Jump. Luckily, we analyzed their technology so that we can also perform Jumps to escape from them. However, it's necessary for us to collect fuels in the space, in order to move and jump. We could also rescue lost people and ships, and add them to our fleet. With our advanced Initializer, we can Initialize ships' weapon system and invite them into our battleship fleet; we can also Initialize people's Implanted learning devices to let them join as crew members. But PLEASE remember, Initialization cost TIME, and jump during Initialization would abandon what's being Initialized. Control: WASD/Arrow + Enter/Mouse' Hope you enjoy this game!

rows.name: Summoners War
rows.short_description: A global hit RPG that captured the Summoners all around the world! Jump into the Sky Arena, a world under battle over the vital resource: Mana Crystals. Design your own deck and strategy using 1,000 Monsters to claim victory. Go on an epic adventure with your Monsters!
rows.description_html: ▶ Game Features ◆ Stunning Action and Infinite Strategy Experience dynamic battles in a truly different fantasy world! Utilize 23 types of Rune Sets, each with unique effects, and build your own strategy to claim victory. Simple controls, endless tactical possibilities! ◆ The True Essence of a Collectible RPG: Massive Monster Collection Fire, Water, Wind, Light, and Dark! Five attributes and over 1,000 Monsters, each with distinctive skills and styles. Maximize each Monster’s individuality and craft the ultimate strategy for thrilling victories! ◆ A World of Endless Adventure and Battle Village, battle, adventure, collection, growth, and crafting! Uncover the schemes of dark forces and take down powerful bosses like Dragons and Giants. Join real-time 3-player raids, awaken new power in the Dimension Hole, explore Tartarus’ Labyrinth, hunt giant slimes with guildmates, and engage in intense Guild PvP battles. An ever-evolving world of massive content— Your adventure begins now in Summoners War! ◆ Real-Time Global Strategy Battles Real-time tactical duels that begin with Pick & Ban! Engage others in Challenge Battle, where victory belongs to strategy with equally provided Monsters. Compete in the World Arena, the pinnacle of strategic combat, and prove your mastery on the global stage in the SWC (Summoners War World Championship)! ◆ Upgraded Growth and Farming Systems Continuous updates now support faster progression for both new and returning Summoners! Take on Summoner support quests and obtain guaranteed Nat 5 Monsters. Enjoy improved farming rewards and less grind through the newly added Ameria's Luck and Scout Battle. Grow with pace and dive straight into the vast world of Summoners War!

rows.name: Block Tower: Prologue
rows.short_description: Block Tower TD is a roguelike tower defense strategy game with interesting innovations. Build a world out of blocks, choose random upgrades to make every run unique.
rows.description_html: Full Game About the Game Block Tower: Prologue is only part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. There are 8 towers available in the prologue and 25 waves of enemies out of 50 in the full game. Block Tower TD is a roguelike tower defense strategy game with interesting innovations. Build a world out of blocks, choose random upgrades to make every run unique. CREATING THE WORLD The world consists of blocks that you can place anywhere. Thanks to this, you will be able to think over a defense plan. BUILD TOWERS Tower locations are the most important aspect in tower defense games. This aspect becomes even more valuable in Block Tower: you can build towers on high ground, leave free blocks for resource extraction or later strong towers. In addition, all towers have an experience bar, the earlier you build it, the stronger it will be in the late game. CHOOSE UPGRADES The order in which upgrades are chosen in each game is very important. You can choose resource-based upgrades, magic tower upgrades, or upgrades for strong early defense, which will allow you to safely move into the late game. Combined with randomly generated blocks, this gives infinite replay value. RESOURCE MINING Think over your economic strategy. Early construction of economic buildings is risky, but gives a big boost in the late game. The random location of resources in each game sets new strategic questions that you will have to answer each time.

rows.name: Santa's Monster Shootout
rows.short_description: Monsters and Zombies from all the world are trying to steal the gift packages, they want it all and they want it now. But Santa has guns, big guns!
rows.description_html: Snowy valleys, Christmas bells and Santa Claus is preparing gifts for Christmas. A normal December. Really? No, something is different this year... Monsters and Zombies from all the world are trying to steal the gift packages, they want it all and they want it now. But Santa don't own just a sack full of gifts and a rod... he also has guns, big guns. Guns to defeat infinite waves of monsters to protect the gift packages. Help Santa to get rid of the evil breed and bring us happy holidays! How to Play: The primary weapon has infinite ammo, it is not very strong but always available. Shoot as many enemies you can to earn money for purchasing new pistols, guns and refill ammo in the shop. Pick up ammo clips and health packages to keep you alive while playing a level. On each level, you must fight against a big end monster to go to the next level. From level to level the game gets harder.

rows.name: Tattoos and Tulips
rows.short_description: Follow Chrys as he declares to swear off dating in favor of focusing on himself and hanging out with friends. That is until a very sweet, and very hot tattoo artist named Shay enters the picture. Has Chrys' bad luck gone away?
rows.description_html: Tattos and Tulips is a feel-good BL visual novel featuring a budding romance between a grumpy florist named Chrys, and a friendly tattoo artist named Shay! Story: Chrys is jaded and unlucky in love. He just wants to focus on being 20—hanging out with friends, working in customer service, and trying not to get his heart broken for the millionth time. Everything changes for him the day a friendly tattoo artist named Shay comes into his shop to sketch the tulips. A kinetic visual novel (no choices). That doesn't mean there aren't twists and turns however! Features: 60K words (18 Chapters + Epilogue) 8 Gorgeous CGs! Original artwork throughout made by real people! Original soundtrack! Partial voice acting! Characters:

rows.name: Magnir Saga Part 1
rows.short_description: Magnir Saga is an action adventure game. Which our hero was reincarnated as a magic sword man. He will journey across the planet of Magnir to revenge for his father and save the planet.
rows.description_html: There is a story on a planet called Magnir which has a magnetic field of the planet necessary for life. Without a planet's magnetic field, high-energy particles from the sun and space, also known as plasma energy coming from the solar wind, hit the star's surface. But the King of Alexania doesn't care. Despite knowing because he believes in his science and abilities that if he can possess the energy of the entire star, he will be able to create a magnetosphere, which is a neighborhood with high-power magnets around it. It increases the energy of the magnetosphere that originally covered the surrounding planet. The stars are so powerful that they can block plasma energy coming from the solar wind. And he himself will be able to take over this planet. -------------------- Main Features -------------------- - Melee Battle - Inventory System - Quest System - Cooking System - Skill System -------------------- Walkthrough -------------------- Escape From Leitu Mining Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Infiltrated Soldier Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Ride On Air Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bandit Village Argyros Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bandit Village Entrance Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Help Blacksmith (random key) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Back To Town (Fallen Barbarian) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Hidden place) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Wall Remove) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Fallen Assassin) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Volcano King Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Stop Boars Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bomb Arrow and Dragon Hideout

rows.name: Neonscape
rows.short_description: Embrace Onyx, the master of the Black Lotus, in intense first-person hack n' slash combat. Maneuver compact battlegrounds, unleash spatial manipulation, and showcase unmatched agility. How long can you survive the relentless waves? Brace for an adrenaline-pumping test of mettle!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Neonscape. The simulation awaits, beckoning warriors like you to prove their mettle and etch their names into the annals of glory. Enter the Simulation Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Neonscape, a thrilling battle simulation that thrusts you into the shoes of Onyx, a formidable warrior harnessing the extraordinary power of the Black Lotus. Prepare to face relentless waves of enemies as you embark on an adrenaline-charged journey like no other. Master the Power of Karma Combat in Neonscape is a symphony of skill and strategy, where mastering the art of Karma is paramount. Unleash the potent abilities bestowed upon you by the Black Lotus, slicing through the fabric of space itself to wreak havoc upon your adversaries. Swiftly maneuver the simulation room with finesse, utilizing your advanced reflexes to execute lightning-fast attacks, evasive dodges, expert parries, and gravity-defying wall-runs. Every move you make is crucial in outmaneuvering your opponents and emerging victorious. Challenge Your Limits The true test lies in the ultimate question: How long will you survive? Keep track of your progress and challenge yourself to beat your personal best! Neonscape features a locally saved score system that allows you to save your hard-earned score and strive for greater achievements. Push your limits and discover the depths of your abilities as you strive for greatness within the confines of your own achievements.

rows.name: Town of Dusk
rows.short_description: Players will enter the Town of Dusk, built on the eve of Empire of Japan's defeat in World War II, along with other characters. Avoid being killed by other characters! Find the mastermind behind the scenes, unravel all the conspiracies, and uncover the truth! Ultimately escape the Town of Dusk!
rows.description_html: The Town of Dusk is a text-based adventure game of mystery, suspenseful, puzzle and slightly horror Set in the backdrop of Japan in the 1990s, two teams accidentally find themselves in the Town of Dusk, which was built just before the fall of the Empire of Japan . There, they embark on a journey of reasoning and adventure. Players take on different roles and influence the story's direction through their choices, leading to different endings. Players need to: Avoid being killed by other characters Solve all the puzzles, find the truth Uncover the mastermind behind everything Ultimately escape the Town of Dusk As an Adventure Game, players can save and load their game at any time, fast-forward through conversations, view dialogue history. This game provides the functions of: Plot Progress Flowchart to jump to any experienced plot point After ending, automatically return to the choice that affect the ending More about the background of this game: 'As secrets buried underground in the Town of Dusk come to light, a shocking conspiracy emerges. Players join the other characters and enter the Town of Dusk built on the eve of the Empire of Japan's defeat. Everyone's identity is shrouded in mystery, and dangerous individuals hide among them, carrying out their hidden agendas. Players embark on a journey of deduction, adventure, and wit that takes them to the brink of death. Please avoid being killed by other characters! Survive until the end, solve all the puzzles! Find the mastermind, thwart all the conspiracies, and uncover the 'real' truth! Then escape the Town of Dusk! If a controlled character deceives you, don't be surprised.'

rows.name: Light of Coco
rows.short_description: Play as Coco - a feline star creature. Use Coco's gentle meows to nurture the environment and ask your butterfly companions to assist you. Beware of the creatures lurking in the shadows.
rows.description_html: Light of Coco is a 3D puzzle platformer, played as a feline star creature named Coco. IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE STORY Light of Coco is a story about love, lonelines, hardship and determination. As you play, you will uncover little pieces of the story delivered via gameplay, level/character design, cinematics and interactive illustrations. The original soundtrack is designed to set the mood and guide the player through an emotional journey. SOLVE PUZZLES WITH THE HELP OF YOUR COMPANIONS Coco is small and gentle, and she has the most adorable, angelic meows. Use her voice to ask your butterfly companions to assist you with activating totems, opening doors, clearing ruble, lifting/carrying items, and so on. Aside from basic movement, you will have to rely on always having a butterfly around you to interact with the puzzles. HEAL, PROTECT AND NURTURE Your butterfly companions might get attacked, trapped or injured. It is your duty to keep them out of danger and use Coco's voice to shoo away any hostiles. Mistakes happen, and that's okay! That's because her voice has healing abilities and can help out those in need. Don't be shy to share your meows with other plants and creatures as well. BEWARE OF THE SHADOWS When there is light, there are also shadows. What evil creatures might be hiding in the darkness? No matter what, Coco must keep moving forward as her love is stronger than anything else. Be ready to hide, run and face her fears.

rows.name: New Day
rows.short_description: New Day is an upcoming life simulation game where almost anything can happen! Create your own islanders, design their apartments, and get involved with their day-to-day life as they divulge into unexpected friendships, problems, and more!
rows.description_html: Welcome... to New Day! New Day is an upcoming life simulation game where almost anything can happen! Create your own islanders, design their apartments, and get involved with their day-to-day life as they divulge into unexpected friendships, problems, and more! Within New Day, you'll be able to use the Islander Creator to create your very own original islanders! The Islander Creator features different eyes, mouths, eyebrows, hairstyles, species, and even a makeup creator -- where you can create custom faces of your own! The Islander Creator is filled with endless possibilities and creative freedom so that you can make the islander you want. The Room Editor is a tool in New Day that you'll use to create custom apartments for your islanders. You'll be able to add up to 4 rooms per apartment, and will be able to decorate to your hearts content. Some pieces of furniture might host some... interesting lore... You'll be able to interact with each, individual islander, which will allow them to form their own opinion of you! Interacting with an islander allows you to access a variety of unique interactions, such as playing mini-games with them, solving a problem they might have, and more! Interactions don't stop at islanders, though, as you'll have access to multiple buildings on your island, such as a movie theater, an arcade, and a clothing shop! Each building will host an NPC that you'll be able to befriend, if you choose to. Befriending the keepers of each building might grant you additional rewards that you won't find anywhere else in the game! Islanders in New Day will be able to form friendships with other islanders, and even relationships, if it gets that far! Friendships/Relationships will form based on how much time islanders spend together, if they have common interests, and their personality trait. If all goes well, maybe two of your favorite islanders will end up together, get married, and... well... the rest explains itself. In New Day, it's entirely possible that a friendship is one-sided, and only one of the islanders enjoy the others company. This can lead to some interesting situations... Jobs are an essential part of New Day. It allows the player to earn money in order to buy furniture in the Room Editor, clothing for your islanders, and more! Each job has their own difficulty setting. With each difficulty increase, you'll earn more money, making the 'harder' difficulty choices more rewarding! In conclusion, New Day aims to be an amazing experience that's suitable for every players gaming preference. We strive to make this an amazing game, made purely out of love and motivation. To end this off, I'm giving a special thanks to everyone on the New Day staff team. (Active Staff Team): Furbies ( Programmer ) Potato Plays ( Artist ) Timtodile ( 3D Modeler ) LilanDeSilva ( Composer ) AjMamoru ( 3D Modeler ) Behon ( Voice Actor ) Rosie_Maybe ( Artist ) Raj ( 3D Modeler ) Anemo ( Artist ) Chamilionio ( Artist / UI Designer ) Valdemar ( 3D Modeler ) absonewtly ( Artist ) Casbastian ( Artist ) Leilanix ( Artist ) Kandy Kat ( Artist ) Zii ( Modeler ) just a fellow girl gamer ( Modeler ) Hunt Moped ( 3D Animator ) SilverBuudha ( Emotional Support )

rows.name: SWAT Commander: Prologue
rows.short_description: The FREE PROLOGUE version of our tactical squad shooter. In SWAT Commander: Prologue, you join an elite special forces unit. Team up with other operatives, manage your equipment, and most importantly – complete your mission successfully.
rows.description_html: SWAT Commander: Prologue is the FREE introductory version of our team tactical shooter and does not reflect the final version of the game. Check out its full version's page for a description of its features! In the prologue, you face the challenges of our second mission – Hot Reception. Team up with your friends in a SWAT squad or go in solo to investigate an auto shop where a violent shootout between rival gangs took place. Secure any evidence of criminal activity, bring the perpetrators to justice, and restore order! Make yourself familiar with the mission's briefing and find out what dangers emerged to threaten innocent civilians – you're about to face them yourself. Equip your SWAT operative accordingly with a selection of rifles, handguns, armors, and tactical gear to tackle the belligerent gangs. Create a multiplayer lobby to invite other players or go into the mission solo or   join the lobby of another SWAT commander . Coordinate and discuss your mission plan down to the equipment each of you will be bringing or the entry point you'll be choosing. Select one of the three available game modes to determine the type of mission you'll be embarking on – high-risk warrant , barricaded suspect , and bomb threat . Your operations' goals can change between bringing down dangerous suspects, neutralizing entrenched criminals, and defusing an explosive device. Enter the Bernard Tire & Auto Center to begin the SWAT intervention. Secure your mission objectives and earn an evaluation of your performance. Remember to keep your eyes open and use every tactical advantage you can think of. Defend the innocents and bring the perps to justice!

rows.name: Des racines et des graines
rows.short_description: A garden game where you will explore a calm and peaceful island. Gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree: Yggdrasil.
rows.description_html: Des Racines et des Graines (Roots and Seeds but in french) is a garden game where the player will explore an island with different species of plants and trees. Each day you're uncovering this new environment and its history. You will gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree : Yggdrasil. . Enjoy a free cozy game . Explore a beautifull hand-draw island . Experiment with mysterious plants . Gaming experience around 1h Please note, due to its short playing experience and its production over 48 hours, the game does not offer a saving system. Some sounds were produced by digifishmusic, klankbeeld, Noted451, DBS_Sounds, cupido-1 & jgrzinich and distributed by FreeSound.

rows.name: Rags to Liches
rows.short_description: A small, third-person, action, tower defense game where you play as a peasant who gets tired of adventurers breaking into his house. Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of 'enemies.' Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama.

Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of 'enemies.' Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama. Features 5 Levels 4 Tower types Endless Mode Keyboard RGB If you find any bugs, please let us know. We hope you enjoy this game we made in 10 weeks.

rows.name: Daycare Descent
rows.short_description: Daycare Descent is a co-op shooter inspired by Left 4 Dead. Take control of our four trepid adventurers as they battle toys throughout the daycare in search of snacks. Tighten your diapers, grab your pacifiers, and fill up your water guns. Playtime's just begun!
rows.description_html: Naptime's over! With rumbling stomachs and no snacks in sight, explore a deserted daycare overrun by vengeful toys. From the nap room to the basement storage, navigate through the eerie corridors and relentless toy onslaught in your quest for snacks. Features: Crawling Babies: Play as one of four toddlers crawling around the daycare. Careful standing up though, as walking around can result in tripping. Tantrum-based Health System: As the players take damage, they inch closer to totally flipping out. Don't throw a tantrum for too long, or the attendant will take notice. Toy-filled Chaos: Battle through waves of mischievous toy enemies, ranging from pint-sized troublemakers to formidable toy bosses. Uncanny labyrinth: From the Daycare's nap room, traverse the halls and delve into the eerie cellar in search of snacks. Characters: Dillian: The French-Korean baby, self-appointed leader of the snack brigade Joah-Joah: The buff baby, muscle of the group Phoebe: The toy expert, hungriest of them all Travis: The lookout, aware of his surroundings

rows.name: Valley of The Savage Run
rows.short_description: Move both frogs in sync to reach the end of the level before the predator catches them. Can you use your brain's left and right hemispheres simultaneously to move the frogs in sync? Only 5% are able to do it.
rows.description_html: Move both frogs in sync and try to reach the end of the level before the predator catches them. Only 5% of all players are able to activate their left and right brain hemispheres at the same time to move both frogs in sync. Are you one of them? You control a white frog and a black frog. They work as a team. The white frog hops on white tiles, and the black frog hops on black tiles. Sometimes one frog has to carry the other because there are no matching tiles. Other times, one frog has to unblock the tiles of the other, so both can continue forward. Teleports are tricky. The frogs may have to hop on each other's backs before and after entering the teleport in order to match the right tiles on the entrance and exit. Meanwhile, you have to move fast. A predator chases the frogs and tries to catch them. Sometimes you can deceive it and use it to unblock your way.

Other times, one frog has to unblock the tiles of the other, so both can continue forward. Teleports are tricky. The frogs may have to hop on each other's backs before and after entering the teleport in order to match the right tiles on the entrance and exit. Meanwhile, you have to move fast. A predator chases the frogs and tries to catch them. Sometimes you can deceive it and use it to unblock your way.

It's up to the Ballymont Paranormal Group to investigate the castle. It appears that there is more than meets the eye... Place equipment and gadgets during the day in order to survive the threats of the night. Featuring: First Person day sections Point and Click night sections Custom Night game mode with 3 new enemy types Investigate the castle during the day and place cameras, sensors, and snares throughout the explored environment. You must use your investigation skills to determine the locations of paranormal hotspots and find clues about countering new enemy types. Unravel the mysterious downfall of the Moloch family and lay their souls to rest. [** From the developer **] This game was created over the course of 2.5 years by one person. Would love to hear constructive feedback!

rows.name: Throne and Liberty
rows.short_description: Throne and Liberty captures the essence of classic MMORPGs while introducing new gameplay elements, depth and excitement at every turn. Gather your guild, prepare for battle, and set forth for throne... and liberty!
rows.description_html: Join massive battles, transform into your favorite creatures, and wield powerful weapon combinations in Throne and Liberty, an unforgettable free-to-play adventure with seemingly endless activities for both PvE and PvP players. Interested in PvE? Challenge Raids, dungeons, Dimensional Trials, and more. Prefer PvP? Form alliances to rule together or betray your way to the top. Will you carve your niche as a solo player or leave your legacy on the world of Solisium alongside friends? The choice is yours. Throne and Liberty captures the essence of classic MMORPGs while introducing new gameplay elements, depth and excitement at every turn. Gather your guild, prepare for battle, and set forth for throne... and liberty! KEY FEATURES: Guild-Based PvP for Every Ambition : Capture control points in guild versus guild Conquest Battles, strike down Guild Raid Bosses, and claim the throne in massive Castle Sieges to carve your legacy on the world of Solisium. Where will your ambition take you? Slash through Dynamic Guild Events, complete Guild Contracts, or hang out in your Guild Base before cutting a path to the top of the Guild Leaderboard in higher stakes game modes.     Activities for Every Level of Adventurer : Journey into 6-player tiered Dungeons, vanquish monstrous, open-world bosses, or best other players in 3v3 Arenas. There are also solo dungeons that help ease you into more difficult group activities like Dimensional Trials. Looking for something even more intense? Venture forth into Raids for a true test of teamwork and skill. How about laid back experiences? Gather materials, build furniture, customize your house, catch fish, and cook local delicacies for buffs. Housing is more than just a place to hang out, it’s a personal space that grows with you throughout your quest.     Innovative Character Abilities, Morphs and Transformations : Interchangeable abilities on the battlefield include the dual-weapons system, player morphs for tactical advantage, and quicker travel or transform into the body of a fallen boss and turn the tide of the battle with Guardian’s Pledge.       Vast, Seamless, and Ever-Changing World : Expansive and immersive environment, with towering cliffs and cavernous dungeons with consequential day/night cycles and unpredictable weather that impacts your gameplay and abilities.       Forge Your Path to Glory : With four primary vertical progression paths interwoven together, players choose from a wide variety of options to determine their playstyle. With hundreds of combinations of builds, you can forge your own unique way to storm the battlefield.

rows.name: Effugium
rows.short_description: Explore a cold, abandoned, and dreary facility to piece together its mysteries and find a means for escape from the horror that lurks within.
rows.description_html: 'Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.' - J. Robert Oppenheimer Effugium is a first-person exploratory horror walking simulator with a heavy emphasis on atmosphere and immersion. Key Features : Navigate and search for a means for escape as you explore the cold and empty space facility. Immerse yourselves in the atmospheric sounds and world of Effugium! Uncover and piece together the mystery of the space facility. Effugium was developed by Team Glasses, a team of two students from USC Games in collaboration with the Berklee College of Music. Playtime is approximately 6-10 minutes. It is recommended to use headphones and an external mouse for the best possible experience of Effugium!

rows.name: Johnny Rocketfingers Complete Game Collection!
rows.short_description: JOHNNY ROCKETFINGERS 1 & 2 - GAME COLLECTION! The internet smash hit Point & Click Adventure game, 'Johnny Rocketfingers,' is finally available to play from your desktop computer!
rows.description_html: JOHNNY ROCKETFINGERS 1 & 2, GAME COLLECTION!! The internet smash hit Point & Click Adventure game, 'Johnny Rocketfingers,' is finally available to play directly from your desktop computer! With over 50 million+ plays world wide this viral Stick Figure flash game won the hearts of everyone who played it on Newgrounds back during it's debut in 2003! Enjoy replaying this classic series or playing for the first time! In this adventure game series you control the character of Johnny Rocketfingers. Move your cursor carefully around environments to walk through and explore your surroundings. Click on items you find on-screen to pick them up. These items go in your inventory for the use of solving in-game puzzles. Talk to characters to get clues for what to do next on your missions. This is your standard Point & Click Puzzle Adventure game but with a violent, gritty, Tarantino-esque twist - inspired by Monkey Island, Lucasarts and Sierra games of the 90's. Also inspired by films such as Pulp Fiction, Goodfellas and Menace II Society. WARNING: This game series is not recommended for young audiences or sensitive players. Contains extremely Crude Humor, Violence, Vulgar Language, Sexual Innuendos. Depictions of sexual acts and extreme violence. Depictions of drug and alcohol abuse.

rows.name: Forwards
rows.short_description: An experiential linear narrative walking sim
rows.description_html: Suggestion Of How to Play This: As the designer behind this, I suggest playing this alone where you can take your time and experience this. I'm hoping this adds a bit of positivity and brightness into your life. This is intended for 'First Person Shooter' players who use WASD controls... kind of... you'll see. --------------------------------------------------------------- Controls: The gameplay for PC players is looking around with the mouse and moving with the WASD keys, kind of. Players can use a controller, just use the joysticks for movement and looking around. There are Haptics for the controller --------------------------------------------------------------- Game Intent: As you move through the game, you'll 'Discover' things and through that discovery, I hope to take you on a journey of looking inside your life. 'Forwards' is an expression of my personal journey as a designer. --------------------------------------------------------------- Playtime: Approximately 1 Min Average playtime is about a minute with the game instantly starting and immediately closing when it's over. There is no menu. --------------------------------------------------------------- Note On Playthrough: Some people have gotten stuck and taken longer and some people have gone through missing parts of it. I took the consideration of making the game easier to playthrough at the potential cost of players going through it the wrong way. Still, I hope the majority of players are able to experience the fullness of this game. --------------------------------------------------------------- Reminder: This is an prototype for an experiential linear narrative walking sim. --------------------------------------------------------------- Spoilers and Inspiration: The Backwards level in The Beginner's Guide. I altered the level, the narrative, the controls, lighting and audio, that I hope, tells it's own story and differentiates it from that level. The environment feeling is suppose to be that of the The Stanley Parable which is the same developer as The Beginner's Guide

rows.name: CATASS
rows.short_description: CATASS is an indie game that is 100% free without ads. In CATASS, you'll be a cat and show your great superiority to your human through fun and short adventures, puzzles, achievements, and lots of humor. Play now!
rows.description_html: CATASS is a game where you are a cat! Never let your human realize your feline plans. THROW THINGS! And many other important plans, of course. I mean... Meow. Complete the main storyline to declare yourself a supreme cat and show your human who's in charge. CATASS is a casual game where you can demonstrate your worth as a cat through different levels and extra challenges. An adventure filled with exciting levels, puzzles, riddles, humor, references to pop culture, and the internet. Complete all the achievements to become the greatest cat of all time and crown yourself as the master and supreme ruler of CATASS. CATASS is a personal project developed solo and made in my free time on weekends. And to provide a fun and exciting experience. This project is to prove myself by developing a solo game from scratch: Game design, graphics, logic, music, and animations. I've made everything except the sound effects and typography I bought in Envato Elements. If you play the game, I beg your pardon because of all the bugs. I'm not a programmer and an absolute noob developing. Surprisingly, many great people have finished the game, streamers, VTubers, and amazing gamers around the globe. The game works. IT WORKS! I really don't know how, but it works! Download CATASS now and experience the thrill of being a cat. You won't regret it!

rows.name: Hauma - A Detective Noir Story - Prologue
rows.short_description: Hauma is a deduction visual novel set in Munich. Discover a conspiracy amongst the upper echelons of society alongside former detective Judith, while visiting real locations in a comic-inspired look.
rows.description_html: ABOUT HAUMA Hauma is a noir deduction visual novel set in the heart of Munich. Step into the shoes of Judith, a former detective with a sharp wit and a knack for getting things done, as she uncovers a conspiracy amongst the city's upper echelons of society. Explore real locations in a unique art style, immersing you in the world of Bavaria's capital. From the historic House of Art to other unexpected locations, discover pieces of hidden history that shed light on the city's past. Collect items, solve puzzles, and overcome dialogue riddles as you make your own investigative deductions using the mindboard, the heart of the game which functions like an inventory containing items and thoughts. Featuring a diverse cast, Hauma is a fully voiced cinematic adventure with an intriguing story. Embark on a journey of deduction and intrigue, uncover the secrets of Munich's society and piece together the puzzle of the conspiracy that lies within. [❖] A thrilling noir-inspired journey through Munich [❖] The mindboard, an innovative inventory of interconnected items and thoughts [❖] Engaging investigation mechanics, including a variety of puzzles and challenging dialogue riddles [❖] A visually unique art style [❖] Fully voiced cinematic adventure, featuring a diverse cast

rows.name: Striker Zone: Gun Games Online
rows.short_description: Join in with friends in a online shooter about modern warfare!
rows.description_html: Step into the thrilling Striker Zone – a cross-platform shooter game where heroism meets the heat of battle. Engage in heart-pounding warfare with soldiers from around the globe, each moment packed with adrenaline and the echo of gunfire. In Striker Zone, you are more than a soldier; you're a modern warrior, a hero poised to strike in the zone where war never ends. Your arsenal? A range of free, state-of-the-art weapons at your fingertips. Every battle is a chance to rewrite history in this world of constant war, where your army comrades become your brethren in arms. Battlefields come to life with the sound of shooting and the rush of survival instincts. Attack is more than a strategy; it's your second nature, honed to perfection in the zone where only the strongest persist. And as the gun smoke clears, will you stand as the ultimate survivor? The game's essence is warfare, but the experience is pure adrenaline. Striker Zone offers a free PvP environment that challenges your shooter instincts at every turn. Each battle, each skirmish, each silent takedown could tip the scales in this relentless world war. With every fight, you climb the ranks of the army elite, proving your mettle as a soldier, hero, and legend of the Striker Zone. Your weapon is not just a gun; it's an extension of your will, modern machinery of warfare that brings the concept of attack to a whole new level. So, prepare to immerse yourself in Striker Zone, where the action never stops and the next battle is just a heartbeat away. Will you answer the call of duty and become the hero this world needs?

Fight with players from all over the world, diversify your arsenal with weapons and prove your superiority on the battlefield. Are you ready for War Gun?

Go into the world war and become an irresistible warrior, ready to face any challenges. War Gun is a story about brave heroes and exciting battles. You will have to fight in epic online battles in which every shot and every decision matters. Choose your side and join the battle full of adrenaline and dynamics. From the moment the game starts, you will plunge into the incredibly realistic world armed conflict. Stunning graphics and high-quality visual effects will allow you to fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of war. The environment comes to life before your eyes, creating the illusion of presence on the battlefield. The game offers you endless opportunities for strategic thinking and tactical reasoning. A variety of game modes and maps will allow you to choose the perfect battlefield for your style of play. Whether it's stormy street battles or a clever operation in the snowy mountains, armed conflict will provide you with an unforgettable experience. A huge selection of weapons and equipment will allow you to customize your character and create unique battle tactics. From powerful assault rifles to deadly sniper rifles, you will be able to choose what is right for you. Gradually unlock new items and upgrade your weapons to become a real military expert. War Gun also offers an exciting multiplayer mode that allows you to challenge players from all over the world. Join a team with your comrades in arms and apply your skills and tactical thinking to achieve victory.

rows.name: Strongblade - Puzzle Quest and Match-3 Adventure
rows.short_description: Strongblade is a match-3 puzzle game where you play as Sean the Mouse. Travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.
rows.description_html: Strongblade is a vibrant, match-3 puzzle adventure with an irresistible charm. As Sean the Mouse, you'll navigate through a stunning world full of puzzles and obstacles, make friends with lovable animal characters, and outsmart crafty villains. The game features over 30 distinct mechanics and thousands of levels, each packed with thrilling power-ups and combinations. Beyond just solving puzzles, you'll be exploring new territories, setting up and decorating unique campsites, and unearthing treasure chests filled with coins, power-ups, and boosters. rows.name: Sea of Chaos
rows.short_description: 'Chaos Sea' is an easy real-time strategy development game, where you play a land floating in chaotic waters. Build your base, recruit your heroes, defeat and capture monsters, match traits and equipment, and reach the depths of the sea.
rows.description_html: 'The Sea of Chaos' is a casual real-time strategy game where you can develop characters. In this game, you are born into a chaotic sea with a small floating land. You need to: 1.Collect resources and expand your land. 2.Recruit members and build defensive structures to fend off randomly generated enemies, each unique. 3.Construct various buildings to strengthen your base and unlock technologies to enhance structures. 4.Choose members with excellent traits, arm them thoroughly, and venture into the depths of the sea to gain greater power. 5.Defeat enemies and imprison them. During battles, you can release them from prison, and they will fight for you. 6.In addition to these, you can also: surround your base with sturdy walls and engage in street fighting with enemies, encounter various interesting or dangerous random events. Your character will not truly die, and you will not be completely defeated. You can play freely and casually. More content is currently in production and optimization...

rows.name: Procrastinaut
rows.short_description: Stranded for unknown reasons in the lower orbit of a purple gas giant, you are kind of just chilling out. You should probably get on with your mission. There's still plenty of time, though.
rows.description_html: Stare down the vast abyss of the unkown until the abyss stares back at you, and the prolonged eye-contact is kind of awkward. Then do something about it! Like, not now , but very soon. Just one more good stare is not going to kill you. Explore A malfunctioning ship and the loss of most of your equipment doesn't even slow you down. What secrets will await you in the foggy expanse of this failed star? Excitement? Danger? Maybe there's snacks? Explore some more You're definitely not just putting your mission off, you're charting new territory! It's time to face the elements with nothing but a high tech space suit and a healthy curiosity. Key Features Smooth platforming gameplay An interactive environment Procedual-ish storytelling A wholly unproductive time-sink Achievements, but you can do them later Space-beer

rows.name: BlueSuburbia
rows.short_description: BlueSuburbia is a haunted world where you explore poems through immersive environments. Seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beautiful and terrible. Explore forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds on your quest to find hope.
rows.description_html: BlueSuburbia is interactive poetry and literature. It is a haunted dreamscape where you explore poems through immersive environments. Wander through the world of poetry, seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beautiful and terrible. Forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds are yours to explore as you venture on your quest to find hope in the darkness. BlueSuburbia is about struggle, survival, tenacity, strength, and hope... along with a healthy dose of existentialism. It is a commentary on strength and persistence despite the world trying to destroy you... the light you feel inside that does not let you give up, even when the world around you is at its darkest. It is a beautiful horror. Features include large open worlds to explore, with poetry and writing that you uncover in these haunted spaces. It is immersive literature. This is a reboot of the 1999 cult classic Flash website. It is currently under production. Regular updates to the demo will be released until it is finished.

rows.reviews_html: “It's exciting and chilling all at the same time, as you never really know what you'll stumble across next. Walking through doors, clicking on words or otherwise discovering a new area initiates a short scene interspersed with text. They're all different, they're all a little breathtaking, and they're completely fascinating to watch.” Jay Is Games “It’s a mystifying, confusing, stunning and captivating game that does a great job of taking short form writing and placing it in environments that really elevate the experience. A powerful and poignant poetic experience well worth diving into.” Alpha Beta Gamer “BlueSuburbia takes you to a place that is filled with a lonely kind of menace – an oppressive fear that crushes you as it tells you that no one will come save you.” Indie Games Plus

rows.name: The Dark Climb
rows.short_description: The Dark Climb is a challenging, third person, resource-based, stealth game in which you try to reach the end of a dark and dangerous map. You are equipped with a light source, which is directly bound to your life in the game.
rows.description_html: The Dark Climb is a resource-based, third-person stealth game set in a dark and dangerous world. Your objective is to navigate through the perilous environment and reach the shining gate at the end of everything. With limited sources of light available, you must rely on a personal light source to illuminate your immediate surroundings. However, this light source is directly tied to your in-game life and will deplete over time. If it runs out of energy, you will meet your demise. Fortunately, scattered throughout the world are safe-havens in the form of giant eyes, where you can replenish your light source. These havens are initially unlit, requiring you to discover and use scattered lanterns to illuminate them. By doing so, you gradually illuminate your path through the world. Beware of deadly flying eyes that also inhabit the map. Drawing their attention with your light will result in them attacking you and rapidly draining your energy. If you do attract their notice, your only means of escape is to temporarily seek refuge in the shadows. Effective energy management and stealthy, evasive gameplay are crucial to your success. Traversing the map is not without its challenges, as the darkness continually tears it apart, leaving a fractured environment adrift in an endless void. Your character possesses basic movement abilities such as walking and jumping to navigate this fragmented world. Moreover, The Dark Climb aims to provide a captivating audio-sensory experience. The fading energy supply and menacing inhabitants of the dark world are emphasized through immersive sound design. The safe-havens also contribute to this experience, offering a sense of relief whenever you can freely activate your light, even if you remain just a small glimmer lost in the eternal night.

rows.name: Bumper Arena
rows.short_description: Buckle up! Bumper Arena is a party game in which you drive a bumper car through a series of arenas featuring different mini-games. Bump and bounce your opponents off the walls, earn the most points during the round and try to win the game!
rows.description_html: Bump your friends in a variety of mini-games Stand out from the competition by collecting as many points as possible before time runs out, and fight your way through overtime to settle any ties. Give everything you've got and get back on track, even if you've started with a loss! Play with up to 4 friends locally or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together Bumper Arena lets you enjoy the game experience locally or remotely with just one copy, thanks to Steam Remote Play Together. Only one player can use the keyboard, and the others will need controllers. Gather your friends and get ready to bounce! Balance your games and practice Having trouble gathering enough players? Don't panic! Complete your games with bots and enjoy mini-games in the best possible conditions. It's also a great way to practice. Choose the character and bumper car that suit you best. Express yourself by choosing your favorite character and vehicle, and challenge your opponents in style!

rows.name: The Stranded Traveler
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in The Stranded Traveler, a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where you take on the role of a traveler stranded on a mysterious island. Explore dangerous environments, fight fierce enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!
rows.description_html: Welcome to The Stranded Traveler! Embark on an epic journey in The Stranded Traveler, a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where you take on the role of a traveler stranded on a mysterious island. Explore dangerous environments, fight fierce enemies, and defeat challenging enemies as you make your way through the game's levels. With a retro-inspired art style and fast-paced hack-and-slash gameplay, The Stranded Traveler offers a challenging experience that's sure to appeal to fans of classic platformers. (Please note this game was made by a single developer in a small time-span) As you progress through the game, you'll uncover the truth behind the organization responsible for dooming Earth. With the fate of the world in your hands, you'll need to take down this powerful organization and restore the world to its former glory. Do you have what it takes to survive the challenges ahead and save humanity from certain doom? Only time will tell in The Stranded Traveler. What to do in The Stranded Traveler? Fight monsters, loot & sell items, Upgrade your character Figure out who created all these mysterious creatures on earth! Single-Player with Mini-Games within (Mini-Games described below) & Much more! Mini-Games 1. Ball Mini-Game, make sure you hit the balls in the right direction! 2. Legacy Space Shooter Mini-Game! Shoot the asteroids to make it out. 3. The Stranded Cafe: Gamble your hard earned coins for a change to win extra coin's & upgrade's Developed by DeadEagle, Published by Spitfire-Games™

rows.name: INVICTA: The Next Queen
rows.short_description: INVICTA: The Next Queen is a TopDown Soulslike game where a legendary warrior must fight her way through hell and claim her soul once more. Take the role of Moma as you explore the labyrinthian dungeons that make up the Circle of Greed and defeat King Midas in single combat.
rows.description_html: INVICTA: The Next Queen is a TopDown Soulslike game where a legendary warrior must fight her way through hell and claim her soul once more. Take the role of Moma as you explore the labyrinthian dungeons that make up the Circle of Greed and defeat King Midas in single combat. Welcome to the 4th layer of Hell, realm of the greedy and the corrupt. Play as a fallen warrior of legend, hell bent on getting her soul back from the demons that took it. Rip and tear through the armies of King Midas, and put an end to the Reign of Gold. Will you be able to take the crown? Do you have what it takes to claim the throne of Hell? Force your way open in 5 zones under the rule of Midas and his commanders. Discover secrets, fight enemies and teach them who will be the Next Queen of hell. Embrace the chaos and break everything you can, you might even discover something interesting! Beat Midas and all of his commanders in a face to face fight that will be written in the books of hell. Synopsis In life she was the most powerful woman to ever roam the earth. The mere uttering of her name made the mightiest warriors run in fear. Priests worshiped the dirt she walked on, and kings gave up their crowns before engaging her in battle. And yet, she fell. A single arrow pierced her heart, and plunged her into the depths of Hell. Moma, The Endless Warrior, was no more. In her fall, The Lords of the Seven Circles, the rulers of the underworld, decided to split her soul. They would shatter it, and spread its pieces all over Hell, in an attempt to weaken Moma and keep her from conquering the kingdom of the dead. Taking it back, becoming whole again, would be a quest impossible for any mortal. But she is no mere mortal. Now Moma, armed with self-righteous anger and her blade, has a single thing on her mind. Defeat the Lords of the Seven Circles and become The Next Queen of Hell.

rows.name: Born to Rise
rows.short_description: To complete Yridis' mission, you'll have to make your way through the bowels of a vast underground dungeon filled with unique environments, deadly dangers and mysterious beings. Jump, dash and give the enemies you encounter their due thanks to powerful weapons.
rows.description_html: In the depths of a long-forgotten city, amidst the ruins, lies the remnants of a malevolent Archonist, whose sadistic pursuits have claimed countless lives in the relentless pursuit of perfection. Prepare to embark on an extraordinary quest as you assume the role of Yridis, immersing yourself in this subterranean realm. Unveil the purpose of your existence, reclaim your lost memories, and expose the enigmatic Archonist. Introducing 'Born To Rise,' an awe-inspiring 2.5D action-adventure platformer set within a mesmerizing underworld. Journey through treacherous acidic ruins, ancient cities steeped in history, and labyrinthine dungeons that seemingly stretch on endlessly. Engage in intense battles against corrupted creatures, unwitting pawns bound to serve their creator's nefarious whims. Immerse yourself in a captivating narrative that will unravel the true significance of your odyssey, while delving deep into the enigma surrounding the identity of the Archonist. Prepare to ascend to new heights as you unveil the secrets that lie within, confronting formidable challenges, and unearthing the ultimate truth that awaits in 'Born To Rise' . Travel through 3 different levels: Discover new locations, enemies and hazards while the Archonist laughs at your failures. Complete each zone as fast as you can and overcome the three strenuous challenges that will determine Yridis’ future. Explore: Investigate and discover every corner and secrets of The Undergrounds The Three Labors: Complete each level as fast as you can and overcome the three strenuous challenges that will determine Yridis’ future.

rows.name: ANDARA: RISE FOR REBELLION
rows.short_description: Ordon’s armies have invaded Hailstone and are plundering their resources. Become Andara, the tyrant’s daughter, in this frenetic third-person shooter. Engage enemy weak points and move fast in a brief yet intense single-player campaign. Rise for rebellion.
rows.description_html: Get immersed in a short but intense single-player campaign in this frenetic third-person shooter taking inspiration from arcade titles such as Returnal and DOOM. Rise for Rebellion Hailstone’s invasion, the plundering of its natural resources, and the killing of its natives has been the last straw for Andara. The cruelty of her father has reached an all-time high, alongside his command capacity, and Andara is the only one who can stop him this time around. It is time for the heiress of the Ethadian Empire to rise and fight against Ordon’s army, to reclaim what’s just. Fear, pain and death are prices worth-paying, if only to stop her tyrannical father once and for all. Loaded and Cyber-implanted The hyper-advanced technology that has helped the oppressors crush the people of Hailstone might just also be their downfall. As Andara, make use of your incredible powers and movement capabilities to breeze into combat, cast powerful blasts of energy, finish enemies and even slow down time. Special Forces Nobody said it was going to be easy. Each enemy will have their own behavior, strengths and weaknesses. Special soldiers like the Charger or the Deadeye will pose a formidable challenge, so fight them all as you’re supposed to - constantly moving, aiming for their weak spots and making full use of both your weapons and your whole repertoire of skills. Extended Synopsis Ethadians are running out of natural resources. Their home planet will soon stop supporting their hyper-technological way of life. ‘If Ethadians wish to live, they are forced to conquer’, says supreme commander Ordon to his people. In his mind is Hailstone, a nearby planet where the mining resources are plentiful and the natives are a much less advanced society. ‘They won’t stand a chance’, Ordon anticipates. He is right, of course. Ethadians conquer Hailstone in a breeze. They subdue the natives, killing those who dare to resist and capturing the rest of them. Ordon and his troops set outposts and advanced mining stations all over the rocky planet. They build the huge Central Tower and set up the servers that control their cyber-implants inside it. Ordon’s thirst for expansion won’t end here – Hailstone will only be the first of many planets to be vanquished by the Ethadians. Or is it? Ordon finds opposition where he least expected it. How could Andara, her own daughter, rebel against him? It was a mistake to bring her with him, thinking that their broken relationship could be mended. Andara has escaped her designated outpost on Hailstone. Aided by G1TH, her companion AI, she is now close to destroying the last generator that shields the Central Tower. She is trained, cyber-implanted and – most importantly – ready to do almost anything to stop her father’s iniquitous plans. Key features Engage in fast-paced combat against varied enemies. Explore Hailstone while completing puzzles and platforming sections. Watch Andara’s rebellion against her own father unfold.
rows.about_html: Get immersed in a short but intense single-player campaign in this frenetic third-person shooter taking inspiration from arcade titles such as Returnal and DOOM. Rise for Rebellion Hailstone’s invasion, the plundering of its natural resources, and the killing of its natives has been the last straw for Andara. The cruelty of her father has reached an all-time high, alongside his command capacity, and Andara is the only one who can stop him this time around. It is time for the heiress of the Ethadian Empire to rise and fight against Ordon’s army, to reclaim what’s just. Fear, pain and death are prices worth-paying, if only to stop her tyrannical father once and for all. Loaded and Cyber-implanted The hyper-advanced technology that has helped the oppressors crush the people of Hailstone might just also be their downfall. As Andara, make use of your incredible powers and movement capabilities to breeze into combat, cast powerful blasts of energy, finish enemies and even slow down time. Special Forces Nobody said it was going to be easy. Each enemy will have their own behavior, strengths and weaknesses. Special soldiers like the Charger or the Deadeye will pose a formidable challenge, so fight them all as you’re supposed to - constantly moving, aiming for their weak spots and making full use of both your weapons and your whole repertoire of skills. rows.name: NightSpawn
rows.short_description: NightSpawn is a high-stakes, escape-room inspired horror experience. Your mission: find a way out. In Single player or co-op play, team up with friends to break out. Work together to solve puzzles, uncover clues and find a way out - before the monsters find you.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in NightSpawn, a heart-pounding multiplayer horror experience playable in first-person or third-person perspective. Join the enigmatic Hollowgate Society—a group of investigators dedicated to uncovering the truth behind the paranormal—and gather your courage to face unimaginable terrors. Collaborate with up to three friends in this escape room-style adventure, or dive into thrilling PvP gameplay that will test your wits and survival instincts. As investigators, you and your team find yourselves trapped in a nightmarish location. To survive, you'll need to scavenge for essential tools, solve intricate puzzles, and cleverly use your resources—all while relentlessly pursued by monstrous entities. Choose your approach wisely. The items you discover can have multiple uses, you must decide how best to use them. Keep on the lookout for ways to open up (or close off) locations around you. A fuse box could restore power and unlock a keypad -  or could be disabled to bypass hazardous electrical traps. Your decisions directly shape your chances of survival. Join the Hollowgate (Story Mode - Upcoming): Follow the lore of NightSpawn and step into the shoes of an investigator for the Hollowgate society. Be courageous (Single Player): Face the horrors of NightSpawn alone and fight to escape the very bowels of hell. Escape the Nightmare (PvE) : Work together with three other players to evade deadly AI-driven monstrosities and escape each haunting location. Competitive Versus Mode (2v2 PvP) : Face off against rival investigators in a tense, competitive environment that demands strategic cooperation and cunning. Play as the Monster (Upcoming) : Step into the shoes of terrifying creatures, turning the tables on investigators in this spine-chilling future mode. Can you survive the horrors of NightSpawn, or will you become another victim to the darkness? Build Your Character: Choose your character wisely! Each investigator specialises in a unique piece of equipment that can turn the tide in your bid for escape.  Perks: Customise your characters to your playstyle with perks. As your favourite investigators get more experienced, they’ll unlock dozens of perks and hundreds of potential builds which give them an extra edge. Relentless NightSpawn Monsters: The monsters of NightSpawn are merciless. Each location the Hollowgate Society investigators discover is host to its own nightmare creature. Inspired by legend, pop culture and horror classics - every creature is unyielding in its hunt for you. Lock In: Your speed and skills will contribute to your overall score at the end of each game. Take on the leaderboards and forge a way to the top. Tailored Thrills & Custom Challenges: Take on the horror at escalating levels of difficulty. Alternatively, make your game bespoke with customisable difficulty settings. Keep an eye out for converted Tarot cards, which can be played in subsequent matches, enabling bonus challenges and offering extra rewards. Prepare yourself—NightSpawn awaits. Will you unravel the truth or succumb to eternal darkness? WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES - READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game. IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms. You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued.

rows.name: Luffi: Homebound
rows.short_description: Luffi is returning home from time away at Hartfer's Art Academy. Explore, collect memories and make new friends along the way! Relax and enjoy a wholesome cozy experience as you journey home.
rows.description_html: Luffi is returning home after studying abroad at Hartfer's Art Academy. Explore vibrant locations and fill your art journal with a collection of memories and discoveries on your journey. Relax and enjoy a wholesome cozy experience with playful characters on their own journeys through life. A lived in world Explore organic locations on your way home. Get lost in the forest burrows, enjoy a treetop tour, explore the nightstone caves. Enjoy the fireworks at Hartfer village, relax in the hot springs on snowy summit or hit the slopes with your snowboard. Each location is filled with life, personality and unique characters to make the world feel alive. Build Relationships On your journey, encounter other characters and learn about them. Watch them travel and experience their own adventure alongside yours. Reminisence about Luffi's past and relationship with his parents, and what it means to finally come home. Each helpful deed is rewarded via stickers to collect! Fill in your journal Each time Luffi finds something new he records it in his journal of memories to share with his family after the adventure is complete. All memories are hand drawn, as Luffi showcases his newfound skills from art school. Musical Vibes Indulge yourself in a lovely soundtrack scored with a sentimental soul from the very talented Epoch Music duo. Game Length Expect a short game roughly 2 hours, filled to the brim with sentimental and cozy vibes. There is no combat and the game features a stress-free environment to relax and enjoy at your own pace.

rows.name: Mage Mayhem
rows.short_description: Mage Mayhem is a roguelike featuring unique magic with hundreds of different styles to explore. Customize your experience through a variety of abilities and upgrades. Enjoy alongside your friends, then battle them in various other PvP game modes.
rows.description_html: Fight your alongside or against your friends with PvP and PvE Roguelike game modes! Choose from eight unique classes, Pyromancer, Ice Magus, Grave Warden, Druid, Trapper, Pirate Captain, Assassin, and Paladin, each with its own distinct playstyle and abilities. Pick 4 abilities from each class's selection, each containing at least 5 or more options to pick from! Head into the PvE roguelike arena to challenge deadly foes and gain numerous upgrades to create a distinct build! In PvP, suit your preferred combat style with 12 perks to be a ranger, a mini mage, and much more. Engage in up to 4v4 battles across multiple game modes and maps with your friends and prove you are the craziest mage of them all. Fight against powerful enemies! Or against your friends Customize your character to suit your playstyle!

rows.name: Romance Club - Stories I Play
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in romantic visual stories where you control what happens!
rows.description_html: Become a character in a story you’ll love! The choice is yours: Pick your own look and style. Romance: Cute or Sexy? Bold or Shy? Guy or Girl? What happens next? Every story has multiple endings! Fantasy, drama, supernatural, horror, adventure, and more. Dozens of original stories with more to come. Which story will you try first? DRACULA: A LOVE STORY : Experience a whirlwind romance spanning centuries: palace secrets of the Ottoman Empire, love and loathing at the royal court, and friends and enemies whose lives span an eternity… HEAVEN'S SECRET : You died and went to... the Angels and Demons Academy? Devilish lecturers, angelic sweethearts, and the temptation to break Heaven's rules—what else awaits you in this dangerous, fantastical afterlife? CHASING YOU : When a routine family get-together becomes a murder scene, the race is on to find the culprit and stay out of jail! HEART OF TRESPIA : Today, you ascend the throne of Trespia. But all is not as it seems. Embark on a journey of danger, love, and betrayal, discover the truth, and save your kingdom! LEGEND OF THE WILLOW : On the eve of your initiation as a geisha, you discover a supernatural secret that changes everything. Now, you’re on the run, and not only from humans. GLADIATOR CHRONICLES : Forced into slavery by the intergalactic empire of New Rome, a young gladiator’s fate hangs in the balance. Can you rise to the challenge and make the empire bow before you? ...PLUS more new stories and episodes coming soon! ABOUT US Your Story Interactive is an independent game studio located in Chisinau, the capital of Moldova. Stories are our passion and storytelling is what we do. Our games are free! If you like romantic stories with choices, graphic novels, and cute characters, you'll love our games!

rows.name: Unsorted Horror
rows.short_description: A collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery and dread.
rows.description_html: UNSORTED HORROR is a collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery in a dark dystopian setting. The majority of the games have a playtime of roughly 10-15 minutes and can be played through in one sitting. Choose a CD case, read the backside, and go on a small adventure. THE GAMES: 1. Tartarus Engine - A group of plucky technicians exploit an ancient machine's seemingly untapped vulnerability. 2. The Other Side - Operate a jury-rigged drill to secretly escape a corrupt bunker. 3. Control Room Alpha - Pull data from a nest of spiders. 4. Carbon Steel - Perform hazardous research in an abandoned facility. 5. Concrete Tremor - A game revolving around plastic explosives and soviet apartment buildings.

The world-building is particularly impressive, with each game managing to really immerse you in their worlds within their brief play times. Highly recommended.” Alpha Beta Gamer

rows.name: Fall of the stick knights
rows.short_description: Fall of the stick knights is based on physics-controlled characters to play with friends up to 4 people. The game features has skin customization, nice fun hook mechanic and the clumsy characters, providing a lot of fun.
rows.description_html: Fall of the Stick Knights is a local multiplayer game designed to play with friends. It features physics-based character controls, supports 1 to 4 players, includes AI enemies, and offers a deck-building system that permanently alters your stats. FOSK is my first game , which I created for fun and to learn programming. It's heavily unfinished, but I believe playing with friends can still be an enjoyable experience. Why did I publish it on Steam? When I made this game, I was 16, and I simply wanted to release a game on Steam. (the release date is 19.02.2025, but this game was in early access for about two years.) Features: -Character editor -Over 40 different weapons -Over 90 unique maps -'Deck-building' cards -Local multiplayer -Controller and keyboard support -Ton of bugs and imperfections I hope you have a great time playing it with your friends!
