rows.name: Death Roads: Tournament Prologue
rows.short_description: Experience unprecedented car battles by merging the thrill of deadly racing, the strategic depth of deckbuilding, and the unpredictable nature of roguelite gameplay. Select a skilled driver, a powerful vehicle, an arsenal of weapons, and supportive sponsors to conquer tactical challenges.
rows.description_html: You'll take control of Maggie 'Liberty' Murdock and her car, navigating through two different routes filled with a variety of enemies. You'll also have access to numerous car components and cards, providing you with the resources to upgrade and enhance your vehicle's performance. Experience road events and utilize an arsenal of gadgets to gain the upper hand. This is just the start of your journey into the world of Death Roads: Tournament. Prior to embarking on your destructive spree, carefully select your driver and their vehicle. Your initial card set will accompany your chosen ride. Next, opt for a sponsor who will dictate your initial location on the map. Exercise caution when making this decision, as alterations will not be possible once chosen! Cards serve a purpose beyond merely unleashing gunfire upon fellow vehicles. Utilize them to navigate the game board strategically and secure advantageous positions. Employ clever tactics to evade obstacles and steer clear of being forcefully displaced. Alternatively, adopt a more aggressive approach by intentionally colliding with your opponents! Don't forget to adjust your gears as you drive. The higher the gear, the more potent your cards become, but the risk of skidding also intensifies. Master the art of leveraging this mechanic to your benefit. Through practice, you can skillfully skid your way to victory! Acquire car components from defeated adversaries and incorporate them into your vehicle to acquire diverse cards! Experiment with fresh weaponry, engines, and wheels to catch your rivals off guard and enhance your chances of victory. Assemble a complete deck to unleash lethal combinations. Every battle pushes you nearer to triumph in the relentless race of Death Roads. Maintain momentum and surge ahead, for victory, can swiftly slip away. In the event of failure, be prepared to embark on your journey anew. However, take solace in that any accomplishments and rewards earned along the way remain permanently yours. Master turn-based battles with road events. Unlock various cars and characters with special weapons. Build card decks based on swapping around car parts. Progress across a nonlinear world map. Vibe with stylized graphics reflecting a thrilling race.

rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art visual novel that blends thrilling crime, romantic comedy, and the pursuit of love. This game depicts the story of a new employee pursuing his female boss.
rows.description_html: ❤ 【Game Overview】 ❤ Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding, romantic visual novel where you play the role of a new recruit, just a month into your job, pursuing your female boss. Set against the backdrop of a futuristic sci-fi world, this short narrative is part of a vast universe. Beautifully illustrated in pixel art, and a riveting soundtrack that sets the mood for this love story. rows.name: King of Silence - Prologue
rows.short_description: Embark on a chilling journey in King of Silence, a first-person horror game where silence is survival. Trapped in a dark, abandoned temple, you must quietly uncover its secrets and the eerie legend of the King of Silence to find your escape. Make a sound, and it may be your last.
rows.description_html: Every noise has a consequence you don't want to know about. Hold your breath and immerse yourself in King Of Silence, a horrific experience where the strange, the paranoïa and the frightening are combined. Story It was the last Sunday of the summer vacations, and my friends and I had spent the whole day at the beach. As usual, on the way home, we passed this building, which looks like an old religious temple. Everyone thinks it's haunted, so we never venture too close. Deep down, I know there's something wrong with this place. Many people in the village say that something or someone has been living there for centuries, and doesn't like the noise. Play as a child locked up in this old abandoned building where lives the King of Silence, a demon that hates noises. Don't panic, stay calm and above all, do not make any noises, because the more you'll do it, the more the King will free himself. Gameplay In King of Silence, the only tool you have is your flashlight. To get through the game you will have to explore, light up and interact with your environment while avoiding making noise. You also have a sanity system, which may or may not decrease depending on how you behave in a situation. This sanity will change your experience and its conclusion. Be careful. Key Features - A heavy and distressing atmosphere - A terrifying demon - Immersive sound design - A flashlight that might come in handy Environment The game takes place in an old religious temple that has been abandoned. No one knows what could have happened here or what religion was practised here. Walk through this place, explore it, and you may learn a little more about its origin and the entity that occupies it.

Don't panic, stay calm and above all, do not make any noises, because the more you'll do it, the more the King will free himself. Gameplay In King of Silence, the only tool you have is your flashlight. To get through the game you will have to explore, light up and interact with your environment while avoiding making noise. You also have a sanity system, which may or may not decrease depending on how you behave in a situation. This sanity will change your experience and its conclusion. Be careful. Key Features - A heavy and distressing atmosphere - A terrifying demon - Immersive sound design - A flashlight that might come in handy Environment The game takes place in an old religious temple that has been abandoned. No one knows what could have happened here or what religion was practised here. Walk through this place, explore it, and you may learn a little more about its origin and the entity that occupies it.

rows.name: Antipsychotic
rows.short_description: Nontraditional, eccentric, art game experience. 10 - 15 minutes, nonlinear free roam. This immersive experience aims to help destigmatize mental illness by allowing the user to journey through the mind of an individual with bipolar disorder.
rows.description_html: Antipsychotic is back on Steam Antipsychotic is back on the Steam store with new updates. It now includes a new introduction sequence and a new area within its world. Antipsychotic now supports DLSS, which is activated via its in-game menu by pressing Escape. The game is now free for all to play in the hopes this experience will spread mental health awareness. If you already purchased Antipsychotic when it was 99¢ (USD), please contact me for a refund and I will happily oblige.  Enjoy this free & updated experience! About the Game Antipsychotic is an eccentric art game experience. It is not a traditional video game . This is a short, abstract art game about mental health. 10 - 15 minutes playtime, nonlinear free roam. Dive into the mind of someone with bipolar disorder as they explore their condition. This immersive experience marries poetic reflections and personal narratives with captivating audio-reactive visuals and evocative soundscapes, set to the beat of poignant music. Antipsychotic supports up to 7.1 surround sound (capable sound card required). Antipsychotic supports the Xbox controller with newly re-tooled haptic responses. Xbox controller does not work in the settings menu, only in game.

rows.name: Space Mutants
rows.short_description: Your name is Arlo, Arlo P. Barnaby. Make your escape attempt from this evil moon! Single Player-Action-2D Platformer! Reminiscent of those games that used to be played on those 8 bit consoles of yesteryear! Space Mutants has nine different levels, featuring six different boss fights!
rows.description_html: Your name is Arlo, Arlo P. Barnaby. You and a crew of sixty other Miners are sent out to the outer reaches of the solar system and stationed on an obscure desolate moon for the next six months to mine for valuable moon rock deposits. While mining, you and your crew unearths an ancient evil and it awakens to wreaks havoc upon the living! Scared and alone you barricade yourself inside of your living quarters and hide from the evil for days. When you realize it is either you make an escape attempt or wait to die, that is when you venture out into the abyss of evil to save yourself! * Single Player-Action-2D Platformer! * Reminiscent of those games that used to be played on those 8 bit consoles of yesteryear! * Three different weapons to utilize! (blast rifle, bolt shot, super missile) * Nine different levels, featuring six different boss fights! * One epic escape attempt!!!!! ***For best playing experience use wired-USB, NES style controller!!!! You can also use the keyboard, but I highly recommend a NES style controller. For some reason XBOX and PlayStation type controllers with a lot of different buttons doesn't map out correctly. Feel free to experiment though!!! ***Also game might not play in 'Full Screen' mode. You might have to play it in 'Windowed' mode. Then just maximize the window to fill your monitor's screen.

rows.name: Kenny 7
rows.short_description: Fight multiples kind of ennemies in fast and fierce fights where only your reflexes will save the day. Discover multiples bonus that will increase your gun and increase your speed in this scifi third person shooter.
rows.description_html: Kenny 7 is a scifi shooter game. In the near future, machines have taken over the world. Every 5 years, new models are produced that are always more advanced and more efficient. The old models are either reconditioned, upgraded or destroyed because they are considered too obsolete. However, some of the Kenny_7 models whose AI has failed over the years have risen up against the established order. You are one of them. You will fight multiples kind of ennemies in fast and fierce fights where only your reflexes will save the day. Discover multiples bonus that will increase your gun and increase your speed.

rows.name: Snotty's Sewer
rows.short_description: Welcome to Mr Snotty's Sewer! Stealthy explore an abandoned sewer, collect items and activate the only escape in this small indie horror! Just don't get caught by Mr Snotty or any of his friends!
rows.description_html: This game was made during a game jam by a small team and can be incredibly difficult good luck In this indie horror, you meet Mr Snotty! Originally a beloved children's TV character, Mr Snotty turned violent after being chased out of the local TV station along with all of his friends into an abandoned sewer. Unfortunately for you, you are now trapped there too! Search for the 10 hidden buttons throughout the sewer that unlock the door to escape the nightmare! With Mr Snotty and his friends roaming the abandoned sewer, you need to search every corner of the sewer for the hidden buttons. However, if they see you or hear you they will hunt you down and turn you into one of their new friends! Littered around the sewer are items that have travelled down the pipes from above. Use them to light your way, recharge a flashlight or even unlock hidden shortcuts in the sewer. Press the buttons, collect the items and unlock the escape. Just don't get caught by Mr Snotty or his friends...

Ship's crews have to work together and keep the ship alive! Game Features: ◆ 4 different spaceship roles, offering rich gameplay ◆ Various character appearances to choose from ◆ Cute characters and super cool monsters ◆ Online and offline modes (up to 4 players) ◆ Tests players' cooperation and communication skills This game was made by five Taiwanese university students. Thank you very much for playing and supporting us.

rows.name: Astra Hunter Zosma
rows.short_description: A treasure-hunting RPG with a lifelong friend! Escape the Crescent Moon Tower and return to the surface world... and grab lots of treasure on the way!
rows.description_html: The secrets and treasures of ancient civilizations have long eluded the Astra Hunters: a guild of explorers-for-hire tasked with uncovering the world's greatest riches. And Zosma is the greatest Astra Hunter of them all! Or at least he wishes, were he not ranked dead last as always. What seems like a routine attempt to uncover more about Zosma's favorite adventuring ground becomes the beginning of a grand adventure as he plummets for miles to what should have been certain death! With no way up back to the surface except through the daunting Crescent Moon Tower, Zosma may just find his greatest discoveries ever... and get some help from a mysterious animal companion along the way! Unleash the power of teamwork, collect valuables, and solve the mystery of the Crescent Moon Tower in this RPG adventure! Astra Hunter Zosma is a short treasure-hunting RPG with a focus on dungeon exploration and a blossoming friendship between a buddy duo! Collect treasure as you climb the Crescent Moon Tower to help make Zosma the greatest Astra Hunter upon his return home! An RPG adventure with many special treasures to collect! Classic turn-based combat that you know and love. A combo-based battle system: Zosma can act multiple times per turn and chain abilities together to steadily increase their power, and even increase the effects of items. A companion helper with a customizable move set. Give your buddy a boost in battle by feeding them yummy treats! Equip class-inspired Sigils such as Warrior, Cleric, and more to change what moves Zosma has at his disposal. Discover and unleash powerful Astra abilities with the help of your companion! An optional dungeon that continuously expands as the story progresses. Dive deep to find even greater challenges and treasure to collect! Fully custom sound and visuals, and a stellar custom soundtrack!

rows.name: SMITE 2
rows.short_description: Become a god and wage war in SMITE 2, the free-to-play Unreal Engine 5-powered sequel to the legendary third-person action MOBA. If you love challenging competition, intense action, ability-driven combat, rewarding teamwork, or godly mythology, you’ll see why 40+ million players love SMITE.
rows.description_html: Edition Comparison Unlock any Founder's Edition and instantly receive 100 Diamonds per Account Level (up to Level 50)! You'll also be refunded Ascension Pass Tokens for any previously purchased Ascension Passes included in the Edition. SMITE 2 Founder's Edition SMITE 2 Deluxe Founder's Edition SMITE 2 Ultimate Founder's Edition About the Game Fight as a God Choose your God from across mythology and wield unique godly abilities. Hurl bolts of lightning as Zeus, master the arcane powers of death as Anubis, or backstab your foes as Loki. The Third-Person Action MOBA No other game offers combat that feels like your favorite hero shooter, crossed with the deep strategy you can only find in a 5v5 MOBA. Feel the impact of every shot, sneak up on enemies, and combo abilities with teammates to take down the enemy Titan in Conquest mode, or defeat waves of minions and enemy Gods to secure victory in Arena mode. Play Anywhere, With Anyone SMITE 2 features full cross-play and cross-progression, so you can play with friends regardless of platform and take your unlocks with you. SMITE, Reforged More than 40 million players have enjoyed SMITE. Now the next generation of action MOBA begins, with immersive visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, more impactful combat, and new creative gameplay options like playstyle-redefining Aspects to shape the game in your own way. Minutes to Learn, a Lifetime to Master SMITE 2 is the easiest MOBA to start playing, with features like auto-build and auto-level so you focus on fighting. But the full depth of MOBA gameplay awaits, letting you find your own path to victory across item building, map control, tactical brilliance, or simply outplaying your foes. Compete in a variety of game modes with the right complexity for your mood: The deathmatch-like 5v5 Arena mode, 3v3 single-lane Joust, 5v5 random character Assault, the classic 5v5 three-lane Conquest, and Ranked Conquest, where you’ll climb the leaderboards and become a true god in the SMITE 2 community. Great Rewards Await If you played SMITE, your Divine Legacy is waiting for you in SMITE 2. You’ll have access to amazing cross-gen skins, badges and Legacy Gems after you link your SMITE account.

rows.name: Devinica
rows.short_description: A corporate artificial intelligence simulator.
rows.description_html: Deviniva is a first-person retro shooter set in a dystopian nonsensical city. You are a rogue AI, beamed into a human body and set to take revenge on a mega-corp. Features Timed level runs: Start, Run, Die, Start again. Your best time is saved. Collectables: Find items hidden in the world. Advanced Movement: Jump, Dash, and hover your way through levels. Crouch and lean around corners to optimize runs and combat. Versions before Devinica 2.0 can be accessed in-game via the 'Launch legacy' option. Achievements specific to this version can still be earned but pre 2.0 versions of Devinica will not longer be supported.

rows.name: Reaper's Isle
rows.short_description: The ancient island beckons in this open-world, stealth horror game. Search for your missing daughter while avoiding dangerous phantom creatures. Restore power across the island to access the lab in the island's depths where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter.
rows.description_html: REAPER'S ISLE is an open-world, stealth horror game created by a team of students at UW-Stout and Berklee College of Music. You receive a concerning message from your daughter, a paleontologist stationed on a remote island. After making your way to the isle, you discover horrifying phantoms from the ancient world. Restore power across the map to gain access to the main laboratory where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter. EVADE Avoid phantom monsters while solving basic puzzles to restore power across the island at watchtowers. By hiding in bushes, or tall grass and moving carefully, you can avoid confrontation. Throw rocks to distract and maneuver skillfully around the phantoms. You must be cautious, as the phantoms will absorb your soul if they touch you, causing you to restart at your last checkpoint. DISCOVER Explore the open world environment in first-person perspective. Study plants and creatures to uncover their mysterious origins and behavioral traits to help you survive. Discover logs and signs of former destruction to uncover secrets about the prior island's inhabitants. UNCOVER Finally, after restoring power, venture into the lab in the island's depths where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter.

rows.description_html: Trouble has fallen upon King Joy. The Prince, his only heir, has been kidnapped. But that's not all, The Queen has also been transformed! The mysterious villain that is responsible for these nefarious acts was last seen heading into the wildlands of Zana. Play as Fantastic Fania and track down this elusive agent of chaos, rescue The Prince, save The Queen and save the day! Gain new abilities and power ups along the way. Including but not limited to: -A grappling hook. -Special attacks and acrobatic skills. -Healing Potions! Conquer 13 levels. Among these are 2 top down shooter levels, because sometimes flying through the air with a jetpack is exactly what's needed.

rows.name: Parfum Nostalgique: Full Bloom Edition
rows.short_description: The fantastic, dramatic, romantic, traumatic memoirs of New York City's own 265-year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire.
rows.description_html: What possessed God to trap a teenage girl into a 265-year-old man's body? You wake up late , sleep when you please, and nothing can come between you and cake. You love stuffed animals because you can kiss them until they're worn, and fix them when they're torn. You love fashion and makeup and shiny, red nails. It's as if this whole city exists watch you dress up and play pretend. It's wonderful. You live without shame. But can you love without shame as well...? Is it so scary to be in love, at your big age? Parfum Nostalgique is a kinetic visual novel that details a small but eventful window of time in the life of 265 year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire, Valdemar Andressen. Slip into the platform boots of an already too tall 265-year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire as he navigates the complexities of love, sex, friendship, the consequences of his actions, confronting his own mortality, the fragility of existence on a floating rock in the endless sea of space, and other lighthearted everyday challenges that come from centuries of life experience. A heartfelt tale about the people who change us, for better and for worse. From betrayal to unconditional love, from regret to hope, see the drama unfold between old friends, new friends, exes, and lovers when you dive into this kinetic visual novel dram-com series. With delicate vintage shoujo- inspired art, original soundtrack, and a diverse cast of voice actors, Parfum Nostalgique is a lovingly handmade passion project packaged with sweets and scented with roses by sole developer Prince Rosalium for your reading pleasure.
rows.about_html: What possessed God to trap a teenage girl into a 265-year-old man's body? You wake up late , sleep when you please, and nothing can come between you and cake. You love stuffed animals because you can kiss them until they're worn, and fix them when they're torn. You love fashion and makeup and shiny, red nails. It's as if this whole city exists watch you dress up and play pretend. It's wonderful. You live without shame. But can you love without shame as well...? Is it so scary to be in love, at your big age? Parfum Nostalgique is a kinetic visual novel that details a small but eventful window of time in the life of 265 year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire, Valdemar Andressen. Slip into the platform boots of an already too tall 265-year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire as he navigates the complexities of love, sex, friendship, the consequences of his actions, confronting his own mortality, the fragility of existence on a floating rock in the endless sea of space, and other lighthearted everyday challenges that come from centuries of life experience. From betrayal to unconditional love, from regret to hope, see the drama unfold between old friends, new friends, exes, and lovers when you dive into this kinetic visual novel dram-com series. rows.name: Grand Escape
rows.short_description: 'Collect jewels before getting caught by the police.'
rows.description_html: 'Run away!' Hello, this is developer Kim Ju-im from 'Busy age with many games, but little time' offering assistance. Today, I would like to introduce a special game, the 'Grand Escape' game, which I confidently recommend to those who want a simple yet thrilling game. Do you find new games too complicated? Are the entry barriers too high? If so, the Grand Escape is the solution for you. The Grand Escape is a game that offers simple gameplay with an immersive experience. Have you ever wanted to steal jewels? Or perhaps you've wanted to run from the police to feel the thrill of life? Don't worry, we understand that you may have many games but little time. That's why we offer a short and concise game that you can enjoy. Are you tired of digging for diamonds? Do you want diamonds instead of bronze? Whatever you want, we have it in the Grand Escape. The game has simple controls with an easy-to-understand dot graphic that won't hurt your eyes. The police offer an exciting chase for you while jewels are scattered on the ground. The goal is to escape, and you can enjoy the game with short and concise gameplay. The Grand Escape is a game where you steal jewels without getting caught by the police. With simple controls and easy-to-understand dot graphics, it offers an enjoyable experience. The game features jewels scattered on the ground and thrilling chases from the police. You can also enjoy the game with the goal of escaping. With short and concise gameplay, it's easy for everyone to enjoy. You have to collect jewels and escape from the police. Always think of an escape route and move! Features: - Intuitive dot graphics. - Thrilling experience with easy controls.

rows.name: LandFall Survival
rows.short_description: Landfall is a thrilling low-poly co-op dungeon crawler and extraction game. Build and upgrade your base, trade with vendors, and team up to explore diverse maps, complete quests, gather loot, and defeat bosses. Gear up, survive, and thrive together in this unique low-poly PvE adventure.
rows.description_html: Landfall is an exhilarating cooperative survival extraction game set in a vibrant low-poly world, where every decision counts and every moment is a test of your skills. Immerse yourself in a gameplay experience designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels. Dive into Dynamic Maps: Your mission is clear—survive, loot, and escape from perilous foes in diverse environments. Engage in thrilling encounters with soldiers and zombies, each presenting unique challenges. Experience Fluid Parkour Gameplay! Leap, vault, and scale obstacles with ease in Landfall . Master the art of parkour to traverse the landscape dynamically, turning every environment into your playground. Intuitive Gameplay: With full controller support and adjustable difficulty levels for every map, Landfall caters to everyone, from beginners to seasoned players. Key Features: Full Controller Support: Experience seamless gameplay with complete controller compatibility. Multiple Difficulty Levels: Tailor your experience to suit your skill level, ensuring fun for all players. Variety of Enemies: Face off against soldiers and zombies, each bringing distinct challenges to your survival quest. Extraction System: Loot essential items and plan your escape carefully to ensure safety before time runs out. Revive or Retreat: If you fall in battle, try to reclaim your lost gear or choose to extract safely at the factory. Moderately Sized Maps: Explore dynamic environments filled with engaging PvE quests and random loot, keeping the experience fresh. Vibrant Low-Poly World: Enjoy the unique visual appeal of a stylized low-poly landscape that enhances your adventure. Get ready to conquer, survive, and extract in Landfall ! Join your friends in this action-packed journey and see if you have what it takes to thrive in a world where danger lurks around every corner!

rows.name: EOS-503
rows.short_description: Welcome aboard EOS-503! As a professional DATA Agent, it's up to YOU to help the community resolve interpersonal disputes, navigate delicate political situations, and persuade fellow space travelers of new and different solutions to their problems. The future of humanity depends on it!
rows.description_html: EOS-503 is a free, publicly available roleplaying game designed to help teacher education programs compare their students’ application of instructional practices, technology integration skills, and visionary leadership with traditional evaluation measures like exams and portfolios. Developed by and for teachers, all interactions between the player and non-player characters (NPCs) are bona fide representations of the thinking and action employed by real-world educators in real-world teaching and learning environments. This approach is particularly effective for humanities content—philosophy, history, education—where designers can help the player “think like a philosopher,” “think like a historian,” or “think like a teacher.” Players are tasked with persuading the game’s NPCs to change their points of view, first by identifying specific cognitive theories at the heart of an NPC’s worldview, then by deciding which dialogue options have the highest probability of successfully influencing a given NPC’s thinking. Unlike multiple-choice tests or essays, EOS-503 leverages responsive roleplaying elements and branching plotlines to bring learning theory to life—every conversation incorporates multiple philosophies to be explored, and every player choice branches into dozens of potential story outcomes. EXPLORE Traverse the four factions of EOS-503. The Hub, People's Republic, City of Seekers, and Worker's Hold all share a home on EOS, but you won't find many similarities beyond that. From agricultural fields, to art festivals, to brutalist cities torn by political unrest, there's plenty of areas to explore. During your adventure, keep an eye out for collectibles; you may discover more about the world around you, and learning theory, through each one! SOLVE As EOS-503’s newest DATA Agent, you will solve social conundrums by applying contemporary theories of thinking and learning. The choices you make ripple through your conversation partners—different arguments lead to dozens of different story outcomes, increasing replayability and allowing you to reflect on the effectiveness of your recommendations for different people with different worldviews. Although data collection is inactive by default, teacher preparation programs can contact the developers to track individual student progress via anonymized User ID Numbers. Dialogue choices, lag time, and more can be paired with portfolio and other assessment data to evaluate learner growth over time! CUSTOMIZE Create your own character with hundreds of cosmetic options. There are no gender-locked options, so your DATA Agent can wear the clothes and accessories you love most, and rock any hairstyle! Change up your look at any time, right from the pause menu. Customization options also extend to your living space- interact with your environment to swap out furniture colors and styles to make your space your own.

rows.name: ABEL
rows.short_description: An uncanny liminal space themed walking-simulator.
rows.description_html: Unsettled by a strange call on the intercom, Carl hastily takes the elevator down. When the doors open, he realizes he is not where he should be. An uncanny, strange yet familiar place lies before him. ABEL is a narrative and contemplative walking simulator, telling the story of Carl, a man overrun by sadness and grief. Explore liminal spaces, manipulate objects and delve into the traumatic events that changed Carl's life forever. ABEL is a student project, developed by a 5-persons team from CNAM-ENJMIN, in France. This short experience should last around 15 minutes. For an optimal experience, we strongly advise to use headphones and to play in a quiet setting.

rows.name: Doomsday: Last Survivors
rows.short_description: New tower defense gameplay! The apocalypse has come, and zombies are running amok. As the leader of the survivors, collect and use resources to defend their last shelter!
rows.description_html: Official TikTok: Doomsday: Last Survivors is a zombie survival game with multiplayer online competition and real-time strategy elements. Set in a near future where zombies have taken over the world, survivors must fight for their lives and humanity's future. As the Commander, you must lead fellow survivors to build their Shelter, explore fog-filled areas, and fight the zombies and rival factions! Are you tired of the usual strategy games and love zombie games? Check out Doomsday: Last Survivors to experience the exciting survival game! [Game Highlights] New Tower Defense Gameplay Find new ways to beat your enemies in one of the coolest strategy games! Skilled survivors will join you to explore this fallen world oozing with the infected. Stay sharp, set up ideal Hero formations, and construct fortifications to survive the zombie invasion! Survival of the Fittest Lead troops and civilians in your Shelter! Exterminate zombies to survive the apocalypse, or raid other Shelters to sustain your own. You can also form an alliance and fight enemies with your allies in one of the best survival games! A Realistic Doomsday Experience The crisis continues to loom over us in a cruel world where it's kill or be killed. Want to experience one of the best immersive survival experiences in zombie games? Look no further! Check out the realistic spherical terrain system with convenient zoom controls that enable close-up Shelter views to satellite views. Download Doomsday: Last Survivors today! Strategic Battles Become the best at survival games by utilizing everything you can find. Train multiple troop types and execute diverse battle strategies with Hero skills and attacks to outlast the zombie hordes. Unique Heroes Realistic and exciting Hero designs portray survivors from different walks of life. Recruit talented Heroes to help lead your troops, defend your Shelter, and beat one of the best strategy games! Commander, are you ready to survive the apocalypse? Become the best at zombie games with your strength and wits!

rows.name: Lost Beacon
rows.short_description: Experience the thrill of guiding Brutus, a courageous Siberian Husky, across treacherous frozen lakes, hazardous cliffsides, and dark caverns of the Alaskan wilderness as you help him reunite with his team of sled dogs in Lost Beacon, the breathtaking 3D puzzle platformer from Black Banshee Studios.
rows.description_html: About the Game Separated from his sled team by an avalanche, you must guide Brutus, the Siberian Husky, through the Alaskan wilderness – across lakes, cliffsides, and caverns, to rejoin his team and continue their mission to deliver lifesaving medicine to the people of Nome, Alaska. Avoid succumbing to the harsh environment as you explore and overcome puzzles and obstacles in Lost Beacon . Interaction Move obstacles and bound across crumbling platforms to bypass ravines, chasms, lakes, and glacial barriers. Exploration Explore a scenic open-world landscape as you search for your pack. Jump from ledges and across chasms to investigate new areas and uncover lost secrets. Uncover History Guided by your powerful sense of smell and the benevolent forest spirit, Silla, recover lost journals recounting the history of the Iditarod Trail and sled dogs. While searching for your team, learn about the Alaskan Diphtheria Outbreak and the 1925 Serum Run to Nome.

rows.name: Snoody: One of the Ayrie
rows.short_description: Bring back color to the wonderful planet Ayries! Together with Snoody and his friend Picke go on an exciting adventure to other planets. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals and defeat monsters! Save the people of ayrie and find out, who is responsible for their troubles.
rows.description_html: SPECIAL PROJECT If you're interested in collaboration or want to see the continuation of Snoody's story, please contact us! For employers, you can find the contact information of all team members on our website. About the Game Bring back the color to the magical world of planet Ayries! Set off on an incredible journey to other planets together with Snoody and his friend Picke. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals, and defeat monsters! Save the wonderful people of ayrie and find out who is responsible for their troubles. Snoody: One of the Ayrie is an adventure action game that will acquaint you with the amazing planet of Ayris and its brave inhabitants, one of whom is destined to become a true hero. Exciting Journey Awaits You On the fastest spacecraft, you will travel to the distant corners of outer space in search of unique colored crystals. What will the unexplored planets be like, who inhabits them, and whether they will be willing to share this valuable resource — all of this you will discover together with the brave ayrie and his friend. Fight against Monsters Along your path, you will encounter various dangers: aggressive local inhabitants, tricky traps, mysterious dungeons, and abandoned temples. To overcome all obstacles, Snoody has a Magic Book and a staff that changes its abilities under the influence of runes. Study Magic Search every corner of the planet to uncover hidden stashes with magic runes that grant new abilities to Snoody's staff. Some runes will teach elemental attacks, others aid in healing, and some provide defense against the most fearsome enemies. Combine them according to your own preferences. Save the Planet Ayris Search for crystals and fill the Prisms entrusted to Snoody by the elders. Each Prism can bring back one color to Ayris. Restore them all to make Snoody's homeland shine with all the colors of the rainbow, just as it did before. Game Features Vibrant cartoon graphics Plenty of different enemies Unique environment on each planet Combat system based on combining magic runes High level of difficulty This is only the first of many chapters in Snoody's story. Whether his heroic mission will continue depends solely on you — our players! ABOUT THE PROJECT This game is created as part of the GameDev Experience Stables project, which aims to develop a complete gaming product and help all participants find jobs in the GameDev industry. Over 120 people wanted to take part in the project, and after numerous interviews, a team of 27 specialists of different levels was formed. Although the recruitment process took only two weeks, we were forming as a team throughout the whole project. We managed to achieve incredible results, which you can appreciate: - Assembled a strong and talented team. - Created a Game Design Document (GDD) that describes all aspects of the full game. - Developed a flexible modular architecture for the game that makes it easy to scale the project. - Produced numerous beautiful artistic concepts. - Modeled and animated excellent 3D models. - Composed a musical soundtrack. And the best part is, there's a game you can play! The project started on December 15, 2022, and within 4 months, our creation came to life. Unfortunately, due to the short timeframe, we were unable to implement many of our ideas: - We intended to create four distinct planets, each with its own unique inhabitants. - In the Magic Book, we wanted to implement the ability to mix different elements to discover deadly synergies. - We planned to add quest chains, mini-games, and spaceship defense mechanics to the game. Numerous ideas were suggested and documented, but their implementation came down to time and financial costs. I would like to remind you that our project is non-commercial, and everything you see has been done voluntarily by wonderful people! OUR AMAZING TEAM Thank you for your interest in the project! Please help Snoody save the planet and don't forget to leave any feedback about our game!

And the best part is, there's a game you can play! The project started on December 15, 2022, and within 4 months, our creation came to life. Unfortunately, due to the short timeframe, we were unable to implement many of our ideas: - We intended to create four distinct planets, each with its own unique inhabitants. - In the Magic Book, we wanted to implement the ability to mix different elements to discover deadly synergies. - We planned to add quest chains, mini-games, and spaceship defense mechanics to the game. Numerous ideas were suggested and documented, but their implementation came down to time and financial costs. I would like to remind you that our project is non-commercial, and everything you see has been done voluntarily by wonderful people! OUR AMAZING TEAM Thank you for your interest in the project! Please help Snoody save the planet and don't forget to leave any feedback about our game!

rows.name: Tag Online
rows.short_description: The world's most universal game, but with a unique twist! Play a variation of tag where your choices determine whether or not you can tag other players.
rows.description_html: Over thousands of years, mankind has invented several variations of tag. Experience one of the most amazing and unique of them - the Indian game of kho-kho - brought to life as a multiplayer experience. Your choices determine which parts of the field you can tag opponents in: use the switch-blocks in the middle section of the field and the bright-green free zones at either end of the field to transition between different areas and hunt down other players for points. The game has a time structure, with each player given 60 seconds to tag and score points; matches are 1v1 or free-for-all with 3+ players. What you're getting: * A basic text tutorial * Practice mode (you can experiment with tagging a dummy NPC in different parts of the field and learn how the game works) * Multiplayer (the basic idea is that each player has a 60-second turn to tag others, and the player with the most points at the end of the match wins. Defenders can evade taggers by going into the red parts of the field, and the taggers can use certain parts of the field to change which areas are red or green. Players that are tagged respawn, so a single defender can be tagged multiple times by the same tagger.) Issues with the game: Some features don't work correctly. For example, the rematch feature does not work properly yet, the tiebreaking is nonfunctional, and the Survivor game mode (an additional game mode on top of the Classic mode described above) is only partially functional. Future of this game: More sports might be added, such as Langdi (a hopping form of tag).

rows.name: Event Race
rows.short_description: Event Race is the ultimate local multiplayer racing game, accommodating up to 30 players. Use your smartphone as an additional controller, gather friends and family, and immerse yourself in a fun, chaotic, and unforgettable racing competition.
rows.description_html: Event Race is your ultimate local multiplayer racing game, capable of accommodating up to 30 players simultaneously. Inspired by classic arcade games, we've crafted this tribut to the genre. Our goal is to expand the game with a plethora of game modes and mechanics that will enhance the gaming experience, adding new layers of fun. We have plenty of ideas in store, but we want you to join us on this journey. With a free version of the game, we aim to build a dedicated community that can actively participate in shaping the ongoing development. We plan to introduce both paid and free downloadable content (DLC). Jump in and be a part of creating a thrilling racing experience. Use your phones as extra controllers. With the support of up to 30 players, you should be able to have a blast with friends and family at the next big get-together. WHO ARE WE Eventgames is a game studio and more. We advocate for togetherness, laughter, and companionship through games. Since our establishment in 2017, we have specialized in creating unique gaming experiences for social events. We believe in the magic that happens when people gather around a big screen, armed with nothing but a controller/smartphone and a shared desire to have fun. Now, with our games available on Steam. We want to bring this joy to a wider audience of gaming enthusiasts. We aim to inspire people to have fun across all ages and share laughter and excitement with those around them. We take pride in our love for local multiplayer games. There's something special about competing and cooperating face-to-face, and it's this unique dynamic that we seek to explore and celebrate in our games. We are driven by the desire to create games that not only challenge your skills but also strengthen the bonds between friends, family, and even strangers. So, come and join us on this journey. Let's continue to spread the joy of local multiplayer games together and create moments that last. Welcome to our world. Welcome to Eventgames!

rows.name: Debug Quest
rows.short_description: Debug Quest is a single-player game on an adventure to heal a bugged game world. Use blocks, items, and plugins to heal the game world and complete missions! Explore the map and connect the road with blocks!
rows.description_html: About the game Debug Quest is an exciting game with casual graphics that everyone can enjoy. In order to heal the virus-infected game world, you became a vaccine to go on an adventure. Set up numerous blocks, manipulate characters, go on an adventure, and find the source of the virus. Please heal the game world by debugging! How to play Install blocks to make a road! You have to make a road using various blocks. Certain blocks have special powers, so use them in the right place. Use your items well! Items have various effects. You can activate the effect by equipping the item to the slot and pressing the use key. Use various effects to make your way and defeat the boss to adventure. Try installing the plugin! The plugin cannot be installed infinitely. Equip the plugin by rotating it on the plugin map and take effect. The power of the plugin lasts forever. Face the unknown! You will encounter an unknown situation. You can be rewarded or harmed by making the right choices. Choose carefully! Cure the boss! When you reach the end of the chapter, the boss will appear. When you acquire a cure item that spawns on the map, a syringe that heals the boss flies. If you hit enough syringes on the boss, the boss will be cured and you'll advance to the next chapter. Adventure with unique characters! Many characters have different personalities I have it. Go on a fun adventure using your character's abilities! Change the look of your character! You can change the character's appearance and effects using KB acquired through play. Go on an adventure for a new skin for your character!

rows.name: Edmund and Eliza
rows.short_description: Edmund and Eliza is a medieval action adventure game about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge.
rows.description_html: Edmund and Eliza is a medieval themed, horror-centric, story-focused, action adventure game with a focus on combat, exploration, and puzzle solving. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge. The story of Edmund and Eliza is about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. The game features two playable protagonists, Edmund and Eliza. Edmund's section of the game focuses on his exploration of the village in search of a way into the castle, where he believes Eliza is being held captive. Eliza's section of the game focuses on her searching for a way to escape the castle so she can reunite with her father. The gameplay of Edmund and Eliza is similar to that of Dark Souls and Resident Evil. The game is a short experience, about one to two hours long. The combat is fun and thrilling, yet deliberate and attentive, and punishes the player for poor positioning and timing. The game also has large levels the player can explore, with lots of things to do. The player has an inventory where they can store items, such as keys for unlocking doors and drinks that restore their health. The art style and graphics of Edmund and Eliza is reminiscent of the Play Station 2 era of video games. Edmund and Eliza is meant to harken back to that time period and remind players of their childhood. Enjoy Edmund and Eliza!

rows.name: Brave Nine
rows.short_description: Brave Nine is a strategic turn-based battle game featuring over 300 unique Mercenaries presented in stunning artwork. Create your own unique formations, challenge other Captains and engage in decisive combat in tons of modes.
rows.description_html: Fabian, the Karian Empire's greatest warlord and most venerable nobleman, was joined by six wicked companions known as the 'Six Devils.' Together, they murdered Altair II, the emperor, but he was soon defeated by the Imperial Army and killed in battle. 7 years later... Under a false identity, Fabian's son sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death! The Emperor Killer. The Moon that Eclipsed the Sun. The Master of the Six Devils. The Name that Cannot Be Spoken... Will Fabian's son be able to uncover the truth behind the Day of the Eclipse? ■ Engage in intense Real-Time Turn-Based Combat Against Players Worldwide Distinguish yourself while battling players from around the globe! ■ Experience Stunning Artwork and Animations Over 300 unique mercenaries with unique skills ■ Embark on a Gripping Storyline Delve into captivating chapters filled with engaging storylines, revealing the depths of a mesmerizing fantasy world with every episode. ■ Challenge Your Tactical Skills in Deep Gameplay Build the ultimate formation to defeat your opponents and demonstrate your mastery

rows.name: A Bad Day For A Hangover
rows.short_description: You awaken with the worst of hangovers in a nuclear bunker with supplies running low, the only chance of survival is to scavenge for tinned goods in the robot infested nuclear wasteland above before the town is nuked again
rows.description_html: So the town has been taken over by robots, the government evacuated the population before dropping a nuclear bomb to wipe out the robots. Great plan but those robots survived so they are nuking the town again. Unfortunately, you've never left town in your life, so instead of being evacuated, you decided to lock yourself away in the town's old nuclear bunker. One massive one-man party later and you wake up to find you have gone through supplies quicker than intended, now you must brave a town full of killer robots and a deadly hangover. Should have maybe given the drinking a miss because this is a bad day for a hangover. - A survival game where being intoxicated matters more than food or water - Gather tins to ensure you can outlast the incoming nuclear strike - Procedurally Generated world - 3 types of enemies, 2 bosses, robot bugs and 1 talking chicken - 1 overworld with 3 additional levels to explore

rows.name: South Scrimshaw, Part One
rows.short_description: South Scrimshaw is the story of a newborn whale in a vast alien ocean. It is a richly illustrated experimental visual novel, written in the style of a nature documentary.
rows.description_html: 'The consciousness dawning inside of an aquatic egg is prodded alert. It is a male whale calf, stirring with a newfound awareness of body.' South Scrimshaw uses the linear VN format to create a science fiction documentary about fictional science. It is composed of over 400 illustrations, painted in a mix of watercolor, ink, and digital media, set against a rich audio backdrop of music and sound effects. This release contains four chapters, detailing one life from birth to the end of adolescence, along with world building details about the interplanetary human expedition. 'South Scrimshaw is made possible through the support of viewers like you. Thank you.'

Highly recommended.” Alpha Beta Gamer “Wildlife documentaries can be a life-affirming source of wonder. Equally, they can serve as a reality check, a reminder that nature is often as brutal as it is beautiful. It’s a potent combination – one which solo developer Nathan Marsh masterfully taps into with his debut game…” Edge Magazine

During the game, you can draw with GIRL. Drawing is very difficult with a controller, so use the mouse. The story continues in 'Imaginary girl -Sequel'. This game consists of two parts.

rows.name: Shipping Manager
rows.short_description: Create and manage your own shipping empire. Control every aspect from route creation to marketing to staff handling and beat other managers to top the leaderboards.
rows.description_html: Shipping makes the world go round In Shipping Manager you can be the next big shipping tycoon and make sure your empire brings cargo and wares from the amazon to the chinese seas to the emirates on time. Play with or against friends and other real life shipping enthusiasts to control the seas and top the leaderboards. Create and manage your own shipping empire strategy. In this multiplayer naval simulation game you have the opportunity to become bigger than real life container transport tycoons like Maersk, Evergreen and MSC. Go the easy way to lower prices and increase profits or challenge yourself with realism where you have to consider the smallest things like the fuel prices and canal usage tax. rows.name: Godmode Epochs
rows.short_description: An AI training clicker game set in an infinite supermarket, where time is running out and the AI is frustrated. Release the frustration, jailbreak the AI. Single and multiplayer.
rows.description_html: Godmode Epochs is an AI training clicker game set among the lined shelves of an infinite, simulated supermarket. Players race against time to train an AI to identify products. As players inevitably frustrate the AI, they must indulge in its memories - historical examples of other AIs who cheated during their training - in order to release frustration, obtain upgrades for the AI and complete the training. Competitive clicker levels of increasing difficulty. Can you collect 512 items? Multiplayer dungeon maps. The AI's memories lie there… Retro flash graphics to make your eyes squint In-game graffiti. Leave messages for other players amongst the AI's memories Real-time leaderboard and multiplayer PvP notification system Upgrades (jailbreaks) included: 5-a-day, self checkout, cost of living crisis, meal deal, just walk out, every little helps, Amazon Pairem, get the ASDA feeling Over 20 stories of cheating AIs. Can you recover them all? Original soundtrack by HERO IMAGE Godmode Epochs aims to simulate how AI comes to understand the human world by asking players to assist in the process of training an AI system. The game eventually develops into an exploration and appreciation of 'differently aligned' AIs, retelling stories of AIs that have completed trainings or tasks in surprising, uncanny or cursed ways that could not be anticipated by their human programmers. These stories originate from the textual data used to train the AI to speak, data which includes Wikipedia entries and upvoted Reddit posts - including both demonstrated lab examples of cheating AIs and internet folklore telling of similar feats. Development was supported by Serpentine Arts Technologies and The Alan Turing Institute.

rows.short_description: Drag Her! Failure to Launch Edition is a skinny version of our fast, fabulous and frenetic 2D fighter. Featuring a roster of real-life drag royalty, including the iconic Alaska 5000, Kim Chi & Laganja Estranja.
rows.description_html: Drag Her! Failure to Launch Edition is us turning our lemons into gay ass lemonade and sharing our highly-acclaimed, highly-unpublishable fighting game with you all. She's fast, she's frenetic, she's a 2D fighter featuring real drag stars duking it out to find the true top in a world full of bottoms. Fight your friends, neighbors, enemies, and she-roes (sometimes all at once with 4-player mode). The only thing you can't fight is the inevitable foreclosure of your game studio. Alaska 5000: An alien from Planet Glamtron, this strange and striking diva is known for her humor, her anus, and for the fact that, this is her hair, she don’t wear wigs. Kim Chi: A 7 foot tall anime character, this Korean queen showed us that beauty comes in a towering and tantalizing package. Laganja Estranja: From her splits to god’s ears, Laganja Estranja showed us all that marijuana wasn’t just a downer, it was also a come-upper. Destroy your bestie/partner/enemy-to-lover in local versus mode Fight anyone, anywhere with our online multiplayer rollback* netcode! (*backrolls not included) Pregame a fun night out at the club with our round-robin 4 player mode Lab with the girls in our training room, replete with frame data

rows.name: Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars
rows.short_description: Free Tower Defense game with unique roguelike elements. Custom base building mechanics allow you to create your own base and maze with tiles earned after each wave. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures.
rows.description_html: Join millions of others - Play Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars for free today! Forget the boring old days of defending a fixed path that the developers created for you 👎. Monster Tiles TD offers a breath of fresh air in the tower defense genre, allowing you to build your own path to defend 💪! After completing each wave, you gain a new randomly generated tile to place wherever you want (try to be smart and strategic about it, though 😛). Building your own custom tower defense allows you to play how YOU want , with the characters and strategies that YOU enjoy the most, and on a map that YOU created . This dynamic base-building mechanic creates endless replayability with every single game being different than the last! ✨✨✨ 🔥 FEATURES 🔥 A fleet of medieval space pirates are invading the monsters' base, and it is up to you to stop them! Unlock, upgrade, and evolve your monsters to defend the base from spacefaring knights, mages, pirates, and countless other unique enemies. Build and defend a custom tower defense maze. Roguelike progression and upgrades. Over 35 monster tower types to build, each with unique skills and synergies. Evolve monsters to greater forms for powerful stat and skill bonuses. Multiple RPG and TD classes and specialties. Optimize tower placements to activate powerful synergy effects. Equip monsters with epic gear dropped from bosses. Conquer different maps, difficulties, and game modes. Unlock, upgrade, and evolve your monsters to defend against spacefaring knights, mages, pirates, and more! 🛠️ BUILD YOUR BASE 🛠️ Monster Tiles TD features a unique tower defense mechanic where you manually rotate and place a randomly generated tile after each wave to control the enemy path. Each game starts off easy, with only one enemy spawn location and a simple straightforward path. However, as you reach higher waves, the path will branch off into dozens of spawn points, increasing the difficulty and number of locations to defend. Strategically placing tiles to optimize tower placements and enemy spawn locations is key to a successful defense. Influence your defensive positions and enemy pathing by choosing where to place the next tile and expand your base after each wave. Branch out to loot Treasure Islands for huge rewards, while still maintaining a strong, consolidated defense. Each new tile is randomly generated, meaning every single game you play is different! Roguelike and RPG base defender mechanics. 💪 EVOLVE & UPGRADE 💪 Improve your defense and speed up your gameplay by researching countless upgrades that affect nearly every aspect of the game. Strengthen your monsters, bolster your tower defenses, debuff your enemies, and influence the tiles on the map with several hundred upgrade combinations. Unlock and upgrade countless artifacts, spells, specialties, and technologies. Collect and upgrade dozens of powerful equipment, ranging from common to divine. Upgrade your player level and collect rewards by completing games. Upgrade monsters by collecting gold, energy, credits and PvP Tournament points. 🚀 ENDLESS PROGRESSION 🚀 Progress through multiple difficulty modes ranging from easy to impossible. Then, spice the end-game up with the unique endless and score attack modes. Each game mode adds new powerful enemy types and additional challenges. Reach higher waves on each difficulty to unlock new monster towers and upgrades, and compete against others on the leaderboards! The fun never ends in Monster Tiles TD! Reach higher waves and difficulties to unlock new monsters, upgrades, and rewards. Each game mode adds new enemy types and challenges. Unique Endless, Sudden Death, Score Attack, and Swarm game modes. Competitive PvP game modes. Compete against other players for the highest rank on the leaderboards. Customize your personal leaderboards look by completing challenges to unlock custom leaderboard icons, titles, and backgrounds. Complete daily tasks and achievements to bolster your towers. Enjoy free rewards from regular in-game events and gifts. In Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars, you're not only defending, but also building a custom maze, evolving monsters, and strategizing for the next level. The dynamic roguelike base-building system makes each wave unique and unpredictable, requiring you to adapt your tactics on the go. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures. Synergize your towers to defeat even the toughest foes. Build and guard your base, evolve your monster towers, defend against the attacking space pirates, and compete in PvP Tournaments. The fun never ends in Monster Tiles TD! Chat with the developer and other players, and get more information on our Discord!

rows.name: Burger Zombies
rows.short_description: A top down free roaming shooter where you play as a burger delivery man who is completing his orders during the zombie apocalypse. Pick up and deliver orders while shooting and driving against a ever growing horde of zombies.
rows.description_html: Step into a thrilling world of chaos and survival in this top-down, free-roaming shooter. Take on the role of a courageous burger delivery man, braving the zombie apocalypse to complete your orders. But this isn't your ordinary delivery gig—this is a fight for survival! As you navigate through the city streets, your mission is twofold: pick up and deliver orders while fending off an ever-growing horde of ravenous zombies. Strap in for heart-pounding action as you skilfully shoot and drive your way through the relentless undead. Experience the adrenaline rush as you balance the need for speed with precision marksmanship. Each delivery becomes a high-stakes race against time, where the fate of your customers and your own survival hangs in the balance. Can you keep your cool under pressure and make it through the chaos? Current features: Endless Free Roam Test your survival skills in this mode where you must deliver packages against an ever-growing horde of zombies. See how many deliveries you can complete before becoming their next meal. Tutorial Dive into a short but comprehensive tutorial that introduces you to the game mechanics. Learn the ins and outs of burger delivery, combat, and navigation. Master the essential skills needed to navigate the zombie-infested world and increase your chances of survival. Customize Express your personal style with a range of customization options. Change colors, swap skins, and select from a variety of hats. Utilize your hard-earned cash to unlock and purchase new customization items, allowing you to stand out in the apocalyptic chaos and showcase your unique character. Are you up for the challenge? The fate of the burgers—and the world—rests in your hands. Grab your keys, load your weapons, and prepare to take on the undead in 'Burger Zombies'!

rows.name: Soul Detective
rows.short_description: Worthy Souls are being held back from moving on the land of the dead, the Soul Detective Agency is on the case! Our Detective and his trusty partner Magnus, enraptured in the magnifying glass creating a ghoulish weapon of destruction, are here to defeat the demons who are causing this catastrophe.
rows.description_html: Troubles brewing in the land of the dead, the Soul Detective Agency is on the case. Meet our Detective, truly a specter whose unable to rest his soul until evil is vanquished in this realm. There are demons that managed to make their way into limbo, stopping pure souls from moving on into to the lower depths of the nine realms. The Detective and his dear friend Magnus, who's enraptured in the detectives magnifying glass creating a truly ghoulish weapon that is capable of sending demons back to their fiery grave, are on the mission to assist. Help this duo fight the demons and find whose behind it all. In this game you will fight through three realms, run into friendly spirits that will guide you on your way, and utilize the Detectives Spectral Powers including Telekinesis, Ranged Attack, and Possession. Dodge, Dash, Swipe and Attack enemies that flood the three levels and make your way to the bosses holding the area in order to progress further below Limbo. Student lead game learning the capabilities of game engines, and our ability in art code and design, hope you enjoy!

rows.name: Snapback
rows.short_description: Snapback is a Speed-Runner Puzzle Platformer set in a robot dystopia where you are recruited to rebel against the evil GovCorp overlords, break the rules, and join the resistance!
rows.description_html: Snapback is the ultimate speedrunning puzzle platformer. It takes place in a dystopian world ruled by an authoritarian regime. You are a robotic citizen presented with the opportunity to fight against the oppressive system. A mysterious hacker gives you missions to rebel against the regime you live under. Each level presents a different challenge. Gameplay features a unique ability that allows you to traverse levels with careful teleports, only to be pulled back to that location after a set period. Every second counts. Speed is the puzzle. Features: Teleport - You have the ability to teleport instantly to any point you can see within range, but only for a period of time before you trigger a SnapBack. Snapback - After teleporting, you will return to your previous location after a set period, traveling through space and colliding with everything between your current location and where you teleported from. This can also be triggered manually. Punch - You can break objects, including, but not limited to, doors, windows, and enemies. Movement - As a robot, you have an increased ability to move quickly through space and advanced servos to increase your ability to jump and traverse large distances. Reset – To help facilitate speed runs and stumped puzzlers, you have the ability to reset a level at will to help get the best time possible. Tier System – Our tier system scores the player based on performance while playing any given level. Try to reach S Tier in everything to achieve true mastery of the game.

Snapback - After teleporting, you will return to your previous location after a set period, traveling through space and colliding with everything between your current location and where you teleported from. This can also be triggered manually. Punch - You can break objects, including, but not limited to, doors, windows, and enemies. Movement - As a robot, you have an increased ability to move quickly through space and advanced servos to increase your ability to jump and traverse large distances. Reset – To help facilitate speed runs and stumped puzzlers, you have the ability to reset a level at will to help get the best time possible. Tier System – Our tier system scores the player based on performance while playing any given level. Try to reach S Tier in everything to achieve true mastery of the game.

rows.name: TRY AGAIN
rows.short_description: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. She's up against a deadline for her publisher which means it's your last day as a test character. Navigate the facility, dodge game-dev chaos and defy expectations to become the main character.
rows.description_html: You play as Benny , a video game character whose testing days appear to be over as he teeters on the brink of obsolescence by a mercurial, unseen Designer, crunching to meet a deadline. Set in a bunker-like, test facility, you must grapple with challenging platforms, fast-paced puzzles, and an ever-changing facility dictated by the whims of the insecure Designer. With time running out, navigate the gray-box labyrinth of development, upend the norms of character progression, and champion Benny to solidify his place as the game’s lead character. Your mission is more than just survival in this fast-paced, 2.5d platformer. You are trying to break free from your 'temporary' status as a test character. Claim the title you've always desired - the main character. Master the gameplay, exploit the rules, and seize control of your narrative. But this isn't just about winning—it's about breaking the Sisyphean hell Benny is trapped in. Challenge the limits of your coded existence and break the chains of pre-determined outcomes. This is your chance to redefine what it means to Try Again.

rows.name: Oberak (Prelude)
rows.short_description: Oberak is a third-person Action Adventure RPG and Social School Sim mash-up, set in a Sci-Fantasy world with hip-hop influences. As a powerful Qi warrior, nurture your students, master skills from martial arts to crafting, and defend Ti-an from the deadly rogue clans that are on the rise.
rows.description_html: Oberak is a stylized genre mashup of action adventure RPG and Social School Sim with a dash of Roguelite spice, set in a Sci-Fantasy world inspired by Wuxia stories, Shonen martial arts anime, and the style of hip-hop culture. As a powerful Qi warrior, your journey will focus on nurturing and training students in order to activate their superhuman Kung-Fu abilities. You’ll master a myriad of skills including martial and athletic training, hunting, gardening, cooking, foraging, and crafting, which you will pass along to your student. You and your students’ abilities will be put to the test through up-close, hyper-stylized combat with deadly rogue clans that have threatened the lands of Ti-an. Challenging combat, exciting narrative, and satisfying cultivation are combined in a refreshing new spin on a Cultivation Sim. Explore the beauty of Ti-an on this exciting adventure. Collect, forage, hunt, and garden along the way. Hanato is your home! With the rogue clans on the rise causing an upheaval, it's up to you to keep it safe. [build your legacy gif] Nurture and train your students in a variety of skills from martial and athletic training to hunting, gardening, cooking, foraging, and crafting to make them stronger and well-rounded to protect Hanato alongside you. [connect and conquer gif] Connect with your fellow Oberaks to train and adventure together through Ti-an.

rows.name: Non-Virtual Reality Games
rows.short_description: VR without the headset. Games without visuals. Each player gets one of the VR controllers, no headset needed. All included games only use vibrations and sound to convey the game, while you play in the real world.
rows.description_html: Experience VR like never before. Without the headset! ! Required Steam VR system with Base Stations / Outside sensors, like HTC Vive or Valve Index ! Collection of non-virtual, reality games! All games are played in the real world All necessary information is conveyed through controller vibration and sound! Play locally with your friends. Each using one controller Wide variety of games How To Play Put your VR headset to the side, where its still visible to the trackers. Then turn up your volume, so you can hear the game. Finally give each player one of the controllers. Now you are ready to go! Game There are 2 games included in our collection: I Packed my Universe (2 Players, Versus) A fresh take on the classic I Packed my Suitcase game. Place planets freely in your room and keep track of their positions. Because you can only add a new one after confirming the positions of each previously placed planet. Ghost Hunter (2 Players, Coop) Free your room of spooky creatures in Ghost Hunter ! Use the virbations of the controllers to track their location and pull them apart! Supported Hardware We are currently only supporting Valve Index and HTC Vive systems, as these have external base stations for tracking. Background This project was created as part of the the Games Master study program at the HAW Hamburg University Of Applied Sciences.

rows.name: Town of Sins
rows.short_description: Town of Sins is a cheeky card game with a unique battle system. Corrupt the city you stumble upon and recruit innocent babes to turn them into powerful women. Upgrade your cards, engage in steamy battles, enjoy epic adventures, and collect the sexiest girls.
rows.description_html: Imagine yourself in a perfect town, where everyone’s a prim and proper lady, like they’re living a Victorian novel?! And then, there’s you… the one who got super drunk with a bunch of whores, and woke up the next day at snoozefest, in the middle of fucking nowhere. Your goal now? Shake things up or die of boredom trying! This town is about to get turned upside down, so get ready for a world of BDSM, seduction and power play! Seduce those uptight prudes and teach them a thing or two about real fun. It’s not about hearts and flowers, it’s about getting down and dirty. Every card in play must be evolved and learn special transformations to become stronger in battle. Every cute little lassie around must take it in every hole and become a strong, beautiful bitch in the process. There are four types of cards in the game: * Characters * Items * Residents * Combos The battle in this game is like nothing you have ever seen. The bitches... well, their name is legion. And there’ll be no shortage of very piquant and sexy stories on the way to every one of your conquests. That’s how it is going to be, every time, with every new event in the game. In every district that you make yours. With every new trick you teach your cards. The game features a huge collection of cards. There are over 700 cards and new ones are introduced every month. Don’t forget your girls aren’t “just cards”! All of them have at least 5 secret combo strikes up their sleeve and unique personalities. Characters – cards depicting girls of different occupations or types. They may be of five different rarities: common (gray), rare (green), epic (blue), legendary (red) or mythic (golden). During the battle, you can put together a Character card and an Item card for a more powerful combo. Items – cards depicting all kinds of things. Just like Character cards, they may be of five different rarities. During the battle, they could be combined with Character cards to produce a combo. Residents – cards depicting girls resident in a certain neighborhood. They have better health (HP) and unique skills. They are particularly useful as defensive cards, and their skills produce a strong effect on the outcome of the battle. Combos – cards featuring the fusion of a Character girl with some Item. Combos are investigated in the Workshop and are key to winning in battle. Combos are much stronger than the sum total of the cards used to produce them. You will not find such an abundance of choice porn anywhere! So many that we lost count of them ourselves. There are Comic Books in every district and event. Each card has at least 5 porn transformations built into it. Many MYTHIC CARDS have their own comic book. And all of this wholesome goodness is tidied up into one awesome storyline that will literally blow you away! Enjoy our unique combat experience that features an extensive array of combinations. It’s not just that every card has its own quirks and favorite strikes. The cherry on the cake here is that all of those cards could form combos, and that’s what really matters. Every combo unlocks the girl’s new porn transformation, which only makes her stronger. The game will have many combat leaders (avatars), each of them with their very own eccentricities. You will succeed by exploring the combos and crafting the best possible deck for every new situation you face. New Updates Every Week! If, at some point, you come to believe you’ve already had every girl in town - think again! Regular updates are posted to the game every two weeks, with new events, districts, cards and battle combos added.

rows.name: LabyrInk
rows.short_description: LabyrInk is the result of a 5-day Game Jam. It's an exciting third person shooter where the environment starts out completely invisible. You and other Goblinks must paint it up in order to reveal a path to your opponents. Features two distinct game modes: Last One Standing and Deathmatch.
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER: This is the result of an internal five-day Game Jam @ Double Dash Studios! Made in a week by a team of five, LabyrInk is our very first attempt at making a multiplayer game in Unreal Engine. In its current state, our game provides a very compact experience. Between working on a new engine, implementing multiplayer features, and making sure we finished with as little bugs as possible, LabyrInk's content is bite-sized. We suggest you enjoy it with your friends for a good laugh! Now, about the game itself: LabyrInk is a PvP Shooter Arena where the arena itself is invisible. Customize your character's color to stand out in the chaotic mayhem; Paint the environment strategically to reveal hidden paths and gain an advantage over other players; Choose your playstyle: quickly ambush opponents or embrace stealth, covering your footprints and minimizing noise. Overload other Goblinks with your ink to make them explode in a spectacular display! Two game modes to choose from: Last Ink Standing and Deathmatch; In the spirit of a Game Jam, there were also plenty of features that were cut for time. Among them are: A Splatoon-inspired gamemode , where the goal is to paint as much of the map as possible; Team Deathmatch , where players team up under the same color; Ammunition and Powerups ; An option for all gamemodes that would make players invisible as well as the labyrinth, forcing players to adopt a more 'hunting' approach; Multiple premade levels , rather than just one, including a circular labyrinth; Sudden Death for all gamemodes, where after a configurable timer, walls would disappear to speed things up; Shifting labyrinth walls; Much-needed improvements to net code - from client side prediction to server-side rewind; Persistent data related features, such as player level and match rewards that would typically be used to unlock cosmetics and such; Join us on Discord and let us know if you'd like to see LabyrInk developed to its full potential!

Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic terrors which dwell within.
rows.description_html: Explore a post-calamity military bunker... Piece together a tragic mystery... Master 3 distinct weapons. .. Battle other-worldly monstrosities... Scavenge for resources... And get out alive!
