rows.name: Space Ball VR
rows.short_description: Play a fun game of Space Ball with your friends! Football and basketball: any mode you like is available in this sporty and dynamic game.
rows.description_html: Experience the excitement and exhilaration of Space Ball! Firing a rocket under everyday sports, Space Ball launches you into an arena full of action, where quick thinking and lightning reaction times are all that matter. Featuring Football and Basketball gameplay modes, this competitive multiplayer is all about scoring points and bragging rights. Slam dunk a basketball like a pro or use your body to score a goal in football, use the arenas anyway you see fit to gain the advantage. Space Ball features a unique movement mechanic that is easy to master. Simply use your hands to leap across the arenas. Slam them into the ground to accelerate, then use the Dash feature to soar into the rafters! You’ve never played a game of Basketball as vertical as this! Space Ball features: Create Private and Public matches 1vs1, 2vs2 and 3vs3 team selection Online multiplayer and AI Bots with multiple difficulty settings Character customisation options - be a Cat, Pigeon, or even a Capybara! Arenas are filled with fans to bring matches to life! Full voice chat with privacy settings Space Ball on Steam also supports cross-play functionality with the Meta Quest version. During Early Access we’ll be regularly updating Space Ball with new features and QoL enhancements, so don’t forget to join our Discord for all the latest updates!

rows.name: Tales of Maana: Lucy
rows.short_description: Dive into an enchanting world where every decision matters—alliances, betrayals, romance, and power struggles shape a story as deep as it is unforgettable.
rows.description_html: Tales of Maana: Lucy is a narrative visual novel set in the enchanting and war-torn world of Maana . Follow Lucy, a determined young girl who joins the Order of Demonists to uncover the legacy of her mother—and begins a journey that will change her forever. Along the way, another tale unfolds in parallel: that of Rose, her rival, whose fate is tightly bound to her own. A World of Secrets and Wonders Shaped by centuries of ancient pacts and divine influence, Maana is a land of lost ruins, clashing kingdoms, and fragile harmony between humans and demons. The Eight Divinities guide its cultures and beliefs, but truth is often buried deeper than faith. A Journey to Find Oneself Leaving her home behind, Lucy sets out into a world she barely understands—seeking not just answers, but the strength to define who she really is. With each challenge, she grows. With each encounter, her understanding of herself and her world deepens. Choices That Echo Every decision matters. Dialogue, actions, and alliances will shape relationships and drive the story toward different outcomes. With two intertwined campaigns offering unique perspectives, your choices carry emotional weight—and lasting consequences. An Emotional Tale Awaits Tales of Maana: Lucy weaves a rich narrative filled with magic, rivalries, love, political intrigue, and personal growth. It’s more than a battle of powers—it’s a story of finding your place, embracing your flaws, and carving your own path. Where certainty ends, her journey begins.

rows.name: The Richmond Rut (In Search of Fenton)
rows.short_description: Traverse the wild Richmond Park in search of your beloved dog who ran after deer. Beware, everything is out to get you!Respect the deer and remember once you're in the park always check your surroundings.Oh Jesus Christ!
rows.description_html: Fenton is still lost... The time has come! Retain good faith as you traverse the wild in Richmond Park, in search of your beloved dog who ran after deer, into the wilderness and out of sight. The disruption has taken it's toll on the local flora and fauna, it's not looking good! Fenton is out there still live and well. It's down to you to bring him home safely. This is a challenging, short, dark, horror survival themed first person shooter based in the district of Richmond-upon-Thames within Greater London. The main objective is to search for your lost dog 'Fenton', collecting whatever you may find to help you find Fenton on the way and to ultimately bring him back home safe and sound. Weapons found in the game include Shotgun, M4 assault rifle, Grenade Launcher and Nuke Launcher. Defeat enemies such as Rabid Foxes, Stags, Killer Bees and more. Respect the deer and remember once you're in the park always check your surroundings.

rows.name: Rogue Slots
rows.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike, with a slot machine as your Dungeon Master. Spin to strike in a roguelike where every action comes from your custom slot machine. Load the reels with weapons, coins, and cursed relics, then let fate drive the fight.
rows.description_html: Spin to strike in a deckbuilding roguelike with a slot machine as your Dungeon Master. Load the reels with weapons, coins, and cursed relics, then let fate drive the fight. Each spin triggers attacks, abilities, and effects as you battle. Build your deck, tweak your odds, and hope the machine is feeling generous. The Machine starts out with minimal items in its deck, as you play you unlock new items to add to the reels. Currently there is 30 items to unlock and explore, 10 Enemy types to fight and several bosses to battle. Random Drops: As you play, you will earn random Knob skins drops trigger randomly, about every 30 min of gameplay.

rows.name: Fista 3-in-1 Retro Pack (Carpet Shark, Plummet Challenge Game, & The Arm Wrestling Classic)
rows.short_description: 3 Free 8-bit games you can play on your PC! Carpet Shark, Plummet Challenge Game, & The Arm Wrestling Classic.
rows.description_html: Fista 3-in-1 Retro Pack: This program is for people that don't want to go through the hassle of messing with emulators and having the games in one little neat package instead. Carpet Shark: Released 1/25/2021. Based on the 2013 Fista Productions short film. 'A shark's soul is trapped inside an 8x10 area rug. It's General Major Cadaver Scab's duty to keep the shark tame. Can he? CAN ANYONE?' Play as the Carpet Shark. Eat as many victims as you can before the timer and your health run out. After each level, fight one of the 4 bosses (our characters from the movie). Try to eat the bosses weapons to fire back at them. Can you beat all 4 levels? Plummet Challenge Game: Released 9/23/2021. Fista productions is back with a brand new game for your retro entertainment system. You are the Plummeteer. Plunge for prizes and points before hitting obstacles or landing face first into the ground. Gold gems are worth 10 points and the special colored gems are worth 100. There are 75 exciting levels in the main game, while the marathon mode has 150 levels for a longer experience. Everyone is able to complete the game, but just how good are you at it? The contest awaits. Can you beat your high score? Let’s find out. The Arm Wrestling Classic: Do you have what it takes to hang with the biggest, the baddest, and the meanest? Just how good are your button mashing skills? You are Barry Biceps. Train your arm to get stronger. Arm Wrestle through the champions of the world and collect your prize money. Take on challengers in the backyard, the parking garage, the bar, the school gym, and the arena. Use the password system to pickup where you left off or to enter secret codes. Go solo with 1 player story mode or invite a friend for 2 player versus. You want NES tough? You got it. The Arm Wrestling Classic. A brand new game for your retro entertainment system. NOW YOU'RE ARM WRESTLING WITH POWER. Released May 19, 2022.

rows.name: Forest of Lesbians (Nymph's Tale Ep1)
rows.short_description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel. Simple fast paced action/puzzle gameplay between story elements. Anime/pixelart/jrpg style.
rows.description_html: A nymph, her telepathic direwolf guardian and her schoolfriends visit her home forest. Adventure awaits, but beware of the thirsty lesbians residing in the forest! A YA fantasy comedy visual novel with gameplay elements. Dialogue heavy. Made in an anime/pixelart/jrpg style. Gameplay ranges from exploring your surroundings to evading enemies and to different kinds of humorous action oriented and fast paced minigames and adventure segments. Gameplay elements can be skipped if you just want to enjoy and advance the story. Episode 1, but it's a pretty much self contained story. Story: The nymph Ellie has been studying in the human lands. During a short break she visits her forest with her friends. Trouble is brewing in the forest, its guardians restless. Can Ellie and her friends uncover the reason for this unrest? And more importantly, can Ellie protect her exotic girlfriend from the lustful inhabitants of the forest? (Note: this is not a game made for the 'yuri fandom', but a fantasy comedy)

rows.name: Autumn Spirit
rows.short_description: Hunted by anxiety, you exiled yourself to a lonely mountain inhabited by a ghost and his regrets.
rows.description_html: The world is slowly crumbling and you are falling apart with it. In an attempt to find a semblance of peace and to rethink your future you go into exile in a remote corner to enjoy the calm of nature. But you are not alone on these mountains, another soul in pain is on your land, a ghost grounded on earth by regrets. Deciding to free him of his curse, you might find peace yourself in the process. Autumn spirit is a melancholic story about love and the modern anxiety of feeling powerless in this chaotic world. Featuring a dog. A very good boy. - Star-crossed lovers, lonely together and more cute relationship tropes to chill on a rainy day. - A beautiful modern and melancholic love story tinted by humor. - Plenty of personality and bickering choices! - Around 30,000 words (approximately 2h per playthrough) - Burtonesque art style and soft atmospheric music Autumn spirit was made in one month for Spooktober 2022

rows.name: Chimera Island
rows.short_description: Rediscover a lost island with mysterious creatures the world has long since forgotten. Now it is up to you to help restore this ruined world and bring about a new age of Chimera.
rows.description_html: About Chimera Island is a casual monster collection and management game created by students. Throughout your journey, raise a group of creatures, train them in various facilities, and improve their stats. In doing so and succeeding on expeditions, restore the desolate landscape to its former lush state. With many different Chimera to discover and facilities to upgrade, players can spend hours immersed and enjoying the island sanctuary they've created. Chimera Each of the three starting Chimera has the potential to turn into one of three unique evolutions. By customizing their training, you can adjust the course of their destiny and guide their evolutions down distinct paths. Can you collect all 12 Chimera? Habitat Expand your habitat to help train and strengthen your Chimera. Unlock three types of facilities, each specializing in a different type of training to help bring out the potential of your monsters. When ready, send your Chimera out on expeditions and gain resources to help restore the island, upgrade facilities, and further improve your Chimera for the challenges ahead.

rows.name: Night Escape
rows.short_description: 'Night Escape' is a tense and strategic multiplayer game. Uncover the hidden assassin, solve puzzles, and escape the mysterious mansion before it's too late. Survive the night or become a victim. Embark on this deadly race for survival.
rows.description_html: 'Night Escape' is a thrilling and immersive multiplayer game set in a mysterious mansion. Step into a gripping battle for survival as a group of players, with one among them secretly playing the role of a cunning assassin. The objective? Uncover the identity of the killer while solving intricate puzzles and finding keys to unlock doors that lead to your escape. As tension fills the air, every decision counts. Engage in strategic gameplay, gather clues, and collaborate with your fellow players to outsmart the assassin before they strike you down. But beware, the assassin is relentless and will stop at nothing to eliminate their targets without being detected. Intrigue intensifies as bodies are discovered, triggering intense meetings where players must vote to identify the killer. As a slain player, you return as a ghost, capable of haunting the assassin by collecting keys from fallen bodies or stealing them from the assassin's own pockets. Your mission as a ghost is to disrupt the assassin's plans and protect the remaining innocent players. Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-pumping experience filled with suspense, mystery, and deadly encounters. Can you survive the night and unravel the secrets of the mansion, or will the killer reign supreme? It's a race against time, where trust is tested and survival hangs in the balance.

rows.name: Sweet Girl Gurumelo
rows.short_description: Amanita is feeling down lately. She lost her best friend and she can't do anything about it. Could you listen to her story, and maybe help her out?
rows.description_html: Story This is a story about a little girl who is grieving the loss of her best friend. It's been a long time since then, but no one believes her when she says she lost her friend because a monster ate him. But that doesn't make sense: She never tells lies. She always gets golden stars from her teacher. In short, she's a good girl. Or is she? After all, she also has the power of the 'malice'. Could you listen to her story, and maybe help her out? Gameplay & Features This is a visual novel where you can: Read a short story where you can make choices that changes the outcome. Get up to 5 different endings. Each one gives a new perspective of the story. Collect up to 27 special CG events.

rows.name: Coffee Brakes
rows.short_description: Battle your friends in an office chair joust to the death! Only one of you can be employee of the month, so battle your friends in a variety of game modes and levels. Get on your office chairs and take your Coffee Brake! Coffee Brakes is a 3rd year project developed at Media Design School
rows.description_html: Have a blast jousting up to four of your fellow players in this goofy party game! THE BATTLE Hop on a chair and battle your friends in a variety of unique levels. Wind up your joust and then slam into your friends, jousting them off of their chairs taking them down! GAME MODES When you're not too focused on slamming into your fellow colleague, play through different game modes such as King of The Hill & Hot Potato where you change up the rules of winning to enjoy a spicy variety of gameplay! COUCH & ONLINE PLAY Perfect for a party session or a relax at home with friends with Local Multiplayer and Online Support! DEATHLY OFFICE IMPLEMENTS Grab fun items that have a variety of deadly consequences for your fellow co-worker RISING TO THE TOP Play around in 6 different fun levels as you slowly rise through the office building, fighting your companions as you go OFFICE ATTIRE Customize your appearance in the office lobby wardrobe with silly little hats, colors and different weapons before the round begins!

DEATHLY OFFICE IMPLEMENTS Grab fun items that have a variety of deadly consequences for your fellow co-worker RISING TO THE TOP Play around in 6 different fun levels as you slowly rise through the office building, fighting your companions as you go OFFICE ATTIRE Customize your appearance in the office lobby wardrobe with silly little hats, colors and different weapons before the round begins!

rows.name: Sand Tanble War: The Crusandes
rows.short_description: Be sure to become the King of the Kingdom of Jerusalem!
rows.description_html: 1. Game introduction 'The Sand Table War: Cruciata' is a war sandbox mobile port. When we designed this game, we followed the history of the entire Crusade, and adopted a highly restored way to restore the armaments, architecture, humanities and other contents of the medieval crusade to the game, and strive to create a real experience and a convincing medieval atmosphere for everyone. The game has a large map, 5 kinds of resources, wood, iron, stone, grain and silver coins, grassland, and desert two kinds of landmarks. The range is 1000*1000, a total of 1 million plots, including 45 kinds of resource land, 5 player cities, 2 types of NPC cities, Jerusalem, Antioch, monasteries, wineries, dynamic rivers, and the image of the crusader knights during the First Crusade. Two factions, fifty-nine heroes, more than 160 skills, a million blocks of land and Jerusalem await you! Be sure to become the king of the Kingdom of Jerusalem! 2. Introduction to gameplay Players play as lords, recruit heroes, and expand their territory and conquer the battlefield through various ways such as city construction and resource capture. The four major arms of the army, detect the enemy, skillfully arrange, outnumbered the enemy, show resourcefulness, and create your own troops! The game is divided into two parts: individual and clan. If you want to experience the full game, joining a clan is essential. Our goal is to grow your castle, train and strengthen your heroic troops, capture more resources, fight with your legion friends, and fight against other legions with the goal of capturing Jerusalem! 3. what the developer wants to say We are a group of ordinary game enthusiasts who founded this team with a love for SLG games,At the beginning of the establishment of the team, it experienced the docking and running-in of the group members, the impact of the epidemic at the beginning of the year, coupled with the research and discussion of medieval characters and architectural styles by fine arts, etc., it can be described as a twist and turn. At the beginning of the test, we repeatedly polished, scrutinized, and quarreled about some unreasonable interface design, and also faced player experience problems caused by various server client crashes, and we also encountered a lot of setbacks, but the reason why we persevered was because the team were loyal players of SLG, and after watching all kinds of brain-opening excellent works on the market, some of them brought us new thinking and inspiration, but some did not really meet everyone's expectations for SLG games, and we have been thinking. What exactly do you expect from a truly fun SLG genre game? So we wanted to create a strategy game that went back to square one and dedicated to players who really like SLG and really wanted the real war theme in our hearts. Under comprehensive consideration, we chose the genre of Bandu Like to make everyone relatively familiar and easy to get started, and we added a lot of our own understanding and optimization on the basis of the core gameplay of this category (among which the hero can swallow the card of the same name from low-level to high-level is the highlight of our game design), hoping to get everyone's like. ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Since the game is in the early stage of development, there will inevitably be some bugs and deficiencies in the game, among which there are still deficiencies in combat, skill damage values and descriptions, which will be gradually optimized and adjusted in the later stage. But our team strives to give everyone the most authentic medieval period and is committed to restoring the trajectory of the Crusades, so all the original paintings and architectural models are made by looking for a lot of information and strictly checking them. We still need to continue to grow, and I sincerely thank you for your tolerance and understanding! At the same time, I look forward to talking to you to help us make the game better and create a better gaming experience for you. We hope you can give us some valuable advice, we will sort out and adjust the suggestions, and strive to embark on the journey with you as soon as possible. Finally, thank you for your great contribution in this crusade! May you fight bravely in the final battle, and move forward as Jerusalem watches over you.

rows.name: Bingo Pets - Save the Pets
rows.short_description: Embark on missions to save adorable pets while enjoying your favorite bingo games.
rows.description_html: Step into an enchanting realm where your love for bingo meets the joy of rescuing adorable pets. If the thrill of scoring 'Bingo!' sends a wave of excitement through you, and if your heart melts at the sight of cute animals, here's a game that impeccably marries your passions. Discover a whole new spin on the classic game of bingo as you delve into an immersive narrative rich with charming characters. In this unique gameplay experience, you're not merely playing rounds of bingo but embarking on a noble quest. The objective is to collect coins while you match your numbers. These aren't just ordinary coins; they hold the key to the freedom of your lovable pet companions. From bunnies and squirrels to sugar gliders and owls, each pet awaits your rescue. Fear not, as your trusted canine companion, aptly named BINGO, is right by your side to help you in your missions. Your pets are active contributors to the game. Their purpose goes beyond looking cute. Send them on missions to collect food for your furry squad, adding another dimension to the gameplay. Personalize your gaming experience with options to choose between 2-card or 4-card bingo. Adjust the call speed according to your comfort, and pick a Male or Female voiceover for the number calls. For a more relaxed experience, opt for the auto-daub feature and never worry about missing a bingo call. This game is much more than just a standard bingo app—it's an adventure where each match is a step closer to rescuing your cherished pets and experiencing the joy of a perfect bingo.

rows.name: Against Great Darkness Prologue
rows.short_description: Against Great Darkness Prologue is a brick-breaking, roguelite where you play as a pagan trying to escape Hell's maw. Trigger relics by keeping your disks bouncing, experience unique events where you can obtain incredible loot, and battle hellish bosses while always keeping an eye on your disks.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST NOW About the Game Against Great Darkness Prologue is a brick-breaker, bullet hell, roguelite. Choose your pagan deity and break free from the clutches of Lucifer. Juggle your disks to defeat your enemies as you progress through the circles of hell and confront relentless demonic bosses. In each run, acquire powerful relics that will assist you in your escape. Juggle the disks to unleash the power they hold and discover the synergies that will truly set you free. Choose between acquiring motes of light, purchasing items in the shop, receiving a much-needed heal, or risking it all with unique mystery events that can either reward or hinder your ascent. You may have gambled on a risky juggle that put you in harm's way and ended your run. Don't fret; the Radiant Shards you collect during your attempts can be used to empower your next run. FEATURES: 1 circle of hell to explore. 3 pagans to choose from. 2 Distinct demonic bosses. Each attempt out of hell is unique. Make choices over unique events to gain powerful relics. 100+ Items offer unique modifiers based on gameplay. Curses that really alter the way you play. Unlock new items on each run. Increase your chances by spending Radiant Shards gained on every run. Ascend through 9 progressively harder levels of difficulty.

These experiences summarise the diverse work produced by our students, during their project based classes while attending the Video Games degree.

These experiences summarise the diverse work produced by our students, during the different project based classes across the three years of their attendance of the Video Games undergraduate degree. rows.name: inFINIte Robotics
rows.short_description: inFINIte Robotics is a visual novel game that is set in a fantasy world filled with modern technology. The premise of the game is to find out the mystery of the world and learn about electronics by solving puzzles!
rows.description_html: Do you want to be an engineer? Do you ever dream of building a robot? Meet Niko an engineering student that always had that kind of thought, however, studying is hard and he hates it! One moment Niko gets hit by a truck and gets transported into the other world. It was a wonderful world blessed with magic, with that Niko tried to cast his first magic spell but nothing came out. It turns out he doesn’t have any magical power, even in this world he still feels powerless and useless... That is until a girl needs his help with fixing a robot?! Follow Niko's journey in this wonderful world of magic and robots where we can learn more about electronics! Around 3 Hours of Gameplay (20k words). Multiples Endings and Bad Ends 4 Cutscene/short animation 6 Minigame puzzle And learn more about basic electronics!

rows.name: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders - Bandit's Trail
rows.short_description: FREE PROLOGUE! Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders is an action-adventure RPG with base-building elements, where you take on the role of a classic hero who stands up to the tyranny and injustice that haunts Sherwood. Fight, craft, steal, and of course help the local people grow and prosper.
rows.description_html: Bandit's Trail is a FREE prologue version of Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders. Become the legendary outlaw of folk tales, explore Barnsdale, the first region of the game's world, and face its challenges. Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders is an action-adventure RPG with city-building elements, where you take on the role of a classic hero who stands up to the tyranny and injustice that haunts Sherwood. As Robin, you’ll fight, hunt, craft, steal, and of course help the local people thrive to spite the Sheriff of Nottingham and his ruthless regime – all within an open-world environment that can be freely explored. Robin Hood is a famous hero of medieval English folk tales, believed to have during that time roamed the forests of Sherwood with his band of loyal outlaw companions. In the game you’re going to meet those legendary characters as well, such as Lady Marian, Little John, Friar Tuck, Allan-a-Dale, and Will Scarlet. Robin's main goal is to help a fledgling community of refugees and rebels advance and expand. Starting with what could be described as a small forest settlement, with a bit of care, hard work, and good luck, it can end up as a town full of people. Recruit local peasants, rebels on the run from the law, and even the citizens and guards of Nottingham themselves as your new outlaw settlers. You start your adventure with building a forest camp, which can soon be expanded following the arrival of new residents. You will be responsible for properly managing the space you secured for yourself within Sherwood Forest to build up the village. Another important part of taking care of the settlement will be to manage the community members’ professions and tasks, training them to become craftsmen, hunters, or guards, and to manage the settlement’s resources, either gathering them yourself or stealing them from convoys and noble estates. As Robin's people grow large in number and strong in sword arm, an uprising in Nottingham may just become a reality, ending the Sheriff's tyranny once and for all. Can Robin Hood and his Merry Men survive and put an end to injustice? Their fate is up to you!

rows.name: Bungo's Bungite Collector
rows.short_description: Collect all of the rarest Bungites and level them up so you can show them off to your friends! Gather Bungcoin to get rarer Bungites, debate them, and watch their stats grow to infinity!
rows.description_html: Step into the Bungo universe and collect the rarest Bungites known to all beings. Collect rare and cool Bungites so you can show them off to your friends! Level them up and see how strong your Bungites can get! Every Bungite is unique to YOU. Every Bungite you collect has it's own unique generated stats so you and your friends can have the same Bungite that acts completely different! There are already almost a dozen stats in the game with dozens more to be added over time! Visit the Storng market and bet on Gorg fruit futures so that you can be the wealthiest Bungite Collector in the universe! Bungcoin are very valuable to a Bungite collector, allowing you to get the rarest Bungites! You can now debate your Bungites with random Bungites from across the universe in the disputation chamber! Watch them in a battle of wits and level up your favorite Bungite into a monster for all to witness!

rows.name: TIME HUNTERS: ミクイ黄金像の呪い
rows.short_description: Are you ready?! Make some noise (and some enemies) in this action-packed party shooter for 4! Utilize your unique energy shots, power-up your attacks with an array of pick-ups, and get set to take down the competition!!
rows.description_html: ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー This game was made by new-hires to Byking Inc. during an introductory training period. We ask for your understanding, for issues arising from certain operating environments, or for any flaws or inadequacies present in the final product. This game was made for local play, but supports online via Steam Remote Play Together. ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー *This title cannot be played using a keyboard or mouse* *Four controllers are required to play, and this title is for local play only* Are you ready?! Make some noise (and some enemies) in this action-packed party shooter for 4! Utilize your unique energy shots, power-up your attacks with an array of pick-ups, and get set to take down the competition!! 4 players enter the arena…but the Curse of the Golden Idol demands that only 1 may leave. …will it be you? 🔷A 4-Way Battle Royale Shooter Extravaganza!🔷 You get a gun, they get a gun. Everybody gets a gun! Shoot your way to victory and be the last Hunter standing! 🔷Watch Your Back Out There!🔷 Who to aim for and when to do it, careful consideration of your and your enemies’ resources could nab you victory…or see you lose it all! Can you make the right decisions under pressure? Only time will tell… 🔷The Golden Idol’s Curse! 🔷 ime Hunters are equipped with special guns…and special bullets. Bounce shots off walls to catch your foes off-guard! And oh, what’s this? The Golden Idol demands a good fight! Pick up glowing, Golden Idols scattered round the arena, and augment your shots with various buffs for maximum mayhem! ＞BOMB Shot＜ Penetrates walls and SHIELDs. Use it for explosive results! ＞BIG Shot＜ Size matters. Fire away and leave them with nowhere to run! ＞3-WAY Shot＜ A 3-WAY spreadshot. Never let them know your next move! ＞BOUNCE Shot＜ More BOUNCE, more mileage. Ricochets 3 times for off-the-wall fun! ＞SHIELD＜ Protect yourself from devastation...once! (Look out for BOMBs though!) 🔷Two Buffs are Better than One!!🔷 Does the power of the Golden Idol know no bounds!? (2, the bounds is 2) Grab 2 different buffs, and reap the benefits of both at once. One Hunter’s meat is another Hunter’s 3-WAY explosive BOMB Shot to the face, so pick your poison and start a-blastin’! The fabled BIG + BOMB Shot! The legendary 3-WAY + BOMB Shot! 🔷A Smart Hunter’s a Happy Hunter!🔷 Whoa okay trigger-happy, hold on. Shooting up the place will only get you so far! Keep track of your dash and remaining buff counts, and those of rival Hunters, for the greatest chance at success! Got all that? Alright. Now go catch ‘em with their pants down, and have a good Time Hunting!

rows.name: Game of Crafts: VR Immersion in the World of Russian Folk Art
rows.short_description: In your hands - a palette with dozens of patterns of Russian folk crafts! Discover their secrets with the magical bird Kika. Paint the world around under Gzhel or Khokhloma according to traditions or drop all the rules and form your own folk style to bring colors back to Kiki's house!
rows.description_html: Put on your virtual reality goggles and let your imagination run wild. Together with an AI named Kika, go from an apprentice to a real master of Russian folk crafts. Learn the secrets of ancient artists and save Kika by bringing colors and patterns back to her home. - Feel like an artist! Use VR controllers to select patterns and apply them to objects around you. - Do as you like! Change the size of patterns and choose how to combine them. Nobody prevents you from decorating Kiki's house with a mixture of Zhostovo and Gzhel bouquets. - Modernize traditions! Prove that folk crafts have not gone out of fashion. Paint a motorcycle under Khokhloma? Easily! Cover the sofa with Palekh miniatures? Why not! - Touch history! Find out together with Kika why Gzhel was not always blue and white, and how the Zhostovo and Tagil paintings are related. - Become an explorer! Explore the workshop and open secret niches to find new patterns. - Learn crafting skills! Assemble the painting blanks from the parts hidden all over the place, but make sure they fit together.

rows.name: Block, Love, and Ancient Greece
rows.short_description: A chaotic educational game set in ancient Greece!Become the fictional philosopher Epistemonos and defeat the scholars who stand in your way!Drag blocks to merge them and defeat the enemies.Immerse yourself in a topsy-turvy story set in ancient Greece, with a focus on the Acropolis.
rows.description_html: A chaotic and entertaining educational game set in ancient Greece! Become the fictional philosopher Epistemonos and get some knowledge by defeating the scholars who stand in your way! Drag letter blocks to merge them and defeat the enemies. Immerse yourself in a topsy-turvy story set in ancient Greece, with a focus on the Acropolis. Developed as a graduation project by the 'The Oath of the Peach Garden' team from Jeonju University's Game Contents Department, this game is designed to provide players with an easier approach to subjects like philosophy, which is weighty and serious atmosphere. Merge the blocks and defeat your enemies! As you drag and merge blocks with the same letter blocks, your character, Epistemonos, immediately attacks against the enemies. Help Epistemonos defeat all the enemies and regain the lost scrolls! Exciting virtual dialogues with scholars! Click on the 'Index' menu on the starting screen to see brief information about the scholars you have defeated and their thoughts. Engage in fictional conversations with eight of these scholars. Through repeated play, unlock the profiles of 17 scholars and make your study of philosophy more enjoyable! Merge blocks and achieve the highest score! In 'Free Mode,' you can merge blocks alone without any battles, accumulating scores with each merge. Strive to set a new high score and challenge yourself to surpass it!

rows.name: Joker Show - Horror Escape
rows.short_description: Your parents left for the night, and you stayed at home alone, you were bored and you decided to call the Jester (Joker), but something went wrong... It looks like you succeeded, now the jester wants to play with you, hide and don't let him catch you, find a way to call the jester away.
rows.description_html: Joker Show - Horror Escape - 3D FPS Hide&Seek Game Your parents left for the night, and you stayed at home alone, you were bored and you decided to call the Jester (Joker), but something went wrong... It looks like you succeeded, now the jester wants to play with you, hide and don't let him catch you, find a way to call the jester away. Description of the gameplay: You play as a teenager who is left alone at home and decides to try summoning spirits. Your task is to first find the necessary items for the ceremony, and follow the instructions to call the jester (joker). When you call the jester, he will trap you and lock you in the basement, try to find a way out and escape before the clock strikes 12, because at 12 o'clock at night, the jester will start a show where you will be the main participant! You have 5 hours to escape, or find a way to get rid of the jester, hide, run away, solve puzzles to find a way to escape. Features: Atmospheric graphics Interesting puzzles Excellent optimization

rows.name: Dreamscape Abyss
rows.short_description: Dreamscape Abyss is a game where you explore the ever-changing and surreal worlds inside of your dreams. Collect items to help you discover even more obscure areas as you delve deeper into your dream world.
rows.description_html: In Dreamscape Abyss, your only goal is to walk and explore your dream worlds. When you fall asleep, you will enter your dream world and you can explore as much as you like before continuing on. Discover new areas and search for unique items that you can use to help your delve deeper into your dreams. Unlike most other games, you will not find any action or heavy dialogue present. Similar to games like LSD Dream Emulator or Yume Nikki, your only goal will be to visit each dream world as you encounter them. Walk through and explore 20+ unique dream worlds found in the game. Collect various items for you to use to navigate to previously unvisited areas. Discover new locations by interacting with objects in the environment such as doors, statues, mushroom creatures, kappa, ghosts, and much more. Most dreams are encountered semi-randomly. The same object you've interacted with before might take you to a new location next time you find it. Wake up and return to reality if you want to exit a dream world at any time. There is a large variety of dreams that you may encounter while sleeping, but there will be no combat or threats to be found. Once you explore every dream, you will know what to do next...

Through the dungeon, the player can level up the unique skill trees for each enemy.

rows.name: Eggsplosion
rows.short_description: Eggsplosion is a free local multiplayer twin-stick arena brawler with fighting chickens, bouncing eggs, tons of power-ups and heaps of fun. Eggcellent for a fun evening with your friends!
rows.description_html: Eggsplosion allows up to 4 players to compete through both Steam Remote Play and local multiplayer. You can play from your computer, tablet, phone or even TV! So make sure to get your friends together and make them eggsplode! The game supports every major controller as well as (probably) almost all others! Use one of the many power-ups to spice up your gameplay! The various different items and combinations allow for fresh and exciting experiences every session! The game currently holds the following power-ups: Freeze Egg, freezes your opponents in place Bounce Egg, will accumulate damage for every bounce so get your angles right! Eggsplosive Egg, yeah this is the big one! Wall Dash, allows you to dash through walls Rapid Fire, removes the fire rate cap Speed Boost, makes you go fast brrrrrrrr Health Boost, will restore some of your health Competitive Mode Last one standing wins! In this mode all that counts is you surviving. Still, it might come in handy to eliminate your opponents while you're at it! Casual Mode Lean back and relax a bit! This mode allows you and your friends to customise the game to your liking. Choose a map, your favourite power-ups and decide on a winning condition. All that's left is having fun!

rows.name: Rune Seeker
rows.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a world created and destroyed by Runes.
rows.description_html: Rune Seeker is a strategy card game with a turn-based format. Each match’s terrain will be generated at random, so players will almost never encounter the same field twice throughout their journeys. We added depth and value to Rune Seeker by incorporating strategy and tactics into almost every action. Not only in the layout of the squad at the beginning of the game, but also in how you construct your squad, develop your base, and collect Runes. In essence, Runes are useless without Heroes and almost so without suitable Heroes. Each Unit has a unique *capacity* specification that determines how many Runes you can bring into the game. There are Heroes with weak attack specs but a large capacity for Runes, and vice versa. Moreover, each Unit will belong to different races and possess distinct skill sets that can be activated passively when it is their turn or actively by Runes. These Heroes are infinitely upgradeable, and their form, strength, abilities, and types evolve over time. Rune sets in Rune Seeker consist of two randomly generated and distinct components. Combinations of 100 times 100 pieces of such can generate up to 10,000 unique Runes. Therefore, players will rarely encounter players with Runes similar to theirs. Besides this factor, the value of Runes also depends on the game meta and their compatibility with player strategies, as opposed to rarity or power. The outcome of battle on the frontline is greatly influenced by what happens in the rear. This is where commanders can build a base system to upgrade and evolve their troops through appropriate utilization of resources.
